title: Equipment Uptime & Production Continuity Management
description:
Lead equipment reliability and availability to maximise production uptime, quality, and safety. Drive failure elimination through structured problem-solving and continuous improvement while developing maintenance team capability and stakeholder collaboration.

Roles & Responsibility

  • Lead end-to-end equipment availability and production support across all manufacturing shops.
  • Eliminate repeat failures and stabilise chronic problem areas impacting output.
  • Establish robust systems for incident logging, root cause analysis, and permanent countermeasure implementation.
  • Ensure production lines consistently achieve output, quality, and safety targets with minimum unplanned downtime.
  • Improve MTBF, reduce MTTR, and sustain zero-accident operations.
  • Drive effective stakeholder management across Production, ME, Quality, IT/OT, and OEM partners.
  • Develop technical capability, competency evaluation, and performance management of maintenance teams.
  • Define and execute the annual equipment availability improvement plan

Familiar with

  • Shop Floor Maintenance Strategy Development
  • General & Breakdown Maintenance Management

  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • People & Capability Management
  • Safety & Compliance
  • Cost & Resource Optimisation
  • Self-Management & Leadership Behaviour

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong leadership and team management capability.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Deep technical expertise in mechanical, electrical, PLC, robotics, and automation systems.
  • High proficiency in structured problem-solving and data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong understanding of TPM, lean manufacturing, and maintenance excellence frameworks.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/electrical/Electronics/Mechatronics Engineering (mandatory).
  • 15+ years of experience in Maintenance, including at least 3–5 years in leadership roles.
  • Strong experience across Weld Shop, Paint Shop, Assembly, Powertrain (minimum 2 essential).
  • Exposure in robots (KUKA, Yaskawa, Fanuc), PLCs (Allen Bradley, Mitsubishi, Siemens), Controls, Instrumentation, Machine tools
  • Knowledge of FMEA, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, SAP /CMMS tools, and preferred digital platforms.

title: Expert DevOps Engineer (Kotlin)
description:
Forma zatrudnienia: umowa o pracę

Lokalizacja: ul. Sokolska 34, Katowice lub ul. Puławska 2, Warszawa (2 dni w tygodniu pracujemy z biura)

Wynagrodzenie: 21 200 - 26 000 zł brutto



O zespole:


Zespół MPDBS odpowiada za rozwój, utrzymanie i dalszą transformację platformy, która pełni istotną rolę integracyjną pomiędzy systemami banku oraz rozwiązaniami grupy ING. Opiekujemy klientów wszystkich segmentów i przetwarzamy bardzo duże ilości danych. System wykorzystuje m.in. mikroserwisy, Kafkę oraz bazy Cassandra i PostgreSQL.



Twoje zadania:


  • rozwijasz i utrzymujesz środowiska produkcyjne i nieprodukcyjne
  • projektujesz, budujesz i utrzymujesz pipeline’y CI/CD dla aplikacji Java
  • migrujesz aplikacje do chmury GCP
  • automatyzujesz procesy z wykorzystaniem skryptów (głównie Bash) oraz narzędzi do zarządzania konfiguracją
  • wdrażasz i rozwijasz monitoring, alerting oraz mechanizmy bezpieczeństwa i kontroli dostępu dla obsługiwanych środowisk
  • uczestniczysz w planowaniu architektonicznym i wnosisz wkład w kształtowanie standardów banku



Nasze oczekiwania:


  • biegle programujesz w języku Kotlin
  • znasz ekosystem Java (Spring Boot, Maven/Gradle)
  • znasz rozwiązania Ci/CD, posiadasz doświadczenie w budowaniu i utrzymaniu pipeline’ów CI/CD (Azure DevOps lub równoważne)
  • płynnie poruszasz się wokół wzorców projektowych
  • masz doświadczenie z administracją serwerami opartymi o Linux
  • posiadasz doświadczenie z Google Cloud Platform, w szczególności z GKE, Cloud Storage, Artifact Registry oraz zarządzaniem środowiskami kontenerowymi
  • posiadasz doświadczenia z tworzeniem skalowalnych mikroserwisów
  • potrafisz programować zwracając uwagę na optymalizacje zasobów procesora i zużycia pamięci
  • masz praktyczną znajomość Kubernetes – deployment, polecenia kubectl, zarządzanie zasobami, troubleshooting
  • masz znajomość skryptowania w Bash na poziomie umożliwiającym samodzielną automatyzację zadań operacyjnych
  • znasz zagadnienia szyfrowania danych w oparciu o protokół SSL (generowanie certyfikatów, szyfrowanie ruchu)
  • posiadasz znajomość zagadnień bezpieczeństwa środowisk chmurowych: zarządzanie tożsamością, sieciami, szyfrowaniem
  • posiadasz umiejętność konfigurowania i utrzymania rozwiązań monitorowania (ELK, Grafana lub podobne)
  • komunikatywnie posługujesz się językiem angielskim (min. B1)



Mile widziane


  • doświadczenie z narzędziami do zarządzania konfiguracją środowisk, np. Ansible
  • znajomość SCALA
  • wiedza z zakresu Graal VM
  • wiedza z zakresu optymalizacji kosztowej środowisk chmurowych
  • znajomość SQL oraz doświadczenie z relacyjnymi bazami danych (np. PostgreSQL)
  • doświadczenie z pracą w sektorze finansowym lub regulowanym środowisku IT



To oferujemy:


  • Pracę w dojrzałym biznesowo i technologicznie ponad 1000-osobowym Pionie IT, w którym razem z nami będziesz tworzyć rozwiązania dla nowoczesnej bankowości
  • Kompleksowy rozwój kompetencji w zakresie wytwarzania oprogramowania, bezpieczeństwa IT, metodyki DevOps poprzez udział w projektach m.in. dotyczących migracji naszych środowisk i aplikacji do chmury publicznej
  • Dostęp do platform edukacyjnych m.in. Microsoft ESI, Udemy Business, eTutor oraz dofinansowanie niezbędnych szkoleń technicznych
  • Współpracę we wzajemnie uczących się społecznościach programistycznych, analitycznych, testerskich, Women in Tech, w tym pracę z mentorami i uczenie się na stażu towarzyszącym
  • Pakiet medyczny, ubezpieczenie na życie, platformę Mindgram, Pracowniczy Program Emerytalny i Program Profilaktyki Onkologicznej
  • Karty sportowe (Medicover Sport i Multisport) i kafeterię benefitową na punkty
  • Dodatkowe dni wolne
  • Program Poleceń Pracowniczych ze świadczeniem pieniężnym
  • Atrakcyjne konkursy z nagrodami i rabaty do wybranych sklepów

title: Senior Specialist, Operational Excellence and Digitalization
description:
Job Description Summary:

Position Summary

Support the deployment and sustainment of Operational Excellence across CPS Japan through management system implementation, productivity governance, capability development, digitalization and transformation initiatives. Manage assigned workstreams and collaborate with functional teams to embed standards, streamline processes and sustain improvements in daily operations


Key Responsibilities

Management System Deployment

  • Deploy OE frameworks, standards and management processes across functions.
  • Coordinate management reviews, action follow-up and escalation processes.
  • Work with functional teams and frontline employees to support implementation, assess adoption and address gaps.

Productivity Governance

  • Support annual productivity planning and target deployment.
  • Maintain the productivity initiative pipeline and coordinate progress reviews, reporting and risk escalation.
  • Track benefit realization and support validation with initiative owners and Finance.

Capability Development

  • Develop training materials and coordinate OE training programs, workshops and learning activities.
  • Support the practical application of OE methods and adoption of new ways of working.
  • Facilitate best-practice sharing and support OE Champion activities.

Transformation Execution

  • Manage assigned OE workstreams, coordinating implementation with functional owners and tracking progress against agreed deliverables.
  • Maintain implementation plans and monitor milestones, dependencies and risks.
  • Support site diagnostics, maturity assessments and follow-up on agreed improvement plans.

Process and Digital Enablement

  • Support business process standardization, simplification and workflow digitalization.
  • Maintain OE documentation, implementation tools and collaboration resources.
  • Coordinate user requirements and adoption activities with functional and digital teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Supply Chain or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of five years of relevant experience in a manufacturing environment, including operational excellence, continuous improvement, operations or project implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing cross-functional initiatives and supporting the sustained adoption of processes or standards.
  • Working knowledge of continuous improvement principles, structured problem solving and performance management.
  • Strong planning, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to manage assigned workstreams independently, resolve implementation issues and escalate risks appropriately.
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to interpret operational and financial information.
  • Business proficiency in Japanese and English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying management systems or supporting manufacturing transformation programs.
  • Familiarity with productivity governance and benefit realization.
  • Lean or Six Sigma certification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in a multinational organization.
  • Experience with workflow digitalization or process automation; familiarity with SQL, Python or Microsoft Power Platform is an advantage.

title: Jr. Facilitair Coordinator
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Over de functie

Als Junior Facility Coordinator ben jij het centrale aanspreekpunt voor facilitaire zaken binnen een of meerdere locaties. Je zorgt ervoor dat de dagelijkse operatie soepel verloopt en dat medewerkers en bezoekers kunnen werken in een prettige, veilige en goed onderhouden omgeving. Je coördineert proactief tussen verschillende disciplines en zorgt voor een optimale dienstverlening aan onze klant.

In deze rol ondersteun je de Facility Manager and Facility Coordinator bij de dagelijkse operationele activiteiten en krijg je de kans om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen het facilitaire vakgebied.

Wat ga je doen?

In jouw rol als Junior Facility Coordinator ben je verantwoordelijk voor een breed scala aan facilitaire taken:

  • Het coördineert en analyseren van meldingen in Corrigo en zorgen voor een adequate opvolging, inclusief het controleren of facilitaire meldingen daadwerkelijk zijn opgelost.
  • Het lopen van KPI-inspectierondes door de gebouwen en het zorgvuldig vastleggen van bevindingen, inclusief periodieke inspecties en het opvolgen van openstaande actiepunten.
  • Het coördineren en opvolgen van kleinere werkzaamheden van leveranciers, zoals reparaties aan koffiemachines, en het controleren van opgeleverd groenonderhoud.
  • Het registreren van actiepunten en deze uitwerken richting leveranciers.
  • Het beheren van en toezicht houden op NON-GMP leveranciers, waarbij je toeziet op de kwaliteit en de naleving van afspraken.
  • Het controleren van offertes op juistheid, volledigheid en prijsstelling, in afstemming met de Facility Coordinator.
  • Het opstellen van werkvergunningen in E-Permit to Work.
  • Het bijhouden van de kantoorartikelen en het voorbereiden van bestellingen na afstemming.
  • Het ondersteunen van facilitaire projecten en vragen van J&J en het assisteren van de handyman/facilitair medewerker, inclusief het klaarzetten en inrichten van vergaderruimtes wanneer dat nodig is.
  • Het ondersteunen van de servicedesk bij afwezigheid van de servicedeskmedewerker.
  • Locatie Breda valt binnen jouw scope. In geval van nood ben je beschikbaar om ondersteuning te bieden op deze locatie, bijvoorbeeld door in te vallen voor receptietaken of floorhost-activiteiten.
  • Het onderhouden van contact met eindgebruikers: je weet wat er speelt in het gebouw en begrijpt wat belangrijk is voor eindgebruikers, zodat je hier proactief op kunt inspelen.
  • Het opstellen van communicatiemails richting eindgebruikers.
  • Het overnemen van de taken van de Facility Coordinator tijdens diens verlof of afwezigheid.
  • Het waarborgen van de naleving van veiligheids- en arborichtlijnen, het coördineren van kleine verbouwingen en verhuizingen, en het actief aandragen van ideeën ter verbetering van de facilitaire dienstverlening.
  • Het ondersteunen van de implementatie van duurzaamheidsinitiatieven binnen de gebouwen.

Wat breng je mee?

Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde MBO+/HBO-opleiding, bij voorkeur in facility management of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt ten minste 1 jaar relevante werkervaring in een soortgelijke rol binnen facilitair management.

Ervaring met facilitaire software en MS Office is vereist. Je bent servicegericht, communicatief sterk en beschikt over een hands-on mentaliteit. Je kunt goed organiseren, prioriteiten stellen en nauwkeurig werken. Je bent proactief, oplossings- en klantgericht, en kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband goed functioneren.

Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal, in woord en geschrift.


About the role

As a Junior Facility Coordinator, you are the central point of contact for facility matters within one or more locations. You ensure that daily operations run smoothly and that employees and visitors can work in a pleasant, safe and well-maintained environment. You proactively coordinate between different disciplines and ensure optimal service delivery to our client.

In this role, you support the Facility Manager and Facility Coordinator with daily operational activities and have the opportunity to further develop yourself within the field of facility management.


What will you do?

In your role as Junior Facility Coordinator, you are responsible for a broad range of facility tasks:

  • Coordinating and analyzing notifications in Corrigo and ensuring adequate follow-up, including verifying that facility notifications have actually been resolved.
  • Conducting KPI inspection rounds through the buildings and carefully recording findings, including periodic inspections and following up on open action points.
  • Coordinating and following up on smaller supplier works, such as coffee machine repairs, and checking completed landscaping work.
  • Recording action points and working these out towards suppliers.
  • Managing and supervising NON-GMP suppliers, ensuring quality and compliance with agreements.
  • Checking quotes for accuracy, completeness and pricing, in coordination with the Facility Coordinator.
  • Preparing work permits in E-Permit to Work.
  • Keeping track of office supplies and preparing orders after consultation.
  • Supporting facility projects and queries from J&J and assisting the handyman/facility employee, including setting up and arranging meeting rooms when needed.
  • Supporting the service desk during absence of the service desk employee.
  • Location Breda falls within your scope. In case of emergencies, you are available to provide support at this location, for example by stepping in for reception duty/floorhost activities.
  • Maintaining contact with end users: you know what is happening in the building and understand what matters to end users, so you can anticipate accordingly.
  • Preparing communication emails towards end users.
  • Taking over the Facility Coordinator's tasks during leave or absence.
  • Ensuring compliance with safety and health & safety (arbo) guidelines, coordinating minor renovations and relocations, and actively contributing ideas for improving facility services.
  • Supporting the implementation of sustainability initiatives within the buildings.

What do you bring?

You have a minimum completed MBO+/HBO education, preferably in facility management or a comparable field. You have at least 1 year of relevant work experience in a similar role within facility management.

Experience with facility management software and MS Office is required. You are service-oriented, a strong communicator and have a hands-on mentality. You can organize well, set priorities and work accurately. You are proactive, solution- and customer-oriented, and can work independently while also functioning well in a team.

You have excellent command of both Dutch and English, verbally and in writing.

Location:

On-site –Leiden, NLD

Guest Service

  • Gain hands‑on experience with AWS, Terraform, Python and event-driven architectures
  • Combine deep technical work with training, coaching and mentoring

What You’ll Be Doing

title: Afdelingsleder til Projektudvikling og Kommunikation
location: Klamsagervej 19B, 1 tv, 8230 Åbyhøj, Denmark, 8230, Åbyhøj, Denmark
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for projektudvikling og strategisk kommunikation hos DGI Østjylland?

Vi har store ambitioner, og ambitioner kræver ledelseskraft. Derfor udvider vi vores ledelsesteam med en ny afdelingsleder for Projektudvikling og Kommunikation.

Kan du omsætte gode idéer til stærke projekter, skabe finansiering til nye indsatser og sætte strategisk retning for vores kommunikation? Og trives du med ledelse, relationer og samarbejde på tværs? Så er det dig, vi leder efter.

Du får ansvaret for at styrke vores projektudvikling og fondsarbejde og for at løfte kommunikationen som en endnu stærkere strategisk kapacitet i DGI Østjylland.

Jobbet

Du får ledelsesansvaret for fire medarbejdere tilknyttet tre aktive projekter og for vores kommunikationsteam, der består af to kommunikationsmedarbejdere og tre praktikanter årligt.

Og du er heldig. For du får et hold af dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, som brænder for deres fag og for at gøre en forskel. Din opgave er at sætte en tydelig retning og skabe rammerne for, at de kan lykkes. Du skal være tæt nok på til at kunne sparre, motivere og udvikle, men samtidig give plads, ansvar og tillid. Du skal sikre høj faglig kvalitet og skabe sammenhæng og samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.

Derfor leder vi efter dig, der både har ledelseserfaring og faglig tyngde inden for projektudvikling og kommunikation. Du skal ikke kunne eller gøre alting selv. Men du skal kunne lede forskellige fagligheder, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og sætte retning. Og når der er brug for det, skal du også være klar til selv at tage arbejdstøjet på.

Projektudvikling

Her får du både ansvaret for at sætte retning og for selv at være med til at skabe. Du skal kunne se muligheder, samle de rigtige mennesker og omsætte idéer og strategiske ambitioner til stærke projekter og fondsansøgninger.

Du skal blandt andet:

  • lede og udvikle større strategiske udviklingsprojekter og koordinere vores samlede projektportefølje
  • identificere nye projekt-, fonds- og partnerskabsmuligheder og gøre dem konkrete samt opbygge og udvikle stærke relationer til fonde og andre bevillingsgivere
  • selv skrive og kvalificere projektbeskrivelser og fondsansøgninger
  • sparre med og understøtte medarbejdere og projektledere i projektudvikling og projektstyring

Du har dokumenteret erfaring med projektudvikling, projektskrivning og fondssamarbejde og kan omsætte strategiske muligheder til projekter, der kan leve i virkeligheden.

Kommunikation

Kommunikation hos os handler om mere end synlighed. Vi vil tættere på medlemsforeningerne og vores samarbejdspartnere, og vi vil være en tydelig og troværdig stemme for foreningslivet og de stærke fællesskaber.

Du får det overordnede ansvar for kommunikationsområdet. En af dine første centrale opgaver bliver sammen med kommunikationsteamet at udvikle en ny kommunikationsstrategi, der omsætter ambitionerne i Strategi 2030 til tydelige valg, prioriteringer og handlinger.

Du skal blandt andet:

  • sætte retning for og udvikle DGI Østjyllands samlede kommunikationsindsats med afsæt i DGI's overordnede brand
  • styrke kendskabet til vores tilbud, kompetencer og værdier blandt medlemsforeninger og samarbejdspartnere
  • styrke vores pressearbejde, branding og digitale kommunikation, så DGI Østjylland positionerer sig som en endnu tydeligere og mere relevant samfundsaktør
  • være det naturlige bindeled mellem DGI Østjylland og DGI's nationale kommunikationsafdeling

Ledelse

Sammen med direktøren og tre andre afdelingsledere er du med til at sætte retning for hele organisationen og omsætte bestyrelsens beslutninger og Strategi 2030 til handling.

Vi har et stærkt og engageret ledelsesfællesskab. Vi udfordrer hinanden, hjælper hinanden og har et åbent og tillidsbaseret samarbejde. Vi er ambitiøse og tager vores fælles ansvar alvorligt, men heldigvis ikke altid os selv. Der skal også være plads til grin undervejs.

Du refererer til DGI Østjyllands direktør og får gode muligheder for at præge både dit eget område og organisationens videre udvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • har erfaring med personaleledelse, faglig ledelse, driftsledelse og strategisk ledelse
  • kender dansk foreningsliv og civilsamfund og gerne har indsigt i sammenhængen mellem idræt, sundhed og fællesskab
  • trives i en politisk ledet organisation og kan omsætte strategiske og politiske ambitioner til handling i samspil med bestyrelse, organisation og eksterne aktører
  • har en relevant videregående uddannelse og gerne en lederuddannelse

Og så det lidt mere personlige

Du leder med tillid, nysgerrighed og mod. Du lytter og involverer, men tør også sætte retning, træffe beslutninger og give ansvar og plads til andre.

Du er stærk i relationer og har blik for at skabe forbindelser både internt og eksternt. Du tager initiativ, ser muligheder og bringer mennesker sammen. Samtidig kommunikerer du klart og præcist, både mundtligt og skriftligt, og du formår at kombinere udviklingslyst med struktur, så gode idéer ikke bare bliver ved tanken, men bliver ført ud i livet.

Og hvis du samtidig bidrager med godt humør, er det bestemt ikke en ulempe.

Ingen kan alt. Men vi håber, at du kan genkende dig selv i det meste.

Hvem er vi?

I DGI Østjylland arbejder vi for mere idræt og bevægelse, stærkere idrætsforeninger og levende fællesskaber.

Vi dækker otte kommuner: Favrskov, Norddjurs, Odder, Randers, Samsø, Skanderborg, Syddjurs og Aarhus. Med 710 medlemsforeninger, 261.874 medlemmer og mere end 32.000 frivillige er vi Jyllands største idrætsorganisation.

Med DGI Østjyllands Strategi 2030 styrker vi vores rolle som aktiv samfundsaktør og udviklingspartner. Sammen med kommuner, fonde og andre aktører arbejder vi for bedre rammer for foreningslivet og for at bringe idrættens og fællesskabernes potentiale i spil inden for blandt andet sundhed, trivsel og lokalsamfundsudvikling.

Vi mener selv, at DGI Østjylland er blandt de bedste arbejdspladser i Danmark. Vi er omkring 40 engagerede kolleger, der både interesserer os for hinanden og udfordrer hinanden fagligt. Hver uge har vi en times betalt medarbejdermotion sammen, som giver både smil på læben og indimellem sved på panden. Det skal du glæde dig til.

Arbejdssted og arbejdstid

Din arbejdsplads er DGI Østjyllands kontor på Klamsagervej 19B, 1. sal, 8230 Åbyhøj.

Du ansættes uden øvre arbejdstid og skal være indstillet på, at noget af arbejdet ligger om aftenen og indimellem i weekenden.

Lønnen forhandles individuelt efter kvalifikationer. Og vi kan lige så godt være ærlige: DGI er ikke lønførende. Til gengæld mener vi, at vi har rigtig meget andet på hylderne, der gør jobbet værd at søge. For eksempel får du et fleksibelt arbejdsliv med netværk på tværs af DGI, fleksible arbejdstider, sundhedsforsikring, betalt internet og sociale arrangementer.

Praktisk

Ansøgningsfristen er 30. november 2026 kl. 23.59.

Vi forventer at gennemføre første samtalerunde 7. december og anden samtalerunde 11. december. Mellem de to samtaler udarbejdes en personlighedsprofil med et opfølgende interview med vores HR-afdeling. Du vil desuden få en opgave i forbindelse med samtaleforløbet.

Har du lyst til at læse mere om DGI Østjylland og vores Strategi 2030, kan du gøre det her.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte direktør Bjørn Ruben Skovsgaard på 27 59 55 15 eller afdelingsleder Jane Østergaard på 30 29 83 27. Send gerne en sms først, så finder vi et godt tidspunkt at tale sammen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Grants Officer  [Open to internal and external applicants]
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP has been working with national and international partners in the Philippines on the issue of the circular economy. UNDP is working with the European Union in implementing the EU Philippines Green Economy Programme (The Programme). The Programme has the purpose of supporting the Philippines’ transition towards a green economy, including circular economy, reducing waste and plastic, as well as increasing energy efficiency and renewable energy deployment to support climate change mitigation. The Programme acknowledges that the transition to circular economy will have other added benefits such as reduction of the use of energy and greenhouse gas emissions, improve biodiversity and natural capital, decreased pollution levels, and climate change adaptation.

The Programme addresses three main levels:

  • Establishing a Policy Dialogue Platform at the central government level to mobilize EU expertise to facilitate policy formulation, improve city-to-city collaboration through supporting the development of a National Circular Economy Strategy and Roadmap, extend the dialogue to promote renewable energy/energy efficiency, and to apply the dialogue’s outcomes;
  • Working with local government units (LGUs) where EU expertise will support to define and implement circular economy, climate change, and energy policies with a human rights and gender-responsive perspective, outreach and support of local business and civil society, and support less advanced LGUs;
  • Enhancing engagement of the private and financial sectors into the circular waste economy creating better conditions for private sector investment by supporting business-driven waste reduction strategies and circular solutions in the production process.

The Programme has 4 specific objectives:

SO1: Improved circular economy and climate change policies and reduced GHG emissions

SO2: Enhanced practices of the circular economy by the LGUs in collaboration with the private sector and civil society sector, with a focus on youth and gender equality

SO3: Enhanced engagement of the private and financial sectors in circular, waste-reduction economy

SO4: Increased energy efficiency and renewable energy deployment

UNDP is responsible for the implementation and execution of SO2 with the purpose of enhancing the capacities and practices of local government units (LGUs) on circular waste economy in collaboration with private and civil society organizations (CSOs), with focus on youth and gender equality.

Key results expected at the end of the Project include:

  • Reduced volume of waste generated and sent to landfills in partner LGUs
  • Greenhouse gas emissions reduced and avoided (tonnes of CO2eq) from reduced waste and implementation of circular economy initiatives
  • At least 20 LGUs have established circular economy models, including introduction of source separation and collection systems for wastes recycling, diversion, repurposing and other CE initiatives
  • Additional number of organizations applying CE and sustainable consumption and production practices in partner LGUs
  • Additional jobs (including green jobs) created across the circular economy value chain, disaggregated by gender and groups
  • At least 10 LGUs in which nationally defined green procurement criteria have been applied
  • About 15 LGUs that feed their NDC reporting with improved gender and youth sensitive data on co-benefits of CE

The Project shall be implemented in partnership with LGUs. A total of 20 Tier 1 LGUs will be supported directly, while 40 LGUs will be supported with targeted assistance on a demand-driven basis.

UNDP Philippines takes overall responsibility and accountability for the delivery of the project outputs. It will be accountable for managing the project, including the monitoring and evaluation of project interventions, achieving project results, and for the effective use of resources, in compliance with UNDP rules and regulations, policies and procedures. These include relevant requirements on fiduciary, procurement, environmental and social safeguards, and other performance standards.

The day-to-day implementation of the project will be led by a Project Manager within a Project Management Unit (PMU) responsible for ensuring that the project achieves the expected targets to the required quality standards and within the specified time and budget allocations. ​​The Project Manager will be supported by a Deputy Project Manager, Project Assistants, technical staff and a pool of contractors and consultants to carry out the deliverables of the project.

As part of key activities, the EU-GEPP SO2 Green LGUs project will provide grants in support for 1) CSO led CE initiatives with special attention to GEDSI groups and 2) CE education and awareness-raising activities for behavioral change.

Duties and Responsibilities

Under the guidance of the Project Manager, Deputy Project Manager, and the direct supervision of Management Specialist (planning), the Grants Officer(s) will be responsible for coordinating and managing the Grants Component of the EU-GEPP SO2 project in liaison with DILG, DENR, and EU.

The Grant Officer(s) will also work closely with all relevant stakeholders (i.e national and subnational government partners, other SO implementing partners, UNDP CO, etc.), in the identification, design and implementation of grant component activities for GEPP. The position will also require engagement, partnership building with national partners, including civil society and non-governmental organizations, women's organizations and networks, bilateral and multilateral donors, and private sector actors.

Co-Design and launch calls for grants

  • Assist in the design and prepare calls for grant proposals including target groups, selection criteria, evaluation committee, evaluation process and outreach strategies ensuring adherence with the UNDP rules, policies and procedures and contractual agreements with the EU;
  • Develop materials, including relevant templates related to the evaluation of applications and implementation of grants;
  • Design and deliver ideation and capacity-building workshops to foster innovative ideas from local innovators, CSOs, and introduce them to the EU-GEPP and grant schemes;
  • This may include but not limited to ideation, brainstorming sessions, writing workshops for grant proposals, and interactive group activities to share, question, and validate their ideas with one another;
  • Design and support launching events and communication outreach for the grant call, in collaboration with the Communication Specialist;
  • Facilitate the selection process in cooperation with the evaluation committee;
  • Ensure that workplans of each grantees are complete, coherent, and in full alignment for each specific LGU circular economy portfolios;
  • Conduct due diligence activities for each grantee before contracting stage;
  • Finalize grant agreements together with the procurement team;
  • Make announcements of successful applications via social media;
  • Ensure timely and effective monitoring and implementation of the awarded grants according to the performance indicators and the approved budget and work plans adhering to relevant EU and UNDP procedures;
  • Conduct meetings and monitoring activities in accordance with the grants playbook schedule;
  • Maintain and routinely update the online monitoring system for each grantee;
  • Review monthly financial reports including attachments and means of verification;
  • Review submitted narrative reports and distribute to relevant team members for comments and suggestions;
  • Update the risk log and identify mitigation measures;
  • Liaise with the relevant national and international stakeholders;
  • Lead logistical, financial and contractual-related work;
  • Ensure timely implementation and monitoring of the grants program.

Lead and coordinate capacity building initiatives

  • Assess the capacities of the grantees;
  • Organize training to grantees during implementation: planning and execution, proper record keeping, and reporting of results;
  • Design and deliver capacity-building initiatives to address their needs and gaps;
  • Ensure implementation and monitoring of capacity-building initiatives;
  • Coordinate with respective colleagues within UNDP to provide regular orientations and practical sessions on UNDP’s reporting requirements;
  • Ensure timely reporting from the grantees following UNDP reporting guidelines;
  • Ensure quality of work through technical review of the deliverables, spot checks and field visits, program and financial monitoring, identify implementation challenges and propose possible solutions.

Contribute to knowledge management and information sharing

  • Document best practices and lessons learned and assist in producing publicity materials on community-based planning, circular economy and other thematic areas in collaboration with the Communication Specialist;
  • Contributes to knowledge networks where applicable;
  • Preparing all reports and other deliverables of Grants Program and checking translations of them;
  • Proactively share information in the UNDP country office;
  • Preparation of grant program status reports to the Project Board, Inter agency Technical Working Group, Programme Steering Committee, EU DILG, DENR and UNDP.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Competencies

Core Competencies:

  • Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline
  • Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements
  • Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback
  • Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible
  • Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident
  • Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships
  • Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-functional and Technical competencies

title: Senior Software Engineer | Data Infrastructure | Rust
description:
About BlockTech

Wegens grote belangstelling verzoeken wij u snel te solliciteren als u een goede match bent voor deze functie.

BlockTech is a fast-paced algorithmic trading firm specializing in crypto options. We facilitate global cryptocurrency derivatives and spot trading while expanding into new markets. Every decision at BlockTech starts with data: exchange feeds, our own trade and account events, and the history we query to make sense of both. The Foundation team owns the systems that move, aggregate, and store all of it. We run our own Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and Iceberg, self-hosted and tuned by us. We work primarily in Rust, with Python and SQL alongside.


The Role

This is a role for an engineer who has already built and operated data infrastructure at scale, and who wants their technical decisions to set direction rather than follow it. You will own the pipelines and stores every other team depends on. When a researcher backtests a strategy, when a trader checks a position, when risk queries yesterday, they are all reading data your systems ingested, routed, and kept correct. As a senior engineer, you will also set the technical standards the rest of the team builds against.


Responsibilities

  • Own the ingest path. Collect public and private exchange information and internal trading data with minimal latency impact, and land it in our trading systems in real time.
  • Architect the streaming layer. Design and operate our Kafka and NATS messaging systems for the throughput and delivery guarantees our critical flows depend on.
  • Build the storage layer. Develop real-time aggregation and long-term storage across PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and Iceberg, and make the structural calls that keep queries fast as volumes grow.
  • Run what you build. Own capacity, retention, schema evolution, and failure behavior for infrastructure we host ourselves, with no managed service to hide behind.
  • Make the data trustworthy. Design the detection and repair flows that catch gaps, duplicates, and drift, and correct them before anyone downstream notices.
  • Enable other teams. Work with trading, quantitative research, and engineering to make integrating with our platform straightforward, and turn recurring problems into shared libraries and frameworks.
  • Drive projects end to end. Take work from concept to production with full ownership, and bring in new tools and approaches when the current ones stop being the right answer.
  • Raise the bar. Mentor engineers, lead by example in code and design reviews, and influence the technical direction of the wider team.

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a software engineer, including a track record of designing and operating production data infrastructure where reliability and correctness are non-negotiable.
  • Proficiency in Rust, or strong C/C++ with the appetite to work primarily in Rust.
  • Hands-on experience with the infrastructure we rely on: Kafka, Redpanda, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and/or Iceberg. Ideally self-hosted rather than through managed or cloud services.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, with the judgment to reason about consistency, backpressure, and failure modes.
  • Systems-level thinking, including a feel for where hardware constraints start to matter.
  • A very strong sense of end-to-end ownership, and a critical mind that follows problems through to completion.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to Have

  • A background in trading, fintech, or another domain where bad data has immediate consequences.
  • Experience with observability tooling such as Grafana.
  • Familiarity with WebSockets, compiler engineering, or systems security.

How We Work

This is an on-site role in our Amsterdam office, built around a high degree of autonomy and end-to-end ownership. You will have hard problems to own from concept through to production, and the freedom to solve them your way. It is a strong fit for people who are energized by deep technical challenges, a wide variety of technologies, and a high level of responsibility.


Benefits

  • A full-time position in a relaxed and modern office in Amsterdam
  • Competitive compensation consisting of a base salary combined with a very attractive bonus plan based on individual and company performance
  • Outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund
  • Pension plan, company laptop, and reimbursement of your internet costs at home
  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget
  • The opportunity to work at the forefront of automated trading using technology built for speed and precision, in an environment that embraces AI to both accelerate productivity and advance our systems and models
  • Gym membership reimbursement and the opportunity to engage in various sports during working hours, including kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer
  • Regular social events, including weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and bi-annual trips abroad
  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks throughout the day
  • For internationals: an all-in relocation package and Dutch classes

Our Culture

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals. In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities. We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. xgiwjmb Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

title: Sporskifte
description:
Merit/sporskifte studerende til Børnehuset Gravhunden

I det pædagogiske arbejde lægger vi vægt på målrettede pædagogiske indsatser med engagerede og nærværende voksne. I vores tilgang til børnene prioriteres anerkendelse og medbestemmelse, som for os betyder af omsorg og hensyn til det enkelte barns læring og udvikling. Dette, sammenholdt med at have fokus på at gribe børnenes initiativer, have aktiviteter og projekter, være aktive og understøttende i børnenes leg og have øje for samspillet, danner fundamentet for vores pædagogiske praksis.

Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper som

  • Er nysgerrig på hverdagslivet og det pædagogiske arbejde med de 1-2 ½ årige børn i vuggestuen
  • Vægter udelivet og er med på at være ude i al slags vejr.
  • Der i et teamsamarbejde kan medvirke til at skabe tryghed, nærvær og stabilitet i børnehøjde.
  • Er indstillet på at lære og blive guidet af pædagogerne ift. det daglige pædagogiske arbejde.
  • Har lyst til medindflydelse på hverdagen, er ansvarlig, initiativrig og kan holde overblikket i aktiviteter, rutiner og samvær med børnene.
  • Har masser af energi samt en positiv og anerkendende kommunikationsform og tilgang til hverdagens muligheder og udfordringer.

Vi kan tilbyde

  • Faglige og pædagogiske debatter som en del af værdigrundlaget.
  • At vi kontinuerligt arbejder med udviklingen af et tæt samarbejde på tværs, som er med til at sikre gode overgange fra vuggestue til minibørnehave og videre i udflytterbørnehave.
  • Vi har fokus på læreprocesser og udbyttet for børnene i både aktiviteter, rutiner og leg. Som dokumentation og evalueringsmetoder anvender vi skriftlighed og billeder.
  • Vi har et værdigrundlag hvor ansvar, åbenhed, omsorg og humor er en del af det at gå på arbejde.
  • Med et godt forældresamarbejde med en engageret forældregruppe.
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Fysiske rammer:
Børnehuset Gravhunden er en kombineret 0-6 års institution med 3 vuggestuegrupper og 2 minibørnehavegrupper i huset på Frederiksberg, samt 2 børnehavegrupper i vores udflytterbørnehave, som ligger i Værløse.

Er du den pædagogmedhjælper, der gerne vil arbejde i vores hus og medvirke til en pædagogik, hvor relationer og samspil er i fokus, så send straks en ansøgning via nedenstående link.

Vi holder løbende samtaler.



Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden.
Vi er en moderne kommune, der betjener 104.305 borgere. Frederiksberg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, handicap, race, hudfarve, religion eller tro, politisk anskuelse, seksuel orientering, kønsidentitet, kønsudtryk eller kønskarakteristika eller national, social eller etnisk oprindelse.

10th of Ramadan – Cairo.

As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

title: Data engineer - datawarehouse
description:
Over de functie

In het kort: Je gaat als data engineer het datawarehouse voorbereiden op migratie, nieuwe databronnen ontsluiten, laadprocessen optimaliseren en datakwaliteit, herkomst, lineage en metadata borgen in een SQL Server en Power BI omgeving.


Maximaliseer uw kans op een succesvolle sollicitatie door ervoor te zorgen dat uw cv en vaardigheden goed aansluiten.
Opdrachtgever

In 10 jaar tijd is de Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie uitgegroeid naar een organisatie met ruim 1700 medewerkers en bijna 600 panden die worden schoongemaakt. Panden van de Rijksoverheid, Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer en Raad van State. Onze focus ligt de komende periode op de doorontwikkeling van de (interne) processen en de organisatiestructuur, zodat we toekomstbestendig en stabiel blijven. Voor het datawarehouse en de BI omgeving geldt dat we beheer gaan uitbesteden aan een interne afdeling binnen ons ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid. Het ontstaan van de RSO komt voort uit het besluit om de schoonmaakdiensten van de rijksgebouwen in eigen beheer uit te voeren. Het rijk wil als werkgever het goede voorbeeld geven door medewerkers in lagere loonschalen zelf ook in dienst te nemen. De Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie (RSO) is de schoonmaakdienstverlener van en voor de Rijksoverheid. Samen met andere dienstverleners zetten we ons dagelijks in voor een schone, gezonde en prettige werkplek voor de collega's binnen het Rijk. We doen dit vakkundig, klantgericht, betrouwbaar en kostenbewust. Om kwaliteit te kunnen bieden, houden we rekening met de beleving die mensen hebben van hun werkomgeving. Resultaten bereiken we door heldere communicatie met de opdrachtgevers, een collegiale samenwerking tussen onze schoonmaakteams, collega's en partners binnen het Rijk én transparantie over onze dienstverlening. De RSO staat voor een duurzame, doelmatige en respectvolle inzet van mensen, materialen en middelen. Het vakmanschap van onze medewerkers vormt de basis van onze dienstverlening en binnen de organisatie hebben zij de ruimte om zich hierin verder te ontwikkelen. Als werkgever biedt de RSO elke medewerker een goede, gezonde en plezierige baan. De RSO is gepositioneerd onder de plaatsvervangend secretaris-generaal (pSG) van SZW, die eindverantwoordelijk is voor het functioneren van de RSO. De staf van de RSO is gevestigd in Den Haag, de operationele uitvoering van de werkzaamheden vindt plaats door het hele land. De RSO wordt aangestuurd door de Directeur, ondersteunt door het Hoofd Operatie en het Hoofd Bedrijfsvoering & Bestuursondersteuning.

Opdracht

Je gaat werken aan een migratieproject in een datawarehouse (SQL Server) en Power BI on-premise rapportageomgeving. Het datawarehouse (SQL Server) van de Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie (RSO) wordt begin 2027 naar de Directie Samenwerkingsverbanden en Uitvoering (DSU) gemigreerd. Voorafgaand aan deze migratie staat de ontsluiting van een nieuwe bron gepland: het vervangen van een bestaande bron door een nieuwe bron gebaseerd op een low-code platform (Mendix). Als Data Engineer zorg je dat alle gegevens uit de oude bron op de juiste plek in de nieuwe bron terechtkomen en dat in de rapportagebehoefte kan blijven worden voorzien. Je borgt de kwaliteit van de data en legt herkomst, lineage en beschrijvingen (metadata) goed vast.

Werkzaamheden
  • Voorbereiden en klaarzetten van het huidige datawarehouse en bijbehorende laadprocessen.
  • Ontsluiten van een nieuwe bron (CSV-bestanden).
  • Afronden van laatste wensen rondom laadprocessen ten behoeve van bestaande rapportages, in samenwerking met business analist en medewerker reporting van RSO.
  • Uitvoeren van de migratie van het RSO-DWH naar DSU, in samenwerking met DSU.
  • Borgen van datakwaliteit en vastleggen van dataherkomst, -lineage en -metadata.
Context en samenwerking

De werkzaamheden vinden plaats in een team. De data engineer is voornamelijk verantwoordelijk voor het back-end gedeelte van het datawarehouse. Het team werkt agile/scrum. Werkzaamheden vinden plaats in Den Haag; werken op afstand is mogelijk, maar bij voorkeur op kantoor (zeker tijdens de inwerkfase).

Gezocht profiel

Wij zoeken niet alleen een ontwikkelaar die werkzaamheden uitvoert, maar een professional die initiatief neemt, eigenaarschap toont en actief meedenkt over technische verbeteringen. Daarnaast kan de kandidaat snel de materie doorgronden en dit vertalen naar werkende oplossingen.

Praktische zaken

Werkzaamheden vinden plaats in Den Haag; werken op afstand is mogelijk, bij voorkeur op kantoor (zeker tijdens de inwerkfase). Het team werkt agile/scrum.

Wat maakt deze opdracht interessant?

De RSO en DSU starten met een mooie samenwerking binnen SZW. Met deze opdracht krijg je zicht op beide organisaties en werk je in een team met goede energie en een pragmatische manier van samenwerken.

Over De Klant

Het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) werkt aan een sociaal en economisch krachtig Nederland in Europa, met werk en bestaanszekerheid voor iedereen. De bewindslieden zijn onder meer verantwoordelijk voor het arbeidsmarktbeleid, inclusief migratie en vrij verkeer van werknemers, uitkeringen en re-integratie, inkomensbeleid, het combineren van arbeid en zorg, arbeidsomstandighedenbeleid en inspectie daarop. Er werken ongeveer 2200 medewerkers bij het ministerie van SZW.

Eisen
  • Dienstverband: Detachering
  • CV aanleveren in Word (Let op! maximaal 7 pagina's)
  • Motiveer waarom jij aan de eisen voldoet
  • Puntsgewijze argumentatie voor zowel wensen als eisen
  • Geen prijs vermelden in het CV
  • CV zonder foto en adres, wel met woonplaats aanleveren
  • Geen geboortedatum
  • Geen persoonsgegevens alleen voor- & achternaam + woonplaats
  • Kandidaat beschikt over minimaal Hbo werk- en denkniveau.
  • Kandidaat beschikt over aantoonbare kennis van VBA, SQL Server, SSIS Packages en C#.
  • Kandidaat beschikt over minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als datawarehouse back-end developer.
Wensen
  • Mate waarin kandidaat beschikt over kennis van VBA, SQL Server, SSIS Packages en C#.
  • Mate welke de kandidaat ervaring heeft met migratietrajecten.
  • Mate waarin kandidaat beschikt over gevraagde competenties en vaardigheden, waaronder het op constructieve wijze samenwerken en relaties opbouwen en onderhouden.
Competenties
  • Initiatief nemen en eigenaarschap tonen.
  • Proactieve houding, vragen stellen en knelpunten signaleren.
  • Snel de materie doorgronden en vertalen naar werkende oplossingen.
  • Actief meedenken over technische verbeteringen.
  • Samenwerken binnen een team en constructieve relaties opbouwen.
Overige informatie

Optie tot verlenging: Onbekend

Gespreksdatum: Onbekend

Dienstverband: Detachering

Over de opdrachtgever

De Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie (RSO) is de schoonmaakdienst van en voor de Rijksoverheid. De organisatie zorgt ervoor dat rijksgebouwen schoon, netjes en verzorgd blijven. Hierbij kun je denken aan kantoren, rechtbanken en andere panden die door de overheid worden gebruikt. De schoonmakers van de RSO zijn in dienst van de overheid en dragen bij aan een prettige en gezonde werkomgeving voor medewerkers en bezoekers. Met aandacht voor hygiëne en gastvrijheid zorgt de Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie ervoor dat de gebouwen waarin de overheid werkt, goed onderhouden en representatief zijn. Zo ondersteunt de RSO het dagelijks functioneren van de overheid.

De sluitingsdatum van deze opdracht is de harde deadline van onze opdrachtgever.

  • Om je krachtig voor te kunnen dragen hebben wij minimaal één werkdag nodig om samen met jou alle bescheiden in orde te maken.
  • Naast een actueel en op de opdracht gericht CV zullen wij altijd vragen om een bondige persoonlijke motivatiebrief (inclusief een toelichting per functie-eis en -wens) en een indicatief uurtarief/maandloon.

Op basis van deze informatie kunnen wij voor je aan de slag! xgiwjmb We nemen contact met je op om alle verdere details goed door te nemen en duidelijke afspraken met je te maken.

title: Project Manager, D&B
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Position Overview

The Design & Build Project Manager is responsible for coordinating and managing the entire project lifecycle from design through construction completion, serving as the core link between design and construction while coordinating the interests of all parties. This position requires comprehensive technical knowledge, management capabilities, and communication skills, making it one of the most challenging and important roles in the construction engineering industry.

Key Responsibilities

1. Critical Presentations and Communication

Lead project presentations at all stages, including introducing project objectives, scope, schedule, and organizational structure to the team and client at project initiation; presenting conceptual and detailed design proposals during the design phase to obtain client approval; conducting regular progress reports on construction progress, issues, and solutions; delivering milestone reports at critical junctures (such as structural topping out and MEP completion); and presenting project deliverables, conducting handover, and providing project summaries at completion.

2. Project Management and Coordination

Responsible for overall project planning, execution, and monitoring to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to quality standards. Coordinate work among design teams, construction teams, consultants, and subcontractors to ensure effective communication and collaboration among all parties.

3. Design Phase Management

Supervise the progress and quality of architectural, structural, MEP, and other design work within the design team, ensuring design solutions meet client requirements, regulatory requirements, and budget constraints. Review design drawings and technical specifications, and coordinate the design change process.

4. Construction Phase Management

Supervise on-site construction progress, quality, and safety within the construction team, conducting regular site inspections. Manage client vendors, construction teams, and subcontractors, resolving technical issues and conflicts during construction. Ensure construction complies with design drawings and relevant specification standards.

5. Financial and Contract Management

Collaborate with design and construction teams to discuss strategies for preparing and controlling project budgets, reviewing and approving change orders and payment applications. Manage contractual relationships with owners, design consultants, and contractors, handling claims and disputes.

6. Risk Management and Reporting

Identify project risks and develop response strategies, providing regular project progress reports to senior management and clients. Ensure projects comply with health, safety, and environmental regulatory requirements.

Main Specification:

1. Educational Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, MEP Engineering, or related field. Master's degree or professional certifications (such as PMP, PRINCE2) are advantageous.

2. Work Experience

Typically requires 5-10 years or more of construction or engineering project management experience, including at least 3-5 years in a project manager or similar position. Proven experience managing Design & Build projects. Familiarity with commercial buildings, office buildings, industrial facilities, or residential development projects.

3. Professional Skills and Knowledge

In-depth understanding of architectural design and construction processes, building codes, and regulatory requirements. Proficient in project management methodologies and tools (such as MS Project, Primavera). Capable of budget preparation, cost control, and financial management. Understanding of interior fit-out contract forms.

4. Skills

Excellent leadership and team management abilities, capable of motivating and coordinating diverse teams. Outstanding communication and negotiation skills, able to interact effectively with clients, consultants, and contractors. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, capable of making timely decisions under pressure. Good organizational and time management skills.

5. Other Requirements

Depending on project nature, may require relevant professional licenses or registered qualifications. Willingness to travel and work on construction sites. Good English proficiency (or other relevant languages).

description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

This is an exciting, high-impact opportunity for people and project-minded leaders.

The Director, Global Tax Operations is a senior position overseeing key teams in RBC Wealth Management Canada Operations. This role works in close partnership with RBC Wealth Management and Capital Markets business lines, as well as with colleagues across the organization to support client and regulatory reporting, as well as critical duties within Operations.

Under the Global Tax Operations mandate, this role is accountable for global tax and information reporting under Qualified Intermediary (QI), Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), and Common Reporting Standard (CRS) regimes, inclusive of regulatory oversight, withholding, reporting, and ongoing compliance. The successful incumbent must be able to dissect complex tax regulations, simplify requirements for a wide audience, and demonstrate leadership in global tax as well as bold tenacity to drive positive industry changes to evolving regulations. Additionally the successful incumbent must have excellent intrapersonal skills to lead a team with diverse mandates, demonstrating a sound understanding of Operations, and ability to exercise high-stakes decision-making and prioritization.

What will you do?

Operations Leadership

  • Coach, mentor, and lead diverse teams of subject matter experts, focusing on employee enablement and operational sustainability.

  • Champion employee engagement and well-being, driving a culture of trust, inclusivity, and continuous improvement.

  • Be comfortable with uncertainty and new technology, guiding large teams to adapt quickly to evolving business, risk, and regulatory requirements.

  • Collaborate with employees across all levels to understand our needs and strategically prioritize resources and development.

  • Oversee budgets and forecasting, demonstrating responsible cost control for ongoing maintenance and new application development.

Business Partnership

  • Communicate often and effectively, simplifying complex concepts for a wide audience including senior executives and business leaders.

  • Promptly and proactively action risks and decisions impacting our business, working closely with Operations, enterprise stakeholders, and business partners to identify challenges and opportunities, and influence direction.

  • Develop a network of internal and external partners to assess best practices and provide expert direction on industry trends and upcoming challenges.

  • Anticipate business needs for operational support, planning and advocating well in advance to minimize impact to Operations, our business, and our clients.

  • Challenge effectively to protect our business and advocate ferociously for continual improvement.

Regulatory Oversight

  • Oversee QI, FATCA, and CRS reporting and compliance, communicating effectively with regulators and industry partners on behalf of the business lines we support, and acting as the escalation point for business inquiries around global tax compliance.

  • Be accountable for RBC’s adherence to regulator (CIRO, CRA, IRS, etc.) and business requirements for client reporting, such as for tax slips, and more.

  • Continually enhance the effectiveness of operational controls and QI, FATCA, and CRS compliance frameworks, working closely with stakeholders across the bank.

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in an Operations, Tax, Regulatory, and/or Finance role.

  • Demonstrated subject experience in QI/FATCA/CRS and ability to digest complex issues quickly.

  • Excellent storytelling, written, and oral presentation skills with comfort engaging large audiences.

  • High professional maturity and emotional intelligence, with excellent interpersonal skills connecting with people across a wide variety of seniority and backgrounds.

  • Ability to actively listen, respectfully challenge, negotiate, and influence outcomes.

  • Ability to think holistically and creatively to grasp broader issues and opportunities.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

  • Opportunities to do challenging work

title: Business Engagement Manager
description:
Job Title: Business Engagement Manager

Location(s): Berlin, Germany

Application Deadline: 16/11/2026

About Springer Nature

Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 175 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities and today, more than ever, we see it as our responsibility to ensure that fundamental knowledge can be found, verified, understood and used by our communities – enabling them to improve outcomes, make progress, and benefit the generations that follow.

About Us

We collaborate on and guide the technology strategy to ensure technologies, data and business capabilities work together smoothly across the complex ecosystem of SN.

We help teams make smart technology & investment decisions, improve efficiency, and stay aligned with company goals for long-term success.


About the Role

As a Business Engagement Manager in the Portfolio & Governance Office in our Springer Nature Technology group (CIO), you will be the expert on the business area you support, its priorities, challenges and opportunities. For any Digital Product Development needs in the business areas, you will work in lockstep with our Product Management group under the Chief Product Office, taking alignment with the Digital Product Strategy as your starting point. Acting as the strategic connector, you will then orchestrate the right people from across Technology teams to the table to kickstart portfolio and project planning, and to inform decision-making in our core Portfolio Governance bodies. You will remove friction and drive efficiency and effectiveness in cross-functional collaboration, and help business areas and product managers shape their strategies and ensure their portfolios are compliant with key policies, regulations and standards, both externally and internally. By spotting and interpreting emerging business trends, you will also help inform and evolve our Technology strategy, ensuring that what we deliver is always relevant, impactful and forward-looking.


About your Business Partners – Publishing, Group General Counsel and PPS
For the Publishing, Group General Counsel, and Products, Platforms & Solutions (PPS) functions, you will serve as a strategic Technology partner and trusted advisor, building a deep understanding of their business priorities, operating models, products, platforms, and regulatory obligations. You will work closely with senior leaders to align technology strategy, digital product development, data capabilities, governance, and operational priorities, ensuring that Technology investments deliver measurable business value and support long-term strategic objectives. Acting as the bridge between business, Product Management, and Technology teams, you will identify opportunities to strengthen end-to-end customer and colleague experiences, improve operational effectiveness, enable AI and data-driven innovation, and embed governance, risk, and compliance considerations from the outset. Through proactive engagement, you will help shape future-ready capabilities across publishing, legal, and technology-led business domains, while ensuring insights from these functions influence both portfolio decisions and the wider Technology strategy.

Role Responsibilities:


Strategic Partnership & Business Alignment

  • Serve as the primary Technology partner for your designated business areas, acting as a strategic tech advisor and catalyst for value creation.
  • Build a deep understanding of publishing processes, legal and compliance requirements, product and platform strategies, and the broader business landscape to provide informed strategic guidance and challenge constructively where appropriate.
  • Work in close partnership with Product Management, Data, Architecture, Engineering and Business leaders to align business priorities, product strategy, technology roadmaps and investment decisions.
  • Champion end-to-end thinking across business capabilities and Technology’s value proposition while ensuring all initiatives meet Enterprise Architecture, Governance and Compliance standards.
  • Champion Future of Work transformation, driving the adoption of AI, automation and other emerging technologies to reimagine processes, elevate productivity and future-proof business functions.
  • Lead strategic planning to strengthen end-to-end thinking across business capabilities, technology capabilities, and data strategy, ensuring close alignment and co-creation with both Technology, Data and business teams.
  • Promote Technology’s value proposition while ensuring all initiatives meet enterprise architecture, governance, and compliance standards.

Demand Shaping & Portfolio Alignment

  • Align business, product and system demand within established portfolio, architecture, and governance processes.
  • Collaborate with IT Portfolio Management, Enterprise Architecture, Governance and the Global Business Systems team to ensure seamless management across the full portfolio lifecycle.
  • Provide data-driven insights and strategic recommendations to strengthen corporate planning cycles, investment decisions and business transformation roadmaps.

Governance & Compliance Leadership

  • Proactively embed governance, risk, privacy, security and compliance considerations into initiatives from the earliest stages to enable sustainable and scalable delivery.
  • Partner with IT Governance, Security and Architecture to maintain compliance, manage risk and ensure alignment with corporate standards and policies.

Relationship Management & Influence

  • Build and sustain trusted, senior-level relationships across Business, Product Management and Technology functions.
  • Act as the bridge and translator between non-technical and technical teams, ensuring clarity, alignment and shared purpose.
  • Be the voice of the business within Technology , and of Technology within the Business.

Innovation & Future of Work

  • Partner with Finance leadership and Technology teams to identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, automation and AI to streamline workflows, be more efficient and enable faster, smarter decision-making.
  • In collaboration with our Tech teams advise on emerging technologies that will modernise business operations and make the function future-proof, including intelligent process automation, self-service analytics, and advanced planning platforms.
  • Act as a connector between business needs and the Competence Centre for AI, Data & Analytics to ensure Business teams can leverage cutting-edge capabilities and have future-ready data management.
  • Champion a culture of Future of Work innovation, encouraging adoption of new tools and approaches that improve productivity, compliance and customer experience.

Capability Development & Change Enablement

  • Champion strategic change initiatives that position Technology as a driver of business transformation.
  • Strengthen the Business Engagement Manager discipline by standardising approaches, sharing best practices and uplifting capability maturity.
  • Foster a culture of transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement that to accelerate outcomes and deliver on our promise of being a reliable and trusted partner

About You

Your Experience:

  • 10+ years in IT and strong experience in strategy or business relationship management, ideally in global, matrixed organisations.
  • Experience working with or supporting publishing businesses, digital products, platforms, content workflows, legal and compliance functions, or other knowledge-intensive business domains is highly desirable.
  • A strong understanding of how technology enables business value, governance, customer outcomes and operational excellence is more important than deep technical specialisation.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and guide strategy-aligned Technology decisions without direct solutioning or delivery ownership
  • Strong understanding of corporate structures, the complexity of a global IT operating model and how to navigate them effectively.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders to shape and cascade strategy in complex, cross-functional environments.

Your Qualifications

  • Brings business acumen and a strategic mindset, translating business goals into Technology opportunities that deliver long-term value.
  • Builds trusted relationships at all levels, using influence, credibility and emotional intelligence to drive alignment.
  • Communicates complex Technology topics clearly, tailoring messages for both business and technical audiences.
  • Drives strategic change and continuous improvement, constructively challenging the status quo to elevate Technology’s impact.
  • Navigates complexity and ambiguity with composure, balancing competing priorities without relying on formal authority.
  • Anticipates emerging business needs and market shifts, positioning Technology as a proactive, forward-looking partner.
  • Breaks down silos and fosters cross-functional collaboration, aligning diverse teams around shared outcomes.
  • Acts as a curious, proactive self-starter, spotting opportunities and driving innovation and value delivery.
  • Facilitates strategic dialogue between business stakeholders and Technology teams to align on priorities and trade-offs.
  • Uses data, insight, and structured frameworks to guide decisions, influence outcomes, and secure consensus.
  • Handles difficult conversations and escalations with confidence, empathy, and diplomacy - protecting relationships while staying aligned to strategic priorities.

What You Will Be Doing

  • In your first six months: Build a deep understanding of your business areas, forge trusted relationships, align closely with Product Management and the various Technology teams, and shape a clear engagement plan that connects business priorities, Technology strategy, and governance.
  • Day-to-day: Act as a strategic connector, translating business goals into Technology roadmaps, driving alignment across teams, resolving engagement challenges, and championing automation, AI, and data-driven innovation to modernise and future-proof your business partners’ functions.

Having a good command of English is important; collaboration is important in our day to day work, so being able to communicate your ideas and understand others’ is key.

For all roles in all locations, we offer a competitive, industry-benchmarked salary.

To find out more about the package provided at each location, please visit:

At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodations.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Milton Keynes | Hybrid, 2 days in the office | £60,000 to £65,000

A senior engineering role at a global data and AI consultancy, joining a small UK team just as a new Snowflake project gets going. You’d be the one shaping the build, guiding the engineers around you and earning the client’s trust.

Why this one’s different

  • A new Snowflake project to lead from the start. They’re an Elite-tier Snowflake partner across EMEA, and you’d be in at the beginning of fresh build work, not inheriting someone else’s decisions.
  • Real influence in a small team. The UK team is around 15, with 2,500+ people behind it globally. Your voice shapes how things get built and how the team works, rather than getting lost in a big department.
  • 60% tech, 40% client. You’ll still be hands-on, but you’ll also be the person clients turn to for the technical answer. If you’ve outgrown the back office, this is the step.
  • Freedom to solve problems properly. The hiring manager moved there from corporate herself and rates the freedom above all. You choose the right fix for the client rather than working around process.
  • A team people stay in. It’s tight-knit, and the manager is known for looking after people. The retention shows it.
  • Close to where data is heading. They’re already building agentic AI into their data engineering work, alongside their own AI platform.

What you’ll be doing

  • Designing and building data pipelines, models and transformation layers on Snowflake and dbt for client projects
  • Making the key technical calls on architecture, data modelling and engineering standards
  • Leading client conversations: understanding their problems, shaping the solution and explaining technical decisions in plain English
  • Mentoring and supporting the mid-level and junior engineers in the team, through code reviews, pairing and guidance
  • Raising the bar on testing, CI/CD, documentation and data quality across projects
  • Working across a varied client base, sharing what you learn with the wider practice

What you’ll bring

  • 4+ years’ commercial data engineering experience
  • Strong hands-on Snowflake experience, ideally alongside dbt
  • Deep SQL and solid data modelling, with dimensional modelling, ELT and production pipelines in your bag
  • Confidence in front of clients and stakeholders. You enjoy the people side and can explain complex ideas simply
  • Experience guiding or mentoring other engineers, formally or informally
  • Databricks or Fabric experience is a plus, but Snowflake is the priority

What’s on offer

  • £60,000 to £65,000 depending on experience, plus benefits
  • Hybrid working, 2 days a week in the office: Tuesday and Thursday in London, or Monday and Friday in Milton Keynes
  • A new Snowflake project to lead from the start
  • A tight-knit team with strong retention
  • A varied client base across multiple sectors
  • A straightforward two-stage interview process

Wil jij bouwen aan moderne dataplatformen die de basis vormen voor analytics en AI?
