Als Lead Data Engineer ontwerp en realiseer je moderne cloud‑native dataplatformen en Lakehouse‑oplossingen, met Databricks als belangrijke technologie. Je werkt samen met Data Engineers, Architects, Data Scientists en business stakeholders om complexe datavraagstukken te vertalen naar betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen.


Please note: deze vacature staat open voor kandidaten die het Nederlands op native of near‑native niveau beheersen.


Je combineert hands‑on engineering met technische verantwoordelijkheid. Je denkt mee over architectuur en design, bouwt en optimaliseert data‑oplossingen en zorgt voor een betrouwbare overgang naar productie. Daarnaast coach je andere Data Engineers en deel je actief je kennis.


Hoe jij ons team versterkt

Je combineert technische diepgang met eigenaarschap en een pragmatische aanpak. Je kunt zelfstandig keuzes maken, helder communiceren met stakeholders en collega’s inhoudelijk begeleiden. Als Lead Data Engineer geef je richting en blijf je hands‑on betrokken.


Dit ben jij:



  • Minimaal 8 jaar relevante ervaring in Data Engineering;
  • Sterke hands‑on ervaring met Databricks, Apache Spark/PySpark en Delta Lake;
  • Goede kennis van Python SQL, NoSQL en ervaring met data pipelines en Lakehouse/Data Lake‑architecturen;
  • Ervaring met cloud‑native dataplatformen, bij voorkeur AWS;
  • Ervaring met CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code en Data Governance;
  • Je kunt technische keuzes helder maken, stakeholders meenemen en Data Engineers coachen en begeleiden; een afgeronde relevante hbo‑of wo‑opleiding en native of near‑native beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Waar kom je terecht

Binnen High Tech & Electronics van CGI werken we vanuit de High Tech Campus Eindhoven, midden in de Brainport-regio, samen met organisaties in een snel veranderende en technologisch gedreven omgeving. We combineren domeinkennis met expertise in digitale technologie om klanten te ondersteunen bij complexe vraagstukken rondom innovatie, engineering, data en digitale transformatie. Als consultant krijg je naast deze mooie opdrachten de ruimte om jouw expertise verder te ontwikkelen, kennis te delen en samen met collega’s en klanten zichtbare impact te maken.


Binnen CGI kijken we continu naar de impact van nieuwe technologieën op onze dienstverlening en de oplossingen die we voor onze klanten ontwikkelen. Ook ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en automatisering spelen hierin een steeds grotere rol.


Binnen High Tech & Electronics werken we aan data- en AI‑vraagstukken waarin betrouwbare dataplatformen, automatisering en nieuwe AI‑toepassingen steeds belangrijker worden. Als Lead Data Engineer help je mee om datafundamenten schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig in te richten.


Waarom CGI

CGI is één van ‘s werelds grootste IT-consultancybedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht‑ en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie‑, transport‑ en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega’s verspreid over de hele wereld.


We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken.


Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook vaak leidt tot betere resultaten. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team!

  • Een concurrerend salaris passend bij jouw senioriteit;
  • 8,33% vakantiegeld;

  • 20 wettelijke en 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen (op basis van fulltime);

  • Hybride werken.

Wat mag je van ons verwachten

In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT‑dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien.


Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede‑eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf.


Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega’s en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise.

Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Duties of the Electrical Shift Engineer

As the post holder, you will be expected to have extensive understanding of Critical Facilities/Data Centre infrastructure (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing & associated assets). As an integrated member of the engineering shift team, you will be responsible for effective inspection, operation and maintenance of all associated MEP assets within the critical facility, with a primary focus on critical facilities risk management, enhancing the quality of the service delivery through effective technical engineering capabilities.

As an electrical biased engineer, you expected to take the lead in the Planned, Corrective and Reactive Maintenance tasks as well as other associated assets when required. You will have the ability to issue PTW, ensuring compliance with method statements, risk assessments

Duties to include:

  • Operational understanding of all MEP systems within the Critical Facility/Data Centre in a competent, and confident manner (Biased towards Electrical within the facility). Making recommendations for improvement and providing concise technical reports when required.
  • Ensure that Specialist Vendors service visits are completed efficiently, and quality of work has been inspected and recommendations are communicated to the duty Shift Leader/Assist Chief Engineer.
  • To provide backup as engineering shift relief cover in the event of annual leave, training or other absence within the engineering team. Ensuring minimum staffing arrangements are always maintained and covering your opposite shift team members when required.
  • Accurately reporting of all completed work orders, including precise recording of any critical spares/stock items used during these tasks.
  • Attend Weekly Team meetings and Quarterly Team Meetings when scheduled.
  • Completing the shift handover reports, ensuring that significant events or activities are noted and effectively communicated to oncoming shifts and management.
  • Actively participate and complete Health and Safety compliance activities, such as Hazard/Near Miss Reporting and regular attendance/completion of scheduled Toolbox Talks.
  • Liaise with the supply chain, when ordering M&E components for remedial/corrective works.
  • Take ownership of areas (including all plant rooms) under control, ensuring they are brought up too and maintained to the required show site standards.
  • Evaluate and escalate any potential risks, with an assessment of impact, probable causes and mitigation opportunities.
  • Actively contribute to continuous improvement of safe systems of work, ensuring compliance with relevant Health and Safety policy and procedures.
  • Complete Reactive, Planned & Corrective Work Orders in line with SFG20 and ensure reliability of assets through excellent standards of maintenance delivery.
  • Escalation of all ONWH Alarm Notifications in line with agreed escalation procedures for EMEA MEP operations.
  • Accurate completion of all Corrigo Work Orders that have been allocated for completion by the CMMS. Including accurate capture of time spent on tasks and clear/concise details of works undertaken. With no errors input onto the system
  • Efficient and Effective completion of Corrigo Work Orders that have been allocated, ensuring that Work Orders have been acknowledged and completed within SLA.

Personal Specification:

  • Minimum of 5 years relevant experience in Critical Environments such as Banking HQ and Data Centres.
  • Electrical Engineering apprenticeship or similar (Experienced in Mechanical Engineering – desirable)
  • HVAC Engineering Experience
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to deal with all levels of staff.
  • Proactive in achieving the highest standard of operation.
  • Have good IT and report writing skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure whilst remaining calm, clear thinking and able to deliver the required services to the client within given time constraints.
  • Individuals who can demonstrate commitment and previous experience; but not meet all the required technical qualifications may be considered subject to Operations Directors approval.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to attend on and off-site training for MEP assets, this may require nights away from home due to the nature of the specialist training such as HV Authorised Person Training
  • A high level of initiative, with drive to continuously improve the operation.
  • Advanced communication skills with a full understanding of customer needs & expectations
  • Ability to comprehend and act upon both verbal and written instruction.
  • Enthusiasm and demonstration of pro-activity, diligence and alertness, with the willingness to participate in appropriate internal training programmes.
  • Integrity, honesty and punctuality is also expected

Our Commitment to Sustainability and Innovation

At JLL, we're committed to building a better tomorrow. As a Senior Facilities Manager, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to our global sustainability initiatives, helping to reduce environmental impacts across our managed properties. You'll also leverage our innovative technologies and data-driven approaches to optimize building performance and enhance occupant experiences.

Growth and Development

As part of the JLL family, you'll benefit from our global reach while working within a supportive local team. title: UN Women: International Consultant, Information Management Analyst (Retainer), Home-based
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security. Placing women’s rights at the centre of all its efforts, the UN Women leads and coordinates the United Nations system efforts to ensure that commitments on gender equality and gender mainstreaming translate into action throughout the world. It provides strong and coherent leadership in support of Member States’ priorities and efforts, building effective partnerships with civil society and other relevant actors.

UN Women’s triple mandate, along with its global network and deep policy and programming expertise, continues to endow the Entity with a unique capacity to: (i) support Member States to strengthen global norms and standards for gender equality and women’s empowerment, and mainstream gender perspectives in other thematic areas; (ii) promote coordination and coherence across the UN system to enhance accountability and results for gender equality and women’s empowerment; and (iii) undertake operational activities to support Member States, upon their request, in translating global norms and standards into legislation, policies and strategies at country level.

UN Women plays an innovative and catalytic role in the State of Palestine since its inception in 1997 (as UNIFEM). In line with the national priorities, the work of UN Women for the period 2023-2025 is aligned with three of the Palestine United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework’s (UNSDCF) outcomes:

• Palestinians have greater access to economic opportunities that are inclusive, resilient, and sustainable, including decent employment and livelihoods opportunities in an empowered private sector.

• Palestinians, including the most vulnerable, have equal access to sustainable, inclusive, gender responsive and quality social services, social protection, and affordable utilities.

• Palestinian governance institutions, processes, and mechanisms at all levels are more democratic, rights-based, inclusive, and accountable.

Its three-year Strategic Note supports the efforts to achieve measurable results in country in terms of four UN Women global Strategic Plan impacts (2022-2025): (SP Impact 1). Governance and participation in public life; (SP Impact 2). Women’s Economic Empowerment; (SP Impact 3). Ending Violence Against Women and Girls; SP Impact 4. Women peace and security, Humanitarian & Disaster Risk Reduction.

One of the challenges to successful gender coordination is the lack of gender disaggregated and gender-specific data to generate meaningful structured analysis that will inform the decisions, advocacy, and programme design of the humanitarian community, including the Humanitarian Country Team and the HC/RC. There is also a need to enhance the interagency information management capacities to support accountability to the affected population in OPT.

The Country Office is seeking to hire an Information Management Analyst to highlight the gendered impact of the crisis, and to inform and enhance the humanitarian response and the coordination efforts of humanitarian actors. The IM Analyst will work closely with the humanitarian architecture and development partners, including the cluster system, to ensure the collection and use of sex, age and disability disaggregated data, in the humanitarian response and early recovery. The IM Analyst will also support early recovery joint programming in Gaza, through Women’s contributions into several joint programmes under the UN Palestine Recovery Trust Fund (Horizon Fund), supporting gender-responsive activities, providing technical assistance, and facilitating partnerships with women-led organizations. These joint programmes require coordinated information management systems to track beneficiaries, referrals, services, economic and protection results, partnerships and financial contributions across participating UN organizations, while preventing double counting and ensuring that gender equality results remain visible within consolidated programme reporting.

The Information Management Analyst will be home-based. They will report directly to the Deputy Special Representative and will work closely with colleagues on SADD data in the humanitarian response and early recovery, particularly the Programme Specialist, Gender Statistics, GiHA Specialist, AAP Specialist, and the Gaza Sub-Office team as well as the regional data team and the Regional Humanitarian Specialist.

Description of Responsibilities /Scope of Work

1- Provide information management support to UN Women’s programmatic activities in Palestine.

  • Support information management, impact and reach analysis for UN Women humanitarian and early recovery programming through Track-IT, including interagency joint programming for early recovery in Gaza.
  • Provide technical and capacity building support to UN Women partners on humanitarian analysis, SADD, data collection (and M&E where requested).
  • Working closely with M&E colleagues, collate reach data from UN Women partners including through Kobo and TrackIT, and share aggregated results through the design of snapshots and reports.
  • Adapt and implement quantitative and qualitative data collection tools (e.g., KoboToolbox, ODK) to systematically capture SADD and intersectional indicators.
  • Support the preparation of technical reports, data snapshots and provide inputs for documentation ensuring accuracy, timeliness and relevancy of information and results.
  • Support the Development of data visualization, collection and quality assurance of primary data and information elements including the preapration of maps, dashboards, infographics and financial/resource analysis.
  • Adhere to data protection, data safeguarding, privacy, confidentiality, and compliance with relevant data management standards and protocols.

2- Integrate gender focus in upcoming data collection and analysis for humanitarian action.

  • Support the production of gender/SADD data in Palestine, through primary and secondary data collection and analysis.
  • Support with gender integration in inter-agency assessments, analysis and methodologies planning to ensure that data collection efforts are gender responsive and will capture gendered impacts of the crisis and early recovery interventions.
  • Participate and contribute inputs to the humanitarian data and information management bodies (such as the Information Management Working Group, the Assessments and Analysis Working Group), and clusters.
  • Support efforts to mainstream gender in sectoral assessments including WASH, Education, SGBV, CP, Health, Nutrition, Shelter, Food Security and MSNAs
  • Build capacities for WLOs/WROs in data collection and gender analysis.
  • Train country office teams, local partners, and other stakeholders on gender indicators, data ethics, and secure data handling.

3- Improve accessibility of gender data for cluster leads and humanitarian and early recovery leadership.

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of data collection and analysis systems in coordination with the information management efforts at the inter-cluster level and develop strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality humanitarian affected area.
  • Conduct data collection and analysis, support UN Women and GiHA WG to produce gender analyses, reports, bulletins, and infographs where needed.

  • Prepare and update visualization and data dissemination strategies for GiHA WG (e.g. map, dashboards, infographics, etc)

4- Support the information management and technical coordination of the inter-agency Community Feedback Mechanism (WASIL).

  • Support the day-to-day maintainenance WASIL CFM information management system, ensuring data quality, accurate case processing, documentation and timely follow-up of open cases.
  • Analyze and consolidate CFM data and develop regular data briefs, visualizations, dashboards and presentations capturing key trends, needs, gaps and priorities emerging from community feedback, to inform the humanitarian response.
  • Coordinate routine technical follow-up with WASIL system supplier and relevant partners, including troubleshooting, system updates, technical reviews and maintenance of relevant system documentation, SOPs and inventories.
  • Support coordination and maintenance of referral pathways, including follow-up with relevant focal points and service providers to facilitate appropriate referrals and case resolution.
  • Provide practical training and support to hotline operators and relevant CFM focal points on data collection, case management (Registration, categorization, and assessment), referrals and data quality.
  • Support to present and disseminate CFM findings and key insights to relevant coordination mechanisms, including clusters, the AAP Working Group and other humanitarian coordination platforms.
  • Where requested, participate in inter-agency platforms as UN Women’s information management focal point (e.g., Inter-Cluster Coordination Groups, Assessment Working Groups, and Gender in Humanitarian Action platforms).
  • Ensure that CFM data and information products comply with applicable data protection, privacy, confidentiality and information-sharing standards.

5- Provide information management support to UN Women’s programmatic activities in Palestine.

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of a consolidated information management framework for UN Women’s contributions across Horizon Fund joint programmes, including projects led or co-led by UN Women and projects in which UN Women is a participating organization.
  • Maintain and update an internal Horizon portfolio tracker covering programme outcomes, outputs, activities, indicators, targets, budgets, implementation partners, geographic coverage, beneficiary groups, delivery status and reporting deadlines.
  • Support UN Women programme teams to translate approved joint programme results frameworks into practical data-collection plans, indicator reference sheets, partner-reporting templates and reporting schedules.
  • Map corresponding indicators across joint programmes and identify potential overlaps in beneficiaries, services, enterprises, cash-for-work placements, training, referrals and partnerships.
  • Support development of data-management protocols and unique or interoperable participant-tracking approaches, where feasible and appropriate, to prevent double counting across joint programmes while protecting personal and sensitive data.
  • Consolidate UN Women results for inclusion in joint programme reports, ensuring that UN Women-supported participants, enterprises and partners are correctly reported as subsets of consolidated programme results.
  • Produce regular portfolio-level dashboards and analytical updates showing progress against targets, implementation gaps, geographic and population coverage, referral completion, expenditure and results for gender equality and women’s empowerment.
  • Where applicable, maintain and update referral-tracking arrangements for Horizon joint programmes, including referrals between protection and enabling services, skills and certification pathways, and employment or enterprise opportunities

6- The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Consultant’s Workplace and Official Travel

This is a home-based consultancy, without travel.

Competencies :

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework.

Functional Competencies:

  • Excellent information management, analytical and research skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data and develop data collection tools and databases, as evidenced by previous work experience and/or outputs (e.g., dashboards, assessment tools, or database systems)
  • Strong understanding of and commitment to gender equality and women's empowerment and its policy implications.
  • Excellent writing skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Excellent knowledge and experience of gender-related humanitarian issues in the country.
  • Strong knowledge and use of computer office tools and statistical software.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a team and in a cooperative and productive fashion both with internal and external colleagues.
  • Excellent interpersonal and networking skills, and ability to work in multi-cultural and multi-disciplinary environments.
  • Ability to work under pressure on multiple projects whilst maintaining high-quality and timeliness.
  • Self-management.
  • Continuous awareness of political and gender sensitivity

Required Qualifications:

Education and Certification:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in gender, international relations, international development, data and statistics, information management or other social science fields is required.
  • A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.
  • A project/programme management certification would be an added advantage.

Experience:

  • At least two years’ experience in humanitarian information management, including M&E, results-based management, and humanitarian action is required.
  • Experience working on cross cutting issues including gender and/or protection and/or accountability to affected populations (AAP) is required.
  • Experience working in humanitarian response and on humanitarian coordination, including experience with the cluster system is highly desirable.
  • Experience using digital data, collection tools, such as Kobo, Toolbox, or ODK is desirable.
  • Experience in data cleaning, validation, analysis and visualization is desirable.
  • Experience working with diverse stakeholder groups or multi-stakeholder partnerships is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with the UN and/or NGOs is desirable; and
  • Experience working in the Arab region is desirable.

Languages:

  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Working knowledge of Arabic is desirable

Statements :

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process.

title: Serviceperson
description:
Shape Your World

At Alcoa, you will become an essential part of our purpose: to turn raw potential into real progress. The way we see it, every Alcoan is a work-shaper, team-shaper, idea-shaper & world-shaper.

This is an opportunity for you to bring your wealth of experience to the team and help shape the future of sustainability with world-changing innovations and low carbon technologies. You have the power to shape things to make them better.

About the Role

We are seeking a Serviceperson to join our team at Alcoa’s Pinjarra Refinery, supporting the safe and efficient servicing and maintenance of plant and process equipment. This hands-on role forms part of an operational crew responsible for completing planned maintenance and responding to unplanned equipment issues.

In this role, you will:

  • Perform minor maintenance activities including pump and valve packing, lubrication, blank swinging and small valve replacement.
  • Assist tradespeople and other maintenance personnel with equipment maintenance and servicing.
  • Operate and undertake basic maintenance with the use of mobile equipment such as EWPs, Bobcats, restricted cranes and general maintenance vehicles, where appropriately qualified.
  • Support troubleshooting and problem-solving of equipment issues to help minimise downtime.
  • Participate in safety activities including tagging and dogging, Fire Watch and confined space safety watch requirements.
  • Work closely with production and maintenance teams to safely coordinate work and keep plant equipment operating effectively.

What’s on offer

  • Family friendly rosters that allow you to be home after each shift.
  • Employee growth and development opportunities.
  • Employee assistance program for personal support services.
  • Alcoa Live Well program offering travel, lifestyle, health and wellbeing discounts.
  • Connect and be part of a community that celebrates diversity through our employee inclusion groups.

What you can bring to the role

  • A current Manual C Class Driver’s Licence
  • Rigging, EWP and Forklift (LF) tickets are highly regarded
  • Crane licences: CN, C2 or CV desirable, with C6 highly regarded
  • Working at Heights and Confined Space Entry tickets are desirable
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and practical, hands-on capability
  • A strong commitment to safety, teamwork and working effectively in an industrial environment

Additional information

  • Interviews may progress prior to the closing date, although all applications will be considered.
  • You will only be contacted if you are shortlisted for an interview, this process can take up to four weeks from the closing date.

Be part of shaping our organisation and join us in building a legacy of excellence for future generations.

#AlcoaAUS

#LI-AW1

About the Location

As one of the world’s largest alumina refineries, our Alcoa Pinjarra Refinery produces approximately 4.7 million metric tons each year. Located within the Shire of Murray in the Peel region of WA, just east of the Pinjarra town site, our workplace offers an inclusive and respectful environment, where we embrace change, new ideas and equal opportunity to succeed.

title: Barselsvikariat som konsultationssygeplejeske til lægepraksis, Taastrup
description:
Ønsker du en hverdag der er uforudsigelig? En hverdag med gode muligheder for at lære nyt og udvikle dig som sygeplejerske, så er jobbet som konsultationssygeplejerske lige noget for dig.

Vi arbejder målrettet mod, at vores lægehuse skal være et rart og trygt sted, hvor vi har fokus på at sikre god faglig kvalitet, nærhed og respekt for både patienter og medarbejdere.

Dine opgaver er bl.a.:

  • Telefonvisitation, tidsbestilling, rådgivning i telefon og ved personligt fremmøde.
  • Svar på diverse prøver, e-mail besvarelser, receptfornyelser.
  • Selvstændige sygeplejekonsultationer og kronikerkontroller.
  • Halspodninger, urin undersøgelser, CRP, INR.
  • Behandling af sår, blodprøvetagning, EKG, lungefunktionsundersøgelser.
  • Børneundersøgelser og børnevaccinationer m.m.
  • Administrative registreringer og akutte opgaver.

Vi søger en sygeplejerske, der tager del i den faglige udvikling, hvor der bl.a. er stor fokus på opgavefordeling og kompetenceudvikling. Der vil være en høj grad af selvstændighed i de daglige opgaver, og du vil også indgå i et fagligt miljø, samt have kontinuerlig sparring med dine kolleger i lægehuset.

Vi forventer at:

  • Du har flere års erfaring som sygeplejerske gerne fra almen lægepraksis eller f.eks. fra hjemmesygeplejen, akut- eller medicinske afdelinger
  • Du er åben, imødekommende og motiveres af en foranderlig hverdag
  • Du udviser en høj grad af respekt og medmenneskelighed i arbejdet med patienterne
  • Du har flair for administrative opgave, og er velformuleret på skrift
  • Du har flair for telefonvisitation og IT
  • Du medvirker til at skabe et positivt og konstruktivt fagligt arbejdsmiljø

Derudover har du lyst til at have indflydelse på din egen hverdag og gøre en forskel for patienterne. Du arbejder målrettet og trives i en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens.

Ved ansættelse vil du indgå i vores on-bording program, hvor oplæring og introduktion til arbejdet planlægges struktureret og i fællesskab med dig, for at give dig den bedste start på arbejdslivet hos alles Lægehus.

Stillingen er 32-37 timer ugentlig. Barselsvikariatet er på 1 år. Opstart pr. 01.01.27 eller efter nærmere aftale.

Løn er overenskomstfastsat mellem DSR/AL.

Er du nysgerrig på indholdet i stillingen eller hverdagsstrukturen er du velkommen til at kontakte Praksisleder Marie Gaarde-Nissen Arnoldus på telefon +45 6644 9773.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i stillingen som konsultationssygeplejerske, så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Upload din ansøgning samt CV senest d. 24.11.26. Vi afholder samtale løbende, og ansætter når rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Senior Manager of Software Engineering – Java, Distributed Platforms & AI/Agentic Engineering
description:

title: Head of Programmes
description:
Since our inception in 2015 in Denmark, Liva has been a pioneer in the field of digital behaviour change. Our ambition is to empower 1 million people by 2030 to improve their health and well-being by preventing and managing chronic conditions through digitally powered, evidence-based lifestyle interventions.

Headquartered in Copenhagen and London, our collaborations with healthcare systems - including the NHS, life science companies and health insurers - allow us to impact lives at scale. We recently acquired Momenta, a leading developer and provider of evidence-based, outcome-driven, healthy lifestyle solutions that help people negotiate the many day-to-day challenges they face in living healthier lives, with a focus on weight management.


About the role

Most digital health programmes are built one contract at a time. We want to design ours once, properly, and deploy them everywhere: across the NHS, across four European countries, and on our platform for clients who run their own services.

You will be the chief architect of our cardiometabolic programmes, covering obesity, type 2 diabetes prevention and remission, and related long-term conditions. Medicated weight management is a major and fast-growing part of that. This is a new seat. You will shape it and build the function around it.


What you’ll be doing

  • Design the pathways. Turn clinical evidence and national guidance into digital care pathways, deciding which steps need a prescriber, dietitian or coach and which can be delivered by content or automation. This is what lets us scale without losing safety.

  • Lead medicated weight management design. From screening to planned discontinuation, so patients stay on treatment, eat well, keep muscle and keep the weight off afterwards.

  • Own engagement. Design how patients start, stay and come back, because outcomes depend on it.

  • Set the rules for AI coaching. Shape how our conversational tools behave, and make sure clinical questions always reach a clinician.

  • Build blueprints clients can buy. Create standard pathway models that get new clients live fast, without bespoke builds.

  • Prove it works. Define the outcomes data that shows commissioners and clients the value of what we deliver.


What you’ll have

  • A clinical background; you are, or have been, registered with a UK or EU regulator (HCPC, GMC, NMC or GPhC). The role signs off clinical design, so this is essential, although you do not need to be practising now.

  • Senior experience in obesity and type 2 diabetes care, ideally medicated weight management pathways.

  • A record of designing end-to-end care pathways in remote or digital settings, deciding who does what and how it is delivered.

  • Applied behaviour change expertise, with data showing what it achieved.

  • Experience leading specialists and influencing product, engineering and commercial teams.

  • Bonus: behavioural science or psychology training, SaaS health-tech experience, or AI coaching governance.


What you’ll get

Scale. Your designs will reach thousands of patients across the UK and Europe, and clients who license our platform.

Influence over delivery and product. Working closely with key stakeholders internally and externally to determine how we build and what we build to meet the needs of our clients and patients.

A seat close to the decisions. You will report to the VP Operations and present to the executive team.

A team to build. You will lead content and behavioural specialists and grow the function as we grow.


At Liva, we are a purpose-driven company; we go to work every day to help people live better lives. Our purpose is in our DNA, and we are always on the lookout for talented people eager to evolve and build a life-changing career within global health tech.

We believe in doing business the right way. Liva is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our workforce. We're committed to developing a representative workforce at all levels, and maintaining a working environment that promotes the health and wellbeing of our employees.

As a signatory to the Armed Forces Covenant we welcome applications from veterans, service leavers, and military spouses.

Guaranteed Interview scheme - As part of our commitment to the Government Disability Confident Initiative, and the Armed Forces Covenant, we are offering a guaranteed interview scheme to anyone with as disability as defined by the Equality Act 2010, or military veterans, service leavers, and military spouses.

Liva will operate a fair, inclusive and transparent recruitment and selection process. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout our interview process please let us know and will be happy to accommodate.

title: Læsevejleder til Erritsø Fællesskole
description:
Vil du være med til at sætte retningen for læsning, læselyst og sprogudvikling på Erritsø Fællesskole?

Vi søger en engageret læsevejleder, der har lyst til at spille en central rolle i udviklingen af vores læseindsats på tværs af Erritsø Fællesskoles tre afdelinger.

Hos os får du mulighed for at præge både indholdet og udviklingen af læsevejlederfunktionen. Du bliver en vigtig medspiller i arbejdet med at styrke elevernes læsekompetencer, deltagelsesmuligheder og faglige udvikling.

Samtidig ønsker vi at styrke vores indsats inden for dansk som andetsprog (DSA) – særligt i udskolingen. Vi ser derfor gerne, at du har interesse for og mod på at være med til at udvikle dette område i samspil med læsevejlederfunktionen. Vores ambition er at skabe en stærkere sammenhæng mellem elevernes læse-, skrive- og sprogudvikling og deres muligheder for at deltage aktivt i undervisningen.

Om stillingen
Vi søger dig, der er uddannet læsevejleder, har erfaring med læsevejledning og har lyst til at videreudvikle funktionen i tæt samarbejde med ledelse og kolleger.

Stillingen er sammensat af cirka 75 % vejlederfunktion og 25 % undervisning. Det giver dig mulighed for både at arbejde målrettet med udviklingen af skolens læseindsats og samtidig bevare en tæt tilknytning til undervisningspraksis.

Du vil i første omgang primært være tilknyttet afdeling Højmosen, men vores ambition er, at funktionen med tiden udvikles på tværs af alle tre afdelinger. Vi søger derfor en læsevejleder, der har lyst til at vejlede og understøtte kolleger fra 0. til 9. årgang og mod på at være med til at udvikle funktionen i takt med skolens behov.

Vi ønsker samtidig at styrke vores indsats på DSA-området (dansk som andetsprog) på sigt, særligt i udskolingen. Derfor ser vi gerne, at du har erfaring med eller interesse for DSA og kan se mulighederne i at kombinere dette med læsevejlederfunktionen.

Som læsevejleder bliver du en del af skolens vejlederteam og får blandt andet til opgave at:

  • Udvikle og kvalificere læsevejlederfunktionen på tværs af skolens tre afdelinger.
  • Understøtte skolens arbejde med literacy og læsning i alle fag.
  • Sparre med lærere og ledelse om læseindsatser, ordblindhed og elevernes deltagelsesmuligheder.
  • Vejlede og inspirere kolleger i arbejdet med læsning og elevernes læse- og skriveudvikling.
  • Bidrage til at udvikle læselyst og en stærk læsekultur i samarbejde med kolleger og skolens biblioteker.
  • Indgå i kommunale netværk og samarbejde med øvrige vejledere, ungdomsuddannelser og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.
  • Bidrage til at sikre gode rammer og vilkår for elever, der aflægger prøver på særlige vilkår.

Vi søger en lærer, der

  • Er uddannet læsevejleder og har lyst til at udvikle og sætte sit præg på funktionen.
  • Har erfaring med eller kendskab til vejledning af kolleger – gerne på tværs af 0. til 9. årgang – og kan se sig selv indgå i denne opgave.
  • Har flere års erfaring med undervisning i dansk.
  • Har erfaring med DSA-området eller interesse for at udvikle sine kompetencer inden for området.
  • Brænder for at styrke elevernes læse-, skrive- og sprogkompetencer.
  • Har stærke relationelle kompetencer og en grundlæggende tro på, at børn gør det bedste, de kan.
  • Kan vejlede, inspirere og skabe udvikling hos kolleger med afsæt i en anerkendende og udviklingsorienteret tilgang.
  • Har mod på at tænke kreativt og finde nye veje, der styrker elevernes læring og trivsel.

Om skolen
Erritsø Fællesskole er en velrenommeret distriktsskole med tre afdelinger og omkring 1.000 elever fra børnehaveklasse til 9. årgang.

Vi har et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og en kultur præget af åbenhed, engagement og humor. Vi lægger vægt på et tæt samarbejde på tværs af teams, vejledere og ledelse, fordi vi tror på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi udvikler skolen sammen.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i udviklingen af skolens samlede læseindsats og læsevejlederfunktion.
  • Stor indflydelse på arbejdet med literacy, læselyst og læsning på tværs af skolens tre afdelinger.
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit faglige præg på en funktion i udvikling.
  • En varieret stilling med både vejledning og undervisning.
  • En skole med ambitioner og fokus på både faglighed og trivsel.
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighed for at præge din egen hverdag.
  • Et stærkt vejlederfællesskab og mulighed for deltagelse i kommunale netværk.
  • En engageret ledelse i øjenhøjde og et godt kollegialt fællesskab.

Vil du vide mere?
Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte distriktsskoleleder Søren Storm, 5088 6835 for at høre mere om stillingen.
Send gerne en sms, så vender vi tilbage hurtigst muligt.

Du er også meget velkommen til at kigge forbi og opleve skolen – vi viser den gerne frem med stolthed.

Læs mere på vores hjemmeside:

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold
I henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer ugentligt.

På skoleområdet organiseres arbejdet fleksibelt med et gennemsnitligt årligt undervisningstal på 750 timer.

Ved ansættelse indhentes referencer, straffeattest og børneattest i henhold til gældende regler. Ansættelsen er betinget af tilfredsstillende attester.

Fredericia Kommune er en tobaksfri arbejdsplads.

Tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027.

Ansættelsessamtaler
Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler 26. november 2026.
Kandidater, der inviteres til samtale, vil blive kontaktet telefonisk.

Send ansøgning online
Fredericia Kommune benytter et elektronisk rekrutteringssystem, hvor du sender din ansøgning, CV, eksamensbevis og øvrige relevante bilag online.

DVJ Insights is an ambitious, innovative and fast-growing marketing research agency located in the Netherlands, Sweden, Denmark, Norway the UK, Germany, and Spain with the ambition to be the best global agency for brand growth. Next to our work, we like to celebrate our achievements and have fun together by regularly organising team activities such as dinners, pub quizzes, and parties to make sure everyone feels included and appreciated.


What will you do as a Data Platform & AI Engineer?

As part of The LAB, you play an important role in strengthening DVJ's data, technology and analytics capabilities. You work at the intersection of data engineering, platform operations, automation and AI-enabled analytics, helping us maintain, improve and scale the solutions that support our consultants, researchers and clients.


A large part of your role will focus on maintaining and improving DVJ's data ecosystem, including Microsoft Fabric, data pipelines and Spenderlog – our proprietary consumer analytics platform. You help ensure that these platforms remain reliable, scalable and future-proof while reducing operational dependencies and increasing continuity.


At the same time, you contribute to the maintenance and further development of AI-enabled solutions that help automate processes, improve data quality and generate smarter insights.


Specifically, you will:



  • Develop, maintain and optimize data pipelines, data models and platform integrations within Microsoft Fabric and related technologies
  • Operate, support and continuously improve Spenderlog, one of DVJ's key strategic data platforms

You enjoy solving data and technology challenges, take ownership of the systems you support and are motivated by creating a reliable foundation that enables others to do their best work.

A fun, versatile and challenging job at an innovative, successful market research agency, with offices in the Netherlands, the UK, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Spain and Germany. An international organisation where you can play a significant part in the success of the business, with a role where you get the chance to learn and develop your career. All in an open culture and pleasant work environment:

  • Working for amazing national and international brands and clients
  • A competitive salary and employment conditions (27 paid vacation days, a powder day and your birthday off, the opportunity to work from abroad for three weeks per year, travel allowance and pension)
  • The job position is in Utrecht, but there is flexibility to partly work from home as well
  • We aim to encourage and support everyone to prioritise their well-being and physical activity, so you receive a monthly allowance that covers part of your costs.

What do you bring?

You enjoy working at the intersection of data, technology and analytics. You are curious about how data platforms, automation and AI can help people work smarter and create better insights. xgiwjmb You combine technical skills with a practical mindset and enjoy improving existing solutions while helping build new ones.


You bring:

  • Interest in data quality, automation and platform reliability
  • The ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions
  • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of operational and technical challenges

title: Studiementorer til ergoterapeutuddannelsen
description:
Vil du gerne være studiementor på ergoterapeutuddannelsen og hjælpe andre ergoterapeutstuderende godt igennem uddannelsen? Går du lige nu på 3., 4. eller 5. semester? Vi søger fire studerende fra ergoterapeutuddannelsen på Københavns Professionshøjskole (KP), som vil være med til at løfte denne opgave.

Hvorfor mentorordningen?
En studiementor er selv studerende på ergoterapeutuddannelsen på KP. Studiementoren fungerer som en faglig sparringsmakker, der stiller sine værdifulde erfaringer til rådighed for nye studerende og hjælper dem godt på vej på uddannelsen.

En studiementor er en studerende fra 3. semester og frem, som følger ’sit’ eget hold igennem studiet fra 1. semester og frem til og med 6. semester.

Alle nyansatte studiementorer skal deltage i et opstartsmøde/intromøde med den studiementoransvarlige underviser og med nuværende studiementorer. Her vil der være fokus på ergoterapeutuddannelsens forventninger, regler og rammer omkring mentorordningen mv.

Studiementorordningen skal ses som en del af den samlede vifte af initiativer for god trivsel og et godt studiemiljø med henblik på at fastholde studerende på uddannelsen. Ordningen supplerer andre tiltag på ergoterapeutuddannelsen, som f.eks. tutorordningen, der har eksisteret i mange år. Den er iværksat på baggrund af initiativer fra ESR (Ergoterapeutuddannelsens Studerendes Råd) i samarbejde med uddannelsen.

Din rolle som studiementor er særlig på den måde, at du er i øjenhøjde med dine medstuderende, fordi du for nylig selv har været dér, hvor de er nu. Du kan derfor sætte dig ind i, hvad der er svært, og du kan forstå deres refleksioner.

Om jobbet
Vi søger i øjeblikket studiementorer med start E26 (efterårssemestret 2026).

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • Deltagelse i opstartsmøde (2 lektioner) for studentermentorer hvert semester, i hhv. januar og august
  • Forberedelse af holdmentormøde sammen med holdets øvrige studentermentorer på opstartsmøder
  • Forberedelse af intromøde til studentermentorordningen på 1. semester
  • Forberedelse af gruppementormøder på 1. semester (kun nye studentermentorer)
  • At stå til rådighed for henvendelser fra studerende på det semester, studiementorerne er tilknyttet
  • Gennemførelse og faciliterering af holdmentormøder (alle) samt introduktion og gruppementormøder på 1. og 2. semester (kun nye studentermentorer)
  • Deltagelse i status-/supervisionsmøder (2 møder á 45 min. pr. semester) med ansvarlige undervisere for studiementorordningen
  • Samarbejde med ansvarlige undervisere for studiementorordningen på ergoterapeutuddannelsen omkring opgaven som studiementor.

Om dig

  • Du er studerende på 3., 4. eller 5. semester på ergoterapeutuddannelsen på KP
  • Du har interesse i det gode studiemiljø på KP og på ergoterapeutuddannelsen
  • Du kan udvise indlevelse og synlighed samt engagement i studiet, fagligt som socialt
  • Du kan understøtte studerende i forhold til forståelse af de enkelte semestre, fag og eksamener
  • Du kan understøtte en rød tråd mellem teori og praksis
  • Du kan understøtte, at nye studerende oplever sig velkomne og inkluderede
  • Du er bekendt med egne kompetencer og grænser for virket som mentor.

Vi tilbyder
Du får et relevant studiejob og ikke mindst:

  • Et diplom på dit eksamensbevis, når du bliver bachelor
  • God mulighed for at netværke blandt studerende og undervisere på KP
  • Et godt punkt på cv’et til fremtidige jobs.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Du bliver ansat som studenterunderviser med start [job.tiltrædelse]. Der er tale om en tidsbegrænset ansættelse på op til 3 år afhængigt af, hvor langt du er i dit studie. Arbejdets omfang kan variere, men anslås til at være omkring 20-[job.timetal_pr._semester] timer pr. semester.

Du ansættes på en individuel kontrakt. Timelønnen er 180,69 kr. pr. 1. august 2026.

Din ansættelse sker i henhold til Bekendtgørelse om stillingsstruktur for undervisere ved videregående uddannelser på erhvervsakademier, professionshøjskoler m.fl., nr. 414 af 27. april 2025.

Ansættelse som studenterunderviser forudsætter, at du er indskrevet som studerende på en videregående uddannelsesinstitution, og at du har gennemført 1. semester af den uddannelse, som der skal undervises på, eller tilsvarende niveau.

Arbejdspladsen er beliggende på [job.location].

Vil du vide mere?
På Københavns Professionshøjskole uddanner vi studerende til meningsfulde arbejdsliv, hvor de møder andre mennesker, og gør en konkret forskel for dem. Vi ser det som vores fineste opgave og vores strategiske vision, at vi sammen med vores omverden vil uddanne fagprofessionelle, der lykkes i og sammen med praksis.

Læs mere om Københavns Professionshøjskole og vores strategi på og om KP som arbejdsplads på vores karriereside.

For yderligere oplysninger om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte [job.titel_på_kontaktperson] [job.kontaktperson] på tlf.: [job.kontaktperson.mobile_phone]​​ eller nara@kp.dk

Interesseret?
Send din ansøgning og CV via ansøgerknappen senest den [job.deadline].

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge [job.i_hvilke_uger_afholdes_samtaler?].

Københavns Professionshøjskole skeler hverken til køn, alder, etnicitet eller lignende, men alene til kompetence og talent. Vi forsøger at minimere bias i rekrutteringsprocessen og opfordrer derfor til, at du undlader at vedhæfte profilbillede i CV/ansøgning.

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Københavns Professionshøjskole er med mere end 20.000 studerende og 2.000 ansatte en af de største videregående uddannelsesinstitutioner i Danmark.

På Københavns Professionshøjskole uddanner vi pædagoger, sygeplejersker, lærere, socialrådgivere, fysioterapeuter, jordemødre og mange flere.

Sammen med vores samarbejdspartnere vil vi sætte nye standarder for professionsuddannelse, forskning, udvikling og efter- og videreuddannelse inden for skole og pædagogik, sundhed og velfærd, ledelse og forvaltning.

title: Staff Data Engineer (Entity Resolution & Identity)
description:
The intelligence engine for legal work, providing AI-powered legal research, contract review, risk assessment, and drafting tools for in-house legal teams.



U kunt meer details krijgen over de aard van deze vacature en wat er van sollicitanten wordt verwacht door hieronder te lezen.
Staff Data Engineer (Entity Resolution & Identity)

As a Staff Data Engineer — Entity Resolution & Identity at Zeno, you will build and own core systems for entity resolution and identity management in a legal AI platform, handling unstructured legal data across jurisdictions. This senior role involves designing durable, explainable systems for matching, merging, and versioning entities with a focus on precision, performance, and maintainability.


Job Description
Staff Data Engineer — Entity Resolution & Identity

About the role


As a Staff Data Engineer — Entity Resolution & Identity, you will build and own the core systems that power Zeno’s data and AI platform. Your work sits at the heart of the product: determining what is the same, what is different, what is a version, and how those decisions evolve over time.


This role is centered on hard engineering problems. You’ll work with large volumes of unstructured and semi-structured legal data from many sources, formats, jurisdictions, and time periods. You’ll design systems that can evolve without constant reprocessing, where every decision is explainable, reversible, and traceable.


You operate at senior-to-staff level and take ownership of long-lived, mission-critical infrastructure where correctness, performance, and maintainability matter deeply.


What you’re working on


What you’ll build



  • A durable entity resolution framework
  • Canonical entities with stable IDs that survive logic and data changes
  • Identity graphs with merge/split semantics and full provenance
  • Matching and consensus logic balancing precision, recall, and durability
  • Incremental recomputation (no “reprocess the world” when logic improves)
  • System-level data quality, validation, and observability

You’ll build systems that can reliably answer:



  • Are these two records the same real-world legal entity?
  • Is this a duplicate, a variant, a new version, or something else?
  • How do we evolve matching logic without rebuilding everything?
  • How do we make merges reversible and decisions explainable?

Constraints you’ll work under:



  • Unstructured and semi-structured legal data
  • Conflicting, incomplete, and shifting sources of truth
  • Long-lived correctness requirements across jurisdictions

Who you are



  • Staff-level experience in data engineering, solving non-trivial identity, deduplication, or consistency problems
  • Strong system design instincts and ownership mindset
  • Experience building complex, long-lived production systems
  • Strong programming skills (for example Python or similar)
  • Hands-on work with unstructured or semi-structured data

You think naturally in terms of:



  • Entity resolution, record linkage, and deduplication
  • Blocking and candidate generation trade-offs
  • Precision/recall calibration
  • Survivorship and conflict resolution
  • Graph connected components and merge cascades
  • Versioning, provenance, and replayability

Nice to have



  • Experience in legal, government, or other high-complexity document domains
  • Experience building human-in-the-loop review systems

Why this roleThis is not a role focused on maintaining pipelines. You will design and build systems that do not yet exist as standard solutions in a domain where data identity, correctness, and evolution over time are exceptionally challenging.


The ride from startup to scale-up means things will break, and there won’t always be a playbook. You’ll wear multiple hats, ship fast, and learn faster. If you thrive on ownership, speed, and building from zero, you’ll love it here.


The ride from startup to scale-up


Things will break, priorities will shift, and there won’t always be a playbook. You’ll wear multiple hats, ship fast, and learn faster. Some weeks will feel chaotic, some problems will feel bigger than your role. That’s the nature of the ride from startup to scale-up: if you need stability and structure, this won’t fit. But if you thrive on ownership, speed, and building from zero, you’ll love it here.



  • Be part of a product-driven team reinventing how legal professionals work.
  • Join early and shape the foundation of a fast-growing, high-impact startup.
  • Work in a place where hierarchy doesn’t matter — only the best ideas do.
  • Collaborate with a top-tier team of engineers, researchers, and entrepreneurs.
  • Competitive compensation, employee benefits and strong upside as we grow. xgiwjmb
  • An inspiring place to work in the heart of Rotterdam.

title: Har du høje faglige ambitioner og blik for fællesskabets betydning?
description:
Bundgaardsskolen søger en fagligt stærk lærer med undervisningskompetencer i Dansk, Kristendomskundskab og Billedkunst

På Bundgaardsskolen søger vi en lærer, der brænder for høj faglighed, stærke fællesskaber og udviklingen af inkluderende læringsmiljøer, hvor alle elever oplever læring, deltagelsesmuligheder og trivsel.

Vi tror på, at tydelige voksne, høje forventninger og gode relationer er afgørende for elevernes faglige, sociale og personlige udvikling. Derfor søger vi en lærer, der både har ambitioner på elevernes vegne og lyst til at bidrage aktivt til vores professionelle læringsfællesskab.

Om stillingen

Som lærer i vores almenafdeling på mellemtrinnet bliver du en vigtig del af et årgangsteam, hvor vi samarbejder tæt om undervisningen, elevernes læring og udviklingen af stærke fællesskaber.

Du vil indgå i et professionelt samarbejde med kolleger, ledelse, forældre og relevante samarbejdspartnere, hvor vi gennem fælles refleksion og udvikling arbejder for at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for alle elever.

På Bundgaardsskolen er vi organiseret i Professionelle Læringsfællesskaber (PLF), hvor vi gennem tæt samarbejde, fælles refleksion og faglig sparring arbejder systematisk med at udvikle undervisningen og styrke elevernes læring. Vi prioriterer desuden Co-teaching i dansk og matematik som en del af vores samlede indsats for at styrke elevernes faglige udvikling og deltagelsesmuligheder.

Vi ønsker en lærer, der kan skabe en varieret, motiverende og praksisnær undervisning, hvor elevernes forskellige forudsætninger, styrker og interesser bringes i spil.

Vi søger en lærer med undervisningskompetencer i dansk, kristendomskundskab og billedkunst. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du også kan undervise i engelsk, men det er ikke et krav.

Vi søger en lærer, der:

  • Har en stærk faglighed og brænder for at skabe motiverende, varieret og engagerende undervisning.
  • Har et inkluderende læringssyn og møder eleverne med anerkendelse, nysgerrighed og høje forventninger.
  • Er tydelig i sin klasseledelse og kan skabe struktur, tryghed og gode rammer for læring.
  • Har blik for både den enkelte elevs udvikling og betydningen af stærke klasse- og læringsfællesskaber.
  • Tager ejerskab for opgaver, relationer og fælles mål.
  • Udviser engagement, initiativ og lyst til at gøre en positiv forskel for børn og unge.
  • Trives i et professionelt teamsamarbejde og bidrager aktivt til fælles refleksion og udvikling.
  • Ser værdien i at arbejde i Professionelle Læringsfællesskaber (PLF) og Co-teaching som ramme for udvikling af undervisningen.
  • Har lyst til at arbejde med børns rettigheder, medbestemmelse og deltagelse som en naturlig del af skolens hverdag.
  • Er nysgerrig på egen praksis og har mod på at afprøve nye tilgange til undervisning og læring.

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, stærke relationer og ambitioner på alle elevers vegne.
  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger, der vægter samarbejde, faglig sparring og fælles udvikling.
  • Et stærkt professionelt læringsfællesskab, hvor vi udvikler undervisningen gennem refleksion, videndeling og fælles prøvehandlinger.
  • Co-teaching, der giver mulighed for tæt samarbejde om elevernes læring og deltagelse.
  • En skole, hvor børns rettigheder, medbestemmelse og stærke fællesskaber er en central del af vores pædagogiske praksis.
  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af undervisningen og skolens faglige og pædagogiske retning.
  • En hverdag med mening, variation og mulighed for at gøre en forskel for eleverne.
  • En ledelse, der prioriterer medarbejdernes trivsel, faglige udvikling og medinddragelse.

Om Bundgaardsskolen

Bundgaardsskolen blev etableret i sommeren 2024 og ligger i skønne grønne omgivelser i Aalborg Øst. Skolen har ca. 650 elever og 120 engagerede medarbejdere fordelt på almen- og specialafdeling.

Vi er UNICEF Rettighedsskole, hvor FN's Børnekonvention danner rammen om vores fællesskab, værdier og børnesyn. Det betyder, at vi arbejder aktivt med børns rettigheder, medbestemmelse og deltagelse, og at elevernes perspektiver er en vigtig del af skolens hverdag.

På Bundgaardsskolen arbejder vi ud fra ambitionen om, at alle børn skal opleve sig som betydningsfulde deltagere i stærke og forpligtende fællesskaber. Vi tror på, at høj faglighed og trivsel går hånd i hånd, og at de bedste løsninger skabes gennem tydelig pædagogisk retning, stærke relationer og professionelt samarbejde.

Vi er en skole i udvikling, hvor vi sammen arbejder for at skabe de bedste betingelser for elevernes læring, dannelse og trivsel.

Ansættelse

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. januar 2027.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Ansøgning

Har du lyst til at blive en del af Bundgaardsskolen og bidrage til at skabe høj faglighed og stærke fællesskaber på mellemtrinnet, glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller ønsker at høre mere om Bundgaardsskolen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingsleder Christine Suadicani på tlf.: 93 52 08 68.

Ansøgningsfrist: 22.november

Samtaler

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt 25.november fra kl 11.00

Forud for endelig ansættelse indhentes der straffe- og børneattest samt reference.


Send ansøgning

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.


Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder
Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.
Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

title: Lead Product Owner
description:
Become a part of our caring community

With over 10 million sales interactions annually, Humana understands that while great products are important, it’s the quality of our service that truly defines us. We know that when our members and prospects have delightful and memorable experiences, it strengthens their connection with us and enables us to put their Health First. After all, a health services company that has multiple ways to improve the lives of its customers is uniquely positioned to put those customers at the center of everything it does.

The Lead Product Owner is responsible for defining and executing the product vision and roadmap for business-critical capabilities supporting sales compliance, business rule management, analytics, and Book of Business administration.

This role partners closely with business, compliance, operations, and technology teams to translate complex regulatory, operational, and business requirements into product capabilities, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlog items.

The Lead Product Owner will serve as a key connection between business stakeholders and Agile technology teams, ensuring solutions are delivered in the appropriate sequence, meet regulatory and operational requirements, and provide measurable business value. This role works on problems of diverse scope and complexity, ranging from moderate to substantial, and requires strong analytical skills, independent decision-making, and the ability to influence stakeholders and leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities for capabilities supporting sales compliance and Book of Business administration.
  • Own, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog to maximize business value and align delivery with organizational priorities.
  • Translate complex business, regulatory, compliance, and operational requirements into actionable product features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
  • Define, document, implement, and govern complex business rules supporting critical processes such as eligibility, enrollment, servicing, retention, and producer management.
  • Partner with compliance stakeholders to ensure regulatory and business requirements are accurately reflected in system workflows, decision engines, and automated processes.
  • Serve as the Agile team's primary point of contact for product direction, backlog prioritization, requirements clarification, and product-related decisions.
  • Collaborate with business, operations, compliance, technology, and other cross-functional partners throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Analyze business and operational data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and potential impacts to Book of Business outcomes.
  • Balance business priorities, regulatory requirements, customer experience considerations, and technical constraints when making product decisions.
  • Develop clear acceptance criteria and ensure delivered capabilities meet established business and compliance requirements.
  • Support the testing and validation of business rules and product capabilities prior to implementation.
  • Establish governance processes to help ensure business rules remain accurate, traceable, and aligned with changing business and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the effectiveness of compliance and Book of Business capabilities.
  • Advise leaders and key stakeholders on product priorities, business process improvements, compliance considerations, risks, and strategic opportunities.
  • Exercise independent judgment on complex product and business issues while working with minimal supervision.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 8+ years of technical, product, business systems, or related experience.
  • 2+ years of project, product, or initiative leadership experience.
  • Experience serving as a Product Owner or working closely with Agile product development teams.
  • Demonstrated experience translating complex business requirements into product features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
  • Experience defining, documenting, testing, implementing, or managing complex business rules.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data and business insights to support product decisions.
  • Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs in a complex business or technology environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across business, operations, compliance, and technology teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex initiatives and competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting sales compliance, regulatory compliance, or rules-based decisioning platforms.
  • Experience with Book of Business administration, including eligibility, enrollment, servicing, retention, or producer-related processes.
  • Experience with business rules engines, decision engines, workflow automation, or other rules-based technology solutions.
  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise platforms and technology implementations.
  • Experience working within a highly regulated industry such as healthcare, health insurance, financial services, or another regulated environment.
  • Experience using analytics, operational metrics, and performance data to drive product strategy and prioritization.
  • Experience partnering directly with compliance or regulatory teams to translate requirements into technology solutions.
  • Knowledge of Agile product management practices and tools for backlog and requirements management.
  • Master's degree.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. title: Third-Party Risk Advisory - Associate
description:
Join the Corporate Third-Party Oversight Risk Management team and help strengthen third-party risk practices through effective program coordination, governance support, and clear business presentations. You will work with business and functional stakeholders to manage plans, coordinate deliverables, track actions and dependencies, prepare meeting materials, and support consistent execution across the program.

As a Third-Party Risk Advisory - Associate in Corporate Third-Party Oversight Risk Management, you will help coordinate program activities, governance routines, and cross-functional deliverables. You will maintain project plans and documentation; track actions, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies; create executive-ready PowerPoint presentations; and support the timely completion of commitments. You will partner with stakeholders across the program to promote consistent execution, clear communication, and effective governance.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Maintain integrated project plans, workstream schedules, governance calendars, and delivery roadmaps for Third-Party Oversight initiatives.
  • Coordinate program activities, stakeholder inputs, meeting schedules, and deliverables across business, risk, controls, technology, and program teams.
  • Prepare agendas and meeting materials, document decisions and action items, and monitor follow-through for governance and working-group meetings and create clear, concise, and visually effective PowerPoint presentations for management, governance forums, and senior stakeholders.
  • Track actions, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and commitments; follow up with owners and escalate delays or roadblocks appropriately.
  • Maintain decision logs, project documentation, procedures, templates, and shared repositories to support effective program execution.
  • Support change management and implementation activities, including stakeholder communications, readiness coordination, and adoption planning.
  • Coordinate status updates and consolidate workstream information into concise summaries of progress, decisions, risks, and next steps.
  • Help identify process gaps, delivery risks, and opportunities to improve program governance, coordination, and ways of working.
  • Support issue resolution by organizing working sessions, clarifying ownership, documenting outcomes, and monitoring agreed actions.
  • Promote consistent use of PMO standards, tools, templates, and documentation practices across workstreams.
  • Support broader Third-Party Oversight initiatives and special projects through planning, presentation development, documentation, and stakeholder coordination.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in project or program coordination, PMO support, risk management, controls, audit, compliance, operations, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, including development of executive-ready presentations with clear storylines, tables, visuals, and concise messaging.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for maintaining project plans, action logs, schedules, inventories, and other program documentation.
  • Experience supporting project governance, coordinating workstreams, maintaining plans, and tracking actions, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, workstreams, and stakeholder inputs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a consistent focus on documentation quality, follow-through, and timely delivery.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize complex information for varied audiences.
  • Ability to facilitate meetings, capture decisions and actions, coordinate follow-ups, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and SharePoint; familiarity with project management or collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge of third-party risk management, operational risk, outsourcing, procurement, technology risk, or related control functions.

title: F&B Supervisor (Russian, French, Spanish, Italian or Arabic Speaking)
description:

Guest Relations

Our commitment to you:

We’re Fans. Are you?

title: Client Tax - Associate
