  • Build AI-enhanced user features — including search, summarization, and explanation capabilities — with a human-in-the-loop approach to ensure correctness, security, and compliance
  • Foster a team culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and proficient applied experience
  • Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
  • Professional development experience with Python, Java, or another object-oriented programming language
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies, including continuous integration and delivery, application resiliency, and security practices
  • Demonstrated knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline such as cloud, artificial intelligence, or machine learning
  • Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle
  • Experience communicating effectively with both business-facing customers and technical teams
  • Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, testing, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs
  • Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Familiarity with modern front-end technologies and UI development patterns
  • Familiarity with large language model application patterns and prompt/context engineering techniques
  • Experience working in financial services or risk technology environments

title: Er du vores nye natteravn på Demenscenter Skovgården?
description:
Er du vores nye natteravn? - Vi søger dig, der er SSA, SSH eller pædagog - og som brænder for at gøre en faglig forskel inden for et givende og spændende speciale.

Demenscenter Skovgården i Hadsund ønsker lige nu at ansætte en social- og sundhedsassistent, social- og sundhedshjælper eller pædagog. Så er du uddannet SSA, SSH, pædagog eller måske bliver du det snart? Så vil vi meget gerne se og høre fra dig.

Fastansættelse fra den 1/1-2027 eller hurtigst muligt i nattevagt.

Om Demenscenter Skovgården

Demenscenteret i Hadsund rummer 66 demensboliger fordelt på syv leve-bo-miljøer.

På Skovgården arbejder vi ud fra en personcentreret omsorgstilgang med afsæt i Tom Kitwoods teorier. Vi prioriterer systematisk faglig udvikling i alle teams gennem undervisning og beboerkonferencer.

Vi tilbyder en attraktiv arbejdsplads med fokus på kontinuerlig udvikling, et stærkt fagligt og tværfagligt samarbejde samt gode fysiske rammer og et sundt arbejdsmiljø med mulighed for faglig sparring. Beboernes trivsel er vores højeste prioritet, og vi tror på, at ”Samarbejde er en professionel pligt.”

Vores arbejde har modtaget flere anerkendelser. I 2022 blev vi nomineret til ”Danmarks bedste plejehjem”, og vi har vundet priser for ”Årets mest innovative boligindretning for mennesker med demens”, ”Årets bedste demensindsats” gennem projekt med sang og musik (2019) samt ”Årets bedste demensindsats” (2024) for vores nytænkende Bagedyst.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Ønsker at bidrage med dine faglige kompetencer
  • Har gode kommunikative evner ift. borgere og samarbejdspartnere
  • Er teamplayer og bidrager til positivt arbejdsmiljø, hvor forskelligheder ses som en styrke
  • Kan arbejde relationsskabende
  • Har sans for kreative og idérige tiltag for målgruppen
  • Kan reflektere over egen praksis samt dele af gode erfaringer
  • Har lyst til faglig og personlig udvikling

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi vægter et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, nærvær og kvalitet i plejen
  • Et bredt tværfagligt samarbejde da vores personalegruppe bl.a. består af: centersygeplejerske, demenskonsulenter, fysioterapeut, diætist, pædagoger, SSH, SSA og 2 faglige teamledere. Der er endvidere ansat køkkenpersonale samt rengøringstekniker og vaskerimedarbejder.
  • Fleksible arbejdstider.

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

Ansøgningen vedhæftet dokumentation for uddannelse samt tidligere beskæftigelse sendes elektronisk via Emply.

Ansøgningen skal være os i hænde senest søndag den 15. november 2026.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler ellers senest mandag den 23. november 2026.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

For at være ansat i Mariagerfjord Kommune skal du have MitID.

Der indhentes straffeattest og ansættelsen er betinget af, at denne kan godkendes.


Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til plejecenterleder Dorthe Lynge på tlf. 3058 0772.

Mariagerfjord Kommune er en af Danmarks smukkeste kommuner med en unik og varieret natur ved skov, strand og fjord. Vi ligger centralt mellem Aalborg og Aarhus og er på den måde et bindeled mellem Nordjylland og resten af landet. Vores mål er klart: Vi vil mere, og der er plads til flere. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores cirka 42.000 borgere, for vores erhvervsliv og for udviklingen af kommunen.

I Mariagerfjord Kommune ønsker vi, at alle vores 3.400 medarbejdere oplever sig som en vigtig del af fællesskabet. Vi har frihed til at bringe vores kompetencer og ideer i spil, så vi løser kerneopgaven bedst muligt og gør en forskel for vores borgere. Vi har fokus på psykologisk tryghed og viser respekt for hinandens forskelligheder. Alle tager vi et medansvar for fællesskabet og opgaven, og derfor lægger vi også stor vægt på et velfungerende samarbejde i MED-organisationen.

title: Global Head of Data
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Global Division Controller


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to define, develop, and lead the global data strategy for Energy Industries, establishing the governance, standards, capabilities, and operating model required to turn data into a trusted and scalable business asset. You will oversee the development and effective use of data across the organization, including data governance, master data, data quality, architecture, ownership, and lifecycle management. You will work closely with business and functional leaders to ensure that our data foundations support operational excellence, digital transformation, advanced analytics, and the rapidly growing use of AI.


The work model for the role is: Hybrid.


This role is contributing globally to ABB Energy Industries. Main stakeholders include Division and Business Line leadership, Finance, Operations, Sales, Service, Digital, IS/IT, Data & Analytics, AI teams, and relevant Business Area and ABB Group functions.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Defining and driving the global data strategy, governance framework, standards, ownership model, and implementation roadmap in close alignment with business priorities and ABB-wide data principles.
  • Establishing strong data foundations across master data, data quality, architecture, accessibility, and lifecycle management, with clear accountability and measurable performance.
  • Partnering with business functions, technology teams, and Data/AI stakeholders to enable trusted, scalable data for business processes, analytics, automation, and AI use cases.
  • Driving implementation and adoption across the organization, monitoring progress and compliance, resolving cross-functional issues, and representing Energy Industries in relevant data governance forums.


Qualifications for the role

  • You have extensive experience in enterprise data management, including data strategy, governance, master data management, data quality, architecture, and data lifecycle management in a complex global organization.
  • You have a demonstrated track record of developing and implementing enterprise-wide data strategies and governance models, translating strategic objectives into pragmatic execution roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.
  • You possess strong knowledge of modern data architectures, data platforms, analytics, and emerging AI technologies, with a clear understanding of the data foundations required to scale analytics, automation, and AI.
  • You have proven experience working across business and technology functions and influencing senior stakeholders in a global, matrixed organization without relying solely on direct organizational authority.
  • You combine strategic thinking with a strong execution mindset and are passionate about improving data quality, ownership, transparency, and the practical use of data to create business value.
  • You hold a university degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, combined with significant relevant professional experience.
  • You are at ease communicating in English in an international environment and can translate complex data and technology topics into clear business language.

What's in it for you?

  • Play a key role in shaping the global data foundation for one of ABB's major industrial businesses.
  • Build the capabilities that enable the next generation of analytics, automation, and AI-driven business solutions.
  • Work directly with senior business and functional leaders across a global organization.
  • Combine strategy with tangible execution and measurable business impact.

More about us

ABB Energy Industries enables safe, smart, and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the energy sector. By integrating automation, electrification, digitalization, and advanced technologies, we help customers improve operational performance while navigating the energy transition.

The Global Data function provides the strategy, governance, standards, and capabilities required to establish trusted, accessible, and well-managed data across Energy Industries. Working across businesses and functions, the team enables data-driven decision-making, operational excellence, advanced analytics, automation, and AI at scale.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Konsulent med stærke analytiske kompetencer til Center for Børn og Natur
description:
Vil du være med til at drive forandringsprocesser – og dokumentere og undersøge, hvad der virker, når vi vil fremme børn og unges leg, læring og trivsel i naturen?

Har du stærke kompetencer inden for evaluering, analyse og samarbejde? Og har du lyst til at skabe overblik, samle viden og understøtte læring på tværs af mange aktører? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Center for Børn og Natur.

Om Center for Børn og Natur

Center for Børn og Natur er et nationalt, missionsorienteret partnerskab med en vision om en verden, hvor alle børn og unge leger, lærer og trives i naturen.

Naturen kan bidrage positivt til børns fysiske og mentale sundhed, deres læring og motoriske udvikling. Men det kræver et større fælles fokus på at nedbryde barrierer i børns hverdag, der står i vejen for, at de kommer mere ud i naturen. Ingen aktør kan løfte denne opgave alene.

Derfor har 16 partnere (forsknings- og vidensinstitutioner, fonde og foreninger) lagt kræfterne sammen i et styrket Center for Børn og Natur. Du kan læse mere om centeret her: .

Partnerne er:

  • Center for Klinisk Forskning og Forebyggelse, Region H
  • Danmarks Jægerforbund
  • Danmarks Nationalparker
  • Danmarks Naturfredningsforening
  • DGI
  • Friluftsrådet
  • Haver til Maver
  • Københavns Universitet (KU), Skovskolen, IGN
  • LIFE Fonden
  • Natur & Ungdom
  • Naturvejledning Danmark
  • Professionshøjskolen Absalon
  • Professionshøjskolen UCN
  • Syddansk Universitet (SDU), Active Living & Center for Grundskoleforskning
  • UCL Erhvervsakademi og Professionshøjskole
  • VIA University College

Vores mission er at udvikle og implementere viden, indsatser og rammer, der fremmer børn og unges leg, læring og trivsel i naturen – til gavn for både børnene og en sund og bæredygtig fremtid.

Centret finansieres gennem partnerskaber med fonde, ligesom partnerne selv bidrager til finansieringen.

Din rolle

Center for Børn og Natur består ud over de 16 partnere af et lille sekretariat, der understøtter partnerne i at drive den fælles mission. Vi søger nu en ny kollega, der vil være med til at indfri centrets ambitioner og støtte op om partnerskabets mange aktiviteter.

Du bliver en del af et lille team, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med centerlederen og en kommunikationsmedarbejder og indgår i samarbejdet med vores studentermedhjælpere. Du får en unik mulighed for at komme tæt på partnerorganisationernes meget forskellige projekter og dygtige medarbejdere. Du kommer både til at lære af deres fagligheder og bidrage med din metodiske og faglige viden. Og du bliver katalysator for samarbejde og udveksling af viden på tværs af partnerskabet.

En central del af din rolle bliver at bistå og rådgive centerets partnere og arbejdsfællesskaber i udviklingen og gennemførelsen af projekter, herunder i nogle tilfælde løse delopgaver som fx evalueringer og indsamling af data. Du får også en rolle i forhold til formidling af viden og resultater – fx i centerets netværks- og formidlingsaktiviteter som skal bl.a. skal forbinde forskere, praksisaktører, organisationer og beslutningstagere på tværs af sektorer.

Du får en bred opgaveportefølje, hvor projektudvikling, sparring med partnere, koordinering og ledelsesbetjening går hånd i hånd med analyse, evaluering, læringsopsamling og formidling af viden og resultater. Du skal både kunne bidrage til, at centerets og partnernes aktiviteter og processer bevæger sig fremad, og medvirke til, at vi systematisk indsamler og analyserer viden om vores arbejde, bliver klogere på, hvad der virker, og deler den læring, vi opnår.

Vi søger derfor en kollega, der trives med både at skabe overblik og fordybe sig i data, analyser og faglige problemstillinger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Understøtte samarbejdet i partnerskabet: Bidrage til koordinering og facilitering af møder, workshops og arbejdsfællesskaber samt sikre opfølgning på aftaler og fælles beslutninger.
  • Bidrage til evalueringsdesign og monitorering: Udvikle og kvalificere evalueringsdesign, relevante spørgsmål, indikatorer og metoder, der kan hjælpe partnerne, samt sikre at vi på centerniveau kan følge indsatser og forstå deres resultater.
  • Analysere data og skabe indsigt: Bearbejde og analysere relevante data og bidrage til at identificere mønstre, tendenser og sammenhænge, der kan kvalificere centrets arbejde og beslutninger.
  • Samle og strukturere viden og læring: Indsamle, systematisere og sammenfatte eksisterende forskning, erfaringer og læring fra projekter og praksis, så indsigterne kan anvendes på tværs af partnerne og centrets indsatser.
  • Udarbejde vidensprodukter og formidle indsigter: Bidrage til analyser, notater, oplæg, rapporter og andre skriftlige produkter, der gør viden anvendelig for forskellige målgrupper.
  • Understøtte ledelse og organisationsudvikling: Bidrage til betjening af centerets styregruppe, fondsansøgninger og den løbende udvikling af Center for Børn og Natur som organisation og nationalt partnerskab.

Opgaverne vil udvikle sig i takt med centrets arbejde, og du får mulighed for at præge både indholdet og måden, vi løser dem på.

Dit team

Du indgår i et lille sekretariat med korte beslutningsveje, tæt samarbejde og en bred opgaveportefølje. Vi er en lille organisation under opbygning, hvor vi løfter stort som småt i flok. Du skal derfor trives med en varieret hverdag, hvor du både driver dine egne faglige opgaver og hjælper med at få de praktiske ting til at fungere. Det kan være alt fra at forberede materialer til en workshop til at sikre, at møder og arrangementer bliver afviklet godt. For os handler det om fælles ansvar, fleksibilitet og lysten til at få tingene til at lykkes, sammen.

Center for Børn og Natur er fysisk placeret hos Danmarks Naturfredningsforening, som fungerer som værtsorganisation for centret. Vi arbejder på tværs af landet, så du skal være indstillet på at bruge digitale mødeformer og på en vis rejseaktivitet i Danmark. Til gengæld får du stor fleksibilitet, mulighed for at tilrettelægge dit eget arbejde og gode muligheder for at sætte dit præg på centrets udvikling.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse og erfaring med projektudvikling, evaluering, analyse- eller konsulentarbejde. Måske har du erfaring fra en konsulentvirksomhed, en styrelse, en kommune, en forsknings- eller vidensorganisation eller en anden organisation, hvor du har arbejdet på tværs af fagligheder og interesser.

Det er vigtigt, at du kan skabe struktur og fremdrift i komplekse opgaver og samtidig har lyst og evner til at arbejde analytisk med viden, data og læring. Samtidig er det en klar fordel, hvis du har faglig indsigt i børn og unge og/eller natur og aktiviteter i naturen.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med projektledelse og kan understøtte partnere, koordinere indsatser og følge systematisk op på aktiviteter, processer, tidsplaner og leverancer.
  • Har stærke analytiske kompetencer og gerne erfaring med at udvikle eller kvalificere evalueringsdesign, monitorering og analyse af data.
  • Kan samle, strukturere og analysere eksisterende viden og erfaringer og omsætte dem til centrale indsigter og anvendelig læring.
  • Har en stærk skriftlig formidlingsevne og kan udarbejde klare, præcise og målrettede vidensprodukter, analyser og oplæg.
  • Arbejder selvstændigt og opsøgende og tager ansvar for at drive opgaver fremad.
  • Har gode relationelle kompetencer og trives med at samarbejde på tværs af organisationer og fagligheder.
  • Har erfaring med fondsansøgninger eller lyst til at bidrage til arbejdet med at udvikle og beskrive projekter til fondsfinansiering.
  • Har interesse for digitale analyseværktøjer og for, hvordan AI kan understøtte arbejdet med data, analyse og vidensopsamling på en fagligt forsvarlig måde.
  • Har faglig indsigt i børn og unge og/eller natur og aktiviteter i naturen.

Du behøver ikke at kunne det hele fra første dag. Vi er interesserede i din samlede erfaring, din analytiske nysgerrighed og din evne til at omsætte viden til handling.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Arbejdsstedet er Danmarks Naturfredningsforenings sekretariat på Østerbro i København. Vi forventer, at arbejdet tager udgangspunkt i sekretariatet, så vi sammen kan opbygge et stærkt team, samtidig med at vi deltager i aktiviteter rundt omkring i landet.

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med forventet tiltrædelse den 1. februar 2027.

Løn forhandles efter kvalifikationer og inden for rammerne af Danmarks Naturfredningsforenings overenskomst, der matcher staten.

Du refererer til centerleder Anne-Louise Bjerregaard.

Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte centerleder Anne-Louise Bjerregaard på telefon 21 45 67 80.

Ansøgning

Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV med dokumentation for erfaring og uddannelse.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 29. november 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde første samtale den 4. december og anden samtale den 10. december 2026.

A multinational defence organisation in The Hague needs a data engineer to design and build the ETL processes that bring imagery and reports from sources on different networks into its systems, and then make those flows controllable, observable and resilient. The engagement is one person, delivered as a set of milestones over the year.

  • Putting configuration control in place: baselines, versioning, change approval and rollback
  • Setting up monitoring with metrics, alerts, dashboards and logging
  • Designing and testing resilience: backup and restore, failover, recovery time and point objectives
  • Troubleshooting production data flows, and handing over through a training package and on-the-job training for the administrators
What you would bring
  • Hands-on experience with modern ETL tools such as Apache NiFi, Informatica, Talend or SSIS, ideally on AWS or Azure
  • Data modelling and transformation from heterogeneous sources
  • Experience with data sharing platforms, object stores and relational, NoSQL, graph and vector databases xgiwjmb
  • Comfort on the Linux command line and a knack for fixing data anomalies
  • Experience delivering against fixed, deliverable-based contracts in multinational teams
  • Familiarity with NATO intelligence and surveillance architecture and applications, and fluent business English
Why this one is worth a look

A clearly scoped engineering job where you own the pipelines end to end, with an option year after the first.

title: Faglig koordinator til nyoprettet afdeling Vagt og Modtagelse
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en mærkbar forskel for børn, unge og deres familier i Nyborg Kommune, trives du med at bygge noget nyt op fra bunden, forstår vigtigheden i samarbejde på tværs, og er du en afslutter, så ser vi gerne en ansøgning fra dig.

Vi udvider vores Myndighedsområde for børn, unge og deres familier i Social og Familie, hvorfor vi søger vi en faglig koordinator til vores nyoprettede afdeling, Vagt og Modtagelse.
Du vil udover vagt og modtagelse også blive koordinator for døgnvagten.

Stillingen er 37 timer ugentligt med start 1. januar 2027.

Social og familie
Social og Familie rummer det samlede specialiserede social område, myndighed og udfører på både børn unge handicap og voksne. Samlet arbejder vi for at skabe størst mulig værdi for borgerne gennem helhedsorienterede løsninger og et stærkt fagligt samarbejde. Vores tilgang bygger på værdierne fællesskab, mod og visionær handling. Det betyder, at vi står sammen om vores ansvar, tør tænke nyt og aktivt søger bedre veje til at understøtte borgernes trivsel og udvikling. Som samlet afdeling arbejder vi målrettet for at levere kvalitet i alle led og sikre, at borgerne møder en organisation, der tager udgangspunkt i deres behov og møder dem med både faglighed og respekt.

Vagt og Modtagelse bliver en integreret del af Myndighedsområdet i Social og Familie.

Afdelingen består i dag af ca. 35 dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, herunder socialrådgivere, familieplejekonsulenter og ergoterapeuter, samt en afdelingsleder og tre koordinatorer.

Vi vægter et tæt, tværfagligt samarbejde højt og tror på, at de bedste løsninger findes i fællesskab. Vores arbejdsmiljø er præget af høj faglighed, stor hjælpsomhed og en uformel tone, hvor der også er plads til et godt grin i hverdagen.

Om stillingen og dine opgaver
Som faglig koordinator i et nyoprettet team vil du få en unik mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på afdelingen. Du vil være med helt fra start, hvor du skal bidrage til at ansætte medarbejdere, planlægge de fremtidige arbejdsgange og besøge Nyborg Kommunes skoler samt dagtilbud for at skabe gode samarbejdsrelationer og sikre vi kommer godt fra start.

Du vil referere direkte til afdelingslederen for Myndighed Børn, Unge og Handicap.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Yde kvalificeret faglig sparring og vejledning til rådgiverne i hverdagen.
  • Sikre høj kvalitet, ensartethed og retssikkerhed i sagsbehandlingen.
  • Understøtte og implementere lovændringer samt nye administrative arbejdsgange.
  • Udføre ledelsestilsyn og systematiske sagsgennemgange i samarbejde med afdelingsleder.
  • Bidrage aktivt til kompetenceudvikling af medarbejderne.
  • Deltage i komplekse sagsforløb og understøtte rådgiverne i de svære samtaler.
  • Indgå i tværfaglige samarbejder og sikre god dialog med skoler og dagtilbud.
  • Samarbejde med civilsamfundet.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant socialfaglig uddannelse, eksempelvis som socialrådgiver, og gerne med solid erfaring fra en lignende stilling som faglig koordinator eller konsulent.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Er stærk i lovfortolkning og forstår, at holde dig opdateret på gældende praksis.
  • Har et solidt fundament i de socialfaglige teorier og metoder.
  • Besidder stærke kompetencer inden for koordinering, struktur og formidling.
  • Har en åben, anerkendende og inddragende tilgang til samarbejdet med kollegaer og borgere.
  • Tænker i helhedsorienterede løsninger og opsøger det tværfaglige samarbejde.
  • Er robust, fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket i en organisation under forandring.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende nøglerolle med stor indflydelse på opbygningen og udviklingen af en ny afdeling.
  • En fleksibel arbejdsplads og fokus på balance mellem arbejdsliv og fritid.
  • Fleksibel fredag.

Yderligere information
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst og principperne for lokal løndannelse.

Den forventede startløn ligger inden for intervallet 40.000-44.000 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension og fritvalgstillæg.
Den konkrete løn fastsættes på baggrund af objektive og kønsneutrale kriterier, herunder uddannelse, erfaring, kompetencer og stillingens ansvar.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at der indhentes offentlig straffeattest og børneattest inden ansættelse.

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder for Myndighed Anni Vexø på tlf. 2960 7636 eller social- og familiechef Charlotte Jensen på tlf. 5120 9986.

Ansøgningsfrist søndag 22. november 2026
Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt 24. november 2026 ml. kl. 12.00-17.00
Tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027

Nyborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Politikken gælder alle ansatte og betyder, at det ikke er muligt at ryge i arbejdstiden. Rygepolitikken skal sikre, at alle ansatte i Nyborg Kommune kan færdes i et røgfrit arbejdsmiljø.

title: Junior High Wrestling Coach (3)
description:
Payroll/Personnel Type: Head Coach
Job #: xxx
SupervisorDirector of Athletics

JOB GOAL: To instruct athletes in the fundamental skills, strategy and physical training necessary for them to realize a degree of individual and team success. At the same time, the coach must instruct and demonstrate behaviors that lead to socially acceptable character development, self discipline, self confidence, and pride of accomplishment in the student athletes. To upgrade his/her knowledge and skills through coaching clinics, observations, consultation, etc.

GENERAL:

  1. The success of athletic programs has a strong influence on the community's image of the entire system. The public exposure is a considerable responsibility and community/parent pressure for winning performance is taxing, but must not override the objectives of good sportsmanship and good mental health.
  2. The position includes other unusual aspect such as extended time, risk injury factor and due process predicaments.
  3. It is the express intent of this job description to give sufficient guidance to function. In cases not specifically covered, it shall be assumed that a coach shall exercise common sense and good judgment.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Has knowledge of existing system, state and league regulations; implements same consistently and interprets them for staff.
  2. Understands the proper administrative line of command and refers all requests or grievances through proper channels. Is aware of all public/staff/departmental meetings that require attendance.

STAFF RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Established the fundamental philosophy, skills and techniques to be taught by staff. Designs conferences, clinics and staff meetings to insure staff awareness of overall program.
  2. Trains and informs staff, encourages professional growth by encouraging clinic attendance according to local clinic policy.
  3. Delegates specific duties, supervises implementation and, at season's end, analyzes staff effectiveness and evaluates all assistants.
  4. Maintains discipline, adjusts grievances and works to increase morale and cooperation.
  5. Performs such other duties which may be assigned by the athletic director/principal.

ADMINISTRATIVE DUTIES:

  1. Assists the athletic director in scheduling, providing transportation and requirements for tournament and special sport events.
  2. Assists in the necessary preparation to hold scheduled sport events or practices and adheres to scheduled facility times. Coordinates program with maintenance and school employees.
  3. Provides documentation to fulfill state and system requirements concerning physical examinations, parental consent and eligibility.
  4. Provides proper safeguards for maintenance and protection of assigned equipment sites.
  5. Advises the athletic director and recommends policy, method or procedural changes.

STUDENT RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Serves as a mentor to each athlete to promote the development and demonstration in student athletes the character traits of trustworthiness, respect, responsibility, fairness, caring, and citizenship.
  2. Gives constant attention to a student athlete's grades and conduct.
  3. By his/her presence at all practices games and while traveling, provides assistance, guidance and safeguards for each participant.
  4. Provides training rules and any other unique regulations of the sport to each athlete who is considered a participant.
  5. Initiates programs and policies concerning injuries, medical attention and emergencies.
  6. Completes paperwork on all disabling athletic injuries on proper forms and submits to athletic office within 24 hours.
  7. Directs student managers, assistants and statisticians.
  8. Determines discipline, delineates procedures concerning due process when the enforcement of discipline is necessary and contracts parents when a student is dropped or becomes ineligible.
  9. Assists athletes in their college or advanced educational selection.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Certified Teacher and/or ASEP Certification
  • CPR/AED Certification
  1. Has the ability to organize and supervise a total sports program.
  2. Has previous successful coaching experience in assigned sport. (Major sports)
  3. The head coach must have substantial knowledge of the technical aspects of the sport and, at the same time, must continue to examine new theories and procedures pertinent to the field.
  4. The head coach must serve as an appropriate role model for student athletes through his/her instructions and actions.

REPORTS TO: The athletic director, who provides overall objectives and final evaluation in conjunction with the high school principals

SUPERVISES: In several instances, the head coach must advise, coordinate and support a staff of high school assistant coaches and middle school coaches in conjunction with the athletic director and respective principal.

FINANCE AND EQUIPMENT:

  1. Participates in the budgeting function with the athletic director by establishing requirements for the next season. Recommends equipment guidelines as to type, style, color or technical specifications. Is responsible for operating within budget appropriations.
  2. Is accountable for all equipment and collects the cost of any equipment lost or not returned. Arranges for issuing, storing and reconditioning of equipment and submits annual inventory and current records concerning same.
  3. Properly marks and identifies all equipment before issuing or storing.
  4. Monitors equipment rooms and coaches' offices, authorizes who may enter, issue or requisition equipment.
  5. Permits the athletes to only be in authorized areas of the building at the appropriate times.
  6. Examines locker rooms before and after practices and games, checking on general cleanliness of the facility. Responsible for cleanliness and maintenance of specific sport equipment.
  7. Secures all doors, lights, windows and locks before leaving building if custodians are not on duty.
  8. Instills in each player a respect for equipment and school property, its care and proper use.

PUBLIC RELATIONS:

  1. Organizes parents, coaches, players and guests for preseason meetings.
  2. Promotes the sport within the school through recruiting athletes who are not in another sports program and promotes the sport outside the school through news media, little league programs, or in any other feasible manner.
  3. Responsible for the quality, effectiveness and validity of any oral or written release to local media.
  4. Responsible for maintaining good public relations with news media, booster club, parents, officials, volunteers and fans.
  5. Presents information to news media concerning schedules, tournaments and results.

Social- og sundhedsassistent søges til nyt kommunalt botilbud for voksne med udviklingshæmning og autisme

Vil du være med til at skabe rammerne for et helt nyt botilbud, hvor faglighed, relationer og udvikling går hånd i hånd?

På Solkrogen i Stenløse åbner vi dørene til et nyt §108-botilbud, og vi søger en engageret social- og sundhedsassistent, som ønsker at være med til at forme kulturen, fagligheden og hverdagen fra begyndelsen.

Solkrogen åbner den 15. februar og består af to afdelinger. Stillingen er til en afdeling med otte voksne borgere med udviklingshæmning og diagnoser inden for autismespektret. Borgerne har behov for en forudsigelig, tryg og struktureret hverdag med individuelt tilpasset støtte. Tværfagligt samarbejde, faglig refleksion og systematisk dokumentation er centrale elementer i vores praksis.

En unik mulighed for at være med fra starten

Hos os bliver du ikke en del af en eksisterende kultur. Du bliver medskaber af den.

Sammen udvikler vi arbejdsgange, samarbejdsformer og faglige løsninger med afsæt i borgernes behov og vores fælles ambition om høj kvalitet i indsatsen.

Vi søger derfor en kollega, som:

Motiveres af at være med til at bygge noget nyt op

Trives i udviklingsprocesser, hvor ikke alt er færdigdefineret

Er initiativrig og tager medansvar for fællesskabet

Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til et stærkt fagligt miljø

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

Yde en helhedsorienteret indsats tilpasset den enkelte borgers behov

Have ansvar for medicinhåndtering, herunder administration og dokumentation

Varetage sundhedsfaglig vejledning og oplæring af kolleger

Bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af Solkrogens kultur og praksis

Dokumentere og følge op på faglige indsatser

LINK TIL FUNKTIONSBESKRIVELSE

Vi søger dig, der:

Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent

Har viden om eller interesse for mennesker med udviklingshæmning og autisme

Er rolig, relationsstærk og fagligt nysgerrig

Møder andre med en anerkendende og undersøgende tilgang

Kan skabe struktur, tryghed og forudsigelighed i hverdagen

Trives i tværfagligt samarbejde og bidrager aktivt til fælles læring

Ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger i en opstartsproces

Kan formulere dig klart i skrift og tale, har erfaring med digital dokumentation

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på et nyt tilbud fra starten

Nærværende ledelse med fokus på faglig sparring og trivsel

Teammøder hver 14. dag

Fast supervision og neurofaglig sparring med ekstern supervisor

Gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling

En kultur præget af åbenhed, refleksion og fælles læring

Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter opgaven sammen

Kun 10 minutters gang fra S-tog og gode parkeringsforhold

Location – London / Frankfurt

JPMorgan Asset Management is establishing a senior EMEA role to develop and scale the commercial architecture for partnering with digital wealth platforms, covering digital distribution through online brokers, neobanks, robo-advisors, digital bank platforms and relevant B2B2C and model marketplace ecosystems.

The role will define, segment and prioritize EMEA digital wealth platforms, standardize commercial constructs and governance, and package propositions to accelerate growth across the breadth of JPMAM capabilities. It will focus on consistent multi-country execution of our strategy, supporting activity led by JPMAM’s country client coverage teams.

The role will report to the Head of Continental Europe Funds, and sit at the intersection of product, marketing, technology and platform teams. It will involve working hand-in-hand with country client coverage teams to grow digital wealth partnerships, and driving a consistent, scalable EMEA approach that reflects local market and regulatory dynamics, ensuring alignment across internal stakeholders.

The role will launch with one Associate reporting directly to the Head of Digital Wealth Solutions (EMEA).

Company Overview

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

J.P. Morgan Asset Management is committed to providing exceptional service to our clients and business partners. Our sales and client service teams, marketing support, and product specialists, are dedicated to the support of our clients and leverage the capabilities of our global firm to deliver to our clients. Our teams help our clients build stronger portfolios, for institutions, intermediaries and individuals alike. Our clients face an infinite set of portfolios building challenges. We meet them with a singular focus: to offer investment solutions designed to achieve their goals in the way that’s best for them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the EMEA digital wealth partnership strategy, and operating model, informed by market intelligence, commercial dynamics, partner operating-model trends and regulatory developments
  • Build and maintain an EMEA segmentation, tiering and prioritisation framework for digital wealth platforms, including online brokers, neobanks, robo-advisors, digital bank platforms, and relevant B2B2C and model marketplace ecosystems
  • Articulate and deliver JPMAM’s product and service offering for both platform ownaccount needs and end-client investment solutions. Engage with the broader J.P. Morgan organisation to leverage the best of the firm’s capabilities for the Digital Wealth segment
  • Partner with in-country client coverage to grow digital wealth relationships with a holistic approach across the JPMAM platform
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Insights to create thought leadership, co-marketing and investor education toolkits with platform partners
  • Orchestrate cross-functional delivery across Product, Operations, Client Service, Technology, Finance, and Legal, Compliance and Risk to ensure a consistent experience and value proposition for digital distributors

  • Represent the firm externally by engaging with industry stakeholders to build presence and credibility in the EMEA digital wealth ecosystem, in coordination with coverage and broader regional leadership

Required Experience And Skills

  • Experience of leading and partnering across a matrix organization, navigating complexities across different countries and markets
  • Proven capability in designing and implementing commercial frameworks and strategies across European markets
  • Strong analytical capability, including scenario modelling, performance management, and executive-ready materials with clear recommendations and trade-offs
  • Controls-by-design mindset, with a strong track record partnering with legal, compliance, risk and finance to establish governance and regulatory standards

  • Executive presence and communication skills to represent JPMAM credibly externally, with senior partner stakeholders and internal leadership

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in developing EMEA digital wealth partnerships within asset management, wealth platforms, fintech, banking or adjacent financial services. Completed in partnership with country organisation.
  • Experience with full spectrum of digital wealth solutions as well as placement mechanics and governance expectations
  • Experience with recurring investment features, savings plan mechanics and retirement system trends across relevant European markets, and how they shape digital investment propositions
  • Familiarity with platform integrations and platform-native readiness, including APIenabled connectivity and operational readiness
  • Multi-language capability across key EMEA markets

title: Linked Data Engineer - Maastricht
description:
Functiebeschrijving

Solliciteer snel! Er wordt een groot aantal sollicitanten verwacht voor de hieronder beschreven functie, wacht niet met het versturen van uw cv.

Is het jouw passie om data slim met elkaar te verbinden en mee te bouwen aan innovaties voor onze klanten? Heb je ervaring met Linked Data, datamodellering of knowledge graphs en wil je jouw expertise verder ontwikkelen? Als Linked Data Engineer versterk je ons groeiende multidisciplinaire SmartLab in Maastricht.


Jouw rol in ons team

Als Linked Data Engineer help je onze klanten om data uit verschillende interne en externe bronnen met elkaar te verbinden en betekenisvol toepasbaar te maken. Je analyseert data, werkt aan datamodellering en denkt mee over hoe organisaties hun data en kennis kunnen structureren, integreren en ontsluiten.


Je werkt aan knowledge graphs, datastromen en andere oplossingen rondom Linked Data. Je hebt ervaring met een deel van de relevante technologieën, zoals RDF(S), SPARQL, SHACL, OWL of SKOS, en wilt jouw kennis hierin verder verdiepen. Je krijgt ruimte om nieuwe technieken te leren en deze samen met collega's toe te passen in klantvraagstukken.


Je kijkt verder dan alleen de techniek. Je denkt mee met de business en het domein waarin je werkt en kunt technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk maken voor verschillende stakeholders. Binnen het multidisciplinaire SmartLab werk je samen met collega's met verschillende expertises en groei je mee met de data-innovaties die we voor klanten realiseren.


Hoe jij ons team versterkt

Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om met data te experimenteren en complexe vraagstukken op te lossen. Je hoeft niet alle onderdelen van het Linked Data-domein al te beheersen; belangrijker is dat je een sterke technische basis hebt, relevante ervaring meebrengt en jezelf verder wilt ontwikkelen in Semantic Web en Knowledge Graphs.


Dit ben jij:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding met een stevige IT-component, bijvoorbeeld Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence of een vergelijkbare richting;
  • Ervaring met Linked Data, datamodellering, Knowledge Graphs en/of andere semantic technologies;
  • Basiskennis van één of meerdere van de volgende technologieën: RDF(S), SPARQL, SHACL, OWL of SKOS;
  • Ervaring met data-integratie en het werken met verschillende interne en externe databronnen;
  • Kennis van cloudtechnologie, bij voorkeur Azure;
  • Affiniteit met AI-concepten en technieken en de verantwoorde toepassing hiervan;
  • Ervaring met Agile en/of DevOps;
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en analytisch vermogen;
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Engelse taal; Nederlands is een pré.

Het is een pré als je ook ervaring hebt met visualisatietools, Docker, Neo4j of vergelijkbare graph-technologie, of met het werken binnen innovatieve en multidisciplinaire omgevingen.


Een pre-employment screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.
Waar kom je terecht

Binnen Region Maastricht van CGI werken we vanuit een sterke regionale verankering samen met klanten aan digitale vraagstukken met zichtbare impact. Je werkt in een betrokken team met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en expertises. We werken dicht bij onze klanten, kennen hun omgeving en bouwen aan langdurige samenwerkingen. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om vanuit jouw expertise bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van onze klanten én onze regio.


Je komt terecht in ons SmartLab, waar we klanten helpen met het realiseren van hun nieuwste datagedreven innovaties. Door te werken met de nieuwste technologieën helpen we onze klanten verder in hun datagedreven reis. We zijn daarom op zoek naar professionals die mee willen denken over het ontwikkelen en implementeren van innovatieve oplossingen. Jouw kennis en expertise zijn nodig om de huidige en toekomstige uitdagingen van de wereld te overwinnen.


AI & Futureproof

Binnen CGI kijken we continu naar de impact van nieuwe technologieën op onze dienstverlening en de oplossingen die we voor onze klanten ontwikkelen. Ook ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en automatisering spelen hierin een steeds grotere rol.


Binnen het SmartLab onderzoeken we hoe Linked Data, knowledge graphs en AI samen kunnen worden ingezet om data beter te verbinden, te interpreteren en toepasbaar te maken. Als Linked Data Engineer krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise hierin toe te passen en verder uit te bouwen.


Waarom CGI

CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancybedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie-, transport- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld.


We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega's tot een succes maken.


Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook vaak leidt tot betere resultaten. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team!

title: Senior Manager, Product and Solutions
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Role Summary:
The Senior Manager, Products and Solutions is responsible for driving the development, commercialization, deployment and performance of products and solutions across multiple markets and client segments. The role identifies growth opportunities, defines product and go to market strategies, leads cross functional initiatives, and supports the successful implementation and adoption of innovative solutions.

Acting as a strategic advisor to both clients and internal stakeholders, the Senior Manager plays a key role in shaping business growth, enhancing customer value propositions and delivering solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, commercial acumen, client engagement and execution excellence to drive product and solution success in dynamic and evolving market environments.

The role requires the ability to work effectively across multiple geographies, diverse stakeholder groups and cross functional teams while managing several initiatives simultaneously.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools to support everyday work.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategy and Market Development:

  • Support the development and execution of product and solutions strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Identify market opportunities, customer needs and emerging trends to inform strategic priorities.
  • Analyze market dynamics, competitive activity and industry developments to support decision making.
  • Contribute to business planning, growth initiatives and commercialization strategies.
  • Develop business cases and strategic recommendations to support investment and expansion opportunities.
  • Represent the organization as a thought leader with clients, industry stakeholders and ecosystem partners.

Product Commercialization and Solution Delivery:

  • Lead the commercialization and deployment of products and solutions from concept through market implementation.
  • Drive market readiness and support launch activities for new products, capabilities and strategic initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross functional teams to ensure effective delivery and execution.
  • Support innovation initiatives and identify opportunities to enhance customer value propositions.
  • Manage product and solution roadmaps, implementation plans and adoption strategies.
  • Ensure successful integration of customer, business and operational requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Client Engagement and Business Growth:

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to identify growth opportunities and strengthen business relationships.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by providing strategic guidance, market insights and product expertise.
  • Develop tailored recommendations and solutions that address client needs and support business objectives.
  • Support client engagements, workshops, presentations and commercial discussions.
  • Contribute to business development initiatives, proposals and growth opportunities.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across client and partner organizations.

Program and Project Leadership:

  • Manage multiple strategic initiatives across different markets, business units and customer segments.
  • Establish project governance, implementation plans, milestones and success measures.
  • Monitor progress, risks, dependencies and execution challenges, ensuring timely resolution where required.
  • Align and coordinate stakeholders across business, technology, operations, marketing, finance and other functions.
  • Drive execution excellence and operational discipline to achieve business objectives.

Performance Management and Continuous Improvement:

  • Monitor product, solution and program performance against defined business objectives.
  • Track adoption, utilization, customer engagement and commercial performance metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize performance, improve customer experience and accelerate growth.
  • Develop reporting, insights and recommendations to support strategic and operational decision making.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, innovation and knowledge sharing.

Innovation and Industry Leadership:

  • Stay informed of emerging technologies, industry trends and evolving customer expectations.
  • Promote the adoption of innovative solutions and leading market practices.
  • Evaluate new opportunities that can enhance business performance and customer value.
  • Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams and stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the development of future product and solution capabilities.

  • Experience in organizing, managing, and implementing complex projects directly or through supervision.

title: Bayhost
description:
🚨 Immediate Hiring | Swing into a Job You’ll Love at Topgolf! ⛳🍔🎉#


THIS IS A FIXED TERM CONTRACT UNTIL JANUARY 10TH 2026


AGES 18+


At Topgolf, we believe in the unlimited power of play to drive fun, connection and innovation. Whether you work behind the scenes or directly engaging with Players, your role is key in bringing people together and redefining entertainment. We’re seeking fun-loving individuals who are serious about delivering excellence and results but who don’t take themselves too seriously. If you excel in a fast-paced, collaborative environment focused on creativity and incredible experiences, Topgolf is the place for you. Grow your career, make an impact and allow your individuality and ideas to fuel your success!


What We’re Seeking

Does hearing your favorite song make you spontaneously break out in dance? Does making someone else’s day special give you all the feels? Do you love waking up knowing no two days will look the same? If you answered yes to those questions, you’re the one we’ve been looking for! We’re seeking fun-loving, dedicated and caring team members for a variety of hourly positions who are fanatical about putting a smile on our Players’ and fellow Playmakers’ faces.


What’s In It for You?

  • Cha-ching: Our hourly wages are competitive, and tips are available for certain positions.
  • Benefits: Health, dental, vision, 401(k) playmaker match, free mental well-being platform – and that’s just for starters for those who qualify.
  • Flexibility: Day, night and weekend shifts are on the table, sure to satisfy both the part-time and full-time seeker.
  • Perks: Enjoy FREE game play, discounted food and retail items, and weekly Playmaker meals—get ready to be the most popular person in your friend group!
  • Career Growth: We don’t just say we offer career growth – we have countless examples of Playmakers who have skyrocketed within the brand as we love to promote from within!
  • Lots of Fun: We promise a playful environment where you can make new friends—what else would you expect from a company that’s all about FUN?

What You’ll Need to Succeed as a Bay host

  • A Positive Attitude – Because being a grump is no fun!
  • One Team Mentality – We believe the phrase “Teamwork makes the dream work” will never go out of style.
  • Player Focus: You obsess over making our Players’ experience the absolute best it can be.
  • Ability to Thrive in a Popular Environment: Keeping calm when things get popular is where you shine.
  • Experience Serving Food & Beverages – You’ve previously served alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks in a restaurant, hospitality, or entertainment setting.

What you will do in the role:

  • Role and Interaction with Players: Welcome Players to their bays with energy and enthusiasm—connect the dots on why they’re visiting, share all the cool things Topgolf has to offer, and set the stage for an unforgettable time. Actively recommend food, beverage, and gaming options tailored to their visit to enhance their overall experience and drive sales through thoughtful suggestive selling.

This role requires that you must be of legal age to serve alcohol {where required by law}.

title: Data Manager Building Experience & Excellence
description:
The team

You will be part of the Building Intelligence Team within the Building Experience and Excellence department. The Building Intelligence Team supports the BEE department by delivering reportings (PowerBI), managing the documentation & Assets, ensuring risk & compliance and managing the different toolings used by the department and ING employees.

As Data Manager, you Own and manage the BEE data backbone, analytics data model, BI roadmap, predictive models and AI use-case portfolio, ensuring data is governed, trusted, documented and fit for business use.

Your role & work environment

Acts as the bridge between business stakeholders and data solutions, translating operational needs and business questions into KPIs, dashboards, reports, analytical models and AI-enabled insights. Develops and continuously improves the BEE analytics ecosystem by designing and maintaining reporting products, analytics data models, KPI frameworks and self-service analytics solutions. Ensures reporting remains standardized, intuitive, consistent and aligned with business priorities and decision-making needs. Transforms governed data into trusted insights, actionable recommendations and decision-support tools, while promoting data quality, governance, self-service adoption and continuous improvement across BEE.


Your key responsibilities

Data & improvement projects

  • Ensure consistent, reliable and scalable reporting across BEE.
  • Partner with the Tooling Lead and Asset & Documentation Manager to enable effective data, tooling and documentation practices.
  • Support business improvement initiatives through performance measurement and analytics.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and process optimisation.

Analytics, BI & AI

  • Own the BI roadmap, KPI framework and Power BI dashboard portfolio.
  • Transform governed data into insights, reporting products and decision-support tools.
  • Develop and manage predictive models, AI use cases and self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Track and communicate the business value delivered through analytics, BI and AI initiatives.
  • Drive adoption and usage of BEE data, dashboards and analytics products, with accountability for agreed usage and engagement targets.

Data governance

  • Act as operational Data manager for BEE data assets, ensuring data quality, governance, compliance and business fit.
  • Maintain and evolve the BEE data model, business definitions and data standards according to the strategy.
  • Monitor data adoption, usage and trustworthiness across BEE, driving continuous improvement.
  • Align Data Owners, Data Users, analysts and engineers around a single source of truth.
  • Maintain end-to-end data lineage from source systems through transformations, KPI definitions, dashboards and AI outputs, ensuring traceability, auditability and trusted use of BEE data

What are we looking for

A colleague with a talent for taking it on and making it happen, enthusiasm for helping others to be successful and a knack for always being a step ahead. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast-changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.

As Data Manager, you will also need following competencies:


  • Stakeholder management to collaborate across and beyond BEE ensuring that the data is available and useable to deliver tailor made reporting to the different BEE departments.
  • Managing complexity to create a single source of truth (One central place for all BEE data).
  • Data collection & analysis to create value. You can pre-analyse data sources and deliver insights to support the business.
  • Data integration and automated data ingestion from internal and external systems (via APIs, database connections, file exchanges, or other available methods).
  • Python/SQL development for data extraction, transformation, and process automation.
  • Data pipeline design, implementation, and automation to make data from various systems readily available for analytics.

We offer you
A clear purpose, a unique offer and a range of flexible compensation and other benefits:

• The possibility to directly contribute to the sustainable growth strategy of ING Belgium, with a pivotal role in credit risk management.
• Get acquainted with complex and automated decisioning processes, applying an end-to-end bank’s perspective.
• An informal, dynamic environment with innovative colleagues supporting your endeavors.
• A progressive and agile way of working, where new ideas are valued ahead of convention.
• A well-functioning multi-cultural team with a good team spirit.

title: IT Application Owner (ITAO), AVP
description:

Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President

Role Description

  • The role's key responsibility is End to end application IT Governance in line with Bank’s policies, procedures and standards. The ITAO has to manage and maintain his application, ensuring compliance with applicable IT policies & procedures and with specific consideration to IT Management and Information Security policies.

What we’ll offer you

Planning/Organizing

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we’ll support you

About us and our teams

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

title: Financial Risk Specialist
description:
Your role & work environment

ING Belgium is looking for a Financial Risk Specialist within the ICAAP Analytics team. The role allows you to contribute to the ICAAP Analytics team which is responsible for overarching topics such as risk appetite setting, risk assessment and stress testing. Additionally, you help ING to define and steer its strategic objectives by proactively providing risk advice unlocking business potential.


Your key responsibilities

Support INGs strategic ambitions by proactively managing INGs risk appetite on Solvency risk.


  • Conduct the Identification and Assessment of risks across ING and ensure they are properly acted on.
  • Provide support on the execution of our must win battle on capital optimization
  • Assess business & financial plans against INGs solvency risk appetite & perform sensitivity and alternative scenario analysis.
  • Assess the impact of new regulations such as CRR3 and explain the interaction between regulatory capital and the Economic Capital perspective.

Positively impact the Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process within ING Belgium.


  • Being the second line of defense with respect to ICAAP and thereby working close together with Group Treasury/Capital Management.
  • Perform Economic Capital (EC) forecasting over the planning horizon, translating business-plan assumptions, portfolio developments, risk parameters and management actions into forward-looking EC projections.
  • Design, execute and challenge EC stress testing, including the translation of macroeconomic and idiosyncratic scenarios into impacts by risk type, aggregation of stressed EC results, analysis of diversification effects and interpretation of capital adequacy outcomes.
  • Translate EC forecasting and stress-testing results into clear management insights, key vulnerabilities, mitigating actions and decision points for senior leadership.
  • Yearly recalibrate solvency risk appetite and allocation to risk types

For this purpose, you will:


  • Develop a strong understanding of the methodologies, parameters, data flows and reporting infrastructure used to calculate Economic Capital across material risk types.
  • Understand the calculation of Credit Risk capital and provisions, including the related ING Group reporting infrastructure (Vortex) and management tools.
  • Maintain transversal contacts with internal and external stakeholders, including Risk, Finance, Capital Management, delivery tribes, ING Group, Front Office, subsidiaries and auditors.
  • Have direct exposure to ING's leadership and present complex EC analyses in a concise, decision-oriented manner.

We look for

A colleague with a talent for taking it on and making it happen, enthusiasm for helping others to be successful and a knack for always being a step ahead, who is interested in expanding its competences and leadership skills. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.


As a Financial Risk Expert within ICAAP analytics you will need:


  • Master's degree (Economics, Finance, other)
  • Relevant experience in Risk Management, Financial analytics, financial project management
  • A fluent level in English (written and oral communicator)
  • Demonstrated prior experience with Economic Capital in a banking or financial-services environment, including hands-on responsibility for EC calculation, forecasting, planning, reporting or stress testing.
  • Proven ability to perform multi-year EC forecasting, including identification of key drivers, reconciliation of movements, assessment of management actions and explanation of deviations against plan or prior forecast.
  • Proven experience in EC or ICAAP stress testing, including scenario translation, risk-type impact assessment, aggregation, diversification, sensitivity analysis and interpretation of results for capital adequacy.
  • Eagerness to learn and explore new ways of working and automations
  • Data-minded: Experience in SAS EG / credit reporting software is a plus
  • Be able to work both autonomously and in team.



We offer you

A clear purpose with

  • Personal growth & challenging work with many opportunities to increase your competences and build on the next step in your career
  • An informal, dynamic environment with innovative colleagues supporting your endeavours
  • Exposure to senior leadership of ING


We redefine banking. What about you?

There has never been a more interesting time to work at ING. We’re on a journey that’s centered around our customers, powered by technology and driven by smart, determined people. Our customers feel our people are empowering them to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We’re proud of that!

title: Informationssäkerhetsspecialist till Neonic
description: Gör säkerhet till en möjliggörare – och hjälp organisationer att fatta tryggare beslut i en allt mer komplex digital värld.Vill du arbeta med informationssäkerhet där du får påverka på riktigt – både hos kunden och i hur framtidens säkerhetsarbete utformas? Informationssäkerhet handlar inte längre bara om policys, ramverk och compliance. I en tid med ökade cyberhot, nya regulatoriska krav och allt mer komplexa verksamheter behöver säkerhet bli en naturlig del av hur organisationer fattar beslut och utvecklas. Välkommen till Neonic!Vi erbjuder digSom informationssäkerhetsspecialist hos Neonic hjälper du organisationer att gå från krav och ambitioner till ett säkerhetsarbete som faktiskt fungerar i praktiken. Ena uppdraget kan innebära att du utvecklar en informationssäkerhetsstrategi, nästa att du driver riskhantering eller en certifiering – och i andra sammanhang kan du arbeta nära en CISO eller själv kliva in och leda en säkerhetsfunktion.Samtidigt blir du en viktig del av Neonics fortsatta satsning inom cyber-, informations-, IT- och OT-säkerhet. Här får du inte bara leverera i dina uppdrag – du får vara med och påverka vad Neonic ska bli framåt.Vi erbjuder dig    Möjlighet att arbeta med komplexa och verksamhetskritiska frågor inom informationssäkerhet    Stor variation i uppdragen – från strategi och rådgivning till riskhantering, styrning och implementation    Möjlighet att påverka både dina kunduppdrag och utvecklingen av Neonics säkerhetserbjudande    En flexibel arbetsplats med högt i tak där du värderas för din kompetens och den du är – inte bara din debiteringsgrad    Kompetenta kollegor som gärna delar erfarenheter, utmanar etablerade arbetssätt och utvecklas tillsammansDet här gör du hos ossSom informationssäkerhetsspecialist arbetar du nära Neonics kunder för att etablera, utveckla och förankra ett hållbart säkerhetsarbete.Du behöver kunna förstå både verksamheten och säkerhetsperspektivet. Det innebär att du kan röra dig från övergripande strategi och regulatoriska krav till konkreta kontroller och arbetssätt – och få med dig organisationen på vägen.Beroende på din erfarenhet och uppdrag kan du bland annat:    Utveckla och implementera strategier för informationssäkerhet    Etablera och vidareutveckla styrning, riskhantering och efterlevnad    Leda initiativ inom exempelvis certifieringar och utveckling av riskhantering    Omsätta verksamhetsbehov till relevanta säkerhetskrav och kontroller    Stötta CISO och andra beslutsfattare i strategiska och operativa säkerhetsfrågor    Tillfälligt leda eller stötta kundens säkerhetsfunktion    Leda arbetet med att ta fram och förankra nya informationssäkerhetsstrategier    Skapa samsyn mellan verksamhet, IT, ledning och säkerhetsfunktionerDet betyder att du inte bara identifierar vad som behöver förändras. Du är också med och driver förändringen, skapar förståelse och ser till att säkerhetsarbetet får effekt i verksamheten.Ditt team och arbetsplatsNeonic vill vara den långsiktiga säkerhetspartnern som kunder kan lita på även när frågorna blir komplexa. Här kombineras specialistkompetens med ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt – rekommendationer och vägledning ska vara välgrundade, men också möjliga att omsätta i verkligheten.Du kommer in i ett bolag som växer och satsar stort på sitt erbjudande inom cyber-, informations-, IT- och OT-säkerhet. Det skapar utrymme för dig som vill mer än att gå in i ett färdigpaketerat konsultuppdrag.Har du idéer om hur ett arbetssätt kan förbättras, hur ett erbjudande kan utvecklas eller hur Neonic kan skapa ännu större värde för sina kunder finns möjligheten att vara med och driva det framåt.Kulturen är flexibel och prestigelös, med högt i tak och stort utrymme för egna initiativ. Här ska du kunna vara både specialist, rådgivare och kollega – och känna att din erfarenhet faktiskt tas tillvara.Mer om digVi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera informationssäkerhet i praktiken. Du förstår ramverk och regulatoriska krav, men framför allt förstår du hur de behöver omsättas för att fungera i en verklig organisation.Du är analytisk och trivs med att sätta dig in i verksamhetens behov, identifiera risker och översätta dem till relevanta säkerhetskrav, kontroller och åtgärder.För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du:    Har erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera informationssäkerhetsstrategier    Har arbetat med styrning, riskhantering och efterlevnad    Har god förståelse för ISO 27001 och NIST CSF    Kan omsätta verksamhetsbehov till konkreta informationssäkerhetskrav och kontroller    Är trygg i dialogen med både tekniska specialister, verksamhet och beslutsfattare    Har förmågan att driva frågor framåt och skapa förankring i organisationenDet är meriterande om du även har:    Erfarenhet av ytterligare standarder och ramverk inom informations- och cybersäkerhet    Arbetat med implementering av NIS2/CSL, GDPR, CRA eller annan relevant lagstiftning    Erfarenhet från tillverkande industri och/eller kritisk infrastruktur    Teknisk förståelse inom exempelvis nätverk, IAM, AWS, Azure eller GCPMen för att lyckas hos Neonic behövs mer än specialistkunskap.Du är social, kommunikativ och bra på att bygga förtroende. Du kan möta människor med olika perspektiv och skapa en brygga mellan verksamhet, teknik, säkerhet och ledning. Du förstår när du behöver utmana – och när du behöver lyssna.Framför allt drivs du av att göra informationssäkerhet begriplig, relevant och genomförbar. För när säkerhet fungerar som bäst är den inte bara något organisationen måste förhålla sig till – den blir en naturlig del av hur verksamheten fungerar och utvecklas. Så här får vi kontaktI den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryterings- och konsultupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: Payment Lifecycle Manager
description:
Join our team and shape the future of digital payments. Be at the forefront of revolutionizing payment operations, driving efficiency, and enhancing our financial systems. Unlock your potential and make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

As a Payment Lifecycle Manager I within Payments Operations, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our payment operations framework by streamlining processes, implementing new technologies, and developing operational functions. You will manage payment processing across various products, ensuring smooth fund transfers and reconciling purchase and sales options, futures, or securities, while leveraging your proficiency in automation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud awareness to ensure security and efficiency. Your ability to manage stakeholders, influence decisions, and handle conflicts will drive mutually beneficial outcomes, and your strategic planning skills will guide our direction and resource allocation decisions. Additionally, your proficiency in AI/ML will be utilized to solve complex problems and enhance processes, applying your knowledge in market product and process improvement to optimize operations.

Job responsibilities
  • Lead teams responsible for operational processes within the payments lifecycle by setting priorities, directing workflows, and monitoring performance against established metrics.
  • Oversee payment processing operations, setting daily production goals, delegating work, and implementing action plans to achieve strategic priorities, high productivity, quality, and enhanced client experience.
  • Manage daily operations, resolving production or quality issues, escalating process delays to management, and ensuring key control tasks are executed on business initiatives.
  • Apply strategic thinking and sound judgment in decision-making, while leveraging leadership, communication, and conflict resolution skills to build collaborative and engaged teams.
  • Participate in fraud detection and prevention, mitigating financial and reputational risks, and assist in strategic initiatives to align resource allocation with long-term goals.
  • Lead or contribute to projects related to client experience, process optimization, and provide expertise in automation, risk management, and compliance with operational guidelines.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Demonstrated ability in operations leadership or management within payments, with at least two years of experience, effectively leading high-performing and engaged teams to drive success.
  • Advanced knowledge of global payment processing operations, products, and systems architecture to support operational efficiency, change management, and issue management.
  • Proficiency in data analysis techniques, capable of interpreting and communicating insights to inform decision-making with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to apply a commercial and growth mindset to adapt to fast-paced operations environments and new business initiatives, leveraging strong interpersonal skills for collaboration.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity controls and anti-fraud strategies to identify and address potential threats, ensuring the protection of information and systems.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in using automation technologies to optimize payments processing, with a proven track record in enhancing customer experience throughout the customer journey.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Knowledge of ISO or Swift message processing or management.
  • Experience with operations, controls and problem solving related to Payments, Cash, Treasury Operations.
  • Experience in global payments and understanding of accounting and money movement processes.
