title: Kompetent sundhedsfaglig profil til hjælpemiddel- og forflytningsområdet, Hospitalsenhed Midt
description:
Vi søger en faglig dygtig sundhedsprofessionel medarbejder til undervisning og konsulentarbejde inden for hjælpemiddel og forflytningsområdet, der med solid faglighed, organisationsforståelse og gå på mod har lyst til at understøtte den fortsatte udvikling på området. Stillingen er en fast stilling på 37 timer og ønskes besat pr. 1. jan 2027.

Vi tilbyder
Hos os bliver du en del af et dedikeret team i HR Uddannelse og Arbejdsmiljø, hvor i alt 14 engagerede kolleger arbejder med uddannelse og arbejdsmiljø i de mange opgaver, fagligheder og sammenhænge, som et samlet akuthospital rummer. Opgaverne med hjælpemidler og forflytning varetages sammen med 4 nære kolleger.

Vi er et team med høj faglighed og et stærkt fokus på at skabe værdi for hospitalets afdelinger. Vi arbejder i en tid med store forandringer, hvor vi blandt andet bidrager til integration af voksenpsykiatrien og forbereder organisationen på nye opgaver som følge af sundhedsreformen.

Du vil få en bred vifte af samarbejdspartnere, både på sengeafsnit, i klinikker og i Servicecenteret. Vi forventer derfor, at du kan understøtte den faglige udvikling i organisationen, inspirere og trives med et bredt samarbejde. Det er vigtigt for os, at du benytter en anerkendende kommunikation og møder kolleger og samarbejdspartnere i øjenhøjde.

Du vil have kontorfaciliteter på Regionshospitalet i Viborg, og der kan være arbejdsdage på alle Hospitalsenhed Midt’s matrikler.

Dine arbejdsopgaver som underviser og konsulent omfatter, at:

  • understøtte afdelinger og centre i en systematisk tilgang til et sundt fysisk arbejdsmiljø
  • drifts- og indkøbsopgaver i henhold til forflytningshjælpemidler og bariatriske hjælpemidler
  • selvstændig forflytningsundervisning efter oplæring
  • udarbejdelse af retningslinjer for området med afsæt i arbejdsmiljølovgivning
  • understøtte en fortsat udvikling af forflytnings- og hjælpemiddelområdet i samarbejde med arbejdsmiljøorganisationen
  • planlægge og afholde temadage
  • understøtte HE Midts’s forflytningsvejledere i deres arbejde i afdelingerne
  • afholde og fortsat udvikle HE Midt’s forflytningsvejlederuddannelse
  • deltage i praktiske opgaver i forhold til logistik og kvalitetssikring af hjælpemidler
  • udføre supervision og andre ad hoc-opgaver i afsnit og klinikker

Vi forventer, at du:

  • har en autoriseret sundhedsfaglig uddannelse
  • gerne har praktisk erfaring inden for hjælpemiddel- og forflytningsområdet
  • kan varetage forflytningsundervisning, i tæt samarbejde med kollegerne i forflytningsteamet
  • er serviceminded og imødekommende
  • er indstillet på fleksibel arbejdstid, dog primært hverdage i tidsrummet ml 7.30 og 15:30
  • har kørekort og gerne bil til rådighed, da vi arbejder på 11 matrikler i Region Midtjylland

Vi tilbyder:

  • at du bliver en del af et yderst engageret team
  • at du kan få solid oplæring og udvikle stærke kompetencer inden for arbejdet med hjælpemidler, forflytning og fysisk arbejdsmiljø
  • at du deltager i kvalitets- og udviklingsarbejde inden for forflytningsområdet
  • en stor daglig kontaktflade til mange dele af Hospitalsenhed Midt
  • en dynamisk arbejdsplads, hvor vi lægger vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø, humor og at fællesskabet fungerer både fagligt og socialt

Vil du vide mere?
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til hjælpemiddelansvarlig Linda Romedahl på tlf. 51 62 49 57 eller hjælpemiddelkonsulent Sanne Lindblad tlf. 23 10 32 54.

Ansøgning
Ansøgning med din motivation for at søge stillingen og oplysninger om uddannelse og hidtidig erfaring skal være os i hænde elektronisk senest den 18. november 2026.
Samtaler holdes tirsdag den 24. november. Hvis du inviteres til samtale, ringer vi til dig fredag den 20. november.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst på området.
Med henvisning til lov om børneattest i forbindelse med ansættelse af personale m.v., vil der blive indhentet børneattest i forbindelse med eventuel ansættelse.
Ansættelse sker ved Region Midtjylland med tjeneste indtil videre ved Hospitalsenhed Midt, læs mere om den samlede hospitalsenhed her, Administrationen.

Ansættelsen sker ved Hospitalsenhed Midt, læs mere om den samlede hospitalsenhed her www.hospitalsenhedmidt.dk
Interesserede ansøgere, uanset personlig baggrund, opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.
Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse. Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

description:
Please note that this opportunity is offered on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Emirates NBD is a market leader across the MENAT (Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye) region with a presence in 13 countries, serving over 9 million customers. There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.

title: Data Governance Manager
description: We have come a long way in our digital transformation, and we are now looking for a Data Governance Manager, who will ensure data governance practice and strengthen our ability to manage data as a strategic asset within MSF Sweden. In this role, you will lead and coordinate data governance initiatives across the organization. You will work closely with stakeholders from different departments to establish clear ownership of data, improve data quality, support compliance requirements, and ensure that data is managed consistently and responsibly throughout its lifecycle.The roleYou will facilitate collaboration between business and technical teams, helping define standards, policies, and processes that enable trusted and well-governed data. You will also contribute to the continued development of our data management capabilities, including data cataloguing, data stewardship, and master data management. The role also involve implementing measures to ensure data security, confidentiality and regulatory compliance.Further responsibilities:    Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of data governance policies, standards, and processes across MSF Sweden.    Facilitate collaboration between departments to establish common definitions, ownership, and accountability for key data domains.    Lead data stewardship initiatives and support stakeholders in managing data quality and lifecycle activities.    Support the development and adoption of data cataloguing and master data management practices.    Monitor and improve data quality through governance frameworks, controls, and reporting.    Ensure that data management practices comply with organizational policies and applicable regulations.    Participate in security and compliance initiatives related to information and data management.    Act as an internal advisor and advocate for data governance best practices.        System owner: Responsible for the data management platform, data storage solutions, compliance tools and other tools in the data management systems portfolio.We are looking for you with    At least 3 years of experience working with data governance,data management, master data management, data quality or similar roles.    Experience in implementing or supporting data governance frameworks, policies, and processes.    Ability to engage and collaborate with stakeholders across different functions and levels of the organization.    Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.    Strong technical understanding and experience with data management tools and technologies such as SQL, ETL processes, data warehouses, and data integration tools.    Excellent analytical skills and experience using data analysis tools.    Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and understandably to non-technical stakeholders.    Strong problem-solving skills and experience in addressing data quality issues.    Knowledge of relevant data protection and data security laws and regulations, such as GDPR.        Fluency in English, written and spokenYou need to be driven, take initiative and be confident as one of the few experts within the area of the organization in Sweden. title: Manager, Product Management - Card Customer Resiliency: Recoveries Offers Delivery
description:
Manager, Product Management - Card Customer Resiliency: Recoveries Offers Delivery

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.


Why Team Customer Resiliency

There has never been a better time to work at the heart of Capital One’s mission. After a frenzied few years reacting to the COVID pandemic’s up-ending of millions of customers’ lives, the Card Customer Resiliency team has embarked on an unprecedented journey to modernize our technology, elevate the voice of our most vulnerable customers, and innovate rapidly to define industry norms of what caring for customers truly means. Every member of our team is united in our passion to treat customers with dignity, clarity and respect. We build the experiences that allow struggling customers to responsibly manage their debt and understand what is best for them in the long-run.


Approximately 1 in 4 adult Americans has a Capital One or Discover Card at any moment in time. Due to the excellence in underwriting, we provide credit access deeper than any of our competitors. Over 30 million of our Card customers typically go delinquent in a given year, the largest pool of DQ customers in America. Our team cares for these customers in their most vulnerable moments, including job loss, healthcare troubles, natural disasters, and other major life events that lead to financial hardship. Managing credit risk isn’t just about understanding access to credit but holistically understanding what happens when that access doesn’t take the path intended.


Team Offers

Our offer programs serve as the vital framework through which we empower customers to resolve outstanding balances, frequently by extending significant concessions to those facing the most acute financial pressures. With millions of individuals engaging with these programs annually, your work will directly impact a massive population, guiding them through periods of instability toward a future of sustainable credit health.


We are driven by a singular ambition: to fundamentally accelerate our delivery of new relief initiatives while enabling the deep personalization required to meet every customer exactly where they are in their journey.


Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product Management:

  • Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
  • Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
  • Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
  • Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
  • Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
    • A Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field), Business or Marketing

OR

  • Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 3 years of Product Management experience


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer)

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

title: Property Services Coordinator
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Shaping the future of real estate for a better world

At JLL, we see a Brighter Way forward for our clients, our people, our planet, and our communities. With over 200 years of real estate experience, we are, and always have been, in continual pursuit of brighter ways of working.

We bring to life a Brighter Way in all that we do by seeking better, smarter, more innovative ways of working. We approach our work in a warmer, more optimistic, and inclusive way.

JLL is a global leader in helping clients envision where people will live, work, play, shop, and eat.

What this opportunity involves:

We are looking for a dedicated and customer-focused Property Services Coordinator to join our team, supporting a multi-client portfolio across property and facilities management. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for client calls and requests, responsible for ensuring every issue is resolved quickly, efficiently, and with a strong focus on customer satisfaction. We believe the most effective teams are built when everyone is empowered to thrive, and as a Property Services Coordinator, you will play a vital part in building lasting client relationships while developing your own skills in property management, vendor coordination, and problem solving. This is a fast-paced, relationship-driven role suited to someone who stays calm under pressure, takes ownership of outcomes, and genuinely enjoys helping people.

An overview of the role:

  • Answer incoming calls from a multi-client portfolio and ensure requests are addressed promptly and professionally
  • Analyze caller needs and determine the best strategy to respond, ensuring superior customer satisfaction
  • Resolve and coordinate the resolution of customer issues, escalating critical matters when further assistance is required
  • Measure costs against established service provider guidelines and track work orders through to completion
  • Approve invoices, arrange payment, and liaise with the Accounts Payable department on vendor payment queries
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client personnel over time
  • Capture information accurately in internal systems while continuing to engage with clients on the phone
  • Remain calm and composed during emergencies, such as fire alarms or bomb threats, following established procedures
  • Support the training and onboarding of new Property Services Coordinators through a buddy system

Sounds like you? This is what we are looking for:

  • A tertiary qualification in a real estate–related field is preferred; experience in the property industry is an advantage
  • Strong working knowledge of MS Word and Excel, with typing speed of 50 to 60 words per minute
  • Previous experience in property management, including an understanding of landlord and tenant responsibilities and commercial lease agreements
  • Ability to administer service agreements and interpret lease documentation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a clear and professional telephone manner
  • A proactive, solution-focused mindset with the ability to distinguish between symptoms and root causes of a problem
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure and tight deadlines
  • A collaborative team player who thrives in a relationship-based work environment and supports others in achieving shared goals
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and customer-service oriented, with the initiative to work effectively with minimal direction

Benefits:

  • Great employee discounts off fitness, wellbeing & other renowned brands
  • 18 weeks paid maternity leave
  • Private Health Insurance Discounts
  • Active Social Club
  • Employee assistant program
  • Novated Lease for EV cars
  • Paid time off for volunteer work
  • Career Opportunities with Australia's #1 Commercial Real Estate firm
  • Premium offices

What you can expect from us:

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where the best inspire the best. Where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things. Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sight and imagine where JLL can take you.

As an organisation, we don’t just accept that we are a place of many different people, but we embrace it, we celebrate it, and we proactively support the needs that difference brings. JLL is committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, age, sexual orientation or disability, and that is why, for more than a decade, we continue to rank among the World’s Most Ethical Companies. We are dedicated to offering veterans from all ranks and services a successful civilian career as they transition out of the military. We recognise and appreciate the skills acquired in their service careers as vital and transferable to our workforce.

title: [Vacatures] Springbok zoekt een Medior Data Engineer
company: Marketing Report (een B2B nieuwsplatform voor marketeers)
description:
Start als Medior Data Engineer



Zorg ervoor dat al uw sollicitatiegegevens up-to-date en in orde zijn voordat u op deze vacature solliciteert.
Jouw functie in een notendop

Als data engineer bij Springbok ben je onderdeel van ons 40-koppige datateam, bestaande uit specialisten op het gebied van data engineering, marketing analytics, data science, media strategie, media measurement en natuurlijk AI agents. Binnen Springbok Data zijn functies en verantwoordelijkheden niet zwart/wit. Op basis van ervaring, kwaliteiten, ontwikkelpunten en ambities kijken we naar de beste verdeling van klanten, taken en projecten. Dat betekent dat je altijd op verschillende manieren met data werkt, je rol veel afwisseling kent en je veel verschillende skills ontwikkelt. Beerpong is hier ook een serieuze skill.


Wat je gaat doen?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van data- en marketingtechnologie in de cloud (bij voorkeur Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery).
  • Het uitvoeren van periodieke en ad hoc data-analyses in big data.
  • Het signaleren en proactief kenbaar maken van kansen voor optimalisatie, conversie, segmentatie of automatisering bij onze klanten.
  • Het bedenken en optimaliseren van datastromen met behulp van cloud infrastructuren.
  • Het begeleiden van implementaties van analysetools en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe dashboards, rapportages en tools om data op een aantrekkelijke manier te visualiseren.
  • Commercieel gevoel: je ziet kansen bij de klant en weet die te vertalen naar oplossingen én naar business.
  • Ervaring met en kennis van CDP's (zoals Tealium en Hightouch).

Jouw (groeiende) vaardigheden

  • Je hebt minimaal 2-3 jaar ervaring;
  • Je hebt een proactieve instelling.
  • Je werkt graag in teamverband.
  • Plezier en geluk is een belangrijk aspect in je werkende leven.
  • Je bent een ontdekker, nieuwsgierig en leergierig.
  • Je hebt tijdens je studie of in pre-werkende leven of je eerdere baan ervaring opgedaan met data, verschillende skills rondom python of SQL.
  • Een afgeronde studie waar Data Science en/of Marketing Analytics een onderdeel van was is een pré.

Wat je krijgt als Data Engineer

  • Wij begrijpen dat salaris een belangrijk aspect is. Daarom bespreken we jouw salariswensen (op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring) tijdens ons eerste contactmoment.
  • Ontwikkel jezelf verder bij onze Springbok academy. Je haalt bij ons hard -en softskills certificeringen en we gaan graag met je in gesprek over jouw ambities op de lange(re) termijn. Daarnaast mag je 10% van je werktijd aan je eigen ontwikkeling spenderen.
  • Een keuze uit een dienstverband van 32, 36 of 40 uur per week. Daarnaast kan je er 28 dagen per jaar (op basis van 40 uur) lekker tussenuit en er is een goede balans tussen thuis werken, op kantoor of bijvoorbeeld in de Spaanse zon.
  • We voorzien je van een telefoon en laptop naar keuze! Gebruik je liever je eigen nummer en telefoon? Dan krijg je een netto vergoeding van €30,00 per maand.
  • Hoe jij naar kantoor komt (OV of auto), dat bepaal je helemaal zelf: ook een E-bike behoort tot de mogelijkheden!
  • We hebben een pensioenregeling via Nationale Nederlanden en je kunt tot 40% goedkoper sporten via onze bedrijfsfitnessregeling.
  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden? Samen met je teamlead werk je aan de beste versie van jezelf! Bij Springbok stimuleren we groei met bijbehorende levels. Wij geven jou het doel, hoe je dat bereikt is aan jou.
  • Het leven moet je vieren! Een cadeautje na het doorlopen van je proeftijd,een lunch met je team in je inwerktraject, verjaardag en andere bijzondere gebeurtenissen.
  • Jaarlijks organiseert de Springbok feest & sportcommissie leuke activiteiten als: padeltournooien, wijn -en bierproeverijen, uitjes inclusief overnachting, bordspel avonden en nog veel meer!

Zijn wij een match?

  • Nieuwe terreinen verkennen Of "We doen het altijd al zo, dus het is goed" - Ontdek je innerlijke Christoffer Columbus. Jij bent een echte ontdekker en wilt graag nieuwe dingen leren. Je bent nieuwsgierig tot op het bot.
  • Solosport Of Teamsport - Teamsport. - Jij werkt graag in teamverband. Talent wins games, but teamwork and intelligence win championships!
  • Python. Grote slang Of Programmeertaal - Programmeertaal. Jij hebt tijdens je studie, in pre-werkende leven of voorgaande baan ervaring opgedaan met data, Python en/of SQL. Bij voorkeur heb je Informatica, Data science, Marketing analytics of een vergelijkbare opleiding afgerond.

Wie is Springbok?

Springbok is een digitaal & creatief bureau voor positieve groei, met 5 kantoren verspreid over Nederland en België. Samen met ambitieuze merken creëren we duurzame groei die goed is voor de planeet, geweldig voor de mens en uitstekend voor bedrijven. xgiwjmb En dat doen we met een team van meer dan 400 getalenteerde strategen en dataspecialisten.

Apply your technical knowledge and problem-solving methodologies across multiple infrastructure platforms and applications .

title: Merchandise Planner
description:
More about the role

In this role you will develop an understanding and expertise about your category of products and will be the driver of sales and margin. Taking responsibility for a trading category you plan, control and monitor the purchasing, intake and launch of products and ranges. You will work collaboratively with key stakeholders to resolve all issues efficiently and effectively.

Some of your responsibilities will include:

  • As the planning expert, advising wider teams of the needs of our customer for your category, the construction of ranges and products attributes. Working in collaboration with business colleagues to manage stock, availability, waste/shrink and markdowns for all the products.
  • Manage availability of products through appropriate channels such as communication to stores, supply chain, logistics, marketing and any other relevant departments and ensuring you are working in the right way to allow your buying colleague the opportunities to manage the supplier relationships effectively.
  • Giving the category team relevant admin, analysis or task support as required.
  • Negotiating with suppliers to optimise value (including sales and margin) and operational efficiencies around product sourcing, supply, availability for the appropriate time.
  • Exploring opportunities for sales and margin for your category of products, being able to articulate this in a plan with targets, for the next 12 months.
  • Being an active member in the category trading cell developing an understanding for buying, quality assurance and supply chain
  • Working closely with your supply chain colleague to ensure stock values are maintained, the Open To Buy process is followed and toxic stock is reduced

More about you



For this role, we’re looking for someone who has:

  • The ability to seek customer perceptions and motivations to inform and drive improvements, and translate these into sales and margin for Morrison's.
  • Ability to interpret the market and make recommendations to maximise sales & margin.
  • The ability to influence with effective interpersonal skills, other teams, such as Supply, Technical, Pricing etc, to drive delivery of your annual plan.
  • Analytical thinking – manage multiple data sources and make the appropriate decisions for sales, stock, markdown and profit
  • Ability to manage OTB Experience
  • The ability to use financial analysis and customer data to create and deliver a business plan, which delivers increased brand perception, sales and profit.
  • An ability to build relationships with key stakeholders & suppliers.
  • A track record of project managing and driving the benefits from an annual plan.
  • An ability to trade within the constraints of trading standards and legal compliance. Stockflow and stocks in line with targets

More about our perks

We value your hard work and commitment, and in return, we provide:

  • Generous holiday entitlement
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • 15% discount in our supermarkets and convenience stores from the day you join us
  • Additional 10% discount card for a friend or family member
  • Genuine career progression and development opportunities - read more about our Leadership School here
  • Healthcare / Wellbeing benefits including Aviva Digital GP
  • 'MyPerks' with discounts at high street shops, cinemas and gyms, and lots more
  • Optional payroll charity donations
  • A range of family-friendly policies including 26 weeks maternity and adoption leave along with neonatal and fertility leave


Alive with activity, our modern Head Office is home to our corporate teams that make sure everything runs smoothly. Here, you’ll find comfy breakout areas, a coffee shop, Morrisons Daily and a subsidised restaurant. We are within commuting distance of Leeds, Manchester and the Yorkshire Dales - and we even have free parking!

At our Head Office you will expect to find supplier showcases, charity fundraising and celebrations all year round for the events that mean the most to our colleagues.

There’s more to our business as it’s fast paced and ever changing, as such we’ve got lots of fresh opportunities for you to play your part in our success. We’d love to meet you!

title: Software Engineer III- Java
description:
Job Summary:


As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the International Private Bank, you will play a key role in designing and delivering secure, stable, and scalable technology products. You’ll work as part of an agile team, carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas to support our business objectives. Your contributions will help improve software applications and systems, while fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration. You will be empowered to leverage advanced tools and practices to drive continuous improvement and deliver high-quality results.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Execute software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting to build innovative solutions and address complex technical challenges
  • Create secure, high-quality production code and maintain algorithms that integrate seamlessly with systems
  • Leverage enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools to enhance code quality, delivery speed, and productivity, validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards
  • Apply knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle, including AI-assisted development and automation, to maximize automation value
  • Produce architecture and design artifacts for complex applications, ensuring design constraints are met during software development
  • Gather, analyze, synthesize, and develop visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets to drive continuous improvement
  • Proactively identify hidden problems and patterns in data to improve coding hygiene and system architecture

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts
  • Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
  • Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
  • Experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation, with ability to critically evaluate and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations
  • Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle

title: Bliv en del af opstarten og vær med til at sætte dit præg på Solkrogen
description:
Pædagog søges til nyt kommunalt botilbud for voksne med udviklingshæmning og autisme

Vil du være med til at skabe rammerne for et helt nyt botilbud, hvor faglighed, relationer og udvikling går hånd i hånd?

På Solkrogen i Stenløse åbner vi dørene til et nyt §108-botilbud, og vi søger en engageret pædagog, som ønsker at være med til at forme kulturen, fagligheden og hverdagen fra begyndelsen.

Solkrogen åbner den 15. februar og består af to afdelinger. Stillingen er til en afdeling med otte voksne borgere med udviklingshæmning og diagnoser inden for autismespektret. Borgerne har behov for en forudsigelig, tryg og struktureret hverdag med individuelt tilpasset støtte. Vi arbejder ud fra en neuropædagogisk referenceramme, low arousal-principperne og en recovery-orienteret tilgang med fokus på mestring, selvbestemmelse og livskvalitet. Tværfagligt samarbejde, faglig refleksion og systematisk dokumentation er centrale elementer i vores praksis.

En unik mulighed for at være med fra starten

Hos os bliver du ikke en del af en eksisterende kultur. Du bliver medskaber af den.

Sammen udvikler vi arbejdsgange, samarbejdsformer og faglige løsninger med afsæt i borgernes behov og vores fælles ambition om høj kvalitet i indsatsen.

Vi søger derfor en kollega, som:

Motiveres af at være med til at bygge noget nyt op

Trives i udviklingsprocesser, hvor ikke alt er færdigdefineret

Er initiativrig og tager medansvar for fællesskabet

Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til et stærkt fagligt miljø

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

Yde en helhedsorienteret indsats, tilpasset den enkelte beboers særlige behov.

Dokumentere og følge op på delmål og faglige indsatser.

Samarbejde tæt med pårørende og eksterne samarbejdspartnere

Bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af Solkrogens kultur og praksis

LINK TIL FUNKTIONSBESKRIVELSE

Vi søger dig, der

Er uddannet pædagog

Har viden om eller interesse for mennesker med udviklingshæmning og autisme

Er rolig, relationsstærk og fagligt nysgerrig

Møder andre med en anerkendende og undersøgende tilgang

Kan skabe struktur, tryghed og forudsigelighed i hverdagen

Trives i tværfagligt samarbejde og bidrager aktivt til fælles læring

Ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger i en opstartsproces

Kan formulere dig klart i skrift og tale, har erfaring med digital dokumentation

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på et nyt tilbud fra starten

Nærværende ledelse med fokus på faglig sparring og trivsel

Teammøder hver 14. dag

Fast supervision og neurofaglig sparring med ekstern supervisor

Gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling

En kultur præget af åbenhed, refleksion og fælles læring

Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter opgaven sammen

Kun 10 minutters gang fra S-tog og gode parkeringsforhold

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt, men vi er åbne for andre ønsker.

Arbejdstiden ligger mellem kl. 06.30 og 23.00 med dag- og aftenvagter samt arbejde hver anden weekend. Der kan forekomme enkelte lange vagter.

Ansættelse fra 1. februar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Der afholdes samtaler i uge 49 og 50.

Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

title: Planner Scheduler
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.

A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

Job Summary





To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a Planner Scheduler located in Bukit Minyak, Penang.

What a typical day looks like:

  • Checking the possibility of order fulfillment based on the available resources (materials, employees, equipment’s etc.), confirmation of the order.
  • Preparation of production plans, input of planning data into the integrated computer system of the company, notification of the purchasing group.
  • Monitoring, controlling implementation of plans, starting necessary actions in case of deviations
  • Preparation of long-term plans, forecasts (MPS, Forecast).
  • Monitoring of system accuracy in daily/weekly bases /General Item data, routing, BOM, CFT data /non-consumed demand, planned WO's.
  • Preparing Clean to build reports, checking the material availability, replanning if necessary, informing of order desk, ECO implementation tracing.
  • Monitoring of stock level, handling of stock differences.
  • Preparing management and CFT specificized reports, monitoring KPI's.
  • Giving assistance, replacement in certain cases to SCM and Order desk within the CFT.
  • Advises non-exempt associates regarding day-to-day priority of customer requests.
  • Monitors and proactively addresses issues that impact performance to committed ship date (CSD), lead-time, response time, and inventory goals.
  • Coordinates and manages high-visibility and/or important customer programs.
  • May include initial customer or product startup initiatives or large customer programs.
  • Coordinates with Master Scheduler to manage product life cycle and related materials availability issues.
  • Drives process improvements inside and outside the area of Order Management.
  • Provides input to management, reschedules, and /or interfaces with customer program management, master scheduling, customers, and production control to reschedule production in the event of design changes, labor and material shortages, backlogs, and other potential schedule interruptions.
  • Represents Order Management on various Customer Focus Teams.
  • May also help inventory control, supply chain management, material planning, and scheduling.

The experience we’re looking to add to our team:

  • Typically requires a bachelor’s degree or minimum 5 years’ relevant experience as Planner in related field with background in electronics manufacturing is preferred.
  • Demonstrates basic people and/or process management skills

What you’ll receive for the great work you provide:

  • Full range of medical benefits, dental, vision
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Allowances & Bonuses

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
About Springer Nature

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest

number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands,

trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and

services that help researchers uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health

professionals stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators advance learning. We are

proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share

knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world.


About the Brand

The Data & Analytics Solutions – IT team builds flagship products such as SpringerMaterials,

Experiments, ADIS Insight, and TDM. Our developers, QAs, business analysts, UI/UX experts,

and SMEs collaborate to ensure easy accessibility of relevant data. We follow a problem

statement and user experience–driven approach to deliver the right data in the simplest way for

the scientific community.


About the Role

As a Senior Quality Analyst in Springer Nature, you will play a key role in ensuring

the reliability and scalability of our digital products. You’ll architect and evolve automated testing

frameworks, mentor developers in quality practices, and collaborate with global teams across

Germany, UK, and India. This role offers the opportunity to shape testing strategies, influence

product architecture, and contribute to impactful solutions used by the scientific community

worldwide.


Role Responsibilities


● Architect, develop, and maintain robust, extensible automated testing frameworks that

align with SN-Software Engineering & Systems Integration standards.

●Mentor developers and guide effective testing practices, fostering accountability and

embedding SN-Quality Management principles across the team.

●Define and communicate best practices, guidelines, and standards for test automation,

ensuring compliance with SN-Governance, Risk and Compliance Management.

●Create and manage comprehensive test suite strategies, applying SN-Process &

Systems Design to focus on high-value scenarios and optimize reliability.

Analyze test results, optimize coverage, and uphold application reliability, leveraging

SN-Data Analytics / Quantitative Skills for evidence-based decision-making.

●Collaborate with stakeholders and product managers to align testing with business

needs, demonstrating strong SN-Decision Quality and SN-Accountability.

●Stay abreast of emerging tools and practices, proactively implementing improvements

that support SN-Continuous Improvement and SN-Process Optimization.

Support global teams in design, implementation, and release from an automation

perspective, effectively managing complexity through SN-Manages Complexity.●

●Diagnose live issues and propose innovative solutions, applying SN-Problem Solving &

Innovation to prevent recurrence and strengthen system resilience.

●Guide teammates, onboard new members, and foster knowledge-sharing, reinforcing

SN-Mentorship & Leadership while embedding a culture of quality.


Experience, Skills & Qualifications

Essential

●6–10 years of experience as a Senior Quality Analyst, Automation Engineer, or similar role.

●Expertise in scalable test automation frameworks and manual testing fundamentals.

●Strong proficiency in programming languages (Java, Scala, Python, JavaScript, React).

●Proven experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG).

●End-to-end testing experience (UI, API, database).

●Familiarity with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured).

●Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling).

●Strong database testing skills (SQL and NoSQL).

●Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Concourse).

●Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.


Desirable

●Experience with accessibility testing tools (Axe, WAVE).

●Exposure to cloud-based testing environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

●Knowledge of security testing methodologies and tools (Burp Suite).

●Certification in testing methodologies (e.g., ISTQB).

●Experience applying AI/ML techniques to quality assurance workflows (e.g., intelligent

test case generation, anomaly detection, predictive defect analysis) to increase

productivity and efficiency.


What you will be doing:


Within 3 Months you will:


●Get familiar with our technology stack. Our application is built in Java,Scala and React,

Docker, Unix. Our applications is deployed to GCP.

●Get to know the various Stakeholders and their general requirements.

●Take part in reducing technical debt by working with team mates to add test coverage.

●Get to know all members of the team.


By 3-6 months you will:


●Have a basic understanding of the team’s context, product’s business model.

●Build more knowledge of the product, domain and mentor new teammates.

●On-board new team members and setup their machines and help them get up to speed

fast.

●Be able to understand and discuss business requirements with stakeholders and

●Product Managers and help other disciplines with these conversations.

●Gain trust and confidence of project stakeholders.

●Hold technical discussions with the team in order to improve the product architecture and

code quality and build more understanding of the overall product.


By 6-12 months you will:


●Build solid understanding of the product’s business domain and have a technical

expertise to participate in discussion for Design and architectural changes.

●Onboard new members to the team or help other teams in the onboarding process.

●Transform high level requirements into actionable work.

●Work with global teams on plan, Design, implementation from an

●Automation perspective and release.

●Architect, develop, and maintain a robust, extensible automated testing

framework for a product in Java/Scala for a product and help the team to

solve different scenarios innovatively to avoid issues in LIVE.

●Proactively provide useful and actionable feedback to all team members and

stakeholders.

●Triage support queries and diagnose issues in the live applications.

title: Analytics Solution-Associate
description:
You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in Transformation. You have found the right team. Join Payments Finance Transformation to accelerate reporting automation and process modernization. You will build production-grade data pipelines, automated financial planning and analysis workflows, and standardized dashboards that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and enable faster decision-making. This role partners closely with planning and analysis leads, Business Managers, Controllers, and Product teams to translate finance requirements into repeatable solutions with strong controls and governance.

As an [associate within Payments Finance Transformation, you will accelerate reporting automation and process modernization by building production-grade data pipelines and automated workflows. You will deliver standardized dashboards and governed self-service views that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and enable faster decision-making. You will partner closely with planning and analysis leads, Business Managers, Controllers, and Product teams to translate finance requirements into repeatable solutions with strong controls and governance. You will implement data quality checks, reconciliation controls, and documentation to support auditability and consistent outcomes. You will communicate progress, outcomes, and control considerations clearly to senior stakeholders.

Job responsibilities

  • Build and deploy end-to-end automation for financial planning and analysis processes, including data preparation, validation, reconciliations, key performance indicator production, and scheduled runs, using Python, SQL, and Databricks
  • Deliver Sigma dashboards to consolidate and rationalize recurring reports into a smaller set of standardized, governed self-service views
  • Set automation standards, mentor other developers, and partner with senior finance and product leaders to deliver measurable business outcomes
  • Develop and maintain finance-ready data models, including actuals, projections and forecast, and headcount and expense drivers, with clear metric definitions and drill paths
  • Partner with stakeholders to define requirements, success metrics, and adoption plans, and convert ambiguous questions into deliverable backlogs and prototypes
  • Implement data quality and controls, including reconciliation checks, completeness rules, threshold alerts, and documentation to support auditability and consistent outcomes
  • Support migration and modernization efforts by reducing reliance on manual workflows and fragmented tooling, including streamlining or re-platforming legacy workflows where applicable
  • Perform user acceptance testing planning and support, production validation, release notes, and stakeholder training and documentation to drive sustained adoption
  • Communicate progress and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders, including what changed, impact, risks and controls, and next steps
  • Apply analytics techniques for anomaly detection, variance driver analysis, and forecast input validation, leveraging approved tooling and governed datasets

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline
  • 10+ years of experience in automation, business intelligence development, and data analytics
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills, including data transformation, automation, performance tuning, and robust error handling
  • Hands-on experience delivering solutions with Databricks
  • Experience building business intelligence dashboards with strong user experience and governance (Sigma preferred; Tableau or Qlik acceptable)
  • Experience with HTML and React dashboards
  • Ability to use AI tools for automation
  • Ability to translate financial planning and analysis and business problems into repeatable automated workflows with measurable efficiency gains
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including ability to explain logic, assumptions, and controls

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience rationalizing report inventories, including consolidation, standard definitions, and adoption tracking
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts, including access controls, sensitivity handling, metric definitions, and lineage and runbooks
  • Experience migrating legacy automation tooling into Python and Databricks, where relevant
  • Certifications in relevant tools (optional; not required)

title: Lead Solution Analyst - Technical Program Manager
description:
Lead the forefront of innovative solutions analysis in a dynamic tech environment, driving success through expertise in data analytics and technical program delivery.

As a Lead Solutions Analyst at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank's Post Trade Technology team, you will play a pivotal role in the Tradevault FICC Program (Project Starship), responsible for seamless onboarding, migration, and control of Pre-Trade datasets into Tradevault. This role will drive data democratization, ensure robust data controls, and support the decommissioning of legacy platforms, enabling Tradevault to serve as the Markets Authoritative Data Store (ADS) for Pre-Trade data. You will be responsible to collaborate closely with Sales, Trading, Surveillance, and Technology teams to deliver high-quality, timely, and accessible data solutions.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the onboarding of Pre-Trade datasets from FICC Sales and Trading Order Management Systems (OMS) into Tradevault, ensuring standardization via JPFIX and creation of semantic data views for Surveillance consumption.
  • Partner with upstream and downstream teams to map, transform, and validate data flows, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage the migration of Pre-Trade Surveillance feeds from Macro Kdb to Tradevault, coordinating the decommissioning of all Macro Kdb feeds related to Order and RFQ data to SAGE.
  • Oversee the migration of F&O flows for semi-overlay markets from SAGE to Tradevault, driving improvements in control and operational efficiency.
  • Design, implement, and monitor end-to-end data controls for completeness, quality, and timeliness across all FICC data flows into Tradevault and onward to SAGE.
  • Proactively identify and remediate data quality issues, collaborating with technology and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity.
  • Champion data democratization by enabling secure, governed, and user-friendly access to Pre-Trade datasets within Tradevault.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, data catalogs, and training materials to support data consumers across the organization.
  • Act as a key liaison between Sales, Trading, Surveillance, and Technology teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment on data onboarding priorities and timelines.
  • Track and report on onboarding progress, risks, and issues, providing regular updates to program leadership.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in business solutions analysis, technical program delivery, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support solutions analysis workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
  • Ability to review and validate AI-assisted analyses and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling expectations.
  • Advanced knowledge of data analytics techniques(database query skills) , with experience in developing and interpreting models, diagrams, and data-driven insights, including data visualization using approved tools
  • Strong track record of leading through change, navigating ambiguous situations, and managing dependencies in complex projects.
  • Good co-ordination skills to work in partnership with users, project manager and developers

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience in one of these: Surveillance, Regulatory reporting or data warehousing

title: Senior Engineer - Test & Validation
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with test requestors, product engineering teams, and other stakeholders to understand test objectives, validation requirements, and success criteria, and to develop test setup concepts, execution plans, and schedules.
  • Support engineering project teams in the development and execution of DVP&R (Design Verification Plan & Report), including risk evaluation, validation strategy input, and technical coaching as needed.
  • Review test data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and prepare professional test reports that clearly summarize test methods, results, conclusions, risks, and recommendations.
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) for test setup, test execution, data collection, and laboratory practices, while ensuring adherence to established standards and processes.
  • Stay current with applicable international, industry, and internal testing standards, validation practices, and laboratory processes relevant to HVAC and refrigeration products and components.
  • Provide day-to-day coaching, technical direction, and work coordination to Test Technicians to ensure testing deliverables are completed safely, accurately, and on schedule.
  • Maintain the integrity of engineering and laboratory systems by reinforcing process discipline, documentation quality, traceability, and the consistent use of standard work.
  • Promote awareness and implementation of industry standards and best practices, with particular emphasis on technology, safety, and quality in laboratory operations.
  • Deliver ongoing technical training and knowledge-sharing to technicians, engineers, and the broader engineering community as needed.
  • Support the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous reliability of laboratory infrastructure, including breakdown maintenance, sensor calibration, and DAQ system upkeep.
  • Troubleshoot HVAC and refrigeration test units, including challenges related to refrigeration system performance, controls, instrumentation, and test setup functionality.
  • Contribute to safe, efficient, and compliant lab operations while supporting cross-functional project execution and business priorities.

Key Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of HVAC&R product and component testing and validation standards.
  • Ability to manage psychrometric laboratory operations, testing priorities, and execution schedules.
  • Strong capability in test data interpretation, engineering judgment, and deriving meaningful conclusions.
  • Demonstrated commitment to Engineering Process Excellence, documentation rigor, and standard work discipline.
  • Experience in instrumentation selection, commissioning, and integration with data acquisition systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills in HVAC&R test units, including refrigeration system performance and electrical controls.
  • Strong technical foundation in thermal calculations, including psychrometric and refrigeration system analysis.
  • Familiarity with sheet metal structure design and engineering tools such as AutoCAD and/or Pro/E.
  • Strong project management, planning, and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Technical leadership and coaching capability for technicians and engineering teams.
  • Focus on safety, quality, continuous improvement, and laboratory operational excellence.

B.Tech Mechanical, 3+ Years of experience in HVAC&R Product Testing.

description:

Assistant manager

Ground Transport - Helpdesk & Command Center

What this job involves

Job Description - Operations, Helpdesk & Command Center Management

1. Role Purpose

The Assistant Manager – Helpdesk & Command Center will be responsible for the end-to-end management of Helpdesk and Command Center operations supporting employee transportation services.

The role will lead and guide the Helpdesk and Command Center teams to ensure that employee queries, calls, emails, walk-ins, trip-related concerns, service disruptions, delayed vehicles, safety alerts and operational exceptions are handled promptly and professionally.

The position will also be responsible for real-time monitoring of login and logout transportation operations through the designated technology platform, ensuring adherence to defined SOPs, SLAs and KPIs, managing vendor performance, reporting operational metrics, escalating service disruptions, and maintaining accurate operational records.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Team Management & Operational Leadership

  • Lead, supervise and guide the Helpdesk and Command Center teams across daily transportation operations.
  • Allocate responsibilities and ensure adequate coverage based on operational requirements, shift timings and peak transportation hours.
  • Provide clear instructions to team members regarding Helpdesk processes, trip monitoring, escalation protocols, safety procedures and stakeholder communication.
  • Conduct regular team briefings and shift handovers to ensure continuity of operations.
  • Ensure all team members follow established SOPs, escalation matrices, communication protocols, SLAs and KPIs.
  • Coach the team on professional communication, incident handling, employee interaction and effective problem resolution.
  • Identify recurring operational gaps and initiate corrective and preventive actions.

B. Helpdesk Operations Management

  • Ensure that all inbound calls, emails and employee walk-ins received by the Helpdesk are acknowledged, addressed, tracked and closed within the applicable SLA.
  • Monitor open employee queries and ensure timely follow-up until satisfactory closure.
  • Ensure transportation-related concerns such as cab allocation, pickup/drop issues, vehicle delays, route concerns, employee no-shows and booking-related queries are handled appropriately.
  • Review pending and ageing Helpdesk cases and escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate stakeholder.
  • Ensure Helpdesk personnel maintain professional and consistent communication with employees, vendors and stakeholders.
  • Monitor the quality and accuracy of Helpdesk responses and ensure proper documentation of cases and resolutions.

C. Login & Logout Trip Monitoring

  • Ensure all scheduled login and logout trips are monitored by the team through the designated transportation technology platform.
  • Track trip lifecycle activities including vehicle assignment, reporting status, employee pickup/drop progress, route movement, trip commencement and trip completion.
  • Ensure exceptions or deviations identified through the technology platform are investigated and actioned promptly.
  • Monitor peak login and logout windows closely and ensure potential operational risks are proactively escalated.
  • Coordinate with vendors and ground operations teams to resolve vehicle or trip-related concerns with minimum disruption to employees.

D. Delayed Vehicle Management

  • Ensure delayed reporting vehicles and delayed trips are identified through the Command Center monitoring process.
  • Coordinate with the respective transportation vendor to understand the reason for delay and establish immediate corrective action.
  • Ensure affected employees and relevant stakeholders receive timely updates wherever required.
  • Track repeated vehicle/vendor delays to identify service-performance trends.
  • Maintain an appropriate record of delays, reasons, vendor responses and corrective actions.

E. Vendor SLA & KPI Governance

  • Track vendor performance against agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Validate vendor breaches relating to vehicle delays, non-reporting, service failures or other applicable contractual requirements.
  • Ensure valid SLA/KPI breaches are documented with adequate supporting data and evidence.
  • Recommend/apply penalties in accordance with the agreed contractual penalty framework.
  • Prepare and provide validated vendor penalty data to the Billing/Commercial team within the defined billing cycle and timelines.
  • Maintain proper reconciliation and supporting records for penalties levied.
  • Review recurring vendor failures and escalate performance concerns to GT management for corrective action.

3. Command Center Responsibilities

A. Real-Time Transportation Monitoring

  • Oversee the centralized Command Center monitoring of all employee login and logout trips.
  • Ensure the team actively monitors the transportation dashboard and operational screens throughout the respective shifts.
  • Track trip execution and deviations in real time rather than depending solely on post-operation reports.
  • Identify operational exceptions
  • vendors, GT operations, Helpdesk or other relevant stakeholders for resolution.

B. Traffic & Operational Disruption Communication

  • Monitor traffic conditions and transportation disruptions affecting employee movement.
  • Track disruptions within and outside the premises, including access restrictions, road closures, unusual congestion or other events affecting transportation operations.
  • Communicate relevant disruptions proactively to employees, internal stakeholders, vendors, leadership and client representatives as applicable.
  • Provide clear information on the impact, expected delay, affected services and corrective/alternative arrangements wherever available.
  • Ensure significant operational disruptions are escalated through the agreed communication and escalation matrix.

C. Safety Alert Monitoring

  • Monitor transportation-related safety and security alerts generated through the designated dashboards/technology platforms.
  • Validate alerts promptly and determine whether intervention or escalation is required.
  • Coordinate with the applicable GT, vendor, safety or security stakeholders for timely resolution.
  • Ensure safety alerts are acknowledged, investigated, actioned and closed in accordance with the applicable SOP and escalation matrix.
  • Maintain records of alerts, actions taken, escalation details and closure status.
  • Immediately escalate critical or high-severity safety incidents in accordance with the incident-management protocol.

4. Key Reporting & Governance

The Assistant Manager will own Helpdesk and Command Center operational reporting and ensure that reports are accurate, validated and published within agreed timelines.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Validate and publish Hourly Inbound OTA / On-Time Arrival performance updates to senior leadership and client stakeholders.
  • Review daily login/logout performance and service-delivery metrics.
  • Ensure Helpdesk call, email, walk-in and query volumes are appropriately captured.
  • Track open, closed, pending and SLA-breached Helpdesk cases.
  • Maintain delayed vehicle and trip-delay reports.
  • Maintain vendor-wise SLA/KPI performance reports.
  • Maintain vendor penalty and service-breach trackers.
  • Maintain Command Center exception and incident records.
  • Validate safety-alert reports and closure status.
  • Ensure all scheduled daily, weekly and monthly Helpdesk/Command Center reports are published within defined timelines.
  • Validate reports before submission to ensure data integrity and consistency.

Good communicator

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable data pipelines and high‑performance analytical solutions using SQL/BigQuery, Spark/PySpark, and Python on Google Cloud. This role focuses on building reliable, cloud‑native data products that enable advanced reporting, analytics, and decision‑making across the organization.


Responsabilities

  • Build scalable data pipelines: Design and deliver batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines across cloud environments to support analytics and reporting.
  • Develop SQL and BigQuery solutions: Write and optimize advanced SQL transformations and build performant, cost‑efficient BigQuery data models.
  • Develop Python workflows: Implement scalable data processing solutions using Python and PySpark, ensuring maintainable and high‑quality code.
  • Design data models and ensure quality: Build robust data models and apply validation practices to maintain accuracy and reliability.
  • Build cloud‑native data solutions: Use GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Pub/Sub, and GCS to build and operate modern data platforms.
  • Optimize performance and reliability: Troubleshoot complex pipeline issues and continuously improve compute, storage, and processing performance.
  • Collaborate using strong engineering practices: Work with engineering, analytics, and business teams while contributing to CI/CD, code reviews, and testing standards.

Skills

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building scalable data pipelines and working with cloud-based data ecosystems.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and hands‑on experience building performant datasets in BigQuery (or similar cloud data warehouses).
  • Proven experience with Python and PySpark for scalable data processing in distributed environments.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ELT/ETL patterns, and data quality best practices.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer, GCS, or equivalent cloud data services.
  • Hands‑on experience building scalable data pipelines (batch and near real‑time) in a cloud‑native environment.
  • Proficiency with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and optimize performance across compute, storage, and processing layers.
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform, Ansible, Chef).
  • Knowledge of shell scripting.
  • Experience in financial services or regulated environments

Well-being & Benefits

Emotionally and mentally balanced: We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health.

  • Empowering managers who value your ideas and decisions. Show your positive attitude, determination, and open-mindedness.
  • A professional, passionate, and fun workplace.
  • A modern office with fun and relaxing areas to boost creativity.
  • Continuous learning culture with coaching and support from team experts.
  • A culture where you can openly speak about mental health.

Physically thriving: We support you managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive. For example, Private healthcare and life insurance with premium benefits for you and discounts for your loved ones, healthier ways of working and check-up's.

Socially connected: We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open-up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being.

  • 24 days holiday, loyalty days, and bank holidays (including weekdays for weekend bank holidays).

  • Enjoy retailer discounts, cultural and CSR activities, workshops, and more.

Financially secure: We support you to meet personal financial goals during your active career and for the future.

title: Portfolio Implementator
description:
Portfolio Implementator

ING Private Banking & Wealth Management

A day in the life of a Portfolio Implementator

  • You construct and manage discretionary portfolios by translating the Investment Office strategy, model portfolios and instrument selection into individual client portfolios.
  • You apply the defined level of personalisation within each client’s mandate, risk profile and investment restrictions, while maintaining consistency with ING’s investment strategy and portfolio-management framework.
  • You monitor and rebalance portfolios, including asset-allocation deviations, cash positions, liquidity needs and mandate-specific constraints.
  • You coordinate the timely and accurate implementation of investment decisions with the Investment Office, client-facing Portfolio Managers, Risk, Compliance and Operations.
  • You analyse portfolio performance and performance attribution. You translate the results into a clear and personalised narrative for Portfolio Managers, explaining the main performance drivers in the context of each client’s portfolio, strategy and specific positioning.
  • You contribute to improving the tools, data, processes and controls supporting consistent, efficient and scalable discretionary portfolio management.

How to succeed

We hire people for their potential and expect them to remain curious, keep learning and take ownership. In return, we support their continued professional development.

As a Portfolio Implementator, you:

  • Have a strong understanding of financial markets, multi-asset portfolio construction, asset allocation and discretionary portfolio management.
  • Combine investment judgement with a disciplined and accurate approach to portfolio implementation, investment restrictions, risk limits and controls.
  • Can analyse portfolio performance and attribution and explain complex investment outcomes in a concise, portfolio-specific and accessible manner.
  • Work confidently with portfolio-management systems and data and actively contribute to improving their quality, reliability and scalability.
  • Collaborate effectively with investment specialists, Portfolio Managers and operational and control functions.
  • Take ownership, identify deviations or implementation risks and address or escalate them appropriately.

As a Portfolio Implementator, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Contribute to the development of ING’s future discretionary portfolio-management model.
  • Work across different investment strategies, risk profiles and levels of defined personalisation.
  • Develop recognised expertise in portfolio construction, investment implementation and performance attribution.
  • Help shape the tools, standards and processes that make discretionary portfolio management more consistent, controlled and scalable.
  • Work closely with experienced colleagues across Portfolio Management, the Investment Office and other specialist functions.

The team

You will join the broader Portfolio Management team within ING Private Banking & Wealth Management. The team is responsible for delivering ING’s investment proposition through discretionary and advisory portfolio management.

In this role, you will work closely with the Investment Office, client-facing Portfolio Managers, Trading, Risk, Compliance and Operations. Your focus will be on portfolio construction, disciplined investment implementation, performance analysis and narrative and the continuous improvement of the supporting portfolio-management framework.

title: Data Engineer Microsoft Fabric
description:
Bouw vanaf de basis mee aan het nieuwe dataplatform van RAI Amsterdam! Binnen RAI Amsterdam bouwen we aan een nieuw dataplatform dat de manier waarop we data ontsluiten en gebruiken fundamenteel verandert. Je stapt niet in een omgeving waarin alles al vaststaat. Het platform is recent opgezet en wordt nog volop ingericht. Daardoor krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken, technische keuzes te maken en direct invloed uit te oefenen op de verdere ontwikkeling.


Is dit de volgende stap in uw carrière? Ontdek of u de juiste kandidaat bent door het volledige overzicht hieronder te lezen.

Je werkt met Microsoft Fabric en bouwt mee aan een modern cloud dataplatform waarin data uit verschillende systemen en domeinen samenkomt. Niet als gebruiker van een bestaande omgeving, maar als Data Engineer die het platform mede vormgeeft. Je komt terecht in een groeiend team. Daarom zoeken we een tweede Data Engineer.

In deze rol combineer je data engineering, datamodellering en platformontwikkeling. Je onderzoekt hoe systemen en databronnen zijn opgebouwd, bepaalt hoe we data ontsluiten en ontwerpt oplossingen waarmee data betrouwbaar beschikbaar komt voor analyses en rapportages.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Engineer Microsoft Fabric speel je een belangrijke rol in het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van ons nieuwe dataplatform. Je werkt op het snijvlak van technologie, data en business en vertaalt informatiebehoeften naar toekomstbestendige technische oplossingen.

Omdat het platform nog volop in ontwikkeling is, heb je directe invloed op de architectuur, structuur en technische standaarden. Je denkt niet alleen mee over wat we bouwen, maar ook over hoe we ervoor zorgen dat het platform schaalbaar, veilig en beheerbaar blijft.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van het dataplatform binnen Microsoft Fabric.

  • Het verkennen en ontsluiten van data uit uiteenlopende bronsystemen.

  • Het ontwikkelen van betrouwbare en schaalbare data pipelines en notebooks voor het verzamelen, transformeren en laden van data.

  • Het inrichten van ETL- en ELT-processen binnen een moderne cloud data-omgeving.

  • Het ontwerpen en implementeren van datamodellen die aansluiten op de informatiebehoefte van de organisatie.

  • Het onderzoeken van bestaande systemen en databronnen en bepalen hoe deze optimaal kunnen worden geïntegreerd.

  • Het meedenken over data-architectuur, technische standaarden en de verdere inrichting van het platform.

  • Het bewaken en verbeteren van datakwaliteit, performance, security en beheerbaarheid.

  • Het beschikbaar maken van betrouwbare data voor analyses, rapportages en Power BI.

  • Het samenwerken met de Product Owner, analisten, IT-collega’s en stakeholders uit de business.

  • Het onderzoeken van nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen Microsoft Fabric en toepassen van technologieën die waarde toevoegen.

  • Het actief bijdragen aan de groei en professionalisering van het data- en analyticslandschap van RAI Amsterdam.

Je komt in een fase waarin het platform nog volop wordt opgebouwd. De komende jaren verschuift de focus geleidelijk van bouwen naar optimaliseren en doorontwikkelen. Daardoor krijg je de kans om eerst mee te bouwen aan de technische fundering en vervolgens een belangrijke rol te spelen in de verdere groei en volwassenwording van het platform.

Wat maakt deze rol interessant? Dit is geen functie waarin je uitsluitend bestaande data pipelines beheert. Je krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken over fundamentele keuzes en ziet jouw ideeën terug in de uiteindelijke inrichting van het platform.

Je werkt met Microsoft Fabric, doet ervaring op met een modern cloud data platform en krijgt te maken met data uit verschillende systemen en domeinen binnen RAI Amsterdam. De combinatie van pionieren, ontwikkelen en samenwerken maakt deze rol interessant voor een Data Engineer die verder wil kijken dan alleen de technische uitvoering.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe systemen werken en krijgt energie van een omgeving die nog niet volledig is uitgedacht. Je kunt zelfstandig technische oplossingen ontwerpen en bouwen, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op met collega’s uit IT en de business. Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in IT, Informatica, Data Science of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Enkele jaren relevante werkervaring als Data Engineer, BI Engineer, Data Platform Engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Ervaring met SQL, datamodellering en het ontwikkelen van data pipelines.

  • Ervaring met ETL- en/of ELT-processen voor het verzamelen, transformeren en beschikbaar maken van data.

  • Kennis van moderne cloud data platforms, bij voorkeur binnen Microsoft Azure en/of Microsoft Fabric.

  • Ervaring met het ontwerpen van betrouwbare en schaalbare data-oplossingen.

  • Affiniteit met datawarehousing, lakehouse-concepten, data-architectuur en analytics.

  • Het vermogen om technische vraagstukken begrijpelijk uit te leggen aan collega’s met verschillende achtergronden.

  • Een analytische en onderzoekende manier van werken.

  • Eigenaarschap, initiatief en de bereidheid om mee te denken over keuzes die nog niet vastliggen.

  • Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal uitstekend, zowel in woord als geschrift.

Wat bieden wij jou?
