title: Electronics and Data System Engineer
description:
About the Company

Established in 2017, Infinite Orbits is a NewSpace company, based in Toulouse, pushing the boundaries of in-orbit services with cutting-edge spacecraft driven by its own Rendez-Vous solution, an advanced Autonomous Vision-Based Navigation Solution. IO has two generations of missions

  • "Orbit Guard" provides Inspection and Space Situational Awareness services in GEO. Our first, OG-1 was launched on 1 May 2023, the second is launching in 2025 and the third third launching in 2026.

  • "Endurance" is a docking service capable of extending the life of GEO telecom satellites, by taking over AOCS takeover for 5 years.

About the Role

As an Electronics and Data System Engineer for Infinite Orbits' GEO satellite missions, you will define, design, and validate the spacecraft’s onboard data handling architecture. You’ll specify functional and performance requirements for the Data Handling (DHS) subsystem, interface with onboard software and avionics teams, and ensure full integration and verification of DHS functions throughout Assembly, Integration, and Testing phases.

Job Description

  • Define onboard DHS architecture, including central OBC, mass memory, TM/TC interfaces, and data buses (RS-422, Ethernet, CAN).

  • Specify redundancy logic and autonomous switching mechanisms; maintain functional ICDs with onboard and external systems.

  • Develop FDIR strategies and implement software monitoring capabilities for DHS.

  • Coordinate with AIT teams to define and review DHS functional test procedures, TM/TC validation campaigns using EGSE/CCS, and interface verification (electrical, software, protocol).

  • Support development and automation of test scripts for PUS service verification; lead DHS-related test readiness reviews and resolve anomalies during integration.

  • Review supplier deliverables, test reports, and integration plans for DHS equipment.

  • Validate end-to-end TM/TC data flows in simulations, hardware-in-the-loop setups, and the final spacecraft configuration.

  • Interface with Ground Segment teams to validate SCOS MIBs and operational TM/TC logic.

Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Avionics, Embedded Electronics, or related field

  • 5+ years of professional experience in satellite avionics or onboard data systems architecture.

  • Deep understanding of ECSS-E-ST-70-41 (PUS), CCSDS TM/TC protocols, and avionics redundancy concepts.

  • Proven experience testing DHS at unit and system level during AIT campaigns.

  • Familiarity with SCOS-2000, EGS-CC, or equivalent checkout systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical reviews, produce interface documentation, and support AIT test phases.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English for technical documentation and collaboration.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Python or Tcl-based TM/TC scripting in AIT environments.

  • Hands-on use of real-time simulation tools (e.g., SIMSAT, emulators).

  • Prior involvement in payload or platform TM/TC ICD validation.

  • Experience collaborating with flight software integration teams.

What we offer

  • The opportunity to be part of an international team transforming the space industry.

  • A creative and innovative work environment where ideas turn into reality.

  • Competitive salary and benefits.

title: IPS-konsulent med Vejviserfunktion i Ungeløftet Haderslev
description:
Vil du være med til at løfte unge ind i fællesskaber, job og uddannelse?
Vil du gøre en forskel for unge mennesker, der har brug for støtte, retning og relationer? Har du blik for både det enkelte menneske og den samlede indsats?

Om os

Vi tror på, at alle unge fortjener muligheden for at lykkes i job og uddannelse – og vi ved, at det kræver samarbejde, mod og tillid.

Ungeløftet Haderslev er et flerårigt udviklingsinitiativ, der skal styrke overgange, skabe jobåbninger og etablere stærke fællesskaber for unge mellem 18 og 29 år. Som IPS-konsulent med Vejviserfunktion bliver du en central aktør i dette arbejde. Du skal ikke blot støtte unge med psykiske vanskeligheder i at komme i job eller uddannelse – du skal også være med til at binde indsatsen sammen med den socialpsykiatriske indsats og bringe IPS-metoden i spil på tværs.

Om stillingen

Som IPS-konsulent med Vejviserfunktion får du både opgaver i jobcenteret og hos Vejviseren. Du kommer til at være den, der kan skabe sammenhængskraft på tværs sammen med de unge og engagerede, kompetente og erfarne kolleger fra begge områder.

Du kommer til at:

  • tilrettelægge individuelle, håndholdte forløb for unge med psykiske udfordringer – med fokus på progression, håb og styrker. Det drejer sig om unge der har brug for en snak om det der fylder og/eller støtte til at takle hverdagen, samt er motiveret for at komme i job eller uddannelse via en IPS-indsats
  • være den der kan bidrage til sammenhængskraft
  • arbejde tæt sammen med virksomheder, psykiatrien og øvrige aktører for at skabe realistiske og meningsfulde job- og uddannelsesmuligheder
  • arbejde med råd og vejledning, som en del af en forebyggende rehabiliterende og recovery-orienteret indsats
  • dokumentere og registrere indsatsen i relevante fagsystemer, herunder bidrage til kvalitetsmålinger og opfølgning på resultatkrav.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er uddannet socialrådgiver/socialformidler, eller har anden relevant uddannelse
  • har solid erfaring med jobrettet arbejde og kendskab til det lokale arbejdsmarked
  • har gode relationelle kompetencer samt kommunikativ styrke – og kan skabe kontakt, opbakning og retning i mødet med både unge og samarbejdspartnere
  • står godt i dig selv og har et fagligt nysgerrig og undersøgende mindset, samt er metodisk velfunderet
  • evner at arbejde selvstændigt og i team, målrettet, struktureret og tværfagligt med udgangspunkt i borgerens mål
  • har blik for at udvikle og koordinere en fælles retning i en kompleks og tværfaglig virkelighed
  • har kørekort.

Vi tilbyder:

  • mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i unges liv – med metode, mandat og mening
  • en tværfaglig funktion i et ambitiøst udviklingsprojekt med stort lokalt ejerskab og stærke samarbejdspartnere
  • mulighed for at være en del af teams med høj faglighed, kollegialt fællesskab og en uformel tone – hvor vi fejrer det, vi lykkes med
  • gode rammer for faglig udvikling, herunder IPS-uddannelse, sparring og ledelsesmæssig opbakning.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Forventet tiltrædelse den 1. januar 2027.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst.
For at sikre fuld gennemsigtighed kan vi oplyse, at stillingens lønramme ligger i intervallet mellem 35.000 kr. og 37.000 kr. Den endelige placering i intervallet baseres på objektive kriterier som f.eks. relevant uddannelse og dokumenteret erhvervserfaring.

Ved ansættelse vil der blive indhentet referencer og en straffeattest.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer.

Interesseret i jobbet?

Har vi vakt din nysgerrighed, og har du yderligere spørgsmål, så kontakt afdelingsleder Tine K. Nielsen på telefon 23 41 50 21.

Her kan du også læse mere om IPS-metoden.

Ansøgningsfrist og samtaler

Send din ansøgning, CV og bilag via ansøgningsknappen senest den 22. november 2026.

Der afholdes 1. samtale den 24. november 2026 og 2. samtale den 27. november 2026. Der vil indgå en case i 2. samtale.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Om Haderslev Kommune
Vi er en organisation med ambitioner for både Haderslev Kommune og os selv. Vi arbejder målrettet og nytænkende, skaber resultater sammen og tør sigte højt. Hos os er dialog og fællesskab nøglen til udvikling – på tværs af fag, borgere, erhvervsliv, foreninger og politikere. Derfor er vores ambition, at vi inden 2030 har 250 flere i uddannelse, 500 flere indbyggere og 1.000 flere arbejdspladser. Alt det kan du blive en del af med et job hos os.

title: Projektassistent til Montage og Service (Kolding eller Aalborg)
description:
Er du den, der skaber overblik og får tingene til at hænge sammen?

Hos Spæncom søger vi en Projektassistent, der kan understøtte vores montageledelse og serviceafdeling med administrative opgaver. Du bliver en vigtig del af hverdagen og hjælper med at sikre, at dokumentation, registreringer og opfølgning er på plads.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med entrepriseledere, montageledere og kolleger i serviceafdelingen. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du trives med at hjælpe andre, holde styr på detaljerne og få de administrative opgaver fulgt helt til dørs.

Dine opgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag med administrative opgaver, der understøtter vores montage- og serviceorganisation. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Opsætte og følge op på værktøjer til kvalitetsstyring i montageafdelingen.
  • Etablere og vedligeholde et registreringsværktøj til leverancesager i serviceafdelingen.
  • Følge op på serviceordrer, herunder oprettelser, bilag og dokumentation.
  • Hjælpe entreprise- og montagelederne med administrative opgaver og sagsstyring.
  • Udarbejde mængdeoptællinger, reguleringer og forskellige opgørelser.
  • Hjælpe med afklaring af projektrelaterede spørgsmål i samarbejde med entrepriselederne.
  • Samle og udarbejde dokumentation i samarbejde med entreprise- og montagelederne.
  • Assistere montage- og servicechefen med øvrige administrative opgaver.

Du får ikke ansvaret for at lede projekterne, men du får en vigtig rolle i at understøtte dem administrativt og sikre, at der er styr på dokumentation, registreringer og opfølgning.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en kontoruddannelse eller en anden relevant administrativ uddannelse. Det vigtigste er dog, at du har en god administrativ forståelse og trives med at skabe orden og overblik.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder systematisk og struktureret og har blik for detaljerne.
  • Er serviceminded, pligtopfyldende og god til at følge op på dine opgaver.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig trives med at understøtte andre.
  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og er fortrolig med de klassiske Office-værktøjer – især Excel.
  • Behersker dansk flydende, både mundtligt og skriftligt, og kan kommunikere godt på engelsk.
  • Gerne har kendskab til tegningshåndtering.

Du behøver ikke at have erfaring med alle vores værktøjer eller arbejdsgange. Vi lægger vægt på, at du har lyst til at lære, tage ansvar og bidrage til at udvikle og digitalisere vores administrative processer.

Hvad kan du forvente hos os?

Du får en rolle, hvor du kommer tæt på den daglige drift i vores montage- og serviceafdeling og bliver en del af samarbejdet mellem de medarbejdere, der planlægger, styrer og udfører opgaverne.

Du får en varieret administrativ hverdag, hvor du kan gøre en konkret forskel ved at skabe overblik, sikre opfølgning og hjælpe dine kolleger med at få hverdagen til at fungere.

Samtidig får du mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af vores administrative værktøjer og arbejdsgange, så vi løbende kan blive endnu bedre til at håndtere vores opgaver.

Du referer til Service- og montagechefen og kommer til at indgå i et team, der består af 10 faglig stærke kolleger.

Du får en faststilling med en ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer, og dit arbejdssted vil enten være i Kolding eller Aalborg afhængigt af din bopæl.

Vil du med på vores hold?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Lars Peter Jensen, Service‑ og montagechef, på telefon 28 99 97 32, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen.

Er du klar til det næste skridt i din karriere, så vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer – AI Agentic Applications, AVP
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Quality Assurance Engineer – AI Agentic Applications

Location: Pune, India

Corporate Title: AVP

Role Description

Quality Assurance Engineer to validate AI agentic applications across development and production. The position combines specialized AI testing, automation, safety evaluation, and continuous quality measurement. The engineer is responsible to design, build and execute the test strategy for LLM accuracy, RAG ingestion and attribution, agent planning and tool use, recovery behavior, and production failure patterns

What we’ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and maintain test strategies and automation frameworks for AI-powered agentic workflows
  • Develop and implement specialized testing approaches for LLM-powered applications, validating response accuracy, relevance, and grounding, while identifying hallucinations and edge-case behaviours
  • Test and evaluate the behaviour of autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents, ensuring proper planning, tool selection/sequencing, agent-to-agent interactions, and graceful error/timeout recovery
  • Validate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) performance, including document ingestion, chunking, metadata quality, embedding accuracy, and citation/source attribution
  • Perform AI safety and security testing to identify vulnerabilities such as prompt injection (direct/indirect), data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, and privilege escalation
  • Establish quantitative AI evaluation metrics and quality gates (e.g., classification accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate, tool-selection accuracy, and cost/latency) to measure performance across releases
  • Build and maintain automated test suites (covering APIs, UI, integration, RAG, and agent trajectories) to progressively transition the testing suite toward automated continuous evaluation
  • Analyze production AI interactions and failed agent journeys to identify recurring failure patterns, create regression tests from production incidents, and ensure decision auditability

Your skills and experience

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline
  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance and testing, with strong knowledge of test planning, functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing
  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience specifically testing GenAI, LLM, or Agentic AI applications
  • Strong experience with test automation and building automation frameworks and test utilities (rather than relying solely on manual tools)
  • Strong programming ability in at least one language: Java / Kotlin or Python
  • Strong understanding of generative AI technologies, including LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents/agentic workflows, and tool/function calling
  • Hands-on experience with LLM and agent evaluation tools such as Langsmith/Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent frameworks for dataset-based testing, custom evaluation metrics, experiment tracking, tracing, and continuous regression evaluation

Add On Experience (Nice to Have):

Building strong client relationships

Of course, as you represent our clients’ best interests, you’ll also keep in mind JLL’s own business needs—and, thereby, strive to achieve an ideal balance between the two. You’ll do so by being on the lookout for opportunities to introduce potential prospects to other business lines at JLL and build relationships with clients. You’ll also see to it that project revenue and payment cycles are properly managed to avoid bad debt.

Upholding excellence in project delivery

For over 200 years, JLL has become synonymous with project success—you will help continue this history of excellence. You’ll manage professional consultants necessary for the design and documentation of the project, as well as carry out contract administration of all vendors professionally and in accordance with legal requirements to protect commercial interests of clients and JLL. You will also help identify project risks and implement measures to mitigate them. Similarly, core to our reputation is our strong focus on health & safety and on sustainability, and you’ll be expected to keep these front-of-mind at all times.

Likewise, you should have a great sense of urgency when it comes to solving problems, improving products or services, finding new markets, and implementing new strategies. You are resilient and can deal effectively with competing priorities and tight deadlines.

title: Afløsere til dagvagt søges til Videbæk Helhedspleje
description:
Kunne du tænke dig at blive en del af et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og godt kollegaskab går hånd i hånd?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Videbæk Helhedspleje søger afløsere til dagvagt i weekender og eventuelt på hverdage.
Måske er du uddannet – eller måske er du ufaglært og nysgerrig på faget og har lyst til at prøve kræfter med arbejdet inden for helhedsplejen.

Om jobbet

Som medarbejder i helhedsplejen bliver du en vigtig del af borgernes hverdag, tryghed og pleje. Opgaverne er varierede og kræver både omsorg, ansvarlighed, overblik og evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt.

Vi arbejder med afsæt i ældrereformen og helhedsplejen, hvor borgeren er i centrum. Vi er organiseret i fire mindre teams: Team 1A, 1B, 2A og 2B. Team 1 og Team 2 har hver sin teamleder.

I vores teams arbejder vi tæt og tværfagligt omkring borgerne. Her samarbejder social- og sundhedshjælpere og -assistenter med blandt andre sygeplejersker, terapeuter og visitatorer. Sammen skaber vi sammenhængende og gode borgerforløb.

Vi arbejder rehabiliterende, sundhedsfremmende og forebyggende med udgangspunkt i Ringkøbing-Skjern Kommunes værdier:

  • Vi er ordentlige
  • Vi er nysgerrige
  • Vi handler

Hvem er vi?

Vi er ca. 80-90 medarbejdere fordelt på forskellige fagligheder og vagter.

Hos os skal der være plads til både faglighed, samarbejde og humor. Vi lægger vægt på, at vi hjælper hinanden, deler vores viden og bruger hinandens forskellige kompetencer.

Vi tror på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi løfter i fællesskab – og når der er plads til både faglige drøftelser og et godt grin i hverdagen.

Vi tilbyder dig

  • En grundig oplæring, hvor vi sørger for, at du bliver godt introduceret til borgerne, området og dine nye kollegaer.
  • Indflydelse på din egen vagtplan, fordi vi ved, at arbejdsliv og privatliv skal kunne hænge sammen.
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har plads til både faglige drøftelser og et godt grin.
  • Faglig sparring og udvikling, hvor du får mulighed for at bringe dine egne kompetencer i spil og lære af andre faggrupper.
  • Et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde, hvor vi sammen tager ansvar for hele borgerens forløb.
  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor du bliver en del af arbejdet med helhedspleje, mindre teams og nye måder at samarbejde på.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret, samtidig med at du ser dig selv som en del af et fælles team.
  • Bevarer roen og overblikket, også på de dage, hvor planerne ændrer sig, og der skal prioriteres undervejs.
  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til både at dele din egen viden og gøre brug af dine kollegaers forskellige fagligheder.
  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og tager medansvar for en arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.
  • Møder borgere og pårørende med respekt, nærvær og ordentlighed.
  • Har lyst til at gøre en forskel for andre mennesker.

Praktiske oplysninger

Ansøgningsfrist: 15. december 2026.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Gitte Juul Larsen, teamleder
E-mail: gitte.larsen@rksk.dk
Telefon: 22 26 96 57

Emina Mujkic, teamleder
E-mail: emina.mujkic@rksk.dk
Telefon: 22 27 09 23

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – og måske byde dig velkommen som vores nye kollega i Videbæk Helhedspleje.


Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Ansøg" nederst på siden. Vedhæft din ansøgning og dit CV samt relevante bilag i PDF eller DOC format.

Vi skal oplyse dig om, at ved eventuel fremtidig ansættelse ved Ringkøbing-Skjern Kommune, vil der være krav om anvendelse af dit private MitID til identitetssikring ved aktivering af IT-brugerkonto.

Medarbejderne i Ringkøbing-Skjern Kommune er vores vigtigste ressource

Vi understøtter det gode liv og væksten. Vi går efter de gode løsninger sammen med borgere, virksomheder og andre gode relationer.

Vores arbejde er båret af viden, som vi hele tiden udvikler. Vi lærer af enhver opgave - både som enkeltperson, team og organisation. Læring er en del af hverdagen.

Vi er og bliver rige på natur i Danmarks største kommune. Naturen er kilden til det gode liv og til at skabe vækst. Det går vi efter. Det lykkes, fordi vi forkæler ildsjælene og arbejder sammen på tværs.

title: Business Analyst, Service Logistics
description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.


Ciena is seeking an experienced, analytical, and results-oriented professional to drive transportation optimization, network design support, and cost reduction initiatives across its global Service Logistics operations.

This role will focus on improving the efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and performance of Ciena's global service logistics network, with particular emphasis on international transportation, cross-border distribution, carrier and routing optimization, and logistics cost visibility. The successful candidate will help evaluate how inventory and replacement equipment move across global distribution centers, forward stocking locations (FSLs), and customer sites, identifying opportunities to reduce transportation and operating costs while maintaining or improving service-level commitments.


Working closely with Service Logistics, Service Parts Planning, Global Trade, Finance, and third-party logistics providers (3PLs), this individual will develop fact-based recommendations, strengthen foundational logistics processes and analytical capabilities, and drive optimization initiatives from analysis through implementation.

The position will also support broader Service Supply Chain cost-reduction programs and special projects, including RMA deflection, repair cost optimization, and operational process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

International Transportation & Logistics Optimization

  • Analyze and optimize domestic and international transportation flows across Ciena's global Service Supply Chain, including distribution center-to-FSL, FSL-to-customer, interfacility, and reverse logistics movements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce transportation costs through carrier and service-level selection, route optimization, shipment consolidation, distribution strategies, and improved utilization of existing logistics infrastructure.
  • Evaluate international transportation lanes, transit times, freight rates, shipping modes, and service capabilities to identify cost-effective solutions that support customer delivery commitments.
  • Partner with Global Trade and logistics providers to assess cross-border shipping requirements, customs clearance considerations, importer/exporter of record (IOR/EOR) arrangements, and other trade-related factors affecting transportation cost, feasibility, and execution.
  • Analyze transportation performance, routing exceptions, expedited shipments, and cost drivers to identify recurring inefficiencies and develop corrective actions.

Service Logistics Network Design & Cost Optimization

  • Support global Service Logistics network design and optimization initiatives, evaluating transportation strategies, distribution alternatives, FSL configurations, and associated cost, service, and operational tradeoffs.
  • Develop transportation and logistics cost models to compare network design scenarios, including centralized versus distributed fulfillment, alternate stocking locations, carrier options, and service-level configurations.
  • Evaluate supplier rate structures, transportation pricing, accessorial charges, and other logistics cost components to identify savings opportunities and support commercially informed network decisions.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and logistics providers to translate network analysis into actionable recommendations, business cases, and implementation plans.

Logistics Spend Visibility, Analytics & Process Improvement

  • Help establish the foundational logistics spend visibility and Spend Cube capabilities required to analyze freight, transportation, duty/VAT, and related expenses across carriers, lanes, regions, and service levels.
  • Develop and improve logistics cost forecasting, actual-cost tracking, performance reporting, and analytical models to support financial planning, cost reduction, and operational decision-making.
  • Analyze large and fragmented data sets, reconcile information across supplier and internal systems, and identify opportunities to improve data accuracy, transparency, and usability.
  • Support the development and documentation of foundational Service Logistics processes and standards, including process mapping, routing and carrier standards, global trade-lane visibility, and operational playbooks, to improve consistency and enable future optimization.

Cost Reduction Initiatives & Special Projects

  • Lead or support assigned Service Supply Chain cost-reduction initiatives, developing business cases, establishing baselines, coordinating cross-functional actions, and tracking results through implementation and realized savings.
  • Drive the RMA FastTrack program by partnering with Technical Support, Product Quality, Repair Operations, and other stakeholders to identify opportunities to prevent avoidable returns and reduce unnecessary repair, transportation, and inventory expense.
  • Analyze repair reason codes, event codes, NFF, CNR, and related repair outcomes to identify systemic cost drivers, improve data integrity, and support corrective actions and process improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Transportation, Business, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Analytics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in supply chain, transportation, logistics, distribution operations, network optimization, or related functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of international transportation and logistics, including cross-border distribution, freight movement, transportation service levels, carrier operations, and associated cost drivers.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing transportation networks, logistics costs, operational performance, or distribution strategies to develop actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex operational and financial tradeoffs.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience with data visualization or business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
  • Experience working with large or fragmented data sets and reconciling information across multiple systems, suppliers, or operational processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage analytical workstreams, lead cross-functional initiatives, and drive projects from analysis through implementation.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations for operational and leadership teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in service parts logistics, aftermarket supply chains, advanced replacement, reverse logistics, or time-critical service delivery networks.
  • Familiarity with international trade and customs processes, Incoterms, IOR/EOR requirements, and cross-border shipping considerations.
  • Experience with 3PL operations, carrier rate structures, freight cost modeling, transportation management systems (TMS), or logistics procurement analysis.
  • Knowledge of FSL network optimization, inventory deployment strategies, transportation serviceability, and service-level cost tradeoffs.
  • Experience with SQL, Python, Java, or similar data analytics and automation tools.
  • Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, or other structured continuous-improvement methodologies.
  • Experience with cost-reduction business cases, savings measurement, forecasting, spend analysis, or operational performance modeling.

We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

title: Manager Fruit & Veg
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

To manage and lead the Fresh Produce department ensuring exceptional product quality, availability, and presentation while delivering strong sales, gross margin, and controlled shrinkage. The Fresh Produce Manager is responsible for driving operational excellence through effective stock management, team leadership, and adherence to merchandising and food safety standards.

The role focuses on delivering a superior customer experience through fresh, high-quality produce, attractive displays, and consistent product availability while ensuring profitability through disciplined stock control and waste management.

Minimum Requirements:

Grade 12 (essential)

3–5 years’ experience in a Fresh Produce retail environment, with supervisory or management responsibility.

Strong knowledge of fresh produce handling, merchandising and stock management.

Experience managing shrinkage, waste control and stock rotation.

Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards.


Competencies:

Strong commercial awareness and results orientation.

Leadership and team management capability.

Excellent organisational and stock management skills.

Strong attention to quality and detail.

Customer-focused mindset.

Ability to work in a fast-paced retail environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Department Management and Commercial Performance

Drive sales and profitability of the Fresh Produce department through effective stock management and merchandising.

Ensure all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are implemented, maintained and adhered to support operational consistency, compliance, and efficiency in the store.

Monitor daily sales performance and implement actions to achieve departmental targets.

Manage pricing, promotions and product mix to optimise sales and margin performance.

Ensure high levels of product availability while maintaining efficient stock holding levels.


Product Quality and Freshness

Ensure all fresh produce meets company quality standards and freshness requirements.

Implement strict stock rotation practices (FIFO) to maximise shelf life and minimise shrinkage.

Regularly inspect product quality and remove damaged or poor-quality stock.

Ensure correct handling and storage procedures are followed to maintain product integrity.


Customer Experience and Merchandising

Ensure adherence to planograms, display standards and seasonal merchandising guidelines.

Promote seasonal and promotional products through effective display execution.

Deliver a positive customer shopping experience through product knowledge and service excellence.


Stock Management and Waste Control

Monitor stock movement, shrinkage, and waste levels and implement corrective actions where required.

Conduct regular stock counts and ensure accurate inventory control.

Work closely with receiving teams to ensure correct product quality and quantities are received.


Team Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop the Fresh Produce team to deliver operational excellence.

Manage staff scheduling to ensure adequate departmental coverage.

Train team members on product handling, merchandising standards, and food safety procedures.

Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and high performance.


Compliance and Food Safety

Ensure full compliance with food safety, hygiene and health regulations.

Maintain clean, organised and safe working areas within the department.

Ensure all staff adhere to company policies and food handling standards.

Join J.P. Morgan’s Emerging Markets Strategy team in London and play a pivotal role in shaping the firm’s approach to EMEA EM local rates. As a Vice President or Executive Director in the EMEA Emerging Markets Local Markets Rates Strategy team, you will formulate top-down and bottom-up views on EMEA EM local rates, including bonds, swaps, and other instruments. You will confidently deliver these insights to internal and external stakeholders through research reports and investment recommendations. You will work closely with the Head of EMEA EM Local Markets Strategy and the broader emerging markets research team, contributing to wider EM research initiatives and collaborating across global teams.

  • Analyse macroeconomic themes and technical drivers affecting EMEA EM local rates markets to formulate views and investment recommendations at both regional and country levels

  • Collaborate with the EMEA EM strategy team, economists, and colleagues in the global EM team to deliver broader EM research
  • Build and manage analytics and quantitative FX models
  • Develop rates models and generate trade ideas based on market-moving events
  • Maintain strong product and technical knowledge to support research and recommendations
  • Contribute to wider EM research initiatives and support team objectives

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

  • Extensive experience covering EMEA EM local rates markets at a top-tier financial institution (sell side or buy side)
  • Bachelor’s/University degree
  • Strong grasp of macroeconomics, financial economics, and local rates drivers
  • Solid rates product knowledge
  • Strong analytical skills, with good knowledge of statistics and econometrics/data science

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

The Project Engineer – Data Centre Cooling / HVAC / Chiller Systems is responsible for supporting the execution and delivery of mission-critical cooling infrastructure projects in data centers. The role focuses on engineering coordination, site execution, technical review, installation supervision, testing, commissioning support, and documentation for HVAC, chiller, and cooling system projects. The position works closely with project managers, design teams, vendors, contractors, and customers to ensure safe, timely, and quality delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support execution of data Centre cooling, HVAC, and chiller projects from engineering review through commissioning and handover.
  • Review mechanical and HVAC drawings, P&IDs, layouts, BOQs, technical submittals, and vendor documents.
  • Coordinate site activities related to chillers, CRAH/CRAC/CDU/FAN WALL units, chilled water piping, pumps, valves, AHUs, heat exchangers, controls, and associated auxiliaries.
  • Monitor installation progress and ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and project schedules.
  • Assist in planning and coordinating material delivery, equipment installation, site readiness, and contractor activities.
  • Supervise mechanical/HVAC works at site and ensure compliance with quality, safety, and project standards.
  • Support testing activities such as pressure testing, flushing, leak testing, balancing, and pre-commissioning checks.
  • Coordinate commissioning activities for chillers, pumps, cooling equipment, control systems, and integrated HVAC systems.
  • Work with BMS/controls teams to ensure proper integration, point checks, alarms, trends, and sequence validation.
  • Identify technical issues, installation gaps, and site constraints, and escalate them with recommended solutions.
  • Maintain daily/weekly site progress records, engineering trackers, snag lists, and issue logs.
  • Support preparation of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, commissioning records, and final handover documentation.
  • Coordinate with procurement, vendors, OEMs, contractors, consultants, and operations teams for timely issue resolution.
  • Ensure execution in live or critical data centre environments is carefully controlled to minimize operational risk.
  • Engineering and site progress reports

title: Kostfaglig eneansvarlig til Søparken LeveBo
description:
Kan du se dig selv arbejde i et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor du får stor indflydelse på beboernes hverdag og trivsel gennem gode måltider? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye kostfaglig eneansvarlig i Søparken LeveBo.

Søparken LeveBo er et plejecenter med 60 beboere fordelt i 6 huse i skønne omgivelser. Lejlighederne er placeret i 2 klynger med grønne områder omkring boligerne. Alle boliger er almene somatiske plejeboliger. Vi har et tæt samarbejde med pårørende og frivillige. Plejecentret er centralt beliggende i Frederikshavn, og der er busstoppested i nærheden.

Vi søger en kostfaglig medarbejder, gerne ernæringsassistent eller med tilsvarende relevant uddannelse, som brænder for at skabe gode madoplevelser og ernæringsrigtige måltider til ældre borgere.


Vi kan tilbyde:

  • en arbejdsplads med et fagligt forankret miljø med borgeren i centrum
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på at levere kerneopgaven med høj kvalitet
  • en arbejdsplads med højt til loftet, hvor vi gerne lytter til alles idéer og forslag for at skabe den bedste løsning
  • en arbejdsplads, som lader dine faglige og personlige kompetencer komme i spil i samarbejdet omkring vores beboere
  • en arbejdsplads med gode muligheder for kollegial sparring, hvor samarbejde og et godt arbejdsmiljø prioriteres højt
  • en arbejdsplads med medindflydelse på arbejdstider og timetal
  • en arbejdsplads med et tæt samarbejde med tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere
  • en grundig introduktion til opgaverne og hverdagen i Søparken LeveBo
  • tæt samarbejde og faglig sparring med den anden kostfaglige eneansvarlige i Søparken LeveBo

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt, men vi er åbne for dine ønsker til timetal. Arbejdstiden vil overvejende ligge i dagtid på hverdage, men et par dage ugentligt vil arbejdstiden være tilrettelagt med overlap til aftenvagten, så der sikres et tæt samarbejde omkring beboernes ønsker og behov.

Ansættelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.


Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • planlægge måltider i overensstemmelse med de nationale anbefalinger samt Frederikshavn Kommunes kvalitetsstandarder
  • stå for varebestilling i samarbejde med plejepersonalet
  • tilberede og/eller forberede den varme mad samt biretter og mellemmåltider, herunder også diæt- og særkost til beboere med særlige ernæringsmæssige behov
  • være i tæt dialog med beboerne og plejepersonalet om ønsker og behov i relation til kosten
  • have overblik over og medansvar for, at kostbudgetterne overholdes
  • være tovholder på egenkontrol og sikre, at gældende retningslinjer efterleves
  • deltage i planlægning og afvikling af fælles sociale arrangementer i husene i Søparken LeveBo
  • bidrage til et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde omkring beboernes trivsel og livskvalitet

Vi forventer, at du:

  • er uddannet ernæringsassistent eller har anden relevant kostfaglig uddannelse
  • har interesse for ældreområdet og for måltidets betydning for sundhed, trivsel og livskvalitet
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for de daglige opgaver
  • har en anerkendende, imødekommende og nysgerrig tilgang til beboere, pårørende og kolleger
  • er fleksibel og bidrager til den gode opgaveløsning i hverdagen
  • tager aktiv del i arbejdsfællesskabet og det tværfaglige samarbejde
  • har økonomisk forståelse og kan arbejde inden for de givne budgetrammer
  • har kendskab til IT på brugerniveau og er indstillet på at foretage fx varebestilling og betalingsgodkendelse online


Dine nye kollegaer er ernæringsassistent, social- og sundhedshjælpere, social- og sundhedsassistenter, og sygeplejersker. I Søparken LeveBo vægter vi fleksibilitet, fællesskab og samarbejde højt. Vi arbejder med afsæt i personcentreret omsorg og den rehabiliterende tilgang, og vi ser måltiderne som en vigtig del af beboernes hverdag, fællesskab og livskvalitet.

Arbejdsstedets adresse
Søparken LeveBo, Søparken 1-7, 9900 Frederikshavn

Du kan få yderligere oplysninger om stillingen hos plejecenterleder Kristine Vigh Thordahl på tlf. 9845 5698 / 2338 0553 eller assisterende leder Camilla Skaarup Bak på tlf. 9845 5945 / 2327 9193.

Er du klar til at bringe din kostfaglige viden i spil og gøre en forskel for vores beboere hver dag? Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt, og senest den 16. november 2026. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes den 24. november 2026.

Inden ansættelse skal straffeattest fremvises, ligesom vi efter aftale indhenter referencer.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

You will act as the lead regional subject matter expert on investigations and will deliver value to the business by protecting Diageo assets, leveraging investigation insights to better prevent or identify future issues and help the business operate more effectively.

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.


We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.


Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

title: Engageret og nærværende
description:
Genopslag

Vil du være med til at skabe stærke legefællesskaber?

Vi søger pædagogisk personale til barselsvikariat i børnehaven Føvling Børnecenter
Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt

Brænder du for at skabe inspirerende legefællesskaber, stærke relationer og udviklende læringsmiljøer for børn i alderen 3-6 år?

Hos Føvling Børnecenter tror vi på, at børn udvikler sig bedst gennem leg, nysgerrighed og deltagelse i fællesskaber. Derfor søger vi et engageret og nærværende pædagogisk personale til et barselsvikariat på 35 timer om ugen, som har lyst til aktivt at være en del af børnenes leg og hverdag.

Hos os møder du en arbejdsplads med højt til loftet, godt humør og dygtige kollegaer. Vi er optagede af at skabe de bedste rammer for børns trivsel, udvikling og læring, samtidig med at vi udvikler vores pædagogiske praksis og styrker vores faglige fællesskab.

Om stillingen

Du bliver en del af et engageret team, hvor vi arbejder ud fra et fælles syn på, at leg er grundlaget for børns trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse. Vi søger derfor en medarbejder, som både kan følge børnenes initiativer og tage ansvar for at skabe meningsfulde legefællesskaber, hvor alle børn oplever at høre til.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er uddannet pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller har anden relevant pædagogisk baggrund
  • brænder for arbejdet med børn i alderen 3-6 år
  • har en legende tilgang til pædagogisk arbejde og trives med at være aktivt deltagende i børnenes leg
  • kan skabe og understøtte inkluderende legefællesskaber
  • er nysgerrig på børnenes perspektiver og følger deres initiativer
  • skaber trygge og positive relationer til børn, forældre og kollegaer
  • arbejder anerkendende og inkluderende
  • tager ansvar og bidrager aktivt til fællesskabet
  • er initiativrig og har lyst til at udvikle den pædagogiske praksis sammen med os

Hvem er vi?

Føvling Børnecenter ligger i naturskønne omgivelser i Vejen Kommune, hvor naturen er en integreret del af vores pædagogiske praksis. Vi ser naturen som et stort legerum, der inviterer til fantasi, bevægelse, nysgerrighed og fællesskaber. Derfor bruger vi vores udeområder aktivt året rundt og skaber læringsmiljøer, hvor leg og nysgerrighed er drivkraften.

Vi er en institution i positiv udvikling med fokus på høj pædagogisk kvalitet, stærke fællesskaber og et godt arbejdsmiljø. Hos os får du mulighed for at sætte dit præg på hverdagen og bidrage med dine idéer, erfaringer og kompetencer.

Vi tilbyder

  • et stærkt og engageret kollegialt fællesskab
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på faglig udvikling og sparring
  • nærværende ledelse og støtte i hverdagen
  • mulighed for medindflydelse og ansvar
  • et tæt og positivt samarbejde med forældrene
  • en hverdag præget af trivsel, humor og engagement

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat på 35 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst. Ved ansættelse indhentes børneattest.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Vi modtager gerne din ansøgning senest d. 17 november.

Samtaler afholdes i uge 47.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Børnecenterleder Simon Wulf Hansen på telefon 42 76 75 73
Daglig leder af børnehave og SFO Thomas Knudsen på telefon 21 26 59 34

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

"Leg er børns måde at være i verden på. Derfor søger vi en kollega, der har lyst til at gå foran, ved siden af og bagved børnene i legen og være med til at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle."

title: End-to-End Data Integration Engineer - ETL Pipelines
description:
The data exists. Your job is to get it where it needs to be, reliably.


Om te solliciteren, leest u eenvoudig de volgende functieomschrijving door en zorgt u ervoor dat u relevante documenten bijvoegt.

A multinational defence organisation in The Hague needs a data engineer to design and build the ETL processes that bring imagery and reports from sources on different networks into its systems, and then make those flows controllable, observable and resilient. The engagement is one person, delivered as a set of milestones over the year.

What you would be doing

  • Documenting, configuring and testing the ETL requirements: source-to-target mapping, traceability and data reconciliation
  • Building data models, pipelines and schemas for data coming from many different sources
  • Putting configuration control in place: baselines, versioning, change approval and rollback
  • Setting up monitoring with metrics, alerts, dashboards and logging
  • Designing and testing resilience: backup and restore, failover, recovery time and point objectives
  • Troubleshooting production data flows, and handing over through a training package and on-the-job training for the administrators

What you would bring

  • Hands-on experience with modern ETL tools such as Apache NiFi, Informatica, Talend or SSIS, ideally on AWS or Azure
  • Data modelling and transformation from heterogeneous sources
  • Experience with data sharing platforms, object stores and relational, NoSQL, graph and vector databases xgiwjmb
  • Comfort on the Linux command line and a knack for fixing data anomalies
  • Experience delivering against fixed, deliverable-based contracts in multinational teams
  • Familiarity with NATO intelligence and surveillance architecture and applications, and fluent business English

Why this one is worth a look

A clearly scoped engineering job where you own the pipelines end to end, with an option year after the first.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
JOB PURPOSE
Reporting to the Manager of Learning, Development & Communications, the Instructional Designer will be instrumental in developing high-quality and engaging learning content that supports organizational goals, enhances employee skills, and fosters career development. This role requires a strategic thinker who can collaborate effectively with subject matter experts and business leaders. The ideal candidate will be a strong team player and seasoned learning specialist who can apply themselves in various aspects of learning design, including needs assessment, storyboarding, eLearning development, and facilitation. This role is a hybrid role with 4 days in office. Some expectation to travel between offices depending on training needs.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Apply adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies to create impactful, learner-centered experiences.
• Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to address learning requests, identify performance gaps, and deliver solutions that meet business needs.
• Write clear, concise, and engaging learning objectives and content that are accurate, accessible, and practical. • Develop eLearning and training materials using authoring and graphic design tools (e.g. Articulate Rise, Storyline, Vyond, and Canva).
• Design and facilitate instructor-led courses and virtual training sessions tailored to employee needs and Mevotech’s objectives.
• Assess training effectiveness through evaluations, learner feedback and performance metrics, sharing insights with key stakeholders to improve future programs.
• Monitor and apply emerging trends, best practices, and technologies in corporate learning to keep training fresh and relevant.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, engaging content.
• Minimum 4+ years of proven experience in designing and developing corporate training programs and materials.
• Minimum of 2+ years of experience in instructional design, learning & development, or a related field.
• Minimum 2+ years of experience in Articulate Rise and Storyline and VYOND.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Suite: Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, Visio, MS Teams, Copilot.
• Experience in leveraging AI tools for design.
• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
• Strong team player with ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
• Analytical skills to evaluate training effectiveness and learner performance.
• Experience in facilitating in-person synchronous learning and virtual learning experiences.
• Superior documentation and editing skills.
• Strong problem solver, highly motivated and resourceful.
• Knowledge of ADDIE and SAM learning models. • Certification in instructional design or eLearning development is a plus (e.g., ATD, ISPI).

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS
▪ Standard office setting

title: Electrical & Mechanical Critical Facilities Services Engineers in Data Center
description:
Electrical & Mechanical Technician / Engineers in Data Center - Hyperscale



U kunt meer details krijgen over de aard van deze vacature en wat er van sollicitanten wordt verwacht door hieronder te lezen.

Location: Groningen - Northern Netherlands - Relocation Support and finance available


Shift Pattern: Rotating days and nights


Build Your Future in the European Data Centre Sector


Are you an experienced Electrical, Mechanical or Critical Facilities Engineer looking for your next career move?


PRS Recruitment Services is partnering with a major US-headquartered hyperscale data centre organisation undertaking significant expansion across Europe, with plans to develop over 1GW of additional data center capacity over the next 3–5 years.


We are seeking technically capable Critical Operations Technicians to join an in-house engineering team at a state-of-the‑art data center facility in Groningen / Eemshaven, Northern Netherlands.


This is an opportunity to work within a growing international organisation, maintain essential mission‑critical infrastructure and develop your career in one of the world's fastest‑growing technology sectors.


The Opportunity


You will play a hands‑on role in maintaining the electrical, mechanical and cooling infrastructure essential to continuous data center operations.


Responsibilities include:


  • Planned preventative and reactive maintenance of critical M&E plant.
  • Maintenance and fault‑finding across UPS, generators and electrical distribution systems.
  • HVAC, cooling and environmental control systems maintenance.
  • Electrical LV/HV operations and switching, where authorised.
  • Fault diagnosis, repairs and root‑cause investigation.
  • Working in accordance with strict engineering safety procedures and operational standards.
  • Supporting continuous improvement and maintaining excellent equipment availability.

Your Background


We are interested in engineers with experience in one or more of the following:


  • Data centres and critical facilities.
  • Electrical and mechanical building services.
  • HVAC and industrial cooling systems.
  • Power generation and emergency power systems.
  • Pharmaceutical, manufacturing and other high‑availability environments.

You should possess relevant engineering qualifications, practical maintenance and fault‑finding experience, a strong safety mindset and the ability to work effectively within a rotating shift team.


Previous data center or critical services experience is desirable, but engineers from other critical environments with relevant transferable skills are encouraged to apply.


Salary & Benefits

Why Consider This Opportunity?


Join an organisation making a major long-term investment in European data centre infrastructure, with opportunities to expand your technical expertise and progress within a growing international engineering operation. xgiwjmb

title: Director of Software Engineering - Data & AI
description:
Role Description:

Als u iets meer wilt weten over deze vacature, of overweegt te solliciteren, lees dan de volgende vacature-informatie.

The Data and AI organization is central to our Connected Trip strategy as its role is to gather, analyze, and interpret data to gain a deep understanding of our travelers and their behaviors including experimentation, preferences, needs and expectations. These insights inform, validate & steer the traveler product vision and traveler interventions. Additionally, the team is responsible for core ML capabilities such as ranking, relevance, recommendation and semantic understanding of our products.

The key capabilities owned by this organization:

- Data Products and Intent Modelling

Customer intent and key canonical data models and data products to enable strong insights, decision making and alignment across our Connected Trip vision.

- Experimentation Platforms

Our experimentation platform is industry leading comprehensively covering the entire experimentation lifecycle from design, metric calculation, statistical analysis right through to launch. Experimentation scenarios are comprehensive and vast across our global product estate for example web, app, personalisation, segmentation, backend services and AI interactions patterns.

- AI Application Platform

Foundational platform that enables compliant, secure agentic workflows with integrated context, memory and steering

- Data Engineering

Partner with tracks and teams across to ensuring that our operational data is ingested into the right models, data sets with clear lineage and ownership

Role specification

We are looking for a technology leader to lead Data from an Engineering perspective partnering with the Data and Product leaders to deliver on our ambition for the Connected Trip. The role will need to evolve our Experimentation platform to the next generation and be focused on Software Engineering related to data, analytics, models, AI and ingestion. To be successful in this role you need to have:

- Deep technical experience related in Software Engineering and Data
- Experience with Big Data systems and projects
- Experience with Data ETL (Extraction, Transformation & Load), data architecture, schema design, and data modeling
- Experience of AI technologies and use within the data ecosystem
- Working knowledge of cloud based data capabilities on AWS
- Experience with Experimentation platforms in order to evolve the platform to the next-generation of A/B testing platforms that empowers to make data-driven decisions for its products and services
- Good understanding of statistical methods needed for experimentation, measurement and in a highly scaled and compute intensive framework in order to continue to grow our platforms including audience split testing, power measures, integrating forward looking measures like future expected value.
- Experience in data privacy and data security related topics specifically to ensure that privacy requirements are factored into segmentation, intent modeling by design

Responsabilities

People & Function Leadership

- Lead, inspire and motivate your Engineering function through leading by example and defining what success looks like, giving ownership & providing clarity when necessary
- Line manage Senior Managers as well as top technical talent, such as Principals.
- Communicate strategy in a compelling manner to multiple teams and stakeholders
- Foster inclusion by holding self and others accountable
- Drive people centric initiatives that enable workforce diversity
- Partner in and outside of our Business unit to lead and shape the people agenda
- Create a learning environment by coaching, maintaining two-way feedback, helping people extract & share personal learnings, and supporting teams to constantly adapt
- Foster the engineering culture; innovate, work as a team and celebrate success
- Build a world class team through nurturing, attracting, and retaining tech talent from around the world
- Empower your teams to do their best work at
- Be curious, learn, iterate and shape our culture

Technology, Craft & Delivery Leadership

- Lead, influence and own delivery within your function including department goals
- Partner with other functions and business units to deliver on our strategic agenda
- Maintain focus on the end goal, minimise risk and remove roadblocks for our strategic agenda
- Ensure clear and effective communication at all levels: proactively keep all stakeholders informed of what’s happening, upcoming changes, projects, issues and risks
- Foster mastery in engineering craftsmanship across including shaping ways of working
- Own Technology-wide topics and help lead and grow the department
- Embed Agile ways of working and values within the organisation
- Identify problems and significantly improve, change or adapt existing methods and techniques drawing from personal experiences and feedback
- Drive a DevOps culture

Technology, Architecture & Product Strategy

- Shape, define and build new services, processes and operational plans in alignment with the commercial and financial needs of the business
- Lead, take ownership and shape the technology strategic objectives and roadmaps
- Be a strategic thought partner and influence stakeholders across the Accommodations and the broader business to set and align the strategic direction of your function
- Make decisions in complex and ambiguous situations, and guide others in their decision making by recognizing and challenging assumptions, introducing relevant data and multiple perspectives
- Ensure that the Booking architecture principles and engineering practices are adhered to, and that there is direction and alignment for each product.
- Anticipate the need for changes based on context, and set renewed courses of action to engage teams and achieve goals, while striving to make the impact clear and understandable
- Drive innovation in your function
- Own the architecture across your function

Skills & Experience

- Extensive Tech Leadership experience with demonstrated success of building, shaping and leading a cross functional Engineering function or business unit at scale (50+ people)
- Industry experience at fast moving, innovative global technology companies
- Experience operating large, Internet scale applications and distributed systems spanning multiple languages, platforms, front and back end services, networks and public cloud platforms.
- Deep understanding of technology, with a proven track record of designing and building platforms at scale
- Highly familiar with the topology of their environment and all of their systems

title: Senior Vice President of Commissioning
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. What this job involves:

The SVP of Data Centers Commissioning will manage JLL's mission-critical commissioning team, translating regional strategic plans into tactical operational goals and driving technical excellence for hyperscale data centers and enterprise mission-critical facilities. This role combines technical guidance on complex projects with the coordination and leadership of a high-performing team. You will implement commissioning standards, resolve complex client escalations, maintain budget oversight, and coordinate commissioning activities from design through operational handover. The position demands deep technical expertise in mission-critical systems and proven capability to manage staffing, schedules, and costs across multiple groups.


Your day-to-day tasks will include:

  • Recommending departmental strategic plans for the commissioning practice to senior leadership, and collaborating on business development opportunities, including RFP responses, client presentations, and pricing estimates
  • Establishing and implementing commissioning processes, procedures, and quality assurance frameworks for Tier III/IV mission-critical environments, aligned with ASHRAE, NFPA, and IEEE standards
  • Overseeing a team of commissioning managers and field technicians, including providing guidance on performance, allocating resources, managing staffing schedules, and delivering technical coaching across projects
  • Serving as a key escalation point for complex technical or operational challenges on flagship projects, coordinating directly with design teams, contractors, vendors, and testing agencies
  • Overseeing integrated systems testing protocols for electrical systems (UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs), mechanical systems (chillers, CRAC/CRAH units, cooling towers), BMS/EPMS platforms, and fire protection systems
  • Reviewing and maintaining commissioning documentation standards, including test procedures, functional performance tests, progress reports, final commissioning reports, and O&M manuals
  • Ensuring strict team compliance with safety regulations including OSHA requirements, NFPA 70E arc flash protocols, lockout/tagout procedures, and confined space regulations
  • Identifying opportunities to integrate emerging technologies and innovative tools, including liquid cooling systems, digital commissioning platforms, and automation strategies
  • Managing moderate-sized budgets, tracking expenditures, assessing risks, and coordinating stakeholder communications to maintain project timelines across concurrent engagements

Desired experience and technical skills:

Requirements:

  • Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline from an accredited four-year institution preferred; OR 12-15+ years of progressive mission-critical commissioning experience with demonstrated leadership
  • Minimum 10-15 years of hands-on commissioning experience in mission-critical facilities, with at least 5 years in leadership or management roles
  • Proven track record commissioning hyperscale data centers (10MW+ IT load) and Tier III/IV facilities across multiple project delivery methods
  • Deep technical knowledge of electrical distribution systems including medium voltage equipment, transformers, ATS, UPS systems (2N, N+1 configurations), generators, paralleling switchgear, and PDUs
  • Comprehensive understanding of mechanical cooling systems including chillers, CRAC/CRAH units, cooling towers, pumping systems, and economization strategies
  • Expertise in functional performance testing, integrated systems testing, commissioning test procedures, and acceptance criteria development for mission-critical environments
  • Demonstrated success building and managing high-performing technical teams with proven ability in mentoring, performance management, and talent development
  • Expert-level proficiency in project management software (Procore, Microsoft Project, Primavera P6) and Microsoft Office Suite
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with ability to present complex technical information to executive-level stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with systems-thinking approach to root cause analysis and solution development
  • Proven ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and make rapid decisions under pressure across multiple concurrent high-stakes projects
  • Availability to travel up to 40% overall (approximately 20–25% per active project across up to two concurrent projects).

Preferred:

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • Certified Commissioning Professional (CCP), Certified Commissioning Authority (CxA), LEED AP BD+C, or Certified Data Center Professional (CDCP)
  • OSHA 30-Hour and NFPA 70E Qualified Electrical Worker certifications
  • Experience with commissioning management software (Bluerithm, CxAlloy, CXAPP), DCIM platforms, and BIM/CAD tools
  • P&L responsibility, business development experience, and proven track record in account management and service line growth
  • Familiarity with emerging technologies including liquid cooling, AI/ML infrastructure, and renewable energy integration

title: Studentermedhjælp til fritidspasordningen
description:
Vil du være med til at åbne døren til gode fritidsfællesskaber for børn og unge i Glostrup?

Et fritidsfællesskab kan betyde meget. Det kan være stedet, hvor man får nye venner, oplever at høre til, bliver bedre til noget og får mere mod på hverdagen.

Men for nogle børn og unge kan vejen ind i fællesskabet være svær at finde. Det vil vi gerne gøre noget ved, og måske skal du hjælpe os.

Vi søger en studentermedhjælper, der har lyst til at gøre en konkret forskel for børn og unge i Glostrup. Du skal sammen med vores fritidsvejledere hjælpe børn, unge og familier med at finde vej til fritidsaktiviteter og fællesskaber, der passer til netop dem.

Om fritidsvejledning

Fritidsvejledningen i Glostrup kommune hjælper børn og unge i alderen 0-24 år med at finde vej ind i gode fritidsaktiviteter og fællesskaber. Gennem vejledning og brobygning til lokale tilbud understøtter indsatsen, at flere børn og unge får et aktivt fritidsliv og oplever sociale fællesskaber. Udover vejledning administrer fritidsvejlederen også kommunens fritidspasordning, som giver økonomisk støtte til kontingent, udstyr og deltagelse i camps og stævner, hvor familiens økonomi kan være en barriere for deltagelse.

Stillingen

Som studentermedhjælper bliver du en del af fritidsvejlederindsatsen i Kultur, Idræt og Fritid. En vigtig del af dit arbejde bliver at møde børn, unge og familier dér, hvor de er. Det kan være på en skole, i en SFO eller klub, på biblioteket eller andre steder i kommunen.

Gennem samtaler og vejledning hjælper du med at finde frem til interesser, ønsker og muligheder. Samtidig får du tæt kontakt til Glostrups foreninger, så du lærer deres tilbud at kende og kan være med til at skabe det gode match mellem barnet eller den unge og det rette fritidsfællesskab.

Nogle gange handler det om at finde den rigtige aktivitet. Andre gange handler det om at gøre det første skridt lidt lettere.

Dine primære opgaver vil være at:

  • opsøge og skabe kontakt til børn og unge, der kan have glæde af et fritidsfællesskab
  • tale med børn, unge og forældre om interesser, ønsker og muligheder
  • vejlede familier om fritidsaktiviteter og foreningstilbud
  • skabe kontakt mellem børn, unge, familier og foreninger
  • hjælpe familier med at søge økonomisk støtte til fritidsaktiviteter
  • være synlig på skoler, i SFO’er, klubber, dagtilbud, på biblioteket og andre relevante steder
  • være med til at fortælle om fritidsvejledernes tilbud, så endnu flere familier kender mulighederne for hjælp og vejledning.
  • i samarbejde med teamet, bidrage i afviklingen af større events

Du kommer ikke til at være alene om opgaven. Du bliver en del af et engageret team og kommer særligt til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores to deltidsfritidsvejledere.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os først og fremmest, at du kan lide at møde mennesker og har lyst til at gøre en forskel for børn og unge.

Det er en fordel, hvis du selv kender foreningslivet og ved, hvor meget det kan betyde at blive taget godt imod, når man er ny.

Vi håber også, at du:

  • er imødekommende og god til at skabe tillid
  • kan møde børn, unge og familier i øjenhøjde
  • tager initiativ og tør skabe kontakt til mennesker, du ikke kender i forvejen
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig trives med at være en del af et team
  • brænder for børn og unges trivsel og deltagelse i fællesskaber
  • har erfaring fra foreningslivet, fx som medlem, frivillig, træner eller instruktør
  • er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse og har minimum ét år tilbage af dit studie.

Din uddannelsesretning er ikke det vigtigste for os. Det vigtigste er din motivation, din nysgerrighed og din evne til at skabe gode relationer.

Om os

Team Kultur og Idræt er en del af Center for Kultur, Idræt og Fritid. Team Kultur tager sig af opgaver inden for kultur, idræt, folkeoplysning, frivillighed og seniorliv. Du vil referere til centerchefen. Udover kollegerne på rådhuset består centeret af Glostrup Bibliotek, Glostrup Idrætsanlæg, Glostrup Musikskole, Byhistorisk Hus samt Aktivitetscentret for borgere 60+, førtidspensionister og fleksjobbere.

Vi er en uhøjtidelig arbejdsplads med let til grin, hvor alle bidrager til den gode stemning på vores fælles kontor. Vi hjælper hinanden og ønsker os et arbejdsliv i balance.

Glostrup Kommune arbejder i disse år med særligt fokus på professionalisme i opgaveudførelsen, med tværgående arbejdsprocesser samt venlighed og imødekommenhed. Tre værdier som i vid udstrækning allerede er indarbejdet på kultur-, idræts- og fritidsområdet. Du skal derfor kunne se dig selv i dette og være indstillet på at fortsætte indsatserne både på centerets eget område og i tæt samspil med de andre fagområder i kommunen.

Løn og tiltrædelse

Der er tale om en tidsbegrænset stilling på 8 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse d. 1. januar 2027 frem til 31. december 2027. Timerne placeres primært på to eftermiddage, og der kan forekomme aften og weekendarbejde. Den konkrete tilrettelæggelse aftaler vi sammen.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst.

Vil du være med?

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag via ansøgningslinket senest 1. december.

Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler d. 7. og 8. december i uge 50.

Kontakt fritidsvejleder Sofie Lose Nielsen på telefon +45 20 34 81 20, e-mail fritidsvejleder@glostrup.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål om stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og måske byde dig velkommen til Kultur, Idræt og Fritid i Glostrup Kommune.

title: Risk Senior Specialist, AVP
location: (do not use) Mumbai Nirlon Knowledge Pk B1
description:
Job Description:

In Scope of Position-Based Promotions



Job Title: Risk Senior Specialist

Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President

Location: Mumbai, India

Role Description

  • Market and Valuation Risk Management (MVRM) provides an independent view of market risks and valuation to Deutsche Bank’s senior management. Market risk team manages Deutsche Bank’s Market Risk position in an independent and neutral way.
  • You will be a part of the Market Risk Analysis and Control (MRAC) function within MVRM and will be responsible for the provision of all official market risk metrics and core analysis in support of risk management decision making for Rates asset class. The team operates a business/asset class and risk metric aligned organizational matrix supported by central functions. The team has a global presence with staff located in London, New York, Berlin, Singapore, Mumbai and Bangalore.
  • You will be exposed to risk management techniques viz. analysis/computation of VaR, SVaR, IRC, Backtesting, FRTB for a diverse range of derivative products. The team is also proficient in combining this risk knowledge with best in class automation and visualization skills including python/VBA/Tableau to provide value added analytical outputs to its stakeholders
  • You will be expected to be proficient in automation tools (python essentially) with sufficient knowledge of risk to enhance the output of the team.

What we’ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

  • Best in class leave policy.
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

This role is within the Rates Asset class team. The primary responsibilities are:

  • Risk validation and ensure appropriate controls in place
  • Review and understand the historical simulation VaR, FRTB and Backtesting(outlier analysis), including staying abreast of the development of this metric and related drivers
  • Facilitating better risk analysis and automated reporting infrastructure to stakeholders using required programming tools(python/Tableau etc.) is a critical part of profile
  • Perform deep dive analysis into concentrations of risk or emerging items of interest, providing high quality and accurate information at a level for senior management consumption
  • Perform analytical analysis of our limit to generate proposals for limit changes and for new limits
  • Support the analysis and communication of business portfolio level topics to senior management and their committees

Your skills and experience

  • University degree in Economics, Mathematics or other quantitative subject.
  • 5+ years’ experience in Market Risk within the Financial Market / Investment Banking industry (other relevant backgrounds e.g. Trading, Product Control, IPV will also be considered)
  • Proficiency in Python/VBA, Tableau, MS Office tools is essential for the role
  • Good understanding of other Market Risk measurement techniques e.g. VaR, RNIV, Economic Capital, IRC.
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate technical and financial topics with global stakeholders
  • A reliable team player with the motivation to work in a dynamic, international and diverse environment
  • Able to multi-task and deliver under tight deadlines
  • A committed and motivated individual for self-development and growth
  • Hands on coding skills(Python specifically) and Tableau skills will be a significant plus

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career.
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team.
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

About us and our teams

Please visit our company website for further information:

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Dit ga je doen

Als Teamleider Data Engineering bij AS Watson, het bedrijf achter Kruidvat, Trekpleister en ICI PARIS XL, heb je een afwisselende rol waarin je leidinggeven combineert met hands-on werk. Je ontwikkelt slimme datapipelines en zorgt ervoor dat algoritmes uiteindelijk op een goede manier in productie komen.
