title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer

About us

Averna powered by Spherea designs, manufactures and supports complex test systems for aerospace, defence and other regulated industries.

The Software Engineer role

This is an engineering software role, not general business application development. You will develop software for test, measurement, simulation and control systems, interacting with instrumentation, data acquisition hardware, communications interfaces and units under test. The software supports test sequences, data processing, operator guidance, diagnostics and traceable evidence. You will work across the lifecycle with systems, hardware, electrical, mechanical and project engineers, from requirements through implementation, integration, verification, acceptance, commissioning and support. Regular work alongside physical equipment is required, with occasional UK and international travel.

Software Engineer Key responsibilities

  • Analyse system and software requirements and contribute to architecture, detailed design and technology selection. Develop software for automated and manual test, measurement, simulation and control applications.
  • Produce maintainable, documented code and develop test sequences, operator interfaces, instrument drivers, data-processing functions, diagnostic tools and reports.
  • Integrate software with instrumentation, data-acquisition hardware, switching systems, communications interfaces and units under test. Implement suitable error handling, logging, user access controls and recovery mechanisms.
  • Reuse proven frameworks and components where appropriate, and modify, extend or migrate software for existing and legacy test systems.
  • Participate in the complete lifecycle, including requirements, feasibility, architecture, detailed design, implementation, unit testing, software and hardware integration, verification, validation, factory acceptance, site acceptance, commissioning and in-service support.
  • Contribute to technical reviews and produce plans, specifications, design descriptions and test evidence. Maintain traceability between requirements, design, implementation and verification.
  • Estimate software effort and provide realistic input to project plans and proposals. Identify risks, assumptions, dependencies and constraints, and assess readiness for integration, formal testing and customer acceptance.
  • Apply source control, configuration, release and change-management practices. Ensure releases are identifiable, reproducible and supported by required documentation; contribute to safety, cybersecurity and compliance activities where needed.
  • Define and perform unit, integration and system testing. Debug in laboratory and production environments and investigate issues across software, hardware, communications and instrumentation.
  • Support demonstrations, factory acceptance, installation, site acceptance and commissioning. Resolve defects, issue controlled updates and support equipment during warranty and operational life.
  • Work with customers and multidisciplinary colleagues to clarify requirements, communicate progress and risks, participate in workshops and reviews, share technical knowledge and improve reusable components and engineering methods.
  • Contribute to feasibility studies, solution development, software estimates, technical proposals, bid reviews and customer clarification meetings.

Software Engineer Essential skills and experience

  • Degree, HNC/HND in software engineering, computer science, electronic engineering, systems engineering or a related discipline.
  • Experience developing software for engineering, industrial, scientific or equipment-based applications.
  • Practical experience with at least one relevant language or environment, such as C/C++, C#, LabVIEW, TestStand or Python.
  • Sound understanding of software architecture and structured design; experience debugging and testing software in a practical engineering environment.
  • Familiarity with source control and configuration management, technical documentation and software test evidence.
  • Understanding of the development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, integration, verification and controlled release.
  • Logical and analytical problem-solving, initiative in resolving issues, and the ability to understand complex technical information.
  • Effective teamwork, written and verbal communication, and confidence engaging with customers and non-software disciplines.
  • Ability to manage assigned work, report progress realistically, meet commitments and adapt to different technologies and projects.
  • Willingness to work alongside engineers and physical equipment and travel occasionally in the UK and internationally. Right to work in the UK.

Software Engineer Desirable technical experience

  • Aerospace, defence, space, rail, energy or another regulated sector; automated or special-to-type test equipment.
  • LabVIEW/TestStand; modern C++ including maintenance of C++14 codebases; hardware-in-the-loop, simulation or real-time test systems.
  • Data acquisition, signal conditioning, switching, instrumentation control or commercial test instruments.
  • Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, serial, RS-232, RS-422, RS-485, CAN, ARINC 429, AFDX or MIL-STD-1553.
  • Multithreaded, event-driven or real-time software; operator/HMI development, automated test sequencing and results reporting.
  • Relational databases, requirements traceability, unit and automated testing, continuous integration, design patterns, object-oriented development or Windows engineering applications.
  • Industrial/test-system cybersecurity, software safety, coding standards, regulated development, build/release management or legacy software migration.
  • Factory/site acceptance and commissioning, or experience in geographically distributed teams. Relevant Armed Forces technical experience in electronics, avionics, communications, weapons systems, test equipment, maintenance, diagnostics or training is welcomed, alongside demonstrable software-development ability.

Security requirements

Applicants must be UK nationals and eligible to obtain and maintain the level of UK national security clearance required. Appointment is subject to relevant background checks and any programme-specific nationality or residency restrictions.

Reporting and offer

The reporting line will be to the Regional Operations Manager or an Engineering Team Leader, to be confirmed.

  • competitive salary, performance-related bonus, pension, family healthcare and health cash plans, 27 days’ annual leave plus UK bank holidays, cycle-to-work scheme and professional development

title: Evidence Generation Lead, Central Europe
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

About the Role

In this Senior Manager level role, you will help shape and deliver the evidence generation strategy for Central Europe, identifying local evidence gaps and translating them into scientifically rigorous, feasible, patient-focused, and compliant plans. You will play a key role in connecting the needs of the Netherlands, Switzerland, and Austria with regional and global evidence strategies, plans, and investment decisions. As part of the Global Evidence Generation organization, you will provide scientific and operational leadership for approved research activities, including real-world evidence, observational research, database studies, and investigator-initiated research. Your work will contribute to high-quality research across the study lifecycle and effective management of the regional evidence portfolio. You will also help advance innovative research methods, digital tools, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities to strengthen evidence generation, synthesis, and decision-making.


How You Will Contribute

  • Lead evidence generation strategy by identifying and prioritizing local evidence gaps with medical, access, and cross-functional partners.
  • Direct research across the study lifecycle from concept development and governance review through execution, analysis, reporting, close-out, and dissemination.
  • Develop scientific study materials with internal experts and external partners, including protocols, analysis plans, reports, abstracts, and manuscripts.
  • Ensure scientific quality and compliance by applying company policies, ethical standards, research practices, and relevant country regulations.
  • Coordinate integrated research planning with regional, global, and local partners across medical, research, access, regulatory, data, and operational functions.
  • Manage the evidence portfolio by overseeing budgets, forecasts, vendors, resources, timelines, governance, performance, and material risks.
  • Apply digital and analytical capabilities to strengthen evidence planning, portfolio oversight, communication, synthesis, and decision-making.

Qualifications

title: Medior Data Engineer – Databricks & Lakehouse Platform (Cloud)
description:
Job Description


Bent u de juiste sollicitant voor deze functie? Ontdek het door het functieoverzicht hieronder te lezen.

Fugro is a global leader in Geo‑data, building a modern cloud‑based lakehouse platform on Databricks to unlock high‑quality, governed data at scale. As we accelerate our digital transformation, we are looking for a hands‑on Medior Data Engineerwho enjoys building reliable cloud data pipelines, curating trusted datasets, and enabling analytics and AI across the organisation. You will work closely with engineering, analytics, data science and domain teams to deliver production‑grade data products that power Fugro’s global operations.

Your role

  • You design, build and maintain cloud‑native batch and streaming pipelines on Databricks using Lakeflow, Delta Lake and orchestration tools.

  • You implement the medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) to deliver trustworthy, performant datasets.

  • You develop transformations in PySpark and Spark SQL and help standardise reusable engineering patterns.

  • You take ownership of data quality, observability and operational reliability through validation, monitoring, alerting and runbooks.

  • You work with Unity Catalog to ensure governed access, documentation and lineage‑aware development.

  • You translate analytical and business requirements into scalable, pragmatic datasets that enable BI, analytics and AI.

  • You contribute to engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing approaches, CI/CD and cost‑efficient cloud usage.

  • You collaborate closely with platform, analytics and domain teams to deliver production‑ready data products end‑to‑end.

Your track record

  • You bring 3–6 years of experience in data engineering or equivalent experience delivering production‑grade cloud pipelines.

  • You have strong Python and SQL skills and hands‑on experience with Apache Spark on Databricks.

  • You have worked in at least one major cloud environment (AWS, Azure or GCP) and understand cloud storage and security concepts.

  • You are familiar with lakehouse principles, Delta Lake and incremental processing patterns.

  • You understand data governance concepts such as catalogs, permissions, lineage and data contracts (Unity Catalog is a plus).

  • You have experience with common ingestion patterns (files, APIs, databases) and know how to balance reliability, performance and cost.

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders.

  • Commuting allowance;

  • Collective health insurance;

description:

Senior Project Manager, Multi-site

As a Senior Project Manager in JLL's Multi-site Program Management service line, you will be a critical delivery driver within one of the most specialized and high-volume project management practices in commercial real estate. Our 300+ project managers across the United States manage programs spanning tens, hundreds, or thousands of client locations — from QSR renovations and retail rollouts to technology deployments, rebranding initiatives, and new construction. You will bring deep expertise in managing concurrent projects across distributed portfolios, executing with the speed, consistency, and discipline that national accounts demand.

Your innovative approach, collaborative mindset, and commitment to repeatable excellence will help clients achieve their portfolio goals while advancing JLL's mission to deliver seamless, scalable solutions across every location.


WHAT THIS JOB INVOLVES

As a Senior Project Manager within Multi-site at JLL, you will be an integral part of a dynamic team shaping a brighter way for our clients, our colleagues, and our communities.

  • You will manage multiple concurrent projects across a client's distributed portfolio, maintaining consistency in scope, quality, budget, and schedule at every site.
  • You will be empowered to own programs end-to-end — from initial solutioning through project closeout — operating with the autonomy and accountability of a senior delivery professional.
  • You will collaborate across centralized scheduling, procurement, and reporting functions that define how Multi-site delivers at scale.
  • You will partner closely with Program Leads, Portfolio Leads, and client stakeholders to ensure program governance, quality standards, and client satisfaction are upheld across the portfolio.
  • You will contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging JLL's best-in-class tools, methodologies, and technology platforms to drive efficiency and data-driven decision making.

WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

Multi-site Project Execution

  • Manage multiple concurrent projects across a client's portfolio, ensuring each site is delivered on time, within budget, and to program quality standards.
  • Execute repeatable project management processes customized to client programs — from initial scoping and schedule development through construction management, closeout, and client handoff.
  • Oversee all project phases including pre-construction, permitting, contractor procurement, construction, FF&E coordination, and final occupancy across assigned sites.
  • Apply JLL's program governance standards to maintain consistency across all locations, including site-specific risk mitigation strategies.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned clients, building trusted relationships and providing transparent, proactive communication throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Facilitate regular client meetings, status reporting, and escalation management across all active project sites.
  • Partner with Program Leads to provide executive-level updates and contribute to client satisfaction reviews.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional JLL teams — including IFM, Design, Work Dynamics, and IPS — to deliver integrated solutions aligned with client portfolio strategies.

Budget & Financial Management

  • Manage project budgets across multiple simultaneous sites, tracking expenditures, processing invoices, and maintaining accurate financial forecasts in Certinia.
  • Develop and monitor cost reports, identify variances, and implement corrective actions to protect project and program financial performance.
  • Support Portfolio and Program Leads with financial reporting accuracy, AR collections follow-up, and timely updates in Salesforce and Certinia.
  • Apply value engineering principles and leverage JLL's Synergy procurement program to generate measurable cost savings for clients.

Vendor & Contractor Management

  • Competitively source, select, and manage contractors, architects, and vendors across project sites in alignment with JLL's delivery model (Agent, Contracting Manager, or Principal as applicable).
  • Administer contracts, review scopes of work, enforce performance standards, and resolve vendor issues across all assigned projects.
  • Drive accountability with trade partners to maintain schedule, quality, and cost targets across a high volume of concurrent projects.

Reporting, Technology & Program Governance

  • Maintain accurate, real-time project data across JLL platforms including Certinia, Salesforce, Smartsheet, and client-specific reporting tools.
  • Produce portfolio-level reporting dashboards and status updates that enable clients to make data-driven decisions about their real estate capital deployment.
  • Adhere to Multi-site program governance frameworks, including program launch protocols, audit processes, and continuous improvement cycles.
  • Leverage JLL's technology suite to enable standardized, efficient, and transparent multi-location project delivery.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to Project Managers and Project Coordinators within the program team, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
  • Collaborate with Program Leads to optimize team structure, resource allocation, and staffing to meet evolving portfolio demands.
  • Contribute actively to business development by supporting solutioning efforts, developing fee models, and participating in client presentations for existing or prospective accounts.
  • Champion JLL's values of collaboration, inclusivity, and belonging across every client and team interaction.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of project management experience, with at least 3 years managing multiple concurrent projects in a program or multi-site environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing distributed, high-volume project portfolios across multiple geographies or client locations.
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management certification required.
  • Proven track record of delivering projects on time and within budget across complex, multi-stakeholder programs.
  • Strong financial acumen including budget management, cost forecasting, and financial reporting.
  • Proficiency in project management platforms (MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent) and financial systems (Certinia or equivalent ERP/PSA tools).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage client relationships and lead cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage competing priorities across a high volume of simultaneous projects.
  • Familiarity with commercial real estate delivery models including construction management, agency, and at-risk contracting structures.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in multi-site or national account program management within commercial real estate sectors such as retail, QSR, healthcare, banking, or grocery.
  • Experience working within structured program governance frameworks, including program launch, ongoing auditing, and closeout processes.
  • Master's degree in a related field or MBA.
  • Knowledge of industry-specific building codes, ADA compliance requirements, and sustainability standards.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and financial platforms such as Certinia.

Grantific helps innovative companies find, manage, and secure funding opportunities more efficiently. As an AI Engineer at Grantific, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data pipelines and AI infrastructure powering our matching platform. You will work on integrating and processing large volumes of heterogeneous grant data from APIs, scraping pipelines, and external sources, while building production-grade LLM workflows for extraction, retrieval, and matching. title: Sundheds – eller socialfaglig medarbejder til FACT-teamet - Psykiatriens Hus (Barselvikar)
description:
Vores kære kollega skal på barsel og vi leder derfor efter en der har lyst til at være en del af vores lille team fra 1. januar 2027.

Hvem er vi og laver vi i FACT-teamet?

FACT- teamet er etableret i efteråret 2025, og vi er derfor stadig i gang med at udvikle og implementere vores indsats. Vi er en tværfaglig medarbejdergruppe på 9 personer med fagligheder som psykolog, ergoterapeut, læge, pædagog, social- og sundhedsassistent og sygeplejerske.

FACT er en fleksibel og sammenhængende social- og psykiatrifaglig indsats på tværs af kommune og region, som samler behandling, social støtte, bostøtte og øvrige indsatser omkring borgerens hverdag. Vi er et tværfagligt team med fælles ansvar for borgerens samlede forløb. Opgaverne fordeles efter borgerens behov og ikke efter sektorgrænser. Vi vil gerne møde borgere der de hvor de er og ønsker at lykkes – tæt på deres hverdag. Det sikrer, at borgere med svær psykisk sygdom og komplekse udfordringer får den rette støtte på det rette tidspunkt fra ét fælles team.

Målgruppen er borgere med alvorlig psykisk lidelse og komplekse udfordringer, og som har behov for vedvarende, koordineret indsats fra både kommune og behandlingspsykiatri. Det er tale om borgere, der har svært ved at profitere af ordinære tilbud, og hvor der er behov for én samlet plan og fleksibel støtte over tid.

FACT-teamets arbejdsopgaver inkluderer:

  • at samle trådene og koordinere indsatsen på tværs af behandling og støtte, arbejde opsøgende og hverdagsnært og løbende skrue op og ned for indsatsen, så parallelle og usammenhængende forløb undgås.
  • at sikre kontinuitet og overblik i de stabile perioder med afsæt i borgerens mål og ressourcer, og aktivere teamet mere intensivt ved ændrede behov.
  • at arbejde recoveryorienteret med både behandlingsmæssig og rehabiliterende indsats
  • at levere fleksible og kreative løsninger i samarbejde med borgere med komplekse problemstillinger
  • at arbejde målorienteret og effektivt, og bidrage til en tillidsfuld og åben samarbejdskultur i teamet
  • at understøtte udviklingen og implementeringen af den integrerede FACT-model i tæt samarbejde med både kommunale og regionale partnere.

Vi søger dig der

  • har en sundheds – og/eller socialfaglig uddannelse
  • har erfaring fra behandlingspsykiatri og/ eller socialpsykiatri
  • står stærkt i egne faglige sko og kan se potentialet i at indgå i et tværfagligt team
  • er stærk i relationsarbejdet og skaber tillidsfulde samarbejdsrelationer med borgere, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere.
  • trives med komplekse opgaver og kreative løsninger
  • har en grundlæggende forståelse af den integrerede opgave, der skal løses sammen med borgerne.
  • har veludviklede samarbejdskompetencer og kan se muligheder i et forpligtende og gensidigt samarbejde på tværs af sektorer
  • har interesse og forståelse for begge sektorer og at vil tage aktivt del i at teamet arbejder målrettet i ét fælles spor.
  • har kørekort

Vi tilbyder

  • Onboarding og introprogram, tilpasset din erfaring
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab med engagerede, erfarne og hjælpsomme kolleger, hvor sparring, humor og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen.
  • En alsidig og meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du gør en forskel for mennesker med psykisk sårbarhed.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt

Ansøgningsfrist onsdag den 18. november 2026. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt mandag 23. november 2026.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027.

Ønsker du yderligere information, opfordres du til at kontakte leder af FACT-teamet Eirin Garnås tlf. 4010 9564; send evt. en sms eller mail til eirin.garnas@silkeborg.dk og du bliver ringet op.

What this job involves:
As the Regional Building Operation Systems (BOS) Manager, you will lead the strategic operation and maintenance of the region’s digital building portfolio. Your primary focus will be managing the holistic "Smart Systems" ecosystem—integrating BMS, LMS, and IoT technologies into a centralized cloud platform to drive operational eff iciency and sustainability. Acting as the technical bridge between Facility Management and IT, you will ensure strict adherence to Client Digital Building Standards, oversee cybersecurity compliance, and manage the full lifecycle of digital assets from hardware deployment to data-driven performance optimization.


What your day-to-day will look like:
● Drive Digital Strategy: Implement frameworks and policies to advance the "Smart Building" portfolio, ensuring all systems meet Client Digital Building standards.
● System Integration: Oversee the onboarding of buildings to the BOS platform, including ontology mapping, data validation, and the seamless integration of BMS and IoT devices.
● Performance Optimization: Analyze real-time operational data to identify inefficiencies, recommending solutions that enhance energy performance and reduce costs.
● Project & Vendor Management: Lead system enhancement projects and coordinate with OEMs/vendors for hardware upgrades, software integration, and defect resolution.
● Cybersecurity & Infrastructure: Manage building ICT networks and ensure strict cyber compliance for all connected devices and digital assets.
● Technical Support: Act as the primary escalation point for troubleshooting BOS integration issues, ensuring the resiliency and uptime of critical equipment.
● Asset Management: Regularly audit and manage the inventory of all digital hardware, software, and associated licensing.



Desired or preferred experience and technical skills:
● Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or IT with a minimum of 8 years of experience, including at least 3 years in a specialized BOS, BMS, or Smart Building role.
● Smart Building Expertise: Deep understanding of IoT ecosystems, cloud integration, and BOS platform technology stacks (e.g., Clearblade, UDMI, Data Ontology).
● Building Systems Knowledge: Strong technical grasp of BMS, HVAC, Lighting (LMS), and Fire Alarm Systems, including how devices communicate to the cloud.
● Network Proficiency: Solid understanding of IT infrastructure and network protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, and KNX.
● Data & Analytics: Experience with data mapping, database management (SQL is a plus), and visualization tools like Power BI to drive data-driven decisions.
● Project Management: Proven ability to manage cross-functional projects, coordinate with OEMs/vendors, and oversee system handovers.
● Digital Proficiency: Advanced literacy in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) or MS Off ice, with the ability to create high-quality technical presentations.


Required Skills and Experience:

title: Data Engineer Communicatie en Informatiesystemen Operaties (CISOPS)
description:
Als Data Engineer bij de Marechaussee automatiseer je processen op Milestone XProtect – hét platform dat camera’s, sensoren en systemen samenbrengt tot één krachtig geheel.



Ervaring, kwalificaties en soft skills: heeft u alles in huis om te slagen in deze functie? Ontdek het hieronder.

Geen losse applicatie, maar een ecosysteem dat loopt van datacenter tot mobiele commandocentra en rapid response voertuigen die binnen twee uur overal in Nederland operationeel zijn. Jij bouwt mee aan een platform dat continu sensordata levert aan de hele organisatie. De schaal, de samenhang en de impact? Indrukwekkend.


Met jouw werk draag je direct bij aan de veiligheid van Nederland. Het platform dat jij helpt bouwen en beheren ondersteunt de Marechaussee bij grensbewaking, het bewaken en beveiligen van vitale objecten en het optreden tijdens incidenten en crises. Dankzij jouw kennis en inzet beschikken collega’s in het veld over actuele en betrouwbare informatie om in split-seconds de juiste beslissingen te nemen. Zo heeft elke regel code, elke automatisering en elke koppeling die jij maakt, tastbare impact op vrede en veiligheid.


Je werkzaamheden zijn veelzijdig en technisch uitdagend. Denk aan:



  • Ontwikkelen, beheren en automatiseren van het Sentinel-platform, hét systeem dat sensordata samenbrengt voor de hele Marechaussee.
  • Bouwen en onderhouden van datapipelines, koppelen van databronnen en het transformeren naar verwerkbare gegevens.
  • Implementeren en optimaliseren van oplossingen op Milestone XProtect en andere gekoppelde applicaties.
  • Ontwerpen van robuuste OTAP-omgevingen en veilig in productie brengen van systemen.
  • Ontwikkelen van geautomatiseerde monitoring en voorspellende analyses om prestaties en beschikbaarheid van het platform te waarborgen.
  • Analyseren en oplossen van complexe incidenten en verstoringen, inclusief Root Cause Analysis en het toepassen van self-healing oplossingen.

Waarom dit zo bijzonder is


Wat jij ontwikkelt, maakt dagelijks het verschil op plekken waar technologie en veiligheid samenkomen. De systemen waar jij aan werkt, zorgen ervoor dat collega’s in het veld precies weten wat er speelt — van de grensovergang tot aan een crisislocatie. Je bouwt mee aan een operationeel platform dat 24/7 moet presteren, onder de meest veeleisende omstandigheden.


Daarbij werk je in een omgeving die je nergens anders vindt: high-tech infrastructuren, directe koppelingen tussen data en operatie, en een hechte samenwerking met professionals die hun vak tot in de puntjes beheersen. Elk script, elke automatisering en elke verbetering die jij oplevert, draagt bij aan de veiligheid van Nederland. En dát geeft betekenis aan je werk.


Benieuwd hoe de afdeling IV&CIS en de sectie CISOPS achter de schermen werken aan innovatieve oplossingen die het verschil maken tijdens operaties? Lees het artikel in het KMar-magazine en ontdek hoe jouw toekomstige collega’s technologie inzetten om veiligheid in binnen- en buitenland te waarborgen:


Wat vragen we van jou?


Je bent een Data Engineer die techniek en veiligheid weet te verbinden. Je werkt nauwkeurig, weet prioriteiten te stellen en hebt een sterke affiniteit met complexe technische omgevingen.



  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding.
  • Meerdere jaren werkervaring met het ontwikkelen en beheren van systemen in omgevingen met o.a. VMware, Nutanix, Linux OS en Windows Server.
  • Kennis van informatiebeveiligingskaders zoals BIO, ISO27001 en NIST-II, en ervaring met monitoringtools zoals Prometheus en Grafana.
  • Ervaring met het automatiseren van processen met bijvoorbeeld Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, Elastic of Python.
  • Postacademische opleidingen zoals Data Engineering, Data & Analytics of Certified Data Engineering Professional (CDEP).
  • Aantoonbare vaardigheden in het schrijven van scripts zoals Python en SQL.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden


Salarisniveau: Burgerschaal IBBAD 10


Dienstverband: Tijdelijke aanstelling met zicht op vaste aanstelling


Contractduur: 12 maanden


Uren per week: 38


Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden


Defensie hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en kent goede studiefaciliteiten, hierdoor sta je nooit stil. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien.


Naast het salaris ontvang je een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,33% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaal vriendelijke doelen. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden.


Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, volledige vergoeding van je OV-reiskosten woon-werkverkeer en gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof.


Ministerie van Defensie


Defensie zet zich in voor de belangen, welvaart en vrijheid van Nederland. We zijn dagelijks actief in binnen- en buitenland. Onze wereldwijde inzet versterkt de internationale samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat mensen zich in vrijheid kunnen ontplooien. Nu en in de toekomst.


Bij het ministerie van Defensie werken ongeveer 58.000 mensen direct en indirect aan vrede en veiligheid. Het ministerie bestaat uit de Bestuursstaf (het departement), de Koninklijke Marine, de Koninklijke Landmacht, de Koninklijke Luchtmacht, de Koninklijke Marechaussee, het Defensie Ondersteuningscommando (DOSCO) en het Commando Materieel en IT (COMMIT).


Defensie is een van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland en vertoont overeenkomsten met een groot bedrijf. De operationele commando's (zee-, land- en luchtstrijdkrachten), de Marechaussee, het DOSCO en de COMMIT lijken op werkmaatschappijen.


Waar kom je te werken?


Je werkt bij het Landelijk Tactisch Commando (LTC), de operationele eenheid van de Koninklijke Marechaussee. Binnen het LTC zorgt de afdelingIV&CIS (Informatievoorzieningen en Communicatiesystemen) voor alle informatievoorzieningen in Nederland én het Caribisch gebied.


De sectie CISOPS bestaat uit twee bureaus:



  • SVM (Sensing, Verbindingen en Meldkamerdomein) – ondersteunt alle KMar-taakvelden met sensordiensten en verbindingssystemen (zoals C2000, SATCOM en militaire radiosystemen) en beheert het Sentinel platform.
  • C2OST (Command & Control Ondersteuning) – beheert systemen en netwerken die nodig zijn voor command & control binnen operatiecentra en daarbuiten.

Jij komt te werken binnen het bureau SVM waar het Sentinel team verantwoordelijk is voor de ontwikkeling en het beheer van het Sentinel Platform. Binnen het team rapporteer je aan de product owner en stuur jij, als meewerkend voorman, de verschillende beheerders aan in de dagelijkse uitvoering. xgiwjmb Samen met collega’s werk je aan pragmatische, robuuste en veilige oplossingen die cruciaal zijn voor het succes van de KMar-operaties.

title: (Senior) Data Engineer
description:
Ben jij een gedreven Senior Data Engineer en typeer jij jezelf als een echte bouwer? Ben je op zoek naar een functie waarin je impact kunt maken en bijdraagt aan een toekomstbestendig Azure dataplatform met als doel om slimmer en innovatiever data te ontsluiten? Dan is deze functie op jouw lijf geschreven!



Wilt u solliciteren? Zorg ervoor dat uw cv up-to-date is en lees vervolgens de volgende functiespecificaties zorgvuldig door voordat u solliciteert.

For this position we only consider Dutch native speakers.


Bij Baker Tilly bouwen we aan een modern, schaalbaar Azure-dataplatform dat de organisatie helpt om sneller en beter beslissingen te nemen én om data-producten te ontwikkelen voor collega’s en klanten.


Ons platform staat stevig: de architectuur is uitgewerkt, de eerste bronnen zijn ontsloten en we zijn klaar voor de volgende fase. We zoeken een Senior Data Engineer die de technische lat hoog legt en meehelpt om data structureel waarde te laten leveren in de organisatie.


Als Senior Data Engineer ontwerp, bouw en beheer je (samen met het team) het dataplatform en de data-infrastructuur. Je vertaalt businessbehoeften naar robuuste oplossingen en borgt dat governance, security en privacy “by design” zijn ingericht.
Concreet betekent dat:


Bouwen & doorontwikkelen van het platform

  • Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert data pipelines in PySpark (en waar passend SQL), van bronontsluiting tot curated datasets.
  • Je breidt het platform uit met meerdere databronnen, datamodellen en herbruikbare componenten (standaarden, templates, libraries).
  • Je levert datasets op als betrouwbare data-producten voor BI en andere toepassingen (data scientists, applicaties, procesautomatisering).

CI/CD & engineering excellence

  • Je richt CI/CD in voor Databricks-workloads en data-producten (tests, quality checks, deployment, versiebeheer).
  • Je stimuleert engineering best practices: code reviews, branching strategy, testing, monitoring, documentatie, runbooks.

Governance, security & compliance

  • Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders (business) én met Security/Privacy/Legal om af te stemmen wat kan en mag.
  • Je implementeert maatregelen zoals row-level security, lineage/traceability, dataretentie, logging/auditing en toegangsbeheer.

Advisory & samenwerking

  • Je acteert als sparringpartner voor business stakeholders: je stelt de juiste vragen, maakt trade-offs expliciet en vertaalt dit naar toekomstbestendige technische keuzes.
  • Je signaleert technologische ontwikkelingen en vertaalt deze naar verbeteringen/innovaties op het platform.

De afdeling Data & Analytics draagt actief bij aan de transformatie van Baker Tilly en we ontwikkelen dataproducten en oplossingen voor onze interne organisatie ten behoeve van een betere en efficiëntere bedrijfsvoering. Daarnaast ligt de focus ook op het ontwikkelen van dataproducten met als doel om deze in de market te zetten voor onze externe klanten.
Deze functie biedt jou dan ook de unieke kans om vanaf de basis mee te denken, mee te bouwen én het verschil te maken in de groei van het team! Kortom: je maakt écht impact!


Ben jij nieuwsgierig, ondernemend en heb je een passie voor data? Houd jij van technische uitdagingen, maar verlies je de business-impact nooit uit het oog? Lees dan gauw verder en check hieronder of deze functie matcht met jouw profiel.


Functie-eisen

  • Je beschikt over WO werk- en denkniveau.
  • Minimaal 4 tot 6 jaar ervaring in een rol als Data Engineer binnen een organisatie, die aan verandering en groei onderhevig is.
  • Je hebt een visie op data en deelt deze graag om een data-gedreven cultuur te bevorderen.
  • Ervaring met het ontsluiten van API’s, databases en andere databronnen.
  • Ervaring met Azure Databricks of vergelijkbare technologieën.
  • Kennis van CI/CD en versiebeheer (bijv. Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is een harde vereiste.

Gelukkig zijn wij allemaal anders. Werken bij Baker Tilly betekent werken bij een werkgever die inziet dat onze verschillen ons juist sterker maken. Hebben wij jou enthousiast gemaakt over deze functie, maar twijfel jij nog of deze voldoende bij je past? xgiwjmb Neem dan zeker contact op met een van onze recruiters om je twijfel en vragen samen rustig te bespreken. Wij horen heel graag van je.

title: Bakery InStore Clerk Part Time Evening

title: Chief Customer Officer
description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.

We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection, no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job. We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow. We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position. Work from anywhere!

Position Overview

Xapo’s product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn’t yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

The Mandate

Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.

You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members’ balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.

Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.

You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product’s contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.

Win the right members, efficiently.

You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.

Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.

Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions’ products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.

Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.

You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.

Build one Customer organisation, not four.

Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.

Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.

You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

How You’ll Operate

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you’ve solved problems with them.

You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they’re convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.

You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn’t move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don’t report “the roadmap item shipped”, you change the approach.

You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you’ve earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive’s plan, including the CEO’s, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.

You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn’t earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

What You’ll Have Done

10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).

Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don’t need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don’t need banking explained to you either.

Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.

Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.

Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product’s economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.

Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that’s sustainable and growth that’s borrowed from tomorrow’s risk appetite.

A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn’t support them, and outcomes you can prove.

The First 90 Days

Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.

Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product’s contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.

Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

What This Role Is Not

Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product’s contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don’t run those functions.

Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.

Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.

Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

Other Requirements

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why Work for Xapo

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

Shape the Future: Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

Great work-life balance: Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

Expect Excellence: Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best, from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

title: Studerende/ufaglærte til Nattevagtsteamet
description:

title: Branch Operations Lead - Center Moriches, NY
description:
At Chase, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences for our clients and employees, making them feel welcomed, valued, and understood. We build lasting relationships by doing the right thing, exceeding expectations, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

As a Branch Operations Lead in a Chase Branch, you'll be at the heart of our branch operations, working closely with the Branch Manager, branch employees, and our team of experts. Your role is crucial in ensuring that our clients' financial transactions are handled with precision and care, all while adhering to our policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

A typical day will involve assisting clients with their transactions, but it doesn't stop there. You'll have the opportunity to make a real difference by introducing clients to self-service options that simplify their banking experience and by building lasting relationships with them. Throughout the week, you'll also dedicate time to reviewing branch operations and keeping the branch team informed about the latest policies and procedures. Your leadership will ensure that our branch not only meets but exceeds control expectations, setting a positive tone for everyone who walks through our doors.

Job responsibilities
  • Collaborate with the Branch Manager to create a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere in the branch, ensuring every client enjoys an exceptional experience and feels part of a dynamic community.
  • Greet clients warmly as they enter the branch, making them feel valued and appreciated. Demonstrate genuine care and concern during interactions, assisting with transactions, managing lobby flow, and scheduling meetings to build trusted relationships.
  • Engage clients with clear, polite communication to understand and help them effectively. Anticipate their needs while checking them into the waiting queue, ensuring a smooth visit.
  • Lead branch operations, including managing cash devices like the cash vault and ATM. Resolve any client issues quickly and effectively, paying attention to detail and striving for consistency while adhering to all bank policies and procedures.
  • Introduce clients to our friendly branch team, who collaborate to deliver seamless service with care and sincerity. Work together to build lasting relationships and assist with any specialized financial needs, elevating the client experience.
  • Simplify clients' banking experience by sharing self-service options, allowing them to access their accounts anytime, day or night.
  • Work closely with the Branch Manager to support all aspects of branch operations, including maintaining high standards for loss control, compliance, and audits, ensuring the branch operates smoothly and securely.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You take pride in adhering to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements, ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently.
  • You are committed to maintaining a keen eye for detail and staying organized, which helps you juggle multiple tasks effectively.
  • You are proud of your leadership skills and operational proficiency, ensuring transaction accuracy while thriving in a collaborative team environment.
  • You have a strong passion for educating the branch team and partners, helping them stay connected and informed.
  • You excel at building meaningful connections and engaging with clients, always ready to educate them and refer them to our team of experts when needed.
  • You have 1+ years of retail banking experience.
  • You have a high school degree, GED, or foreign equivalent.
  • You have the ability to work branch hours including weekends and evenings.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You have 6+ months of Associate Banker (Teller) experience.
  • You have a college degree or military equivalent.
Training and Travel Requirement
  • You’ll successfully complete our Branch Operations Lead Training Program before being considered for placement as a Branch Operations Lead.
  • You’ll need to be able to travel as required for in-person training and meetings.

title: Service Associate
description:
As a member of the C&S Wholesale Grocers family of companies, SpartanNash is a food solutions company that delivers the ingredients for a better life. A distributor, wholesaler and retailer with a global supply chain network, SpartanNash distributes grocery and household goods, including fresh produce and the Our Family® portfolio of products, to locations in all 50 states.

Our braggingly happy team members — ranging from bakery managers to order selectors; from IT developers to vice presidents of finance; from HR Business Partners to export specialists — create braggingly happy customers spanning national accounts, independent and chain grocers, e-commerce retailers, U.S. military commissaries and exchanges, and the Company’s own brick-and-mortar grocery stores, pharmacies and fuel centers.

Ready to contribute to the success of our food solutions company? Apply now!

Location:

2900 Burlingame Ave SW - Wyoming, Michigan 49509

Position Summary:

This role is responsible to provide highly satisfactory service and assistance to guests; bag groceries and provide carry-out service to vehicles for quests, retrieve carts from parking area, perform bottle tasks and janitorial duties as needed. Ensure that the shift contributes to the financial best interests of the store. Complete all other duties as assigned in a timely manner.

Here's what you’ll do:

  • Use proper bagging supplies and proper bagging techniques when handling guests' purchases.

  • Empty bottle bins, clean bottle machines & bottle return area.

  • Collect, return, clean, and organize shopping carts and take out and load groceries into customers’ vehicles.

  • Have familiarity with location of products carried in the store.

  • Handle spoiled/damaged products per established guidelines.

  • Maintain a clean, attractive and well stocked department.

  • Know the location of products in the store.

  • Able to work independently of others.

  • Perform cleaning duties as well as other assigned work in a timely manner.

  • Follow all PPE and Safety Guidelines

  • Follow all Food Safety and Cleaning Expectations

  • Follow Guest Experience Guidelines

  • May be assigned tasks in other departments based on customer experience need

  • Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed

Here’s what you’ll need:

  • High School Diploma (GED) preferred

  • Good oral communication skills.

  • Ability to interact politely and effectively with customers.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. May be required to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds frequently, and up to 50 pounds occasionally. The associate is required to stand and walk for extended periods of time and may bend, stoop, twist and turn frequently. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is subject to a typical retail store environment (varied temperatures) and is exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. Travel requirements vary by assignment.

SpartanNash is an Equal Opportunity Employer that invests in Associate development, recognizes and celebrates success, fosters two-way communication, and promotes a sense of belonging. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, including those with disabilities and Veterans.


We are not able to sponsor work visas for this position.

title: Børnehandicapteamet i Nyborg Kommune søger socialrådgiverkollega
description:
Vi har altid ambitioner om at blive et endnu stærkere handicapteam på det specialiserede børne- og familieområde, og vi har brug for endnu en dygtig socialrådgiver på rejsen, da en af vores dygtige medarbejdere går på barsel. Der er tale om en fast stilling.

Brænder du for socialrådgivning med hjerne og hjerte, og vil du via dialog og inddragelse være med til at sikre børn og unges udvikling, sundhed og trivsel? Har du lyst til at blive en del af et prioriteret område og en engageret afdeling, der altid arbejder målrettet på at udvikle og forbedre det specialiserede børnehandicapområde? Så er en hel flok dygtige kolleger klar til at tage i mod dig.

Om os:
Vi er en dynamisk kommune, der tror på, at stærke fællesskaber skaber trivsel sammen med borgerne. I Nyborg Kommune hylder vi fællesskaber, ambitioner, visioner og mod.

Vi tror på nødvendigheden af et tæt samarbejde med kommunens øvrige forvaltninger, så vi i fællesskab kan finde den bedste løsning i samarbejd med de familier vi er i kontakt med.

I Børnehandicapteamet arbejder vi med børn i alderen 0-23 år. Vi yder råd og vejledning til familier med børn, unge- og deres familier, som har en betydelig og varigt nedsat fysisk eller psykisk funktionsevne. Vi arbejder ud fra lovgivningen i Barnets Lov samt enkelte paragraffer i Serviceloven, herunder kompensationsydelse og tabt arbejdsfortjeneste m.v.
Vi udarbejder målgruppervurderinger i form af Børne Handicap Udredninger, børnefaglige undersøgelser, børne-og ugeplaner, iværksættelse samt opfølgning af støtteforanstaltninger jf. Barnets Lov.
Handicapteamet håndterer også søskendesager i de tilfælde hvor det giver bedst mening for barnet/familien og ellers i tæt samarbejde med rådgiver i Børneteamet.

Du kommer naturligvis til at bruge din socialfaglige baggrund, men også din evne til at møde og rumme den specifikke familie, det enkelte barn og den situation, de står i. Når familierne kommer til os, er de ofte i sorg eller krise, og der er stort behov for empati, situationsfornemmelse og professionalisme i mødet. Vi møder barnet og familierne med en faglig nysgerrighed i forhold til, hvad vi kan tilbyde og vi søger proaktivt at tænke i løsninger og muligheder.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Screening af ansøgninger og underretninger vedr. børn med nedsat funktionsevne og i nogle tilfælde også deres søskende.
  • Afdækning af barnets støttebehov.
  • Behandle ansøgninger om handicapkompenserende ydelser.
  • At sikre lovmedholdelighed i de sager, du har på din sagsstamme og i de afgørelser du træffer.
  • Inddragelse af børn, unge og deres familier.
  • Yde råd og vejledning til familier, som har børn med nedsat funktionsevne.
  • Deltage i netværks-, status- og opfølgningsmøder.
  • Understøtte familierne i udvikling af kompetencer i forhold til deres barns særlige behov.
  • Foretage løbende og rettidig opfølgninger.
  • At sikre et tæt og ligeværdigt samarbejde med udfører, samarbejdspartnere og kollegaer.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med kommunens øvrige forvaltninger.

Vi forventer, at:

  • Du er uddannet socialrådgiver med flere års erfaring.
  • Du har solid erfaring med myndighedsarbejde og med børn som har nedsat funktionsniveau samt deres familier.
  • Du er facilitator for et inkluderende og anerkendende menneskesyn og er opmærksom på egen kommunikation.
  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og har en systematisk og struktureret tilgang til at arbejde med børn, familier og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Du kan bruge retsregler, vejledninger, principafgørelser og praksisundersøgelser i dit arbejde og du tager medansvar for en høj faglighed i teamet og afdelingen.
  • Du trives med et tværfagligt samarbejde og er garant for en proaktiv tilgang til netværksinddragende møder og metoder.
  • Du har gå-på-mod, er åben og imødekommende.
  • Du er indstillet på at indgå i tværfaglige samarbejdsrelationer i en foranderlig hverdag.
  • Du kan håndtere IT som naturlig og nødvendig del af arbejdet. Fagsystemet er DUBU.
  • Du har kørekort, så du kan køre ud til familier og møder med samarbejdspartnere (der stilles biler til rådighed).

Vi tilbyder:

  • Fagligt kompetente og dygtige kollegaer med socialfaglig baggrund.
    Handicapteamet bestående af 6 socialrådgivere med flere års erfaring på området, en ergoterapeut som behandler hjælpemidler til børn, samt en ergoterapeut som behandler sager omkring handicapbiler.
    Herudover er der tilknyttet en Faglig Koordinator til teamet.
  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling og indflydelse på organisationens udvikling.
  • Masser af godt kollegaskab, arbejdsglæde og humor.
  • Bred, tværfaglig sparring i hverdagen.
  • Fokus på at sikre en sammenhængende og kontinuerlig indsats for børn.
  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår og fleksible arbejdstider, herunder fleksibel arbejdstidstilrettelæggelse om fredagen.
  • Løbende kurser og kompetenceløft.
  • Faglig supervision ved ekstern supervisor.
  • Et sagsantal, der ligger indenfor den ramme, der anbefales af Dansk Socialrådgiverforening på ca. 25 sager pr. rådgiver.

Yderligere information:
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst og principperne for lokal løndannelse. Lønniveauet (37 timer) udgør spændet mellem løntrin 32: ca. 400.000 kr. årligt og løntrin 38: ca. 445.000. årligt. Hertil kommer pension og fritvalgstillæg.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at der indhentes offentlig straffeattest og børneattest inden ansættelse.

Har du spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen eller har du lyst til at komme forbi til en uforpligtende snak over en kop kaffe, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Anni Vexø på tlf.: 2960 7636 / Fagkoordinator Karen Steffensen på tlf:. 2048 6652.

Ansøgningsfrist 23. november 2026
Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt torsdag 26. november 2026
Tiltrædelse snarest muligt eller seneste 1. januar 2027.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og byde dig velkommen i Nyborg Kommune.

Nyborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Politikken gælder alle ansatte og betyder, at det ikke er muligt at ryge i arbejdstiden. Rygepolitikken skal sikre, at alle ansatte i Nyborg Kommune kan færdes i et røgfrit arbejdsmiljø.

title: Airfreight Manager
description:
About Us

Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.
For the better. Together.

.This position has a base compensation range of $140,000.00 to $155,000.00. In addition to this base compensation, you'll benefit from our competitive health and welfare programs, a 401(k)-retirement savings plan, opportunities for tuition assistance, and incentive compensation for eligible positions. Salary determination considers your skills, experience, job location, internal pay equity and job architecture. Hellmann Worldwide Logistics regularly reviews our pay ranges against industry standards to ensure fairness.

The Airfreight Manager will manage the air product team for his/her assigned territory and be responsible for that territories product compliance, levels of working capital, quality outcomes to internal and external stakeholders, volume and revenue growth, yield, and operating efficiency.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Directly or indirectly manages all air product staff within assigned territory

• Ensures all air product operations within assigned territory are compliant to internal HWL policies and external government regulations

• Ensures air product working capital targets are met within assigned territory especially targets set for DPO (with product vendors) and DSO (especially on pass-through items)

• Responsible for timely and accurate costing, revenue estimates, rating, and invoicing to minimize WIP, DSO, and BadDebt

• Ensures air product operations within assigned territory meet internal HWL and external customer quality goals per Customer Standard Operating Procedure (CSOP)

• Ensures product air operations meet minimum customer service levels through effective procurement and routing

• Meets volume and top line air product revenue growth targets for assigned territory

• Ensures product yield is within target range at both a customer level and in aggregate for assigned territory

• Has authority and is responsible to set product general and customer specific sell tariff and spot rates for assigned territory and customers transacted within territory superseded only by geographical or functional up-line

• Ensures all financial and quality controls and audits are completed accurately and on-time

• Makes available to sales and Network Partners via a database market competitive general tariffs to assist them with accurately and quickly pricing FAK low and medium volume HWL opportunities

• Holds team accountable for developing clear and concise CSOPs Customer Specific Operating document(s) and certifications. Validates product staff understand and comply with CSOPs.

• Consults with Sales prior to their agreeing to non-standard services and/or pricing

• Works with Sales to effectively explain HWL product analytics including trend drivers and to develop business recommendations to customers to save money, reduce costs, or improve reliability

• Trains and coaches Sales on external market opportunities or threats, internal strengths and weaknesses, and how to effectively gain market share from HWL competitors on a case by case level or in aggregate

• Professionally manages customer escalations in conjunction with Sales

• Performs role of product subject matter expert when communicating with customers in a variety of settings

• Performs role of executive sponsor for key customers within assigned territory

• Leads or participates in corrective actions as necessary to mitigate the likelihood of revenue or profit loss when business is at risk

• Develops all department employees to ensure they are trained, certified, and re-certified periodically on product SOPs and Quality Management System

• Ensure performance goals are set, performance is measured, and regular informal and formal feedback is provided to direct and indirect reports within assigned territory

• Monitors and manages staffing levels and workload allocation across product team. This includes talent acquisition, furloughing, re-purposing, re-shifting, demotion, promotion, and severance

• Develops team and individuals within the team. Responsible for succession planning at agent, supervisor, and one’s own level

• Responsible for the accuracy and timeliness of product budgeting and forecasting within assigned product territory

• Manages vendors or TSP relationships within assigned product territory or as agreed with functional up -line and to develop strategic partnerships as necessary to differentiate HWL product competitiveness

• Responsible for the quality of cross-docking, consolidation, deconsolidation, and other product specific activities occurring either in a HWL or 3rd party warehouse. Assists District or Branch Managers with selecting, measuring, and managing HWL or 3rd party warehouses

• Manages the quality of all product vendors and to ensure business continuity in the event a vendor is unable to perform

• Performs other duties as assigned


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position supervises up to twelve (12) full time employees and may supervise temporary employees from time to time based on projects.


QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s degree (Business, Logistics and Supply Chain, Transportation, or associate field), or equivalent combination of education and work experience will be considered in lieu of educational requirement

• 5-7 years minimum airfreight experience

• 3-5 years minimum supervisory experience

• Completion of any industry related course is an asset


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

• Financial acumen – understands business drivers

• Results-oriented – drives strategy and execution

• Leadership – demonstrates professionalism

• Customer-focused

• Organizational skills

• Time management and prioritization

• Adaptable / flexible to high-pressured environment

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Email, and Internet

• Proficient in world geography, shipping documentation, and Incoterms preferred

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English in order to present information to customers, management, and subordinates in a professional setting

• Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as freight rates, discounts, and other percentages

• Analytical skills / problem-solving ability

• Coaching skills – able to train, coach, and develop subordinates


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• Frequently required to stand, and walk

title: Director Of Service Operations
description:
Since our inception in 2015 in Denmark, Liva has been a pioneer in the field of digital behaviour change. Our ambition is to empower 1 million people by 2030 to improve their health and well-being by preventing and managing chronic conditions through digitally-powered, evidence-based lifestyle interventions.

Headquartered in Copenhagen and London, our collaborations with healthcare systems - including the NHS, life science companies and health insurers - allow us to impact lives at scale. We recently acquired Momenta, a leading developer and provider of evidence-based, outcome driven, healthy lifestyle solutions that help people negotiate the many day-to-day challenges they face in living healthier lives, with a focus on weight management.

About the role

Patients rely on Liva through nine live direct care services and more than 30 contracts across five markets. Alongside our national NHS contracts, sits a fast-growing commercial book: GLP-1 wraparound support for major pharmacy chains in Europe and the Middle East, enterprise SaaS clients, our own dietetic clinics in Scandinavia, and the delivery of major clinical trials with academic partners.

We need an experienced operator to sit beside our VP Operations as chief of staff and delivery lead, to take ownership of contract performance, cost-to-serve and transformation, and make sure Liva keeps delivering gold-standard care as contracts, markets and volume grow. You will sit on our Leadership Team.

What you’ll be doing

  • Making sure we deliver what we promise. You will set the controls that show contract risk early and trigger recovery before a breach.

  • Making every patient affordable to serve. You will set cost per programme, per patient and per service, run the Service Operations budget roll-up and deliver cost improvement through automation, smarter support and better utilisation.

  • Building the operating model for the next stage. You will own the transformation roadmap, test our model against growth scenarios and decide when to add capacity or layers.

  • Taking new markets, contracts and acquisitions live. You will design and run the playbook that takes new work from mobilisation to business as usual, and lead operational due diligence and integration when Liva acquires or merges.

  • Leading through others. You will line manage our Customer Operations and act as Chief of Staff across all of Service Operations, resolving cross-functional conflict directly so teams own shared outcomes.

  • Standing up when things go wrong. Platform outages, supply shortages and missed submissions happen. You will lead from the front and make sure we learn from every one.

What you’ll have

  • You have led managers of managers across more than one function and in medium to large teams.

  • You have run services against SLAs with payment tied to performance, ideally in NHS-commissioned services or a comparable regulated setting.

  • You have held a budget and delivered cost improvement through unit economics.

  • You have led a restructure or operating model change through formal consultation to completion.

  • You have scaled a service through a step change in volume, or integrated an acquired business.

  • You have won support from a board or commissioners for significant change.

Bonus points for Chief of Staff or deputy experience, scale-up operations, M&A or TUPE, NHS England national programmes, or running operations across Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands or the Gulf.

What you’ll get

This is a rare seat. You will shape how a growing health-tech company delivers care to thousands of people across five markets, with a spot on the Leadership Team and a direct line into the Executive. The model is being rebuilt now, so your decisions will set how Liva operates for years. You will work alongside clinicians, technologists and commercial teams who care about outcomes, on services the NHS and major partners depend on.

This is a full-time role, UK-based and remote-first, with regular time together in London and occasional travel to our other markets. We are open to flexible start and finish times. Tell us what works for you.


At Liva, we are a purpose-driven company; we go to work every day to help people live better lives. Our purpose is in our DNA, and we are always on the lookout for talented people eager to evolve and build a life-changing career within global health tech.

We believe in doing business the right way. Liva is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our workforce. We're committed to developing a representative workforce at all levels, and maintaining a working environment that promotes the health and wellbeing of our employees.

As a signatory to the Armed Forces Covenant we welcome applications from veterans, service leavers, and military spouses.

Guaranteed Interview scheme - As part of our commitment to the Government Disability Confident Initiative, and the Armed Forces Covenant, we are offering a guaranteed interview scheme to anyone with as disability as defined by the Equality Act 2010, or military veterans, service leavers, and military spouses.

Liva will operate a fair, inclusive and transparent recruitment and selection process. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout our interview process please let us know and will be happy to accommodate.
