title: Distribution Planner Lead
description:
Job Description :

Role: DRP Leader

Location : Bangalore, India

Role Type: Permanent

Join our Supply Team

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.


Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.


Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

About this Role

The Distribution Requirements Planner’s (DRP) Leader primary role is to lead a team of DRP located across APAC, enabling smooth DRP operations and the team to deliver service, cash, cost, SLOB and capability.


The role also drives a strong team culture, develops planning capabilities, and builds a high-performing planning organization.


Given the long end-to-end supply cycle, the role is critical in driving robust demand planning, market accountability and proactive risk management. The Planning Leader will establish clear ways of working across inbound and outbound planning, drive root cause analysis of demand and supply variances, challenge assumptions, and ensure risks and misses are communicated early with clear mitigation actions and ownership.


You will be responsible for:

  • Coach, mentor and develop supply planning team.
  • Ensure Supply Planning systems and processes in place are aligned to global supply planning standards.
  • Delivery of optimal supply network plan to meet customer service OTIFNE targets and drive Diageo inventory performance to level of top 3 CPG companies.
  • Own appropriate inventory policies in partnership with markets to deliver upon agreed business targets.
  • Represent Supply in leading S&OP process, balancing demand and supply signals whilst ensuring strategy and annual targets can be delivered.
  • Lead and embed continuous improvement agenda across wider supply planning team enabling effective delivery of performance improvement plans prioritised by business targets. Including customer service and inventory targets.
  • Track progress of performance improvement plans and course correct to consistently ensure projected benefits are achieved.
  • Address any supply disruption or conflict situation through consensus solution or recommendation for escalation.
  • Coach, mentor and develop supply planning team.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

  • 5 years + Supply Chain planning experience in CPG (Demand Planning, Supply Planning, SMR, Logistics).
  • Additionally, some wider cross functional experience preferable e.g. commercial, finance or supply.
  • Exceptional systems experience within supply chain optimisation platforms (ERP / master data, time-phased replenishment planning systems, SAP, APO,OMP).
  • Understand, implement and sustain global supply planning codification agenda.
  • Detailed understanding of end-to-end supply chain operational processes e.g. DRP, MPS, inventory, conversion, logistics and customer service.
  • Exceptional influencing and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to challenge senior stakeholders and manage tension in demand/supply and S&OP conversations.
  • Exceptional communication skills – verbal, written and presentation.
  • Customer centric mind set.
  • Numerate with statistical, and analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • High degree of quantitative and analytical skills.
  • Proficient in MS applications e.g. Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access.

Working with Us

Flexibility is key to success in our business and many of our staff work flexibly in many ways, including part-time, compressed hours, flexible location. Please talk to us about what flexibility means to you and don’t let anything stop you from applying.

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.


We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.


Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.


Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.


If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Recruitment Scam Warning

Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

title: Product Director, Advisor Spain
description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants. Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe. We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your hiring experience matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive. If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.


The Advisor Spain at Shine

The Advisor Spain area owns the full Spanish CPA scope — the products that Spanish accounting and advisory firms (despachos) run their practice on today, and the path that takes them onto the Shine Advisor platform tomorrow.

The area covers tax and accounting, payroll, the small-business side of the despacho's client base, and the migration of legacy cohorts onto the strategic platform. It is a real business with real revenue, and a demanding professional user base.

The mission is dual. Near term: protect and grow the Spanish base — make Despachos/Diez a credible home for Spanish CPAs through usability and AI-assisted capabilities, and complete the planned product migrations. Longer term: Spain is the third market in the pan-European CPA platform alongside France and Germany, and this area decides what Spain contributes to that platform and what it takes from it.

The area consists of 5 product teams — Tax & Accounting, Payroll, Advisor Tools & Services I, Advisor Tools & Services II and Migrations — each led by a Product Manager working with engineering.

Your role as Product Director, Advisor Spain

As Product Director, Advisor Spain, you own the product direction for the full Spanish CPA scope end-to-end. This is a turnaround-and-build role: you are responsible for stabilising and modernising a product that Spanish despachos depend on every day, while connecting Spain to the European platform being built in parallel.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the Advisor Spain product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — sequence what gets built when across tax & accounting, payroll, small business and migrations, balancing near-term retention with the long-term platform bets.

  • Land the migrations without losing customers — take ongoing migrations onto the strategic platform, and treat functional fit and handover quality as product problems, not project problems.

  • Make Despachos/Diez a product Spanish CPAs trust — lift NPS and usability, hold stability through tax peak season, and close the functional gaps that cost us firms today.

  • Lead and develop your product teams — support and challenge your PMs and their teams across the area. Set a high bar for outcome-focused discovery and delivery.

  • Drive real discovery with despachos — we validate problems with accountants directly, from shadowing closings and tax campaigns to usage analysis, and build what earns their trust rather than working from a sales backlog.

  • Shape our AI strategy in Spain — decide where AI genuinely transforms the work of a Spanish despacho and where the conservatism of the profession demands transparency and control.

  • Turn Spanish regulatory change into a lever — Verifactu and e-invoicing reshape what firms and their clients need, and we would rather lead that than comply late.

  • Orchestrate across the ecosystem — partner closely with Advisor Global, the Tax & Year-End area, Core Accounting and Shine ERP Spain, and with the Spanish commercial and customer teams, to deliver one coherent experience for CPAs and their clients.

  • Track what matters — active despachos and end-clients, revenue and churn, migration completion, and the adoption and efficiency metrics that show accountants are winning back time.

📍 Job located in Madrid with possibility of remote working days

About you

  • You have led product teams building complex B2B SaaS products — ideally in accounting, tax, payroll, fintech or adjacent domains.

  • You have a solid accounting or bookkeeping domain knowledge and understand double-entry bookkeeping.

  • You have a strong understanding of the Spanish accounting and tax space and of how a despacho actually works — the client portfolio, the tax campaigns, the closing and filing obligations, and the software firms run on today.

  • You are a product leader — you give your PMs real ownership, set outcome-based goals, and raise the quality of discovery and delivery without becoming the bottleneck.

  • You are comfortable turning around an established product with a demanding installed base — you can hold a retention and quality agenda and a modernisation agenda at the same time.

  • You are AI-fluent across the board — you use AI tooling in your own workflow, you think critically about where AI changes what accounting software should do, and you can shape product bets where AI is a core capability.

  • You hold the tension between serving the Spanish market today and converging on a European platform — and make deliberate trade-offs rather than defaulting to one or the other.

  • You are comfortable owning cross-team and cross-area dependencies and sequencing under pressure.

  • You communicate with precision — with engineers on system design, with accountants on workflow needs, and with leadership on strategic trade-offs.

  • You are fluent in Spanish and English

title: Job- og ungerådgiver til ungeområdet i Vejen Kommune
description:
Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for unge i alderen 16–25 år, og har du lyst til at arbejde med både sociale og beskæftigelsesrettede indsatser?

Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Team Myndighed i Vejen Kommunes Ungeområde.

Vi søger en engageret socialrådgiver til en fast stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde helhedsorienteret med unge i alderen 16–25 år på tværs af Barnets Lov og Lov om en Aktiv Beskæftigelsesindsats (LAB).

Du får en blandet sagsstamme med myndighedsopgaver inden for begge lovområder. Vi tilstræber samtidig, at du så vidt muligt følger den samme unge på tværs af lovgivningerne, når den unge har behov for indsatser efter begge områder.

Vores ambition er at skabe sammenhængende forløb, hvor den unge oplever kontinuitet og så vidt muligt har én gennemgående rådgiver at forholde sig til, når der er behov for indsatser efter begge lovområder.

Vi forventer ikke, at du har erfaring med begge lovområder fra begyndelsen. Det vigtigste er, at du har en stærk socialfaglig forståelse, lyst til at udvikle din faglighed og mod på at være med til at udvikle vores myndighedspraksis.

Om os

Ungeområdet er en del af Unge & Familie i Vejen Kommune. Vi er et område i udvikling, hvor myndighedsopgaver efter Barnets Lov og beskæftigelseslovgivningen er samlet i Team Myndighed.

Vores ambition er at skabe sammenhængende indsatser for unge, hvor vi har blik for den unges samlede livssituation, ressourcer og muligheder.

Ved at samle myndighedsopgaver efter Barnets Lov og beskæftigelseslovgivningen i Team Myndighed har vi skabt et godt udgangspunkt for at styrke samarbejdet på tværs af lovområderne.

Vi er nysgerrige på, hvordan vi kan udvikle vores praksis, så de forskellige indsatser og planer i endnu højere grad understøtter hinanden og skaber en fælles retning for den unge.

Vi arbejder ud fra et fælles ungesyn, hvor den unge er aktør i eget liv. Vi møder unge med positive forventninger, værdighed og respekt og tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i samarbejde med den unge, familien, netværket og relevante samarbejdspartnere.

Du bliver en del af et team med engagerede og fagligt dygtige kolleger, der bringer forskellige erfaringer og kompetencer fra både det socialfaglige og beskæftigelsesfaglige område.

Vi har vores daglige gang på Basen – Ungecenter Vejen, hvor vi er samlet med blandt andre uddannelsesvejledere, ungevejledere, SSP og Ungdomsskolen. Det giver gode muligheder for tæt samarbejde, faglig sparring og fælles løsninger.

Din rolle og dine opgaver

Som job- og ungerådgiver får du en blandet sagsstamme med myndighedsopgaver efter både Barnets Lov og Lov om en Aktiv Beskæftigelsesindsats (LAB).

Vi tilstræber, at du så vidt muligt får ansvar for den samme unge på tværs af de to lovområder, når den unge har behov for indsatser efter begge lovgivninger. Du vil samtidig have sager, hvor indsatsen alene vedrører det ene lovområde.

Det kræver, at du både kan arbejde selvstændigt med myndighedsopgaven inden for de enkelte lovgivninger og samtidig bevare et helhedsorienteret blik på den unges situation, ressourcer og muligheder.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Myndighedsarbejde efter Barnets Lov, herunder screening, afdækning, børnefaglige undersøgelser, iværksættelse af indsatser og opfølgning.
  • Myndighedsarbejde efter beskæftigelseslovgivningen, herunder samtaler, vurderinger, planlægning og opfølgning på beskæftigelsesrettede indsatser.
  • At udarbejde og følge op på planer og mål i tæt samarbejde med den unge.
  • At sikre inddragelse af den unge og dennes familie og netværk, hvor det er relevant.
  • At koordinere indsatser på tværs af lovområder og samarbejdspartnere, så den unge oplever sammenhæng og kontinuitet.
  • At understøtte gode overgange til voksenlivet, uddannelse og beskæftigelse.
  • At bidrage til udviklingen af vores fælles myndighedspraksis og den helhedsorienterede ungeindsats.

Du vil få mulighed for at bringe din eksisterende faglighed i spil og samtidig udvikle nye kompetencer i tæt samarbejde med kolleger, faglige koordinatorer og ledelse.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, der er uddannet socialrådgiver og har interesse for myndighedsarbejde med unge i alderen 16–25 år.

Du har måske erfaring med Barnets Lov og er nysgerrig på Beskæftigelsesområdet. Eller måske kommer du fra Beskæftigelsesområdet og har lyst til at arbejde mere socialfagligt med unge og deres familier.

Begge dele kan være et godt udgangspunkt hos os.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver.
  • Har en solid socialfaglig forståelse og gerne erfaring med myndighedsarbejde.
  • Har kendskab til Barnets Lov og/eller Lov om en Aktiv Beskæftigelsesindsats (LAB).
  • Har lyst og motivation til at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for begge lovområder.
  • Kan arbejde systematisk og struktureret med lovgivning, dokumentation og faglige vurderinger.
  • Er god til at skabe relationer og inddrage unge i beslutninger, der vedrører deres liv.
  • Kan bevare overblikket og træffe fagligt begrundede beslutninger, også når sagerne er komplekse.
  • Er nysgerrig, reflekterende og tør udfordre vante arbejdsgange.
  • Trives med tværfagligt samarbejde og ser muligheder i forskellige faglige perspektiver.
  • Har lyst til at bidrage til et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager fælles ansvar for kerneopgaven.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med ICS, DUBU eller Momentum, men det er ikke en forudsætning.

Vi forventer ikke, at du har lige stor erfaring med begge lovområder fra begyndelsen. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du har lyst til at udvikle din faglighed og på sigt kunne varetage myndighedsopgaver inden for begge områder.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde?

Vi er et engageret team af myndighedsrådgivere, mentorer, talentudviklere og en personlig jobformidler. Vi sætter stor pris på både faglighed og fællesskab. Hverdagen hos os er præget af et uformelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til smil, latter og en forkærlighed for søde sager til kaffen. Vi tror på, at arbejdsglæde og gode relationer skaber de bedste forudsætninger for et stærkt samarbejde. Vi arbejder aktivt med feedback og anerkendelse i hele ungeområdet.

Samtidig er vi ambitiøse på faglighedens vegne. Vi arbejder systematisk, ordentligt og med stor ansvarlighed i vores opgaveløsning. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og er oprigtigt nysgerrige på vores kollegaers perspektiver, fordi vi ved, at de bedste løsninger ofte opstår i fællesskab.

Hos os er der højt til loftet. Vi vil hinanden, løfter i flok og møder både unge og kolleger med ordentlighed, respekt, engagement og et åbent sind. Det er netop kombinationen af faglig kvalitet, humør og omsorg for hinanden, der gør vores team til noget særligt.

Vi ved, at det kræver tid, sparring og fælles refleksion at udvikle en ny praksis på tværs af lovområder. Derfor forventer vi heller ikke, at du kan det hele fra begyndelsen.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En arbejdsplads, der er værdibaseret og lægger vægt på faglig og personlig udvikling, som du kan læse om her Vision, Mission og Værdier - Vejen Kommune
  • En spændende og alsidig stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med hele den unges situation.
  • Et fagligt stærkt team med kolleger, der har forskellige erfaringer og kompetencer.
  • Mulighed for at udvikle din faglighed inden for både Barnets Lov og Lov om en Aktiv Beskæftigelsesindsats (LAB).
  • Tæt faglig sparring, supervision og støtte fra faglige koordinatorer og ledelse.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til faglig refleksion, forskellige perspektiver og nye idéer.
  • Mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af vores fælles arbejdsgange og myndighedspraksis.
  • Fleksibel arbejdstid og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale.
  • Et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger kan gøre en konkret forskel for unge i Vejen Kommune.

Vi er fortsat i gang med at udvikle vores fælles praksis, og du får derfor mulighed for at bidrage med dine perspektiver og erfaringer til, hvordan vi kan styrke sammenhængen i myndighedsarbejdet på tværs af områderne i et samlet ungeområde.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Der er tale om en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt med fleksibel arbejdstid.

Arbejdssted: Basen – Ungecenter Vejen, Askovvej 7, 6600 Vejen.

title: Junior SMC Specialist (Mobile Data)
description:
Je werkt aan een van de belangrijkste onderdelen van onze dienstverlening: een betrouwbaar mobiel netwerk. Je krijgt te maken met actuele technologieën, werkt samen met ervaren technische collega's en krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen de wereld van telecom en netwerktechnologie. En dit is dan wat je gaat doen:

  • Je monitort het mobiele datanetwerk en signaleert mogelijke verstoringen.
  • Je onderzoekt technische storingen, achterhaalt de oorzaak en werkt aan een snelle oplossing.
  • Je schakelt met collega's en andere technische teams wanneer problemen complexer worden.
  • Je voert operationele werkzaamheden uit om het netwerk stabiel en betrouwbaar te houden.
  • Je ondersteunt bij technische veranderingen en projecten rondom 5G en cloudtechnologie.
  • Je draait eens per vier weken mee in een bereikbaarheidsdienst, zodat ook buiten kantooruren belangrijke storingen kunnen worden opgelost.

Dit breng je mee

Je bent technisch nieuwsgierig, houdt ervan om problemen op te lossen en blijft rustig wanneer er snel geschakeld moet worden. Je hoeft nog niet alles te weten, maar je vindt het leuk om je te verdiepen in hoe netwerken werken.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een afgeronde technische hbo-opleiding en ongeveer 1 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring.
  • Affiniteit met netwerken en telecom. Kennis van IP-netwerken is mooi meegenomen.
  • Een praktische instelling: je analyseert niet alleen, maar komt ook graag in actie.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en werk je graag samen met collega's.
  • Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en een goede beheersing van het Engels.
  • Je woont in Nederland en bent bereid om eens per vier weken bereikbaarheidsdienst te draaien.

title: Head of Global Trade Transformation & Change
description:
Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


Job Description:

The role is responsible for defining, leading and executing the multi-year transformation of the Global Trade business within Global Payments Solutions (GPS). It is accountable for the transformation strategy and execution framework, investment and funding strategy, target operating and service models, technology modernization and legacy migration, ecosystem partnerships, organizational change and client adoption.

- The successful candidate will bring together global and regional stakeholders to deliver a more digital, data-led, automated and scalable Trade business while ensuring transformation investment translates into measurable improvements in growth, client experience, operating leverage and risk.

- Transformation strategy and execution: Own and execute the multi-year Global Trade transformation strategy, aligning Product, Operations, Technology, Service, Sales and regional stakeholders around a common roadmap and measurable outcomes.

- Transformation blueprint: Maintain and evolve the transformation execution blueprint and playbook, including governance, resourcing, delivery methodology, prioritization and flexible execution models appropriate to available funding and program complexity.

- Investment and funding: Own the transformation business case and multi-year funding strategy, developing compelling investment proposals and representing Trade through relevant investment, planning and governance forums.

-Target operating and service model: Lead implementation of the future-state operating model and digital-first service model, simplifying and standardizing processes while accelerating automation, data-led processing and straight-through processing.

- Technology modernization: Provide business leadership for the global migration from legacy Trade platforms to the future-state technology architecture, including migration sequencing, business readiness, risk management and legacy platform retirement.

- Digital, data and AI: Identify and champion opportunities to use digital capabilities, data, automation, AI and emerging technologies to improve client experience, reduce manual activity and increase scalability.

Ecosystem partnerships: Develop strategic relationships with technology providers, FinTechs and other ecosystem participants, maintaining an external perspective on emerging capabilities and determining where partnership can accelerate the strategy.

- Client migration and adoption: Lead the strategy for pilot clients, commercialization and broader adoption of new digital capabilities, partnering with Sales, Product, Operations, Service and Technology to support successful global rollout.

- Change leadership: Drive organizational readiness and adoption across the transformation, ensuring changes to technology are accompanied by the required changes to processes, roles, skills, controls and ways of working.

- Governance and benefits realization: Establish executive-level transparency across delivery, investment, risk and dependencies, with clear accountability for the realization of financial and non-financial transformation benefits.

Required Skills:

  • Extensive transformation leadership experience within a large, complex financial institution, with demonstrated accountability for major multi-year business and technology transformation rather than solely project or program delivery.
  • Strong Trade Finance and working-capital domain expertise, with knowledge across areas such as Letters of Credit, Guarantees/Standbys, Supply Chain Finance, Open Account and Receivables Finance, including an understanding of the associated client, operational, risk and technology processes.
  • Proven ability to translate strategy into execution, including development of multi-year roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, delivery models, governance structures, resource strategies and measurable business outcomes.
  • Significant experience operating across Product, Operations and Technology, with the credibility to challenge and influence senior leaders in each discipline and resolve complex cross-functional dependencies.
  • Demonstrated technology-transformation experience, including modernization of complex platforms, integration of new technology into existing architecture, migration of clients and processes and retirement of legacy applications.
  • Strong target-operating-model expertise, with experience redesigning end-to-end processes, organizational responsibilities, service models and technology interactions rather than optimizing individual components in isolation.
  • Demonstrated experience driving digitization and automation, including the redesign of manual or paper-intensive processes toward digital, data-led and straight-through processing.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, with proven ability to construct and defend major transformation business cases incorporating investment requirements, revenue opportunities, operating efficiencies, risk reduction and other measurable benefits.
  • Experience securing and managing significant multi-year transformation investment, including working through annual planning, continuous funding processes and senior investment-governance committees.
  • Proven global leadership experience, successfully delivering initiatives across multiple regions, legal entities and organizational structures while balancing global standardization with legitimate regional and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong change-management capabilities, including stakeholder alignment, organizational readiness, communications, training, adoption, behavioral change and business transition.
  • Demonstrated senior stakeholder management, with the ability to influence executives and drive decisions across organizational boundaries where direct reporting authority may not exist.
  • Strong risk and control orientation, with experience delivering material transformation within a highly regulated environment and partnering effectively with Risk, Compliance, Legal and other control functions.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex issues, articulate strategic choices and communicate effectively with senior executives, governance committees, technology leaders and client-facing teams.
  • Proven leadership and talent-development capabilities, including building high-performing transformation teams and creating accountability across matrixed delivery organizations.

Desired Skills:

  • Deep understanding of the global Trade Finance ecosystem, including trends in digitization, electronic trade documents, interoperability, transaction processing, data and the evolving role of banks, FinTechs and technology providers.
  • Experience with Trade Finance and transaction-banking platforms and strategic technology providers, including familiarity with organizations such as Finastra, FIS and IBM and the role such providers can play within a modern Trade architecture.
  • Knowledge of AI-enabled Trade capabilities, including intelligent document processing, compliance and sanctions-screening use cases, workflow automation, data extraction and opportunities for generative AI to improve employee and client journeys.
  • Knowledge of ERP and client-connectivity models, APIs and integration strategies that enable banks to embed Trade and working-capital solutions more directly into corporate-client workflows.
  • Experience creating or leading a Transformation Office / Transformation Management Office, including development of repeatable transformation methodologies, portfolio governance, resource models and executive reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience with complex client and portfolio migrations, particularly where migration must be carefully sequenced across products, geographies, operational processes and underlying technology platforms. Experience successfully decommissioning legacy platforms, including managing the commercial, operational, technology, control and client dependencies required to achieve actual platform retirement and associated cost benefits.
  • Experience developing digital-first service models that combine self-service and automation with specialist human support for higher-value or more complex client requirements.
  • Strong understanding of data as a transformation asset, including how common data models, analytics and improved data quality can enable automation, better servicing, enhanced controls and new client propositions. Experience evaluating build, buy and partner strategies and managing strategic third-party relationships from initial capability assessment through implementation and ongoing roadmap alignment.
  • Strong knowledge of transformation economics, including benefit attribution, capacity release, cost takeout, operating leverage, revenue enablement and tracking benefits through realization.
  • Demonstrated ability to commercialize new capabilities, including pilot-client selection, initial deployment, client feedback, sales enablement and transitioning from pilot to scaled global adoption.
  • Strong external orientation and knowledge of emerging technologies and competitive developments affecting transaction banking and Trade Finance. Demonstrated ability to operate successfully in an executive-level global matrix, creating alignment across stakeholders with different regional, functional and commercial priorities.
  • A leadership style characterized by strategic thinking, intellectual curiosity, execution intensity and constructive challenge, with the ability to move comfortably between senior-level strategy and detailed execution issues. Ability to create a strong transformation culture, establishing clarity of purpose, pace, ownership and accountability while bringing stakeholders with different priorities through significant organizational change.

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Purpose:


Support the Project Manager in the delivery of a construction project on behalf of the Client. Take ownership of defined areas of programme, cost, quality, safety and reporting, and coordinate the PMC team, Contractors and Designers day to day, so that the project is delivered on time, within budget, to the approved design and specification, and handed over ready for use.


Key Responsibilities:


Project Delivery Support

  • Support the Project Manager in implementing the project execution plan, governance structure and communication protocols.
  • Act as a day-to-day point of contact for the Client, Designers, Contractors and authorities on delegated matters.
  • Coordinate the PMC project team, including the Construction Manager, Resident Engineers, Planner, Cost Manager, HSE and document control staff, tracking actions and deliverables to closure.
  • Deputise for the Project Manager in meetings and decision-making when required.

Design and Procurement Support

  • Track design development against the Client's brief, budget and programme, and escalate design issues, delays and change requests.
  • Support design change control and value engineering, and help assess their impact on cost, programme and quality.
  • Support tender preparation, bid evaluation and contract award, including clarifications and recommendation reports.
  • Monitor long-lead procurement and flag supply chain risks.

Programme and Progress Control

  • Review Contractor programmes, updates and look-aheads with the Planner, and monitor progress against key milestones.
  • Identify critical path risks early and support recovery and acceleration measures.
  • Verify progress through site visits and coordination with the site team.

Cost and Commercial Support

  • Support the Cost Manager in budget tracking, forecasting and cash flow reporting.
  • Review interim valuations, variations, claims and extension of time submissions, and prepare recommendations for the Project Manager.
  • Maintain records of notices, instructions and correspondence to protect the Client's contractual position.

Quality, Health and Safety

  • Support the implementation of quality management, inspection and test regimes, and monitor NCR and snagging close-out.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements, and follow up on HSE findings and incident corrective actions.
  • Support testing, commissioning, completion and acceptance processes, including UAE authority approvals.

Risk, Reporting and Governance

  • Maintain the risk register, and support risk reviews and mitigation planning.
  • Prepare monthly progress reports, dashboards and presentations for the Client and senior management.
  • Prepare agendas and minutes, and manage action logs for project meetings.
  • Apply PMC quality procedures and information classification requirements to all outputs.

Handover and Closeout

  • Support completion, handover and operational readiness, including as-builts, O&M manuals, training and defects liability processes.
  • Contribute to project closeout, lessons learned and final account settlement.

Requirements:

  • Degree in Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  • 8 to 12 years' experience in construction or project management, including at least 3 years in a project management or deputy project management role.
  • Minimum 3 years' PMC or consultancy experience in the UAE, with working knowledge of UAE authority processes, local approvals and market practice.
  • Proven experience supporting delivery of projects from design through to construction, completion and handover.
  • Working knowledge of FIDIC or equivalent contract forms, including variations, claims and EOT.
  • Experience with programme, cost and risk management, and reviewing Primavera P6 programmes.
  • Proficient in MS Office, with working knowledge of document control platforms and project reporting tools.
  • Strong coordination, communication and report-writing skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.

On-site –Abu Dhabi, ARE

title: Vi søger en afdelingsleder til Plejeboligerne Østervang
description:
Er du sygeplejerske, har du lyst til ledelse, og tror du på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi lykkes sammen? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Jeg hedder Laila og er forstander på Østervang. Jeg søger en afdelingsleder, der har lyst til at stå i spidsen for en afdeling og være med til at skabe en trygt hjem for beboerne og en sund arbejdsplads for medarbejderne.

På Østervang har vi en fælles vision: Sammen skaber vi et trygt hjem og en sund arbejdsplads.
Men hvad betyder det egentlig at arbejde her?

Jeg har spurgt medarbejderne, hvad de sætter pris på ved at arbejde på Østervang. De fremhæver omsorg, hjælpsomhed og godt fagligt samarbejde. Vi lytter til hinanden, griner sammen og har plads til forskelligheder. Her er en god kollegial ånd, hvor vi gerne vil hjælpe hinanden og hjælper til, når der er brug for det.

Det samme går igen i tilbagemeldingerne fra beboerne og pårørende. De oplever os som imødekommende, mærker den gode tone og ser, hvordan vi samarbejder om at skabe en god hverdag. For os er det grundlæggende, at vi er her for beboerne og deres pårørende.

En leder, der lytter, støtter og sætter retning

Som afdelingsleder får du ansvar for den faglige kvalitet, personaleledelsen og den daglige drift af en afdeling med 27 beboere og 25 medarbejdere.

Vi søger en uddannet sygeplejerske med faglig tyngde og gerne ledelseserfaring. Du er nærværende, synlig og lyttende og møder medarbejderne med respekt. Du giver plads til dialog og faglig sparring, men kan også træffe beslutninger og sætte retning, når det er nødvendigt.

Du tager ansvar, understøtter medarbejdernes faglighed og holder fokus på beboernes behov og ønsker. Du behøver ikke at have alle svarene, men skal have lyst til at finde løsninger sammen med andre.

Du bliver en del af et lederteam, der står sammen

Som afdelingsleder bliver du en del af vores lederteam, som består af Jan, Tom, Birgitte, Lotte, Elisabeth, Torben og mig selv. Vi mødes systematisk for at drøfte faglighed, udvikling og de udfordringer, vi hver især står med. Vi bruger hinanden som sparringspartner, deler erfaringer og hjælper hinanden videre – og husker også at dele de gode historier.

For mig er det vigtigt, at vi som ledere både kan støtte og udfordre hinanden, tage fælles ansvar og stå sammen om de beslutninger, vi træffer. Vi behøver ikke at være ens, men vi skal være nysgerrige på hinandens perspektiver og kunne tale åbent om det, der fylder.

Kan du se dig hos os?

Har du lyst til at lede mennesker, udvikle fagligheder og være en del af en arbejdsplads med godt samarbejde, plads til forskelligheder og et godt grin. Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Stillingen er til besættelse 1. januar 2027

Ansøgningsfrist den 22. november 2026. Samtalerne forventes afholdt onsdag den 25. november.

Du er også meget velkommen til at kigge forbi til en kop kaffe og en uformel rundvisning, hvis du har lyst til at lære Østervang lidt bedre at kende. Jeg glæder mig til at møde dig.

Du er selvfølgelig meget velkommen til at kontakte mig, Laila Egedal Andersen, på tlf. 2898 3550 eller mail: laan18@frederiksberg.dk

Jeg ser meget frem til at høre fra dig.

Med venlig hilsen

Laila Egedal Andersen


Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden.

Work Arrangement - The successful candidate is expected to report to GM Technical Center Korea, located in Bupyeong and Cheongna Proving Ground, Incheon, on a full-time basis.


The Role -

Join GM's Software and Electronics organization and work with vehicle cybersecurity engineers to build a practical, repeatable way to plan vehicle security tests. Over this internship program, you will review how a connected vehicle communicates, help draft reusable test plans and checklists, and try selected checks in a supervised lab pilot on one approved target. The goal is to create an approach that can be considered for reuse on other programs—not to test every vehicle or set company-wide policy. You will document what you learn, suggest ways to improve security, and present your work to the team. You will also gain experience with vehicle cybersecurity, from understanding risks to helping teams validate fixes.


What You'll Do-

Understand the vehicle and plan the work:

  • Review how a connected vehicle communicates through areas such as telematics, infotainment, gateways, vehicle diagnostics, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cellular connections, mobile apps, and back-office services. Note which connections and features differ across vehicle programs.
  • Help draft a risk-based plan for choosing what to assess first. Document factors the team can use when considering in-house testing or an outside specialist; the responsible team will make the final decision.

Create reusable test materials:

  • Help connect proposed test checks to a security framework chosen by the team, so reviewers can see what the plan covers.
  • Draft test plans, checklists, and sample checks for vehicle networks and diagnostics (CAN, LIN, UDS, Automotive Ethernet); Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and cellular; debug access and secure boot; and firmware, over-the-air (OTA) software updates, and remote vehicle commands. Any hands-on firmware access or extraction must be specifically approved and included in the test scope.

Prepare and run a supervised pilot:

  • Set up and document the lab bench and approved tools, such as hardware tools and protocol analyzers, with guidance from the team.
  • Try selected checks on one approved target in a controlled lab (a vehicle or bench) under team supervision. Record what worked, what needs adjustment, and what could be reused on future programs.
  • Report findings and share recommendations:
  • Draft a findings-report template that explains the issue, its potential impact, and possible fixes. Propose severity categories for review; the responsible engineers will confirm final ratings and remediation actions.
  • Work with cybersecurity compliance partners to identify relevant standards and regulations. The responsible teams will determine how those requirements apply.
  • Document the proposed approach, pilot lessons, and recommendations; present the results and handoff materials to the team.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited four-year university, or expected to earn one by February 2027.
  • GPA: A cumulative GPA of B or higher, or at least 3.0 on a 4.5 scale.
  • Major: A STEM-related field, such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field
  • English proficiency: TOEIC score of 750 or higher.Equivalent scores accepted: OPIc IM2 or higher, or TOEIC Speaking score of 130 or higher.TOEIC score submission is waived for graduates of, or candidates expected to graduate from, universities outside Korea.
  • Availability: Able to participate in the internship on a full-time basis throughout the internship period.
  • In accordance with applicable laws, preference may be given to persons of national merit and other individuals eligible for employment protection.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) –

  • Hands-on experience with CAN or other vehicle networks, or hardware interfaces such as UART, JTAG, or SPI; experience using a logic analyzer is a plus
  • Experience inspecting firmware to understand how it works, or other firmware analysis experience

Job Description

About the Role

The Talent Intelligence Partner is a strategic advisor who combines external talent market intelligence, advanced sourcing, and data-driven insights to help the organization make informed workforce and hiring decisions.

Reporting to the Talent Intelligence Lead, this role will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HR, and business stakeholders to understand current and future talent needs, assess external talent markets, identify critical and scarce capabilities, and translate insights into actionable talent strategies.

The Talent Intelligence Partner will support both proactive workforce planning and active hiring priorities. This includes assessing talent availability and market competitiveness, identifying optimal talent pools and locations, developing external talent pipelines, and providing intelligence that informs sourcing, recruitment, and broader workforce decisions.

The successful candidate will bring a strong combination of talent sourcing expertise, analytical curiosity, market research capability, and stakeholder advisory skills, with the ability to move from data and research to clear recommendations and action.


How you will contribute:
Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies for critical, specialized, and difficult-to-fill talent, leveraging advanced sourcing techniques, professional networks, market intelligence platforms, and emerging technologies.

  • Build and maintain external talent maps, pipelines, and talent communities for current and future workforce needs, proactively identifying critical and scarce talent segments and strengthening talent readiness ahead of demand.
  • Conduct external talent market research to assess talent availability, demand, competition, skills, locations, compensation trends, and competitor activity, translating insights into strategic recommendations on talent pools, role profiles, market feasibility, and emerging talent risks and opportunities.
  • Develop compelling, executive-ready presentations that turn complex talent data and market intelligence into clear stories, insights, and recommendations for stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HR, and business stakeholders to understand workforce priorities and hiring challenges, using talent intelligence to inform sourcing, recruitment, and broader workforce strategies.
  • Embed inclusive sourcing practices and consideration of diverse talent pools across talent intelligence, sourcing, and pipeline strategies.
  • Track sourcing and talent intelligence outcomes and continuously improve strategies, methodologies, tools, and ways of working based on data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.
  • Stay current on emerging talent intelligence, sourcing, AI, analytics, and recruitment technologies, identifying opportunities to strengthen team capabilities and drive more innovative approaches.

Expected skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in Talent Intelligence, Talent Acquisition, strategic sourcing, talent research, or related disciplines, including 4+ years of hands-on experience in talent sourcing, talent mapping, pipeline development, and strategic talent projects, ideally supporting specialized roles within the biopharma or life sciences industry (e.g., R&D, Medical).
  • Strong talent sourcing and market research capabilities, with the ability to analyze talent markets, identify relevant talent pools, and translate insights into actionable sourcing and talent strategies.
  • Experience working in a complex, global organization, with strong business acumen and the ability to navigate evolving priorities and stakeholder needs.
  • Strong technical and analytical capabilities, with experience using sourcing, talent intelligence, ATS/CRM, data and analytics platforms, and emerging AI-enabled technologies.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights and recommendations for stakeholders at all levels.
  • Exceptional collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, business leaders, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Creative, curious, and highly organized, with the ability to independently structure work, manage multiple priorities, drive projects forward, and embed inclusive practices into talent strategies.

title: Americas Account Director
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Americas Account Director – Operations Leadership – M3

What This Job Involves

As Americas Account Director, you'll serve as both the strategic leader and technical authority for one of JLL's most valued Global accounts. This unique role positions you at the intersection of operational excellence, technical expertise, and client partnership, where you'll drive service delivery across a complex, multi-site portfolio while leading high-performing engineering and operations teams.

You'll be responsible for the overall financial performance, client satisfaction, and strategic growth of your account, with particular emphasis on hard services delivery including mechanical, electrical, critical environments, fire life safety, and asset lifecycle management. A critical component of your leadership will be establishing and overseeing a robust Project Management Office (PMO) framework that ensures capital projects, strategic initiatives, and transformation programs are executed with precision and alignment to client objectives and in partnership with our PDS organization.

At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way — for our clients, ourselves and our fellow employees — and in this role, you'll embody that commitment daily. Based in Austin, TX, you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams locally and across the Americas to deliver seamless, world-class facilities management solutions. We believe the most effective teams are built when everyone is empowered to thrive, and as a people leader, you'll create an environment where your team can excel while developing their careers alongside yours.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Strategic Client Leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic contact for the client, building deep relationships with key stakeholders and understanding their evolving business needs and priorities
  • Build trusted partnerships with client stakeholders, proactively addressing technical and operational challenges
  • Develop deep client business intelligence to anticipate needs and deliver strategic value beyond contractual obligations
  • Lead regular client business reviews and presentations, showcasing performance achievements, project portfolio status, and presenting strategic recommendations for portfolio optimization

Engineering & Technical Excellence

  • Partner with Engineering team/SMEs to ensure world-class delivery in mechanical, electrical, critical environments, and fire life safety systems across the portfolio
  • Drive compliance with KPIs, service levels, and client delivery methodologies while maintaining exceptional service quality standards
  • Optimize standard operating procedures and implement engineering best practices across all sites
  • Champion health, safety, and environmental excellence in all service delivery activities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and develop teams of engineering and facilities management professionals, providing coaching, performance management, and career development opportunities
  • Build high-performing teams with the technical expertise and operational focus needed for complex facility environments
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and accountability
  • Create an environment where technical specialists and operations professionals can excel and grow

PMO & Project Delivery

  • Establish and manage PMO governance structures, standards, and methodologies in partnership with PDS to ensure consistent project delivery
  • Oversee capital improvements scoping in partnership with PDS, strategic initiatives, and facilities/engineering projects across the portfolio
  • Monitor portfolio health, proactively addressing issues and implementing corrective actions when necessary
  • Ensure seamless coordination between operational teams and project delivery resources

Financial & Operational Performance

  • Drive financial performance by managing P&L responsibilities, including budget development, forecasting, cost optimization, and identification of value-add opportunities
  • Achieve agreed financial targets while maintaining exceptional service quality standards
  • Manage contract, budget, schedule, and invoice processes with precision
  • Identify and execute account expansion opportunities and additional service offerings

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with technical specialists, project managers, Data Centers, Platform SMEs, JLLT, Security, EHS teams, and strategic partners
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service delivery and operational efficiency across multiple functions

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Business Administration, or related technical field
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in facilities management, engineering, or corporate real estate, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing complex accounts
  • Proven track record of managing large-scale Integrated Facilities Management accounts with P&L responsibility exceeding $10M annually
  • Subject matter expertise in hard services with integrated facilities management focus

Technical & Operational Leadership

  • Demonstrated experience establishing PMO functions with oversight of capital project portfolios
  • Proven ability to deliver complex IFM programs successfully in partnership with engineering team/SME and with a focus on engineering excellence
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with data-driven approach to operations

Team & Financial Leadership

  • Demonstrated experience leading, developing, and managing teams of 10 or more direct and indirect reports, including technical specialists
  • Strong financial acumen with experience in budget management, forecasting, contract negotiations, and cost-benefit analysis
  • Experience managing client sensitivities and escalation protocols in technical environments
  • Ability to balance client interests with business objectives while maintaining operational excellence

Relationship & Communication Skills

  • Exceptional client relationship management skills with a history of building trusted advisor relationships at the executive level
  • Outstanding presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts for diverse audiences
  • Ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels
  • Proven trustworthiness with strong ownership mindset

Location & Travel

  • Ability to travel up to 35% across account sites

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing multi-site portfolios across diverse property types including corporate offices, industrial facilities, critical environments, and specialized technical environments
  • Background in change management and leading organizational transformation initiatives within engineering and facilities operations
  • Demonstrated success in identifying and executing account expansion opportunities in hard services and technical solutions
  • Familiarity with facilities management technology platforms, CMMS systems, project management software, BIM/BAS systems, and data analytics tools
  • Experience working in a matrixed organization with ability to leverage technical and operational resources across functional and geographic boundaries
  • Track record of initiating and executing innovation and improvement initiatives in technical services delivery

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about operational excellence, engineering leadership, client success, and building high-performing teams, we want to hear from you. Apply now with an updated resume, location, and contact information.

If you're a current JLL employee, please apply using the Internal Career Site.

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

192,300.00 – 278,700.00 USD per year

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Company Overview:

Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!


Site Overview

We serve regional customers with our "Two sites, one team" approach, operating from OWS Doha and Dubai. Our team is diverse, with more than 20 different nationalities, and we celebrate different perspectives and backgrounds, which contribute to innovative solutions and a dynamic workplace. Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen.

At GE Aerospace Technology & Operations, our customers challenge us to tackle some of the world’s most complex engineering problems that require innovative approach using new technologies. Our engineers depend on software developers to bridge data, tools, and emerging technologies, like cloud and AI, to unlock new possibilities and shape the future of flight.

What You will Do

  • Develop technical solutions for engineers to evaluate and adopt data and AI solutions.
  • Consult on architecture, implement proof of concepts and deliver solutions for business strategic projects, including data science and machine learning systems
  • Build and present product architectures, write technical code, and demo applications to stakeholders.
  • Gain hands-on experience with the Innovator Method and turn customer insights into solution that deliver real business value
  • Sharpen your skills in cloud platforms, databases, data engineering, web design, AI technologies, and numerical methods
  • Use your strengths to support team members and build cross-functional relationships across the company.
  • Work to ship solutions to production that meet business needs and drive impact.

Our culture thrives on innovation, diversity, and deep collaboration. You’ll contribute as both a learner and a builder, helping us push the design frontier in aerospace.


Required Qualifications

  • Graduate or pursuing a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field at an accredited university or credentialed software accelerator program.
  • Minimum 3.7 cumulative GPA off a 4.0 scale without rounding
  • Strong academic performance in Computer Science or other STEM disciplines
  • Experience designing AI solutions and architecting distributed data systems
  • Proficiency in programming and debugging with Python, C#, C++, and SQL
  • Customer-centric mindset with ability to lead design thinking workshops
  • Hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Computer Vision

About The Internship

  • Real-world project ownership
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers


At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Where others stop, we accelerate. ​​

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the product vision and roadmap: Execute the vision, strategy, and prioritized roadmap for customer engagement and communication experiences, aligning investments to customer needs, business objectives, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead customer communications strategy: Oversee the end-to-end development, delivery, and optimization of timely, relevant, and personalized communications across digital, mobile, email, SMS, push, online, and other channels.

Create, prioritize, and refine the backlog; support agile ceremonies; remove impediments; and partner with delivery teams to ensure quality, speed, and technical integrity.

  • Customer activation and engagement
  • Customer satisfaction, retention, and loyalty

  • 3+ years of experience in product management, customer engagement, marketing, multi-channel communications, or a related discipline.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use customer insights and performance data to make informed decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize roadmaps and backlogs, and translate business needs into executable requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

Preferred

  • Drives adoption and governance of approved AI-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including approved AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation at scale.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-based applications and agentic systems with tool use, memory, and multi-step reasoning in production environments
  • Advanced proficiency in one or more programming languages, particularly Python and/or Java
  • Deep experience with large-scale data processing, microservices, API design, and event streaming (Kafka)
  • Working knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, vector stores, and data lake architectures
  • Experience with caching technologies (Redis, MemCached), observability tools (Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana), and orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Temporal)
  • Proficiency in CI/CD, test-driven development, automation, and all aspects of the Software Development Lifecycle
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies, application resiliency, and security best practices
  • Practical cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Demonstrated experience leading effective use of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching senior engineers/leads on compliant usage patterns and controls.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks . Hands-on experience with model serving infrastructure or managed endpoints (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI)
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability practices: evals frameworks, red-teaming, prompt drift detection, and cost/latency monitoring.Understanding of agentic design patterns and how to constrain agent autonomy in high-stakes financial workflows
  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake.Hands-on experience with Spark/PySpark and big data processing at scale
  • Knowledge of the financial services industry and its technology system.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Dit ga je doen

Lees nu meer over de dagelijkse taken, algemene verantwoordelijkheden en vereiste ervaring voor deze functie door naar beneden te scrollen.

Wil jij complexe data omzetten in betrouwbare, schaalbare oplossingen én meebouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van datadienstverlening binnen DICTU? Ben je een ervaren data engineer die verder kijkt dan alleen de techniek en ook graag adviseert, innoveert en collega's helpt groeien? En wil je jezelf verder ontwikkelen tot een brede, t-shaped professional, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van dataplatformen en machine learning? Dan zoeken we jou als Senior Data Engineer.


Binnen DICTU werken verschillende teams dagelijks aan uitdagende datavraagstukken voor onze klanten. We ontsluiten, verwerken en visualiseren complexe databronnen en zorgen ervoor dat data daadwerkelijk bruikbaar wordt. Daarnaast ondersteunen we onder andere data-analisten en data scientists met de juiste omgevingen, tooling en functionaliteiten om hun werk goed te kunnen doen.


Jouw rol als Senior Data Engineer


Als Senior Data Engineer werk je met gegevens uit verschillende bronsystemen. Je inventariseert en analyseert deze data, brengt databronnen samen en organiseert de gegevens zo dat ze geïntegreerd kunnen worden in verschillende datamarkten en ongestructureerde (big data) oplossingen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de technische oplossing: je weet complexe vraagstukken helder over te brengen en gaat hierover ook met het management in gesprek.


Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de levering en het goed functioneren van verschillende datadiensten. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat datasets voldoen aan wettelijke en organisatorische eisen rondom gegevensbeveiliging en privacy. Je houdt oog voor de wettelijke basis voor het verzamelen en gebruiken van persoonsgegevens en bedrijfsvertrouwelijke gegevens en ziet toe op het tijdig verwijderen van persoonsgegevens.


Ook adviseer je eindgebruikers over het aggregeren en transformeren van gegevens, het publiceren van data en het inventariseren van externe behoeften. Je gebruikt jouw technische expertise en de kennis die je bij klanten opdoet om onze dienstverlening continu verder te ontwikkelen. Nieuwe technologieën en mogelijkheden binnen het datadomein volg je op de voet. Je herkent kansen en vertaalt deze naar innovatieve datadienstverlening voor DICTU en haar klanten.


Als senior heb je bovendien een belangrijke rol binnen het team. Je helpt collega's groeien en coacht hen niet alleen op technische vakinhoud, maar ook op proces, kwaliteit en samenwerking. Zo til je samen met het team zowel de techniek als de dienstverlening naar een hoger niveau.


Tot slot faciliteer je eindgebruikers door betrouwbare dataplatformen beschikbaar te stellen waarop zij met data kunnen werken, analyseren en verder bouwen.


Dit krijg je

  • Schaal 12
    €4.818 - €7.094 (bruto)
  • Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd
  • 12 Maanden
  • 36 uur
  • Het salaris is gebaseerd op een werkweek van 36 uur.

Dit bieden we nog meer

  • Een salaris in schaal 12 (€ 4.818 - € 7.094 bruto bij 36 uur), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Een fulltime werkweek van 36 uur, met de mogelijkheid om (meer) uren te werken en extra verlof op te bouwen
  • Een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 16,5% van je salaris dat je kunt inzetten voor extra verlof, uitbetaling op momenten die jij kiest of fiscaal aantrekkelijke doelen zoals een fiets, woningverduurzaming of aflossing van je studieschuld
  • Een goede pensioenregeling op grond van het ABP-pensioenreglement
  • Wij bieden een uitdagende functie met een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé en daarom werken wij hybride. Voor de dag(en) dat je naar kantoor of een externe locatie komt, ontvang je reiskostenvergoeding of reis je gratis met het OV
  • Uitstekende opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via DICTU Academy en andere leerprogramma's, zodat je je kennis continu kunt verdiepen
  • Goede verlofregelingen (onder andere zorgverlof en ouderschapsverlof) en faciliteiten zoals bedrijfsfitness

Dit vragen wij

Om voor deze functie in aanmerking te komen, verwachten we het volgende:



  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding (ICT)
  • Ontwikkelaar/data engineer (ETL, DWH, Datamarts en Dasboards) met het vermogen om the lead te nemen
  • Kennis van/ervaring met Oracle-dataproducten: OBIEE/ODI/OAS
  • Kennis van databases en zeer bedreven in het schrijven van queries
  • Affiniteit met data-ontwikkelingen, zoals data-lakes, data-scienceplatforms en datahubs
  • Affiniteit met financiële data en de opslag daarvan (bijv. EBS)
  • Affiniteit met omgevingenbeheer
  • Brede inzetbaarheid, T-shaped-profiel
  • Teamplayer als passend in een agile context

De competenties die wij zoeken voor deze rol, zijn:



  • Je beschikt over een sterk coördinerend vermogen en werkt graag Agile samen in een team.
  • Je bent resultaat- en verbetergericht en neemt vanzelfsprekend verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen werk.
  • Je hebt sterke adviserende en communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • Je kunt gemakkelijk schakelen tussen verschillende inhoudelijke onderwerpen en doelgroepen.
  • Je bent proactief en beschikt over een goed analytisch vermogen.
  • Je blijft jezelf graag ontwikkelen en wilt vooroplopen binnen je vakgebied.
  • Bij voorkeur heb je de ambitie om op termijn door te groeien naar de rol van Data Solution Specialist.
  • Je wilt je daarbij verbreden richting werkzaamheden van een Data Platform Engineer en/of Machine Learning Engineer, hebt begrip van dataconcepten en ontwikkelt je verder op het gebied van regie en consultancy.

Hier kom je te werken
Meer over jouw toekomstige plek in de organisatie

Het team Data Diensten biedt je een leuke werkomgeving in een dynamisch onderdeel van DICTU. Waar we ons elke dag bewust zijn van toegevoegde waarde leveren voor de klant. Je werkt samen met gepassioneerde collega's. Die werken vanuit de drijfveer: passende datadiensten leveren voor de overheid!


Over Dienst ICT Uitvoering (DICTU)

DICTU is een van de grootste ICT-dienstverleners binnen de Rijksoverheid. Ruim 1.800 gedreven professionals werken in Den Haag, Assen en Zwolle vol enthousiasme en met focus op de klant aan voor Nederland belangrijke IT-systemen.
Wij ondersteunen vooral de ministeries van EZ, LVVN en KGG, inclusief hun uitvoeringsorganisaties zoals de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland en de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit. Daarnaast leveren wij bepaalde ICT-diensten ook aan andere organisaties binnen het Rijk.
DICTU legt zich toe op het ontwikkelen en beheren van systemen en applicaties en de bijbehorende dienstverlening. Dat kunnen bedrijfsvoeringsapplicaties, websites en apps zijn, maar ook digitale werkplekken en applicaties op het gebied van subsidies, inspecties en registers. Wij maken daarbij gebruik van moderne technieken en ontwikkelingen zoals Cloud, Mobile en Big Data.
Wij stellen kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, continuïteit en informatieveiligheid centraal. Niet voor niets voldoen onze processen en systemen aan de internationale beveiligingsnorm ISO 27001. De Nederlandse burger mag erop vertrouwen dat de data en systemen die DICTU beheert niet in verkeerde handen komen.
DICTU vindt het belangrijk om een diverse en inclusieve organisatie te zijn. Werken in divers samengestelde teams maakt ons effectiever, innovatiever en het werk leuker. We streven naar een cultuur van gelijkwaardigheid en van veiligheid, waar je kunt zijn wie je bent. Waar je ingezet wordt op je unieke kwaliteiten en waar je gestimuleerd wordt om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen. We willen dat onze organisatie een betere afspiegeling van de maatschappij is qua leeftijd en afkomst. Daarom nodigen wij een ieder uit om te solliciteren.


Bijzonderheden

De vacature kan bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten eerder worden gesloten. Na het sluiten van de vacature zullen de vacaturetekst en de gegevens van de vacaturehouder online niet meer zichtbaar zijn. Om te voorkomen dat je deze moet opvragen, verzoeken wij je de vacaturetekst te bewaren.


Ben je nieuw bij DICTU (en de Rijksoverheid)? Dan is de intentie om, na de periode van een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst, de overeenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd voort te zetten. Wanneer je al een vaste overeenkomst bij de Rijksoverheid hebt, dan behoud je deze.


Tot slot vinden wij het belangrijk om een diverse en inclusieve organisatie te zijn. Werken in divers samengestelde teams maakt ons effectiever, innovatiever en het werk leuker. We streven naar een cultuur van gelijkwaardigheid en van veiligheid, waar je kunt zijn wie je bent. Waar je ingezet wordt op je unieke kwaliteiten en waar je gestimuleerd wordt om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen. We willen dat onze organisatie een nog betere afspiegeling van de maatschappij is en daarom nodigen wij eenieder uit om te solliciteren!


DICTU is groot voorstander van technologische innovaties, waaronder het gebruik van AI. We vragen je daarom transparant te zijn over eventueel gebruik van AI in je sollicitatie. DICTU maakt géén gebruik van AI bij de beoordeling van sollicitaties.
