title: Operations Engineer
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Core Responsibilities

To perform the routine jobs describe below:

  • Work closely with Facilities Manager and Facilities team and support client on mechanical, electrical, and technical field strategy and support in driving the implementation of more technical features include driving continuous improvement in all aspects of facilities operations in terms of cost, processes, performance and efficiency.
  • Manage the M&E Services in the most efficient and economical manner to ensure zero Interruption to Services, Business, and site Manufacturing Operation.
  • Serve as the liaison for all facilities management services, inclusive but not limited to janitorial, pest control, M&E, landscape, waste management, space planning, transportation, and project development services.
  • Investigate serious plant incidents and ascertain that corrective and preventive actions are taken immediately to avoid any interruptions to manufacturing operation and business services. Ensure risk mitigation plans and measures are in place.
  • Coordinate and confer with FM Facility Manager & site team which associates on all matters arising from Operation and Maintenance of the site.
  • undefined
  • Planning, organizing, and controlling major maintenance work in relation to the overall site operations and maintenance activities under normal and emergency conditions. This includes daily work orders and scheduled task, Preventive Maintenance, and reimbursable/variable works.
  • Define project work requirement and scope of work, liaise and arrangement of project vendors for quotation based on tender specification and requirement.
  • Evaluate of submitted vendor quotations, consolidate, and prepare and submission of formal quotation to client as per project specification and requirement.
  • Project award and coordination of vendors and client to ensure safe and timely completion of project within budget and specification.
  • Conduct of project meetings; provide progressive updates of project to the manager, client and stakeholder.
  • Promote customer and JLL related sustainability initiatives by proposing & participating in recycling, energy, waste reduction, sustainability program.
  • Cascade of objectives established by manager to technician team into our JLL team’s Performance measuring system (Workday).
  • Maintain an effective succession plan for yourself and all team members under your care.
  • Complete and submit goals/objectives, mid-year reviews and year-end accomplishments by required due dates.
  • Manage and engage in the on-going performance review process for all direct reports by required due dates.
  • Develop technical service standard, establish and continuous update Engineering & Operational procedures, roll out training for operations staffs.
  • Review the maintenance/service practices of M&E vendors to deliver quality work practices in line with the manufacturer recommendations, established processes, tools and documentation.
  • Respond promptly to unusual or emergency conditions which affect critical system/asset capacity and reliability.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to the site technical team as required to ensure delivery and achieve of high client service standards.
  • Driving Operational control through Metrics/KPI Management.
  • Deliver services based on contract Scope of Work (SOW) with applicable contract deliverables in accordance with prescribed frequencies.
  • Ensure uptime and smooth operation of M&E system, attend and response to site incident and emergency as required.
  • Manage the performance and outcomes of assigned staff reporting to the position.
  • Monitor of 52 weeks PPM planner and ensure that all PMs are completed on time and updated into Corrigo system.
  • Have strong focus ensuring our JLL staffs and vendor partners meet all EHS, SLA, KPI, Satisfaction Surveys, Contracts and Scope of Work requirements.
  • Confer and coordinate with subordinates to ensure timely reporting of daily, weekly, and monthly operations report.
  • Initiate studies to solve and avoid all technical and administrative problems at the site particularly to enhance customer satisfaction and optimize costs.
  • Hold regular staff meetings with on-site technical team other key personnel to discuss operational, maintenance and other technical and non-technical issues.
  • Determine manpower requirements, training, and administrative needs.
  • For every direct report, build actionable and measurable career development plans.
  • Coordinate and review the preparation of site annual Capex and operation budget plan including client’s spending.
  • Implement safety program at the site and enforce safety rules and practices.
  • Regular inspection for conformance to service standards and expectation of M&E and facility infrastructure.
  • Investigates complaints regarding M&E service and equipment and takes corrective action.
  • Assist and support site’s daily operations and technical issues, providing effective solutions whenever difficulties arise.
  • Work closely with vendors, coordinating with them on a variety of services, projects and rectification & maintenance work and certify completion of jobs from beginning to end.
  • Assign jobs, supervise technicians and ensure that all assigned or routine jobs, maintenance, repair and replacement works are carried out properly.
  • Regular inspection of building and facilities to ensure building facilities are in satisfactory, serviceable condition and to ensure quality standards are being maintained.
  • Effectively support the management to control of site operating expenses to meet/exceed glide path savings targets.
  • Support JLL Sourcing Team on all Sourcing Initiatives; implement all service level changes and/or supplier transitions as required.
  • Ensure all financial processes are following and compliant as per JLL and clients’ competitive bids process, issuing of PO's, and receipting work.
  • Actively identify, develop and document best practices that increases JLL’s value to the client.
  • Actively identify, develop, propose and document innovations that increase JLL’s value to the client.
  • Actively apply and support of JLL new technology and corporate programs to increase value to the client.
  • Perform any other tasks as assigned by management, client and immediate reporting manager.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Minimum Diploma In Electrical Engineering or equivalent field
  • More than 5 years’ experience working in Facilities Management preferably in Manufacturing environment.
  • A4 Chargeman and electrical work certification is a plus point.
  • Able to work independently and with minimum supervision, Independent, self-motivated, flexible, responsible, and willing to work under pressure.
  • Computer literature, Microsoft Office, MS project, PowerPoint, Excel, AutoCAD – plus point.
  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills.
  • Knowledge in statutory requirements.
  • Knowledge of Energy Reduction and Sustainability Programs – plus point.
  • Pleasant personality with strong customer service
  • Strong interpersonal skills and problem-solving ability.

On-site –Bukit Mertajam, Malaysia

title: Mechanisch Data-Applicatie Engineer
description:
Wil je machines en modules niet alleen ontwerpen, maar ook zien hoe jouw keuzes uitpakken in de praktijk? Als Mechanisch Data-Applicatie Engineer werk je aan constructies vanaf het eerste ontwerp tot en met testen en documenteren. Je gebruikt 3D-ontwerpsoftware voor modellen, maatschetsen, productietekeningen en stuklijsten. Daarbij controleer en bereken je constructies, onder andere met FEM- en handberekeningen. Ook denk je mee wanneer verkoop of productie een technisch vraagstuk tegenkomt. Je hebt contact met productie en leveranciers en bent een technisch aanspreekpunt. Een deel van je tijd besteed je aan het coördineren van projecten en het vastleggen van informatie. Zo combineer je technisch ontwerpwerk met analyse, validatie en afstemming. De functie is in Doetinchem en wordt aangeboden op basis van een detavastconstructie.



Heeft u wat nodig is om te slagen? De volgende informatie dient door alle kandidaten zorgvuldig gelezen te worden.
Functie-inhoud

  • Je ontwerpt en modelleert complete machines en modules in 3D en maakt daarvan maatschetsen, productietekeningen en samenstellingstekeningen.
  • Je berekent en controleert constructies met FEM-analyses en handberekeningen, waaronder druk-, sterkte- en vermoeiingsberekeningen.
  • Je stelt stuklijsten op en toetst ontwerpen aan de geldende specificaties en technische uitgangspunten.
  • Je helpt technische problemen voor verkoop en productie oplossen en stemt af met productie, leveranciers en betrokken projectleden.

Functie-eisen

  • Je hebt een mechanisch-technische achtergrond waarmee je constructies en machineonderdelen kunt beoordelen en uitwerken.
  • Je kunt werken met 3D-ontwerpsoftware en technische tekeningen, samenstellingstekeningen en stuklijsten begrijpen of opstellen.
  • Je hebt kennis van sterkteberekeningen en kunt FEM-resultaten combineren met handmatige technische controles. xgiwjmb
  • Je communiceert helder met productie en leveranciers en legt technische keuzes en projectinformatie zorgvuldig vast.

title: Culinary Manager
description:
ABOUT TOPGOLF

Topgolf is a sports entertainment company that has changed how millions of people experience golf and where you can build a serious career. Our venues are high-energy, high-volume environments where performance matters and results are visible. Every day, we bring together golf, food and beverages, events, and entertainment into one experience that keeps guests coming back.

WHAT WE’RE SEEKING

Do you hold the line on quality even when it is busy? Can you lead a kitchen team through a high-volume service and still have the team better when the shift ends than when it started?

We are looking for a Culinary Manager who leads from the front. Someone who understands food cost and portion control, coaches their team through the work, and takes genuine ownership of the kitchen's performance. Consistency is not lucky. It is what happens when a leader pays attention.

If you run a tight, proud kitchen, this is where those matter.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Lead Kitchen Operations

• Supervise the kitchen team in delivering best-in-class culinary experiences every shift

• Coach and develop Team members and drive engagement across the kitchen

• Delegate tasks effectively and follow up to ensure completion and quality

• Manage day-to-day line operations or events execution as assigned

Maintain Culinary Standards

• Select and develop recipes to corporate approval and standardize production for consistent quality

• Establish and maintain presentation techniques and quality standards

• Plan and cost menus for special events and chef-choice occasions

• Ensure proper equipment operation, maintenance, and cleanliness

Manage Costs and Inventory

• Monitor inventory levels and purchase product within budgetary guidelines

• Maintain food and labor costs according to budget, with a solid understanding of COGS

• Oversee safety and sanitation in the kitchen in compliance with all regulations

Contribute to Team Culture

• Demonstrate Topgolf's core values: Fun, One Team, Excellence, Courage, and Caring

• Support the Executive Culinary Manager in building a high-performance kitchen team

• Participate in team development and model the standards expected of all kitchen team members

CORE COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

Drives Results | Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

• Demonstrates a strong drive to achieve consistent culinary quality and operational results

• Drives tasks to successful completion each shift — no corners cut

• Shows determination in the face of high volume, obstacles, or short-staffed situations

• Sets high standards for own performance and inspires the same in the team

Customer Focus | Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

• Ensures every dish that leaves the kitchen meets or exceeds guest expectations

• Uses guest and internal feedback to continuously improve food quality and presentation

• Independently anticipates and adjusts to evolving event and service needs

• Follows up on any culinary feedback to ensure issues are fully resolved

Decision Quality | Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

• Demonstrates good judgment in routine kitchen decisions — prep, production, quality, and staffing

• Makes sound independent decisions in urgent situations such as equipment failures or staffing gaps

• Considers various inputs and trade-offs to arrive at effective decisions during high-volume service

• Uses good judgment about when to act independently and when to escalate an issue to the Executive Culinary Manager

Communicates Effectively | Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

• Communicates clearly and professionally with kitchen team members and venue leadership

• Shares information and production updates with the team in a timely manner

• Listens attentively to the Executive Culinary Manager's direction and translates it into action

• Documents kitchen operations, production notes, and inventory clearly and accurately

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 3 years of culinary management experience in a high-volume environment
  • Culinary degree, professional culinary certification, or equivalent training and experience in a high-volume full-service kitchen and events-driven environment preferred
  • Must be 21 years of age or older as required by state or local law

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Let us be real — this is not your typical desk job! Here is what you will need to do to thrive in this role:

  • Ability to remain on your feet and in motion for extended periods throughout the shift, including standing, walking, and navigating a fast-paced kitchen environment; this role operates in a high-volume kitchen and requires sustained physical stamina throughout the duration of each shift
  • Ability to lift, carry, and move items up to 50 pounds independently and up to 75 pounds with assistance, including food products, equipment, supplies, and delivery transport across multiple levels of the venue
  • Ability to navigate stairs, ramps, and multi-level areas of the venue when transporting food, coordinating events, or overseeing service delivery
  • Ability to work in varying temperature environments on a frequent basis, including hot kitchen conditions, walk-in coolers, and freezers
  • Ability to perform repetitive hand and wrist motions including cutting, stirring, lifting, and operating kitchen equipment throughout the shift
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in a high-energy venue environment that may include moderate to high levels of background noise
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining focus, food safety standards, and quality under pressure

BENEFITS

Free Play & 1/2 price food! Health, dental, vision, 401(k) team member match, free mental well-being platform – and that’s just for starters for those who qualify. View team member benefits here.

title: Vice President - Business Enablement Manager - Chase Auto
description:
Chase Auto is a leading provider of auto financing with a portfolio of more than $80 billion in assets and relationships with 75% of U.S. franchised automotive dealers. The Chase Auto Private Label Captive Finance business has more than 20 years in the captive finance business and is the largest bank-owned private label captive finance provider in the U.S. We serve as the captive finance partner and preferred lender to seven domestic and global auto manufacturers: Subaru, Jaguar Land Rover, Aston Martin, Maserati, McLaren, Rivian, and Tesla.

As the Vice President, Business Enablement – Electric Vehicles Brands in Chase Auto, you will be a trusted advisor to the General Manager (GM) and an extension of the EV Brand leadership team, accountable for establishing team operating cadence, enabling strategic initiative execution, supporting preparation for executive meetings and coordinating cross-functional accountability across Chase Auto and JPMorganChase partners for project timelines. The role leads business and program management priorities including team communication strategy, ensuring decision governance and stakeholder management is executed in timely manner, strategic initiative delivery accountability, and executive preparedness (materials, insights, and messaging).

This role acts as the central conduit for EV Brand priorities, representing the portfolio in forums when the GM is unavailable to continue advancing strategic initiatives and ensures alignment across internal stakeholders while maintaining a high bar for partnership stewardship, operational excellence, and on time execution.

Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as a senior advisor to the GM, shaping and driving the operating agenda, priorities, and strategic narrative for EV Brand partnerships.
  • Anticipate decision points and risks; provide structured recommendations, options, and executive-ready insights to accelerate outcomes.
  • Own the business management operating model for the EV portfolio (meeting cadence, governance routines, facilitate talent reviews, and decision forums).
  • Drive disciplined follow-through across commitments, milestones, and deliverables; escalate proactively and manage trade-offs to protect outcomes.
  • Partner and keep informed with the ED of EV Operations to ensure accountability and timelines are met for complex, cross-functional initiatives across Product, Operations, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Controls, Technology, Marketing, Finance, and partner-facing teams ensuring alignment to business objectives, brand standards, and timelines.
  • Work with GM, strategy and corporate development to translate strategy into executable roadmaps with clear owners, dependencies, and measurable success criteria as part of annual and quarterly planning.
  • Develop and manage high-impact internal and external communications, including executive-level presentations, QBR materials, meeting briefs, talking points, and strategic updates; build and maintain strong relationships with Chase Auto and broader JPMorgan Chase stakeholders, ensuring alignment, transparency, and effective collaboration.
  • Support the GM in engagement and sustaining executive relationships with high-profile prospects, clients, industry leaders, and influencers through event participation and regular meeting cadence and represent the EV partnership portfolio in meetings and events as needed, acting as an executive brand ambassador and ensuring consistent messaging when GM has a conflict.
  • Partner with Marketing, Strategic Business Management, CIB, Sustainability, Private Bank, and external partners to maximize firmwide value, strengthen client outcomes, and elevate brand impact.
  • Identify opportunities to broaden connectivity across the firm to support partnership growth and strategic differentiation; identify, prioritize, and implement process improvements that enhance speed, quality, and scalability while reinforcing a strong control environment.
  • Establish best practices for planning, reporting, and execution across the EV portfolio.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in business management, program management, team operations, chief-of-staff, program leadership, or related leadership roles within financial services, automotive, technology, mobility or a matrixed corporate environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a vice president level, advising senior leaders and driving outcomes through influence in a complex matrix.
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional, multi-workstream initiatives with strong governance, executive reporting, and on-time delivery.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including producing executive-level presentations and concise decision materials.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills across all levels, including senior executives and external partners.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to deliver high-quality work products under time-critical deadlines while managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong judgment and ability to identify risks, navigate ambiguity, and drive clear decisions and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in EV automotive, mobility, technology-enabled retail, or private label/captive finance partnerships.
  • Experience supporting high-profile client engagements and executive events with measurable business outcomes.
  • Ability to work in a fast pace environment.

title: Klinisk diætist til barselsvikariat i "Din Sundhedsvej" i Tønder Kommune
description:
Vil du gøre en forskel for borgere, der ønsker varige forandringer i deres livsstil og sundhed? Så har vi jobbet til dig.

I Din Sundhedsvej i Tønder Kommune (Sundhedsafdelingen) søger vi en engageret klinisk diætist til et barselsvikariat.

Vi søger en kollega, der brænder for at støtte borgere i at skabe bæredygtige vaner gennem en anerkendende og helhedsorienteret tilgang til kost, sundhed og trivsel. Vores arbejde er inspireret af en vægtneutral tilgang, hvor fokus er på sundhed, livskvalitet og varige adfærdsændringer. Samtidig hjælper vi borgere med forskellige ernæringsrelaterede problemstillinger.

En arbejdsplads med fokus på forebyggelse og udvikling

Du bliver en del af Sundhedsafdelingen – Din Sundhedsvej, som arbejder med borger- og patientrettede sundhedsindsatser, forebyggelse og trivsel. Vi arbejder for at styrke borgernes muligheder for at leve et sundt og selvstændigt liv og for at skabe sammenhæng mellem sundhed, forebyggelse og øvrige kommunale tilbud.

Du indgår i et tværfagligt fællesskab med engagerede kolleger, hvor faglig sparring, udvikling og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Dine opgaver

Som diætist i Din Sundhedsvej vil du blandt andet

  • afholde individuelle samtaler og forløb
  • facilitere gruppeforløb inden for kost, sundhed og livsstilsændringer
  • vejlede borgere med overvægt, hjertekarsygdom, diabetes og andre ernæringsrelaterede udfordringer
  • understøtte borgernes motivation, mestring og tro på egne ressourcer
  • samarbejde med kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere om sammenhængende borgerforløb
  • bidrage til udvikling og tilpasning af sundhedstilbud og indsatser.

Vi søger en kollega, der

  • er uddannet klinisk diætist
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for vanecoaching og adfærdsændringer
  • arbejder anerkendende, relationsskabende og borgercentreret
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • trives i tværfagligt samarbejde
  • kan omsætte ernæringsfaglig viden til konkrete og meningsfulde løsninger for den enkelte borger.

Vi tilbyder

  • et spændende barselsvikariat med stor grad af selvstændighed
  • meningsfuldt arbejde tæt på borgerne
  • et stærkt fagligt og tværfagligt miljø
  • mulighed for faglig sparring og udvikling
  • engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger
  • et godt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor og nye idéer
  • frugtordning og mulighed for motion i arbejdstiden.

Praktiske oplysninger

Der er tale om et barselsvikariat med forventet tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Foreløbig indtil den 1. december 2027.

Arbejdsstedet er som udgangspunkt i Tønder, men kan også foregå på Din Sundhedsvejs lokationer i Toftlund.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Louisa Nellemann på telefon 23 64 08 20.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 22. november 2026, og vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende.

Indplacering i lønramme afhænger af erfaring, kompetence og relevant uddannelse.

Du søger stillingen ved at sende ansøgning, CV og anden dokumentation elektronisk via ansøgningslinket. Du modtager en kvittering for ansøgningen, men vær opmærksom på, at kvitteringen og en eventuel invitation til samtale kan ende i dit spamfilter.

title: Senior Compliance Specialist – Respectful Workplace Investigator
description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior Compliance Specialist – Respectful Workplace Investigator, Compliance Investigator works with a team that is developing and implementing an overall strategy for internal Compliance investigations. The Compliance Investigator will be responsible for investigating cases regarding a variety of matters involving alleged violations of law or GE Aerospace Respectful Workplace policy related to discrimination, harassment, bullying, hostile work environment, and retaliation. Working with other stakeholders in Legal, Compliance, HR and other areas, the Compliance Investigator will conduct investigations of policy concerns raised through the open reporting system. The Compliance Investigator must be a self-starter, with ability to handle a large and varied caseload simultaneously and to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as proven record of being thorough, fair, and objective with attention to detail. This role requires excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively in a team and interface effectively with senior business and functional leaders throughout the organization.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead and conduct independent investigations
  • Carry out prompt, thorough, and objective investigations into alleged violations of law or policy. Cases will primarily involve GE Aerospace’s Spirit & Letter policy related to Respectful Workplace and may include discrimination, harassment, bullying, retaliation, hostile work environment, and other labor and employment matters
  • Review and assess complaints and allegations and be able to develop and manage investigate plans and strategies
  • Conduct concern raiser, witness, and subject interviews
  • Conduct investigative research: including review and analyze all reliable and relevant information (i.e. emails, data files, invoices) including performing forensic analysis and reviewing GE Aerospace policies & procedures
  • Provide oral briefings to senior leadership and functional owners on cases, and identify appropriate corrective actions
  • Draft reports to ensure investigations are clearly and properly documented
  • Maintain client relationships in the face of conflicting demands or directions and provide evidence-based conclusion and recommendation on sound diagnosis and information
  • Know and understand all applicable legal and policy requirements pertaining to the conduct of investigations including in areas involving employee interviews, data privacy, labor and employment requirements, and more; monitor changes in such laws and policies and provide guidance to colleagues with respect to such changes

Required Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 10 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 12 years of professional experience
  • Minimum 6 years of professional experience in conducting workplace investigations related to Respectful Workplace including discrimination, harassment, bullying, retaliation, hostile work environment, and other labor and employment matters
  • Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience
  • Eligibility Requirement: Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Law degree, post-graduate degree in business or other relevant field, or an audit or quality background
  • Prior experience Compliance, Law, Audit, Quality, Human Resources, or another related field
  • Proven analytical and evaluation skills
  • Proven ability to prepare, present, and discuss findings and recommendations at a senior level and produce clear and compelling report clearly and concisely
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills
  • Fluency in English required; other languages a plus



The base pay range for this position is $155,000 - $206,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 20th, 2026.


GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

title: Liikkuvan kaluston asentaja
description:
Haluatko työskennellä kaivoskoneiden kunnossapidon parissa tehtävässä, jossa oman työn jäljen näkee konkreettisesti? Haemme Boliden Kevitsaan liikkuvan kaluston asentajaa. Tässä tehtävässä huolehdit yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa siitä, että kaivoksen koneet pysyvät turvallisesti toimintakunnossa. Pääset työskentelemään Suomen suurimpien kaivoskoneiden parissa sekä kehittämään osaamistasi monipuolisen tekniikan ja kunnossapidon tehtävissä. Lue lisää ja hae tehtävää!

Boliden Kevitsa hakee vakituiseen työsuhteeseen

Liikkuvan kaluston asentajaa

Liikkuvan kaluston asentajana tärkein tehtäväsi on kaivoskoneiden huolto, korjaus ja kunnossapito. Huolehdit omalta osaltasi myös turvallisesta työympäristöstä, työkaluista ja kalustosta. Työ on käytännönläheistä ja vaihtelevaa, ja sitä tehdään sekä sisällä että ulkona erilaisissa työskentelyolosuhteissa.


Tehtävässä turvallisuus on keskeinen osa ammattitaitoa. Huolto- ja korjaustöiden tavoitteena on varmistaa, että koneet ovat työn jälkeen turvallisesti toimintakunnossa. Saat samalla mahdollisuuden kasvattaa osaamistasi kaivoskoneista, hydrauliikasta, ajoneuvosähköstä ja muusta liikkuvan kaluston tekniikasta.

Kenen kanssa tulet työskentelemään?

Liityt kuuden hengen kaivoskoneiden kunnossapitotiimiin, jossa työtä tehdään sekä itsenäisesti että yhdessä muiden asentajien kanssa. Teet yhteistyötä myös muiden osastojen ja ulkopuolisten urakoitsijoiden kanssa. Työ on 12 tunnin vuorotyötä, jossa työvuororytmi on kaksi päivävuoroa, kaksi yövuoroa ja kuusi vapaapäivää.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • asentajan ammatillista perustutkintoa (kone-, auto-, metsäkone- tai työkoneasentaja)
  • suomen kielen taitoa
  • B-luokan ajokorttia
  • soveltuvuutta vuorotyöhön
  • huolellista, vastuullista ja yhteistyökykyistä tapaa työskennellä turvallisuus huomioiden

Arvostamme

  • aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista asennus-, huolto- tai kunnossapitotehtävistä
  • englannin kielen taitoa (teknisten ohjeiden ymmärtämistä)
  • C-ajokorttia
  • nosturikorttia

Miksi hakisit meille töihin?

Tässä tehtävässä pääset tekemään käytännönläheistä ja merkityksellistä kunnossapitotyötä. Tehtävään kuuluu erilaisia teknisiä osaamisalueita ja työn vaihtelevuus antaa mahdollisuuden oppia kaivoskoneista ja niiden tekniikasta käytännön työn kautta.

Meillä pääset työskentelemään modernissa työympäristössä. Vapaa-aikaa voit puolestaan viettää lapin luonnon maisemissa. Bolideniläisenä etuihisi kuuluvat muun muassa kilpailukykyinen palkkaus, kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä edut liikuntaan ja vapaa-ajan aktiviteetteihin. Tarjoamme lisäksi maksuttoman työmatkakuljetuksen henkilöstöllemme Sodankylän keskustan ja Boliden Kevitsan kaivoksen välillä.

Lisätietoja

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa liikkuvan kaluston kunnossapidon työnjohtaja Rami Pöyliö, rami.poylio@boliden.com.


Hakuprosessiin ja rekrytointijärjestelmään liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaa Talent Acquisition Partner Maarit Uusipaikka, maarit.uusipaikka@boliden.com.

Hakemukset

Jätä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ansioluetteloineen 22.11.2026 mennessä.

_____________________________________________________________________________

Tule meille töihin! Boliden Kevitsa on Pohjois-Suomessa Sodankylän kunnassa toimiva monimetallikaivos ja merkittävä työllistäjä alueella. Päätuotteemme ovat kupari- ja nikkelirikasteet. Rikasteet sisältävät myös kobolttia, platinaa, palladiumia ja kultaa. Malmirikaste toimitetaan Bolidenin omalle sulatolle Harjavaltaan. Olemme osa kansainvälistä Boliden-konsernia, jonka tavoitteena on olla maailman ilmastoystävällisin ja arvostetuin metallien tuottaja.

title: Medical Communications Officer (Start Date: January 2027)
description:
Position Type:

Permanent

*

Closing date:

2026-11-23

*

Emergency Medical Care Inc. (EMC) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Medavie Health Services (MHS) that manages and operates ground ambulance, air medical transport and the medical communications operations in Nova Scotia through a performance-based contract with the provincial government's Emergency Health Services (EHS) Operations division and the Department of Health and Wellness. As well, EMC operates TeleHealth/811 medical communications for Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island for the Department of Health.

We access all communities in Nova Scotia in a timely and efficient manner with our fleet of more than 180 ambulances and support vehicles operating out of 60+ stations. We respond to 165,000+ calls annually across the province, which are actively managed through the EHS Operations Medical Communications Centre, the hub of all emergency (911) and non-emergency (hospital transfers) medical calls.

The EHS Operations LifeFlight program provides even greater accessibility by responding to patients on scene or through inter-facility transports by our critical care team via helicopter, fixed wing, or ground ambulance.

In addition, paramedics in Nova Scotia participate in various programs both urban and rural such as community-based paramedic programs, collaborative emergency centres, and emergency preparedness and special operations, to name a few.

There are lots of opportunities waiting for you in Nova Scotia. Apply now to learn more about our service and available positions.

*

Position: Medical Communications Officer

Class Date: January 2027

Location: Dartmouth, NS (On-site, Shift Work - Days, Nights, Weekends, Holidays)

Rate of pay: Step 1: $29.58 per hour + shift premiums on evenings and weekends


Full Time Permanent and Term positions are available.


Nature and Scope


Reporting to the MCC Operations Lead, the Communications Officer is responsible for the processing of requests for service for the provincial EHS system. In this role, you may be tasked with acting as a call taker or dispatcher during shift operations. title: Mechanical / Packaging Design Release Engineer – 12V Component Shields
location: Warren, Michigan, United States of America
description:
Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking a Mechanical / Packaging Design Release Engineer (DRE) to lead the design, packaging, release, and execution of shields and associated mechanical interfaces for 12V components for vehicle programs. This role is responsible for translating system and vehicle requirements into robust shield and package solutions for generators, inverters, converters, battery vent tubes, jump start nuts, and related 12V hardware that support performance, manufacturability, serviceability, quality, and program timing.

The ideal candidate brings strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, product development experience, and the ability to drive cross-functional alignment across electrical, mechanical, packaging, manufacturing, quality, purchasing, and supplier teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead design release responsibility for assigned 12V component shields and related mechanical hardware
  • Own mechanical design and package integration for shields supporting generators, inverters, converters, battery vent tubes, jump start nuts, and related 12V hardware
  • Develop and maintain component requirements, design concepts, packaging studies, and release documentation
  • Ensure shield designs meet vehicle packaging, environmental, mounting, sealing, durability, service, thermal, and assembly requirements
  • Create and review engineering drawings, specifications, BOMs, and engineering change documentation
  • Drive package integration within the vehicle environment, including clearance management, attachment strategy, surrounding component interfaces, and issue resolution
  • Work closely with electrical, systems, packaging, and vehicle integration teams to ensure shields for generators, inverters, converters, battery vent tubes, and jump start hardware are properly packaged and supported within the full vehicle architecture
  • Support CAD reviews, tolerance studies, DFMEA, DVP&R development, and validation planning
  • Collaborate with suppliers to review designs, resolve technical issues, and support sourcing and execution
  • Support prototype and production builds, issue resolution, root cause investigations, and implementation of corrective actions
  • Manage engineering changes and execute deliverables in support of program timing, cost, quality, and performance targets

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline
  • Experience in mechanical design, packaging, or design release engineering for automotive components
  • Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, packaging integration, materials, manufacturing processes, and assembly methods
  • Experience supporting shielding, brackets, housings, and packaging interfaces for automotive applications, including generators, inverters, converters, vent systems, jump start hardware, or similar 12V components
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and GD&T
  • Experience using CAD tools for component design and package reviews
  • Experience working in a cross-functional product development environment
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and project management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple technical issues and priorities in a fast-paced program setting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with generator, inverter, converter, battery vent tube, jump start hardware, or similar 12V component packaging
  • Experience with shield design, underhood packaging, bracket and attachment strategy, or vehicle electrical power environments
  • Familiarity with shield mounting strategies, structural supports, vent routing, thermal protection, serviceability, and environmental protection considerations
  • Experience with DFMEA, DVP&R, tolerance analysis, and change management
  • Experience supporting supplier technical reviews, validation, and launch execution
  • Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field

What Success Looks Like

  • Shields for 12V components are released on time and meet package, interface, and program requirements
  • Mechanical designs support robust installation, retention, serviceability, durability, and thermal protection in the vehicle environment
  • Cross-functional package and interface issues are identified early and resolved effectively
  • Supplier and engineering concerns are driven to closure with strong technical ownership
  • Shield designs achieve quality, cost, manufacturability, and performance targets

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to work on critical vehicle electric power content by owning the mechanical and packaging execution of shields for generators, inverters, converters, battery vent tubes, jump start nuts, and related 12V hardware from concept through production. You will influence key integration decisions, solve packaging challenges, and help deliver robust solutions that support successful vehicle launches.

Work Environment

This position requires strong collaboration across electrical, systems, packaging, manufacturing, purchasing, quality, and supplier teams. Candidates should be comfortable leading technical discussions, driving issue resolution, and executing engineering deliverables in support of aggressive program milestones.

description:

India Region Lead – Integrated Facilities Management


Business Unit: Work Dynamics – Integrated Facilities Management
Region: India | APAC Portfolio
Reporting To: Regional Account Director
Regional Leadership: Senior Facilities Managers and associated country facilities management teams
Key Functional Relationships: Regional Engineering, Projects, Workplace Experience, Health & Safety, Sustainability, Finance, Procurement and other specialist service delivery functions


Role Overview

The India Region Lead is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational performance and integrated facilities management service delivery of the client's India portfolio, encompassing approximately 4 million square feet across owned and leased facilities, representing the majority of space in the broader APAC account portfolio.


Reporting directly to the Regional Account Director, the role holds overall responsibility for the performance of the India account operations, ensuring the consistent delivery of safe, compliant, efficient and high-quality facilities management services in alignment with contractual obligations, client expectations and regional business objectives.


This is a senior leadership position requiring a combination of operational expertise, commercial acumen, strategic thinking and strong client relationship management. The successful candidate will be expected to operate beyond traditional facilities management, providing meaningful business insights, identifying opportunities for value creation and contributing to regional account strategy, financial performance and portfolio planning.

The position will lead a geographically dispersed team of senior Facilities Managers and operational teams, providing direction and oversight across both hard and soft services while ensuring effective integration with specialist functions including Engineering, Projects, Workplace Experience, Sustainability and Health & Safety.


A key element of the role will be the ability to influence and coordinate outcomes across a matrixed organisational structure, working collaboratively with regional functional leaders and specialist verticals that may operate outside the direct reporting hierarchy.

The India Region Lead will act as a senior point of accountability for country-level service performance, operational risk, financial management and client engagement, ensuring that India operations contribute effectively to the wider APAC account strategy and performance objectives.


Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. India Portfolio & Account Leadership

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership across the client's India facilities management portfolio, ensuring consistent service delivery, operational excellence and alignment with regional account objectives.
  • Take ownership of consolidated India account performance, driving accountability across facilities operations, service delivery, financial management, risk and client satisfaction.
  • Lead and develop a geographically dispersed team of senior Facilities Managers and associated operational teams, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations and a culture of accountability.
  • Translate regional account strategy into actionable country-level objectives, ensuring consistent implementation across diverse locations and operating environments.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the India portfolio, including owned and leased facilities, service delivery models, operational requirements, stakeholder priorities and associated commercial obligations.
  • Act as the primary country-level escalation point for significant operational, financial, service delivery and stakeholder matters, ensuring timely intervention and resolution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operating models, resource deployment, service integration and overall account performance through continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Support the Regional Account Director in the development and execution of strategic initiatives that strengthen service performance, client relationships and long-term account sustainability.

2. Client Relationship Management & Business Governance

  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, acting as a strategic partner in the management and performance of the India portfolio.
  • Represent India operations in regional account governance forums, management reviews, financial reviews and strategic business discussions.
  • Provide clear, insightful and commercially informed reporting to the Regional Account Director, translating operational performance, financial results and portfolio risks into meaningful business insights and recommendations.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of India account performance for Monthly Management Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews, financial reviews and other governance meetings.
  • Anticipate client requirements and emerging business priorities, proactively identifying opportunities to improve service delivery, operational efficiency and workplace outcomes.
  • Ensure effective communication and alignment between local client representatives, corporate stakeholders, country facilities teams and regional account leadership.
  • Demonstrate strong commercial and business judgement when balancing service expectations, financial constraints, operational risks and longer-term portfolio considerations.
  • Maintain a proactive and solutions-oriented approach to stakeholder management, ensuring that the India operation is viewed as a trusted contributor to the client's broader corporate real estate objectives.

3. Integrated Facilities Management & Service Delivery

  • Oversee the delivery of comprehensive integrated facilities management services across the India portfolio, ensuring operational consistency, contractual compliance and high standards of service quality.
  • Provide leadership and governance across hard services, including building engineering, mechanical and electrical systems, preventive and reactive maintenance, critical infrastructure and asset reliability.
  • Oversee soft services delivery, including cleaning, housekeeping, landscaping, waste management, front-of-house and other applicable workplace support services.
  • Ensure effective coordination and integration of services across owned and leased facilities, recognising the differing operational responsibilities, landlord interfaces and contractual obligations associated with each property type.
  • Drive consistent application of account operating procedures, service standards, reporting requirements and performance management practices across locations.
  • Ensure service delivery aligns with the Master Services Agreement, agreed scopes of work, contractual KPIs, critical KPIs and client-specific operational requirements.
  • Monitor operational performance, identify recurring service challenges and implement corrective actions to improve reliability, customer experience and service efficiency.
  • Oversee vendor and specialist service provider performance, ensuring effective contract management, compliance, service quality and continuous improvement.
  • Support the mobilisation, transition and integration of new facilities, services and operational changes, ensuring effective resource planning, service continuity and governance.

4. Financial Management & Commercial Performance

  • Take accountability for the financial performance of India facilities management operations, ensuring effective budget management, cost control, forecasting and financial governance.
  • Work closely with the account Finance Team and Regional Account Director to monitor financial performance, understand variances and implement timely corrective actions.
  • Maintain visibility of operational expenditure, financial commitments, accruals, forecasts and cost-saving opportunities across the portfolio.
  • Ensure effective management of contractual financial obligations, including performance-related fee exposure, service credits, budget adherence and other relevant commercial risks.
  • Develop and implement cost optimisation and productivity initiatives that contribute to the account's agreed savings glidepath without compromising safety, compliance, service quality or business continuity.
  • Identify opportunities for improved resource utilisation, service delivery efficiencies, procurement optimisation and operational cost avoidance.
  • Contribute to business cases, investment recommendations, capital planning and financial evaluations relating to facilities operations and portfolio improvement initiatives.
  • Provide commercially informed analysis and recommendations to regional leadership, demonstrating an understanding of the wider financial and business implications of operational decisions.

5. Engineering, Asset Management & Project Delivery Integration

  • Maintain strong technical awareness of building services, engineering operations, critical infrastructure and asset management principles to provide effective leadership and oversight of operational outcomes.
  • Work closely with regional Engineering leadership and specialist teams to ensure engineering compliance, infrastructure reliability, maintenance performance and asset lifecycle requirements are appropriately addressed across India facilities.
  • Support the implementation of asset management strategies, including asset data accuracy, condition assessments, maintenance planning, lifecycle replacement and capital investment prioritisation.
  • Maintain visibility of engineering risks, asset reliability concerns, infrastructure vulnerabilities and associated mitigation or investment requirements.
  • Provide regional account leadership and operational oversight of project delivery activities within India, ensuring technical and non-technical projects are aligned with client priorities, business requirements and operational objectives.
  • Collaborate with the Regional Projects function to monitor project performance, delivery milestones, budgets, risks and stakeholder requirements, ensuring appropriate escalation and resolution of issues.
  • Ensure effective coordination between facilities management, engineering and project delivery teams, particularly where capital works, infrastructure upgrades or workplace changes may impact ongoing operations.
  • Support the evaluation and prioritisation of capital works, infrastructure improvements, asset replacement programs and non-technical business initiatives.
  • Ensure completed projects are appropriately commissioned, documented and transitioned into facilities operations, including relevant asset data updates, maintenance requirements and stakeholder handover.
  • Promote effective collaboration across Engineering, Projects and other specialist functions, influencing delivery priorities and outcomes while maintaining alignment with established functional governance and reporting structures.

6. Risk, Health & Safety, Compliance & Business Continuity

  • Provide leadership and accountability for the implementation of health, safety, environmental and risk management requirements across India facilities management operations.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable statutory regulations, building codes, fire and life-safety requirements, contractual obligations and client/JLL policies and procedures.
  • Work closely with regional and local Health & Safety teams to promote a proactive safety culture, effective incident management and continuous improvement in operational risk controls.
  • Maintain oversight of significant operational, engineering, vendor, compliance and business continuity risks, ensuring appropriate mitigation plans, escalation and tracking through to resolution.
  • Ensure effective governance of contractor safety, permit-to-work systems, high-risk activities and specialist service provider compliance.
  • Oversee the implementation and effectiveness of emergency preparedness, incident response and business continuity arrangements across the portfolio.
  • Ensure significant incidents, audit findings and compliance gaps are investigated, communicated and addressed through structured corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Promote a culture in which operational decisions consistently balance service performance, financial considerations, safety, compliance and the protection of client assets and personnel.

7. Workplace Experience, Space & Portfolio Intelligence

  • Champion the delivery of a consistent, high-quality workplace experience across the India portfolio, ensuring facilities services support employee productivity, wellbeing and overall workplace satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with Workplace Experience specialists and client stakeholders to identify and implement initiatives that enhance the workplace environment and employee experience.
  • Support client workplace and occupancy strategies through effective facilities planning, service alignment and operational readiness.
  • Ensure effective utilisation of Integrated Workplace Management Systems (IWMS), Computerised Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and other account technology platforms.
  • Drive data accuracy, governance and reporting consistency across facilities, asset, space, occupancy and service performance information.
  • Collaborate with regional specialists to translate portfolio data into meaningful insights supporting space utilisation, asset planning, operational investment and real estate decision-making.
  • Promote the adoption of digital tools, reporting dashboards, analytics and process improvements that enhance transparency, operational efficiency and management decision-making.
  • Support sustainability and energy management initiatives that contribute to the client's environmental objectives and long-term portfolio performance.

8. Leadership, Collaboration & Organisational Effectiveness

  • Provide clear leadership, coaching and professional development to senior Facilities Managers and their teams, fostering a high-performing and collaborative country organisation.
  • Establish effective management routines, communication structures and performance reviews to ensure consistency of service delivery across geographically dispersed locations.
  • Influence and coordinate regional specialist and vertical functions, including Engineering, Projects, Sustainability, Workplace Experience, Procurement and Health & Safety, to ensure integrated delivery of India account priorities.
  • Build strong working relationships across direct reporting and matrixed teams, demonstrating the ability to drive outcomes through influence, collaboration and stakeholder alignment.
  • Ensure appropriate workforce planning, succession planning, capability development and resource allocation to meet current and future operational needs.
  • Encourage innovation, knowledge sharing and the adoption of best practices across the India portfolio and wider APAC account.
  • Support organisational change, service model improvements and regional transformation initiatives, ensuring effective engagement and implementation at country level.

Required Qualifications, Skills & Experience

Professional Qualifications

  • Recognised degree or equivalent professional qualification in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Management, Real Estate, Property Management or a related discipline.
  • Relevant postgraduate qualifications or professional accreditations in business management, facilities management, engineering or project management are advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of corporate real estate operations, integrated facilities management and commercial service delivery models.
  • Sound knowledge of financial management principles, contractual governance, business reporting and operational risk management.

Leadership & Professional Experience

  • Significant professional experience in facilities management, corporate real estate services or integrated account management, ideally with at least 10 years of relevant experience and substantial senior leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large, complex, multi-site facilities portfolios, preferably within India and across geographically dispersed locations.
  • Proven experience leading senior Facilities Managers, multidisciplinary teams and large outsourced service delivery operations.
  • Strong background in both hard and soft facilities management services, with the ability to oversee complex operational environments and diverse service provider arrangements.
  • Demonstrated experience managing client accounts or significant portfolio responsibilities, including financial performance, contractual obligations, service governance and senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Experience operating within matrixed organisational structures, with a proven ability to influence functional leaders and specialist teams outside direct reporting relationships.
  • Demonstrated financial and commercial acumen, including budget ownership, forecasting, cost optimisation, variance analysis and performance-related commercial risk management.
  • Experience preparing and presenting executive-level management information, operational performance reviews, financial reports and strategic recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of engineering operations, asset management, infrastructure reliability and capital planning within a facilities management environment.
  • Experience supporting or overseeing technical and non-technical project delivery, with an understanding of project governance, budgets, schedules, risks and operational handover.
  • Strong understanding of statutory compliance, health and safety, operational risk management and business continuity requirements.
  • Familiarity with workplace experience, occupancy management, sustainability initiatives and corporate real estate performance objectives.
  • Experience using IWMS, CMMS, financial reporting and other facilities management technology platforms to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic & Commercial Leadership: Ability to understand the wider business environment, translate portfolio performance into commercial insights and contribute meaningfully to account strategy.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior corporate stakeholders and regional account leadership.
  • Operational Excellence: Comprehensive understanding of integrated facilities management and the ability to maintain high standards across complex, multi-site operations.
  • Financial Acumen: Strong financial literacy, analytical capability and demonstrated ability to manage budgets, financial risks and cost optimisation initiatives.
  • People Leadership: Proven ability to lead, motivate and develop senior managers and diverse operational teams.
  • Matrix Leadership & Influence: Ability to align and influence specialist verticals and cross-functional stakeholders without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
  • Risk & Decision-Making: Sound judgement when managing operational, commercial, safety and reputational risks.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation and reporting skills, with the ability to translate complex operational matters into clear business recommendations.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactive, analytical and solutions-oriented approach to service improvement, innovation and organisational effectiveness.
  • Technology & Data Literacy: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort working with operational dashboards, reporting systems and facilities management platforms.
  • Adaptability & Mobility: Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic regional account environment, manage multiple competing priorities and travel across India as required.

Key Performance Objectives

Performance will be assessed against agreed regional and country objectives, including:

  • Integrated Service Delivery: Achieve agreed contractual KPIs and critical KPIs across India facilities management operations, maintaining consistent service quality, operational performance and client satisfaction.
  • Financial & Commercial Performance: Deliver effective budget management, forecasting accuracy, financial governance and cost optimisation while minimising contractual fee risk and financial exposure.
  • Regional Account Governance: Provide accurate, timely and commercially relevant performance reporting, financial analysis and strategic recommendations to the Regional Account Director and client governance forums.
  • Engineering & Asset Reliability: Maintain effective oversight of engineering performance, critical infrastructure risks, asset management practices and lifecycle planning in collaboration with specialist functions.
  • Project Delivery Integration: Ensure effective coordination and oversight of India project delivery activities, with visibility of agreed scope, budgets, schedules, risks and operational handover requirements.
  • Risk, Safety & Compliance: Maintain appropriate statutory compliance, safety performance, operational risk controls and business continuity arrangements, with timely closure of significant findings and corrective actions.
  • Workplace Experience & Client Satisfaction: Drive consistent workplace standards, positive stakeholder engagement and measurable improvements in employee and client experience.
  • Continuous Improvement & Value Creation: Identify and implement service efficiencies, resource optimisation initiatives and cost-saving opportunities that contribute to agreed account financial and operational objectives.
  • Leadership & Organisational Effectiveness: Build and maintain a capable, engaged and accountable country leadership team, strengthening collaboration across facilities management and regional specialist functions.

40

title: EMEA Corporate Access Associate (f/m/x)
description:
Job Description:

Deutsche Bank’s EMEA Corporate Access team, based in London and Frankfurt, manages Corporate Access activities across Europe. The team organizes investor conferences, non-deal roadshows, field trips, investor trips and bespoke meetings that connect company management and investor relations teams with institutional investors. Based in Frankfurt, you will play a central role in planning and delivering these activities, working closely with Research, Sales and Banking as well as Corporate Access colleagues in the US. Your contribution will support the efficient delivery of complex Corporate Access events and effective engagement with corporate and institutional clients.


Your Responsibilities

  • You lead the planning, coordination and execution of Corporate Access events across Europe, including investor conferences, non-deal roadshows, field trips and bespoke meetings.
  • You build and maintain relationships with company management and investor relations teams, supporting investor engagement, targeting, roadshow planning and travel requirements.
  • You manage the smooth organization and execution of complex Equity Corporate Access events.
  • You engage with corporate and institutional clients to support successful outcomes across Corporate Access activities.
  • You coordinate complex, multi-city schedules and logistical arrangements for Equity Corporate Access roadshows.
  • You collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Research, Sales and Banking as well as international Corporate Access teams to support strategic alignment and successful event delivery.

Your Skills and Experience

  • You bring experience in coordinating complex, multi-city Equity Corporate Access roadshows, combined with strong project management and logistical planning skills.
  • You demonstrate strong interpersonal and communication skills and can engage effectively with clients and stakeholders at different levels.
  • You communicate fluently in both German and English.
  • You work effectively under pressure and demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.
  • You understand the Corporate Access market environment and relevant regulatory landscape, supporting compliant and efficient event execution.
  • You collaborate effectively within diverse and international teams and contribute to a strong team environment.
  • You use AI tools effectively to increase productivity, optimize processes and solve business problems. You apply sound judgement and ensure the responsible and conscientious use of data and AI-generated outputs.

What we offer


We provide you with a comprehensive portfolio of benefits and offerings to support both, your private and professional needs.


  • Emotionally and mentally balanced
    A positive mind helps us master the challenges of everyday life – both professionally and privately. We offer consultation in difficult life situations as well as mental health awareness trainings.

    Networking opens up new perspectives, helps us thrive professionally and personally as well as strengthens our self-confidence and well-being. You can benefit from PME family service, FitnessCenter Job, flexible working (e.g parttime, hybrid working, job tandem) as well as an extensive culture of diversity, equity and inclusion.

    We provide you with financial security not only during your active career but also for the future. You can benefit from offerings such as pension plans, banking services, company bicycle or “Deutschlandticket”.


Since our offerings slightly vary across locations, please contact your recruiter with specific questions.


This job is available in full and parttime.


In case of any recruitment related questions, please get in touch with Philipp Maass.


Contact Philipp Maass: +49 (0) 151 18173970
