title: Servicemedarbejder til drift af boliger i Sydhavnen
location: Driftsområde G / Hammelstrupvej 4A, st. th., 2450, København SV
description:
Hvad skal der til for at du trives? Vi kan tilbyde en hverdag med stor frihed, hvor du får ansvar for dit eget område og mulighed for at gøre en synlig forskel for beboerne hver dag.

Vi søger en servicemedarbejder til Boligforeningen 3B i Sydhavnen - en god kollega, der trives med frihed under ansvar og kan vurdere, prioritere og træffe beslutninger i hverdagen. Du får stor indflydelse på din arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab med 18 kolleger fordelt på 15 afdelinger. Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi ikke bare har trivslen men også det gode fællesskab, lederskab og kollegaskab tilfælles.

Det får du hos os i Boligforeningen 3B

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen. Du arbejder mandag til torsdag kl. 06.30-14.30 og fredag kl. 06.30-14.00.

Dit arbejdssted er Hammelstrupvej 4A, st. th., 2450 København SV.

Lønnen er 31.000-34.000 kr. om måneden afhængigt af erfaring. Hertil kommer pension, sundhedsforsikring og valgfrie lønelementer.

Du får ansvar for dit eget område

Du får en alsidig arbejdsdag med både praktiske opgaver og kontakt til mennesker. Du planlægger i høj grad selv din dag og handler på de udfordringer, der opstår.

  • Du sørger for drift og vedligeholdelse af bygninger og udearealer
  • Du udfører mindre reparationer og tekniske serviceopgaver
  • Du håndterer forsikringssager
  • Du har kontakt med beboere, håndværkere og samarbejdspartnere
  • Du sørger for affaldshåndtering og pæne fællesarealer
  • Du vurderer og prioriterer løbende driftsopgaver
  • Du holder øje med vejret og reagerer, når det kræver en indsats

Du passer godt ind, hvis:

  • Du arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine beslutninger
  • Du er handlekraftig og finder løsninger, når noget uventet opstår
  • Du har praktisk erfaring og teknisk forståelse
  • Du trives med beboerkontakt og lægger vægt på god service
  • Du kan bruge digitale arbejdsredskaber
  • Du har kørekort til kategori B
  • Du har de fysiske forudsætninger for en aktiv arbejdsdag med praktiske drifts- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver

Ønsker du at høre mere?

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte serviceleder Nicolai Høgh Hallqvist på telefon 61 62 03 59.

Send din ansøgning senest mandag den 16. november 2026 kl. 12.00.

Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Project Manager- Power Reliability
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Operations Manager - BL Excitation(AMEA)

__

Job Description Summary

Leads the execution of medium-size projects and ensures that all related activities are performed in accordance with ABB policy, relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards, contractual agreements, quality standards, Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) requirements, financial targets, and schedule commitments.


Role: Project Manager


Core Responsibilities
Project Leadership

o Leads the project team, establishes the project execution approach, and oversees project hand-over, execution planning, and monitoring and control activities for internal and external resources to accomplish all project goals.

o Provides performance feedback for the resources allocated to projects.


Instructions and Guidelines

o Involves in continuous improvement and simplification.

o Supports in improving guidelines, tools, and templates.

o Ensures compliance with relevant cybersecurity regulations, standards, and contractual requirements.


Budget, Sales, and Operations Planning

o Supports local Sales and Tendering through early involvement in tenders.=


Project Execution and Control

o Ensures that the project follows execution best practices and ABB policies.

o Monitors and controls project progress effectively and efficient resource utilization.

o Monitors and controls project financials, overseeing project invoicing status, cost, expenses, and cash flow.

o Identifies, qualifies, quantifies, manages project risks, and ensures all opportunities are identified and pursued.

o Captures, analyzes, and shares lessons learned throughout the project.

o Drives the formal acceptance of the project, contract close-out, and acknowledgment by the customer, all in accordance with the contract.


Contract and Claims/ & Procurement Management

o Ensures that the project consistently applies contract and claims management in accordance with ABB policies and contractual agreements.

o Coordinates with Supply Chain Management and successfully procures required services, materials, and equipment for the project from external and internal suppliers.

o Supports Procurement and Logistics in supplier negotiations, claims, and project changes.


Stakeholder Relations

o Acts as the key contact for the customer and an escalation point for project issues.

o Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and effectively communicates with all stakeholders.


Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE)

o Ensures the project follows and complies with company HSE policies.

o Creates project HSE plans and ensures that common HSE policies and reporting are implemented across the project with all stakeholders, including collaboration/consortium partners and sub-suppliers.

o Demonstrates unique actions/initiatives to support site safety and ensures consistent HSE performance.


People Leadership and Development

o Leads the project team members to achieve project requirements, deliver contracted deliverables, and meet the committed project result.


Project Recovery

o Demonstrates and proactively applies immediate recovery actions to mitigate schedule delays and cost overruns.


Planning and Scheduling

o Defines and applies project scheduling techniques to manage schedule risks proactively to avoid possible future schedule deviations with On Time Delivery (OTD) impact.

o Applies earned value method to manage the critical path and project float to optimize the schedule.

o Forecasts schedule to determine if the project is still within defined tolerance ranges and identifies any necessary change requests to drive the closure.

o Plans and tracks all project activities, establishes scheduling risks and opportunities to deliver projects on time according to commitments to the customer and ABB.

o Demonstrates ability to guide and collaborate with a Project Planning and Control Specialist.


Document Management

o Identifies and plans all document deliverables required by the contractual scope of work and incorporates this plan into the overall project plan/schedule.

o Tracks document progress and follows up on overdue comments from customer.


License to Operate / Core Values

o Ensures all staff (under scope) understand ABB’s core values and group safety and integrity standards and act accordingly.

o Implements and ensures compliance with the ABB code of conduct, global and local standards, tools, policies, and processes related to project execution.

o Ensures adherence to all internal and statutory regulations and policies pertaining to the teams in scope.

o Ensures integrity and compliance with ABB values and ethics in all activities across all teams in scope.

o Accountable for the health and safety of all employees and contractors for the teams in scope, and continuous improvement in Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) processes and integrity performance.


Collaboration / Leadership

o Promotes and enables collaboration in the division, across divisions, business areas, and teams to maximize results for ABB.

o Provides guidance to the teams and seeks knowledge for their own development and coaching/mentoring of the teams.

o Manages relationships with stakeholders in their own area of responsibility and ensures alignment.

o Ensures that their own area of responsibility is properly organized, staffed, skilled, and directed.

o Inspires, guides, motivates, and develops direct and indirect reports within HR policies.

o Builds effective, competent, and high-performing teams.

o Reviews organizational effectiveness and performs competence assessments and continuous skill upgrades


This role is contributing to the Energy Industries Division /Power Reliability Business Line in Saudi Arabia.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading the project team, establishing the project execution approach, and overseeing planning, monitoring and control activities for internal and external resources to accomplish all project goals.
  • Monitoring and controlling project progress, efficient resource utilization, and project financials.
  • Identifying, qualifying, quantifying, managing project risk, and ensuring all opportunities are identified and pursued.
  • Driving the formal acceptance of the project, contract close-out, and acknowledgment by the customer, all in accordance with the contract.



Qualifications for the role:

  • Electrical Engineer/Electronics Engineer or equivalent.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in project management role, working as Project Manager within the oil & Gas, utilities, and other industrial market.
  • PM certification – PMP or equivalent PM certification from large MNC companies like ABB.
  • Knowledge of using Microsoft projects, SAP, and PR+ will be added advantage or having used similar enterprise resource & data management system for PM process implementation.
  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach, and strong written and spoken communication skills.
  • Project execution experiences with Saudi Arabia local regulations standards shall be an Add-on

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Bliv vores nye kollega på Samstyrken, Østervang i Varde
description:
Har du lyst til at blive en del af et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi gør os umage for borgerne og for hinanden?

Brænder du for relationsarbejde, faglig udvikling og for at skabe livskvalitet for voksne med udviklingshandicap? Og vil du være en del af et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler vores viden og tager fælles ansvar?

Er du SSA, pædagog. ergoterapeut eller omsorgsmedhjælper?

Så er det måske dig, vi mangler på holdet!

På Samstyrken, afdeling Østervang i Varde, søger vi en engageret kollega til en stilling på 37 timer om ugen. Vi er åbne for dialog om stillingen, og vi ønsker, at du starter hurtigst muligt.

Hos os bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, nærvær og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Hvem er vi?

Samstyrken, afdeling Østervang, er Varde Kommunes specialiserede botilbud for 15 voksne med varigt nedsat fysisk og/eller psykisk funktionsevne.

Vores vigtigste opgave er at skabe de bedste betingelser for, at den enkelte borger kan leve et meningsfuldt liv med høj livskvalitet, størst mulig selvbestemmelse og indflydelse på egen hverdag.

Hos os lykkes vi sammen

Vi ønsker at være en arbejdsplads, hvor vi både tager ansvar for borgernes trivsel og for hinandens arbejdsglæde. For os hænger faglighed og et godt arbejdsmiljø tæt sammen. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår, når vi bringer vores forskellige fagligheder i spil og løfter opgaven i fællesskab.

Derfor prioriterer vi:

  • Et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager fælles ansvar.
  • Høj faglighed, hvor vi er nysgerrige, reflekterende og åbne for nye perspektiver.
  • Et anerkendende arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til dialog, forskelligheder og faglig sparring.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde, hvor pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige indsatser går hånd i hånd.
  • Faglig udvikling, hvor du får mulighed for at styrke dine kompetencer gennem sparring og efteruddannelse.

Vi tænker i hele mennesker

Borgernes liv er ikke opdelt i sektorer eller fagområder. Derfor tager vi udgangspunkt i hele borgerens livssituation og har blik for sammenhængen mellem familie, arbejde, fritid, netværk, sundhed og bolig. I Samstyrken kalder vi det; helhedstænkning. Det betyder, at vi alle tager ansvar for en sammenhængende indsats, hvor borgerens behov og ønsker er i centrum.

Gennem dialog, samarbejde og koordinering deler vi viden og erfaringer, så vi bevarer den røde tråd i indsatsen. Vi samarbejder tæt med pårørende og kolleger på tværs af faggrupper og organisationen for at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for borgerens trivsel og udvikling.

Vores pædagogiske tilgang – med mennesket i centrum

I hverdagen tager vi blandt andet udgangspunkt i KRAP – Kognitiv, Ressourcefokuseret og Anerkendende Pædagogik.

Det betyder, at vi:

  • tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers mentale udvikling og forudsætninger.
  • ser og bygger videre på borgerens ressourcer og styrker.
  • møder borgerne med respekt, anerkendelse og nysgerrighed.
  • løbende reflekterer over vores praksis og søger de bedst mulige pædagogiske løsninger.

Vi er desuden optagede af neuropædagogik og sanseintegration. Vi er nysgerrige på, hvordan den enkelte borgers sanser, forudsætninger og behov påvirker hverdagen, og hvordan vores tilgang kan understøtte trivsel og livskvalitet.

Hvem håber vi, du er?

Vi søger en kollega der:

  • værdsætter holdånd og bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsfællesskab.
  • interesserer dig for relationsarbejde og for at skabe trygge, tillidsfulde relationer.
  • har lyst til at arbejde i en neuropædagogisk kontekst med fokus på sanseintegration.
  • kan arbejde struktureret med udgangspunkt i borgernes døgnrytmeplaner.
  • kan bevare overblikket og navigere i en hverdag, hvor planer og behov kan ændre sig.
  • kan planlægge og prioritere dine opgaver og samtidig være fleksibel.
  • trives med tæt dialog og samarbejde med andre faggrupper og pårørende.

Arbejdstid og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer om ugen.

Arbejdstiden varierer mellem dag- og aftenvagter samt arbejde i weekender og på helligdage. Du skal forvente weekendarbejde hver tredje weekend. Vagtplanen tilrettelægges i dialog med medarbejderne.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst. Samstyrken har røgfri arbejdstid.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsledere, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, vores faglige tilgang eller hverdagen på Østervang.

Tina Jørgensen: 20 58 70 09

Camilla Hansen: 20 54 56 37

Du kan ringe på hverdage mellem kl. 9.00 og 12.00.

Ansøgningsfrist d. 15.11.26. Ansættelsessamtalerne vil blive afholdt løbende.

Send din ansøgning elektronisk via linket i stillingsopslaget.

This application is for the February 23, 2027 Emergency Call Taker Academy.


The rate of pay for this position is $29.00 an hour.


Trainees will receive 11 weeks of paid classroom instruction followed by 13 weeks of paid, on-the-job training to prepare for live call-taking duties.


Denver's 9-1-1 Emergency Communications Agency is staffed by highly trained public safety professionals who answer emergency and non-emergency calls and coordinate the dispatch of police, fire, and emergency medical services.


Working alongside the Denver Police Department, Denver Fire Department, and Denver Paramedics, our team serves as the critical first point of contact during emergencies, helping protect everyone who lives, works, and visits the City and County of Denver.


We are seeking dependable, resilient, and service-driven individuals to join our team as 9-1-1 Emergency Call Takers. This rewarding career is ideal for those who remain calm under pressure, communicate effectively, and are committed to serving others. Every call is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference through compassion, professionalism, and teamwork.


Denver 9-1-1 operates 24/7 and relies on dedicated employees to work rotating 8–10-hour shifts, including days, nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure continuous emergency service. Employees are expected to report during inclement weather and emergency situations. This is an on-site position; remote work is not available.


Primary Communication Center: 12025 E 45th Ave, Denver, CO 80239

Back-up Communication Center: 950 Josephine St, Denver, CO 80206


Job Responsibilities will include:

  • Serving as essential personnel by responding to emergency and non-emergency calls for Police, Fire, and EMS with professionalism, composure, and empathy
  • Quickly and accurately collect, assess, and document critical information into the Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD) system
  • Determine the nature and priority of each call, initiating appropriate protocols and dispatch responses, including Emergency Medical Dispatch (EMD) when required
  • Provide lifesaving instructions and emergency triage guidance over the phone as needed
  • Manage a high volume of back-to-back calls in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while maintaining accuracy and focus
  • Operate and navigate multiple systems, including CAD, telephone, and mapping software, to ensure efficient call handling
  • Exercise sound judgment and independent decision-making under pressure to support timely emergency response

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Multitasking and Attention to Detail: Demonstrates the ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, organization, and timely performance

  • Geographical Knowledge: Familiarity with the City and County of Denver’s streets, landmarks, and locations

title: Internship - Market Research & Data | CM Navigator
description:
Want to understand what actually moves global freight markets?

A new grain season. Rising geopolitical tensions. Fuel prices moving. Port congestion. Ships suddenly heading in different directions.

What do these things have in common?

They all influence freight markets – and ultimately the USD/mt freight rates that commodity traders use every day.

At CM Navigator, you'll get to connect those dots.

You'll join our digital market intelligence business, working with research and data used by more than 100 commodity trading companies. And while Navigator will be your home base, you'll also be part of the wider Copenhagen Merchants Group – spanning brokerage, shipping, terminals, logistics, plant proteins and energy.

In other words, a pretty interesting place to learn how global trade actually works.

What you'll be doing

Your work will sit at the intersection of shipping, commodities, geopolitics and data.

You'll gradually learn how dry bulk voyages work, what they cost and why those costs change.

Your work will include:

  • Researching and maintaining the market data behind CM Navigator's freight rates

  • Following dry bulk markets, vessel movements, trade flows and freight rate developments

  • Investigating how geopolitical events, port congestion, bunker prices and other market changes affect voyage economics

  • Diving into numbers that don't add up – comparing sources, challenging assumptions and finding explanations

  • Supporting clients with questions about specific voyages, routes and freight calculations

  • Breaking down voyage costs and understanding what drives a USD/mt freight rate

  • Helping the team continuously improve research, data quality and methodology

Some days require structure and discipline. Others call for curiosity, detective work and a good commercial instinct.

Either way, your work ends up in a product used for real commercial decisions.

Who we're looking for

Got a curious brain, an analytical mindset and an interest in what makes global markets move?

You don't need to know the difference between a Panamax and a Supramax on day one. We'll teach you.

But we hope you:

  • Enjoy working with numbers, spotting patterns and figuring out why things happen

  • Follow global developments and are curious about how they affect business

  • Like asking questions, challenging assumptions and getting to the bottom of things

  • Are comfortable with Excel and interested in digital tools

  • Take responsibility for your work and enjoy getting things right

  • Like combining independent research with interaction with colleagues and clients

Experience with shipping or commodities is not required. Curiosity, analytical thinking and a willingness to learn matter much more.

And if you have a little Merchanteer in you – someone who enjoys connecting markets, people and commercial opportunities – even better.

What you'll get out of it

Real responsibility. Real market exposure. And hopefully a considerably sharper understanding of global trade.

You'll work alongside experienced freight and commodity professionals, learn how voyage economics translate into market prices and get involved in the research and client questions behind a growing digital platform.

You'll also get a look inside the wider Copenhagen Merchants universe – a Danish, family-owned group where commercial thinking, collaboration and a healthy dose of entrepreneurial spirit are part of everyday life.

We're informal, pragmatic and prefer useful work over corporate theatre.

We also have an octopus as our cultural ambassador, T.W. Heart. You don't need to understand that just yet. Most of us didn't either.

The practical bits

Location: CM Navigator, Pakhus 48, Nordhavn, Copenhagen

Period: Autumn 2027, as part of your CBS IST internship semester.

Eligibility: This internship is exclusively for students enrolled in CBS's BSc in International Shipping and Trade (IST). Applications from other programmes or institutions are not eligible for this particular opening.

Interested?

Upload your CV and a short video introduction (max. 60 seconds).

Tell us what makes you curious about freight markets, international trade and CM Navigator – and why you think we'd enjoy having you on the team.

No studio. No script. Just you.

title: Vil du være med til at give glade Anabia nogle hyggelige søndage? Brønshøj/Husum
location: Hørkær 20, 2 sal, 2730 Herlev, Danmark, 2730, Herlev, Denmark
description:
Om jobbet og Anabia

Anabia er en glad og aktiv pige på 7 år med infantil autisme, som bor i Brønshøj/Husum sammen med hendes forældre og 2 søskende. Hun elsker at synge, grine og opleve nye ting – særligt gåture, trampolin og svømmehallen!
Anabia har endnu ikke et egentligt talesprog, men kommunikerer tydeligt gennem lyde og sang og forstår meget af det, man siger til hende. Hun er nysgerrig, selvstændig og generelt rolig og nem at være sammen med.
Familien søger en hjælper, der kan give Anabia nogle hyggelige søndage med leg og oplevelser, mens forældrene får et lille pusterum.

Dine opgaver

  • At lege, hygge og tage på små ture med Anabia.
  • At støtte hende i hverdagens aktiviteter og hjælpe med bleskift ved behov.
  • At skabe tryghed og holde godt øje med hende, da hun kan finde på at gå på opdagelse på egen hånd.

Hvem er du?

Du er rolig, omsorgsfuld og ansvarsbevidst og har lyst til at give Anabia nogle sjove og trygge oplevelser. Anabia forstår både dansk og engelsk, mens hendes forældre taler engelsk. Du skal derfor kunne kommunikere på engelsk med familien.

Det praktiske

Arbejdssted: Brønshøj/Husum

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte [job.projectmanager.name] på mail [job.projectmanager.email]

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Team Lead – Energy & Engineering
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Job Description

Team Lead (MEP Design) – Energy & Engineering

About JLL

For over 200 years, JLL (NYSE: JLL), a leading global commercial real estate and investment management company, has helped clients buy, build, occupy, manage and invest in a variety of commercial, industrial, hotel, residential and retail properties. A Fortune 500® company with annual revenue of $23.4 billion and operations in over 80 countries around the world, our more than 112,000 employees bring the power of a global platform combined with local expertise. Driven by our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world, we help our clients, people and communities SEE A BRIGHTER WAYSM. JLL is the brand name, and a registered trademark, of Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated. For further information, visit

Role Overview

As a Team Lead (MEP Design) for Energy & Engineering operations, you will be responsible for leadership, development, and management of a multidisciplinary engineering team delivering projects across the Gulf region, India (APAC), and broader EMEA (Europe, Middle East & Africa) markets. You will ensure all team members adhere to project delivery standards and follow essential procedures in line with company QA/QC requirements. This role combines strategic team leadership with technical oversight of MEPF engineering projects.

The successful candidate uses discretion within set boundaries (operating procedures, processes, standards) to execute tasks and effectively delegate to team members to achieve defined deadlines and targets in the most effective and efficient way. You will coordinate activities across a multi-disciplinary environment to meet deadlines, ensure quality standards, and deliver within budget. The desirable candidate shall also be responsible for mentoring the team in technical as well as professional subjects/matters and able to identify the best talent for further future recruitment within the team as team expands.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning:

  • Collaborate with Energy and Engineering stakeholders to execute and implement a strategic roadmap for Energy and Engineering operations across the Gulf region, India (APAC), and EMEA, aligning it with JLL's Project & Development Services (PDS) overall objectives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement areas, standardization, SOPs for MEP Engineering.

Team Management:

  • Build and lead a high-performing team of design engineering professionals (8-15 direct reports), ensuring appropriate training, development, and succession planning.
  • Foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Allocate tasks, review work quality, and coordinate the daily activities of the full project delivery team across multiple MEP disciplines.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and support career development of team members, identifying training requirements and opportunities to improve productivity.
  • Plan resourcing requirements for all projects, including cost forecasts, in consultation with the stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance and on-the-job training to all members of staff whenever required.
  • Motivating Team members towards achieving higher goals towards Quality, Time and Upskilling themselves.

Process Optimization:

  • Analyze existing engineering delivery processes and systems to identify areas for optimization and implement best practices.
  • Streamline and automate workflows to enhance efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
  • Continuously monitor project performance metrics and implement corrective actions as required.
  • Implement and maintain project management best practices, processes, and tools across the team.
  • Drive operational excellence by identifying process inefficiencies and implementing improvement initiatives.

Service Delivery and Stakeholder Management:

  • Ensure timely and accurate delivery of engineering services to internal stakeholders, meeting or exceeding service level agreements.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their requirements and effectively managing expectations.
  • Represent JLL at project meetings, both internal and external, ensuring seamless project delivery across multi-region teams.

Compliance and Risk Management:

  • Stay updated on relevant legal and regulatory requirements related to engineering operations in the Gulf region, India (APAC), and EMEA.
  • Implement and maintain strong internal controls, compliance procedures, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations during design, construction, and operation.
  • Identify and mitigate potential risks, hazards, or environmental impacts associated with mechanical systems.

Quality and Operational Excellence:

  • Ensure high quality and timely delivery of Building Services Engineering Design.
  • Undertake reviews and implement proper QA/QC procedures for all projects.
  • Continuously assess and improve project delivery methodologies and strategies.

Technical Leadership and Project Delivery:

  • Perform lead engineer duties on a variety of projects, responsible for management of time and resources to effectively deliver projects.
  • Maintain financial control of projects, ensuring they are delivered at or under budget.
  • Create detailed designs, specifications, schedules and drawings for mechanical systems and equipment, considering factors such as feasibility, efficiency, safety, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Use computer-aided design (CAD / BIM) software and other tools to create and test prototypes.
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to manage projects, ensuring compliance with relevant codes & standards and local authority regulations.
  • Monitor project progress, timelines, and budgets, and provide technical guidance and support to the team.
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, procedures, manuals, and reports. Ensure accuracy, completeness, and clarity of documentation for future reference and audits.
  • Provide technical support in diagnosing and resolving MEP issues.
  • When required, oversee testing, inspection, and commissioning activities to ensure the proper functionality of MEP systems and equipment. Conduct performance tests, troubleshoot issues, and make adjustments as necessary.
  • Draw on technical knowledge and experience and information/specifications received to develop the most effective and efficient solution for less standard or routine problems with a prescribed outcome.

Requirements

Education and Professional Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or Building Services Engineering (or similar).
  • Professional license or registration such as C.Eng, P.Eng (or similar) from any International Institutions like I.MechE, CIBSE etc.

Experience:

  • 12-15 years minimum experience in MEP design engineering, with at least 5 years in a team leadership role.
  • Proven experience as an MEP Design Engineer, preferably with a focus on Gulf region projects.
  • Demonstrable experience in project cost and programme controls, including change control.

Technical Knowledge:

  • In-depth knowledge of local regulations and authority requirements, such as DM, ADM, SBC, NBC and UAE FIRE CODE.
  • In-depth knowledge of relevant international codes and standards such as NFPA, ASHRAE, UPC, IPC, BS EN, NEC, IEC etc.
  • Familiarity with relevant and latest industry software and technologies.

Software Proficiency (Essential):

  • Proficiency in BIM, Revit MEP, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Navisworks Manage, Carrier HAP, CHW Pipe sizer, MS-Office, Dialux Evo, McQuay Duct Sizer, and related engineering software.

Core Competencies:

  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and technical skills.
  • Effective communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to lead and manage projects, teams, and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects simultaneously.

What we can do for you:

At JLL, We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.

title: Lead Analytics Engineer — Build Scalable Data Solutions (Hybrid NL)
description:
Lead Analytics Engineer

Location: Netherlands (Hybrid)

Employment Type: Permanent

Overview

We are looking for a Lead Analytics Engineer to join a growing data and analytics function. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced analytics professional to shape data transformation standards, develop scalable data products, and help build a robust analytics engineering capability across a complex organisation.

You will work closely with data, analytics, and business stakeholders to transform raw data into trusted, reusable datasets that support strategic decision-making. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with leadership, mentoring, and long-term capability building.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain high-quality datasets that support reporting, analytics, and business decision-making.
  • Build scalable data models and transformation pipelines using modern analytics engineering practices.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into reliable data products.
  • Define and drive analytics engineering standards, best practices, and governance frameworks.
  • Own and evolve the technical roadmap for analytics engineering capabilities.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives focused on data quality, scalability, and operational excellence.
  • Mentor analytics engineers and support the growth of the wider data community.
  • Collaborate with engineering, analytics, and business teams to improve data accessibility and usability.

The ideal candidate would have experience in the following:

(If you do not meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.)

  • 8+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related data-focused role.
  • Strong SQL expertise and experience designing production-grade data models.
  • Proven experience with dbt in production environments.
  • Experience working with modern data stack technologies and cloud-based analytics platforms.
  • Strong understanding of DataOps principles, including version control, testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives and influencing engineering standards.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring and developing data professionals.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with Python and distributed data processing technologies.
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-driven data ownership models.
  • Experience with analytics engineering platform development or enablement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Experience driving organisational change and adoption of data best practices.

Why This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of a modern data organisation. You'll have the chance to influence technical strategy, establish best practices, and work on high-impact data initiatives that support business growth and decision-making.

Working in a collaborative and agile environment, you'll have significant ownership, opportunities to mentor others, and the ability to drive meaningful change across a growing analytics function.

If you're passionate about building scalable data solutions, setting technical direction, and enabling teams through high-quality data products, we'd love to hear from you.

title: UN Women: Programme Specialist, Women’s Economic Empowerment, Bangkok, Thailand, P3, Fixed-Term Appointment
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.

One of the key areas of concern is the economic empowerment of women. It is expressed in targets and indicators of SDG 5 (Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls) and SDG 8 (Promote inclusive and sustainable development, decent work and employment for all). Progress toward it depends not only on the adoption of a set of public policies by governments, but also on the existence of an enabling environment and active engagement of the corporate sector. This is also relevant to the achievement of SDG 1 (Poverty Reduction), SDG 10 (Reduced inequalities) and SDG 17 (Revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development).
Women’s economic empowerment in the Asia-Pacific comprises a diverse and complex portfolio, including different thematic focus areas from social protection and unpaid care to SME private sector development and very different country specific contexts from the Pacific (highly informal working with predominantly low-income women) to China (middle-income country with a strong and growing private sector and limited bilateral funding). WEE has become increasingly of relevance in the region, particularly in the wake of the pandemic and economic recovery of post-crisis countries.

Responding to the diverse contexts, the UN Women Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific WEE has been developing an overall strategic WEE that is strongly linked to the UN Women global Economic Empowerment Strategy, focuses on the key strategic priorities aligned with the SN ROAP Women’s Economic Empowerment & Migration for 2023-2025 and reflecting UN Women’s Global Gender Equality Accelerators (GEAs), namely Women in the World of Work, Transforming Care and Climate Action:
(1) Advancing Gender-Responsive Business Conduct and Creating More Decent Work Opportunities (WEPs)
(2) Accelerating Gender-Responsive Entrepreneurship for (M)SMEs (i.e. Gender-Responsive Procurement & strengthening women’s entrepreneurship)
(3) Sustainable Finance
(4) Transforming Care Systems
These thematic areas are not operating in isolation and are strongly inter-connected and under-pinned by cross-cutting principles, such as: sector-agnostic work (across the Green & Blue -, care, fintech and digital economy); embracing an intersectional and conscious social norms lens into programming, and nexus to thematic areas such as Climate Change among others.

In July 2024, UN Women in partnership with the Government of Australia Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is launching the new initiative “UN Women Gender Action Lab (GAL): Innovation and Impact for Gender Equality in Asia-Pacific, powered by the Women’s Empowerment Principles (WEPs).”

The Gender Action Lab builds on UN Women’s success generating commitment to and implementation of the Women’s Empowerment Principles (WEPs), a set of 7 principles that provide companies a roadmap to become more gender-responsive throughout their value chain. The WEPs were launched in 2010 by UN Women and the UN Global Compact and is the only framework that encompasses gender equality at all organizational levels, beginning with leadership and providing guidance for the workplace, marketplace and community, underpinned by a strong emphasis on accountability and transparent reporting of progress.

Based on the very strong foundation built through previous programmes, the UN Women’s Asia-Pacific Gender Action Lab (GAL) aims to further advance private sector and government action to accelerate gender-responsive business policies and practices in Asia-Pacific by strengthening, in particular, implementation efforts to contribute to closing the Private Sector and Government ‘Action Gap’ across the Asia and the Pacific, with a specific regional focus on ASEAN and especially in four priority countries, namely Indonesia, Philippines, and Malaysia and Cambodia. GAL will aim to incorporate an inclusive and creative problem-solving methodology to enable multi-stakeholder and innovative thinking around specific thematic areas to ideate and prototype new multi-stakeholder solutions. The programme will cover four countries: Cambodia, Indonesia, Philippines, and Malaysia. It will also have a regional component under the responsibility of UN Women Region Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP).

The key outcome is: More private sector companies in Asia - Pacific are implementing gender-responsive business practices and policies to enable more women to equitably lead and participate in the world of work.

The program will achieve this through 3 interrelated pillars:
1) Awareness, Commitments, and Capacity built on the WEPs and engagement of key stakeholders for the thematic lab
2) Multistakeholder thematic Gender Innovation labs: piloting concrete solutions with innovators and policymakers (thematic areas may include employer-supported care, disability inclusion, transparency & reporting)
3) Document Best Practices, generating and disseminating recommendations for action, and recognizing businesses through the Asia-Pacific WEPs Awards and WEPs Forum

Reporting to the Regional Programme Manager and Technical Advisor - Women’s Economic Empowerment in Asia and Pacific (P4), the Programme Specialist exercises overall responsibility for planning, implementing, and managing UN Women interventions under their portfolio. The Programme Specialist works in close collaboration with the programme and operations team, UN Women HQ staff, Government officials, multi and bi-lateral donors and civil society ensuring successful UN Women programme implementation under portfolio. In particular, the Programme Specialist will also be responsible for Programme Management of the Gender Action Lab.

Key Functions and Accountabilities:

1. Design and develop programme strategies in the area of Women’s Economic Empowerment (WEE)
• Design and formulate programme/project proposals and initiatives;
• Draft inputs to country strategy documents, briefs, policy dialogue and other documents related to Women’s Economic Empowerment and specifically to advance gender-responsive business conduct through implementation of the Women’s Empowerment Principles (WEPs).

2. Manage the implementation and management of WEE programmes, including the Women’s Empowerment Principles (WEPs) and the UN Women Innovation Platform - Gender Action Lab
• Finalize the annual workplan and budget and manage their implementation;
• Manage the technical implementation of the programme/project; ensure synergies with other teams;
• Manage the submission of implementing partner financial and narrative reports;
• Provide guidance to personnel and partners on Results Based Management tools and performance indicators;
• Organize Project Steering Committee, project review and/or evaluation meetings, as needed.

3. Manage technical assistance and capacity development to project/programme partners, especially the Gender Action Lab
• Manage the implementation of technical advice and guidance. Develop and implement technical tools, and initiatives
• Build and manage relationships with national partners to support implementation and expansion of the WEE programme, especially the WEPs; respond to any potential problems;
• Identify capacity building needs of partners and lead the coordination of technical assistance, mentoring, training and capacity development initiatives to partners.

4. Manage the monitoring and reporting of the programme, especially the Gender Action Lab
• Manage the monitoring of programme/ project implementation and finances using results-based management tools;
• Undertake field missions and review reports on monitoring missions;
• Write quarterly reports and donor reports, focusing on results, output and outcomes;
• Contribute to office donor and UN Women reports.

5. Manage the people and financial resources of the programme, especially the Gender Action Lab
• Manage the programme budget and draft financial reports;
• Supervise Programme Analysts and Technical Specialists or consultants; Mentor and coach personnel and conduct performance assessments;
• Oversee recruitment processes, as necessary.

6. Build partnerships and support in developing resource mobilization strategies
• Develop and implement partnerships and resource mobilization strategies;
• Finalize relevant documentation on donors and potential opportunities for resource mobilization;
• Analyze and research information on donors, prepare substantive briefs on possible areas of cooperation, identification of opportunities for cost sharing.

7. Contribute to inter-agency coordination on Women’s Economic Empowerment to achieve coherence and alignment of UN Women programmes with other partners across the region
• Provide technical support to the Regional Lead, WEE & Migration on inter-agency coordination related activities by attending meetings, events, and participating in groups and committees as needed;
• Coordinate with other UN agencies, government departments, donors and NGOs to ensure the projects’ capacity development programme is harmonized and aligned with other in-country efforts.

8. Manage advocacy, knowledge building and communication efforts, especially for the Gender Action Lab
• Develop and review background documents, briefs and presentations related to WEE
• Represent UN Women in meetings and policy dialogues on issues related to WEE as necessary;
• Develop advocacy strategies and oversee their implementation based on global normative standards and instruments on women's economic empowerment and associated UN Women research and evidence
• Identify best practices and lessons learned to guide programme improvement and strategy planning;
• Develop knowledge management strategies, products and methodologies on women’s economic empowerment

9. The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation.

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: The incumbent will supervise up to 10 affiliate personnel (SC, consultants and interns) at the Regional Office with possibility to supervise project staff based in countries where the programme is implementing e.g. Philippines, Cambodia and Indonesia.

Competencies :

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

• Strong programme formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation skills
• Strong knowledge of Results-Based Management
• Ability to synthesize program performance data and produce analytical reports to inform management and strategic decision-making
• Strong knowledge of Women’s Economic Empowerment

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Role Overview

The Shift Engineer is the on-ground senior resource for the Airoli facility during each shift, holding end-to-end operational responsibility for electrical and mechanical infrastructure. The role operates critical systems including in-house substation, transformers, UPS, HVAC, and fire systems per laid-down SOPs and EOPs, while coordinating with multiple internal teams, vendors, and OEMs. Beyond technical operations, the Shift Engineer owns shift-level governance: ensuring continuity of critical operations across shift handovers, driving timely escalation and incident response, and maintaining the documentation and compliance discipline required to support audits, SLA tracking, and leadership reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Critical Infrastructure Operations

  • Operate and maintain critical infrastructure including in-house substation, transformers, UPS, PAC, PAHU, FWU, HT/LT panels, chiller system, BMS, CPM, EMPS, and SCADA systems.
  • Operate electrical and mechanical setups per laid-down SOP and EOP.
  • Apply working knowledge of HVAC systems, with exposure to precision air conditioning operations.
  • Apply knowledge of DG set operations.
  • Apply knowledge of HT installation operations (11 kV–220 kV); authorized to work on Hi-Tension installations.
  • Monitor and maintain fire detection and fire suppression systems.
  • Apply working knowledge of BMS, safety, and security systems.

Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

  • Coordinate on-ground operations with multiple internal teams throughout the shift.
  • Coordinate with vendors and OEMs for incident management, preventive maintenance tracking, and supervision of maintenance activity.
  • Prepare PM schedules for utility equipment and apply preventive and breakdown maintenance procedures.
  • Log all maintenance activity and utilize CMMS (ServiceNow or equivalent) for operational tracking.
  • Support energy management of electrical systems such as transformers and UPS, and analyze equipment performance to support operational reliability.

Shift Governance & Continuity

  • Act as the single point of operational accountability for the facility during the assigned shift.
  • Conduct structured shift handovers, documenting open issues, ongoing work, and pending approvals for the incoming shift.
  • Ensure continuity of critical operations across shift transitions with no gaps in coverage or awareness.
  • Maintain real-time visibility of all active maintenance, incidents, and vendor activity on-site.

Incident & Emergency Response

  • Act as first responder to onsite emergencies, directing immediate corrective action.
  • Escalate issues to external facility contractors, OEMs, and relevant stakeholders per defined escalation protocols.
  • Prepare incident reports with root-cause detail and ensure timely closure tracking.
  • Raise approval requests to management for procurement of goods/services required during the shift.

Compliance & Reporting

  • Maintain records required to support internal and external audits, in line with statutory requirements for the site.
  • Apply knowledge of compliance processes for relevant ISO certifications (QMS, ITSM, ISMS, BCMS, EnMS, EMS, OHSE).
  • Coordinate effectively with internal teams and external customers, ensuring accurate and timely communication during both routine operations and emergencies.
  • Contribute shift-level data and observations to support leadership reporting, SLA/KPI tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

  • Graduate engineer in Electrical or Mechanical stream with 2–3 years' experience; OR Diploma engineer with 3–5 years' experience; OR ITI candidate with 8–10 years' experience, with strong experience in the electrical and mechanical field.
  • Adequate exposure to Data Center or telecom equipment-related facility infrastructure.
  • Experience handling large facilities with in-house substations and critical infrastructure.
  • Authorized to work on Hi-Tension installations.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Computer literacy, with working knowledge of CMMS (ServiceNow or equivalent).
  • Ability to work rotational shift duty, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Sound judgment and composure to act as the lead operational authority during emergencies and high-pressure situations.

48

description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Field-based: Work is conducted on-site at customer locations.

Job Summary

The Project Engineer – Data Centre Cooling / HVAC / Chiller Systems is responsible for supporting the execution and delivery of mission-critical cooling infrastructure projects in data centres. The role focuses on engineering coordination, site execution, technical review, installation supervision, testing, commissioning support, and documentation for HVAC, chiller, and cooling system projects. The position works closely with project managers, design teams, vendors, contractors, and customers to ensure safe, timely, and quality delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support execution of data centre cooling, HVAC, and chiller projects from engineering review through commissioning and handover.
  • Review mechanical and HVAC drawings, P&IDs, layouts, BOQs, technical submittals, and vendor documents.
  • Coordinate site activities related to chillers, CRAH/CRAC/CDU/FAN WALL units, chilled water piping, pumps, valves, AHUs, heat exchangers, controls, and associated auxiliaries.
  • Monitor installation progress and ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and project schedules.
  • Assist in planning and coordinating material delivery, equipment installation, site readiness, and contractor activities.
  • Supervise mechanical/HVAC works at site and ensure compliance with quality, safety, and project standards.
  • Support testing activities such as pressure testing, flushing, leak testing, balancing, and pre-commissioning checks.
  • Coordinate commissioning activities for chillers, pumps, cooling equipment, control systems, and integrated HVAC systems.
  • Work with BMS/controls teams to ensure proper integration, point checks, alarms, trends, and sequence validation.
  • Identify technical issues, installation gaps, and site constraints, and escalate them with recommended solutions.
  • Maintain daily/weekly site progress records, engineering trackers, snag lists, and issue logs.
  • Support preparation of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, commissioning records, and final handover documentation.
  • Coordinate with procurement, vendors, OEMs, contractors, consultants, and operations teams for timely issue resolution.
  • Ensure execution in live or critical data centre environments is carefully controlled to minimize operational risk.

Key Deliverables

  • Engineering and site progress reports
  • Material and equipment tracking logs
  • Technical submittal review comments
  • Installation quality checklists
  • Testing and commissioning records
  • Snag/punch list tracker
  • As-built documentation
  • O&M manual inputs

Handover dossiers and closure documents

title: WVV Area Development Program Finance Officer
description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Employee Contract Type:

Local - Fixed Term Employee (Fixed Term)

Job Description:

Financial Compliance (40%)

  • Provide financial and administrative support to the ADP/Project to ensure a high level of fraud-risk awareness, compliance, quality, accuracy, and consistency in financial management and project implementation.
  • Work closely with ADP/Project team members and provide guidance on account codes, preparation of cash advances, Employee Expense Report (EER), and payment requests.
  • Carry out day-to-day financial procedures related to planning, implementation, monitoring, evaluation, project closure, and audits in a timely manner and in compliance with World Vision policies, donor requirements, procedures, and the Finance Manual (FM).
  • Ensure that all financial activities comply with World Vision policies, donor compliance requirements, and relevant local regulations.
  • Review supporting documents for payments and prepare vouchers (using the Voucher Interface) to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with World Vision policies and donor requirements.
  • Monitor financial transactions regularly to ensure project financial records are accurate, up-to-date, and properly maintained.
  • Conduct regular field visits and participate in program activity monitoring at community level to verify the accuracy, transparency, and compliance of related financial activities, transactions, supporting documents, and asset utilization.
  • Work closely with ADP/Project staff, community groups, and partners to ensure financial procedures are properly followed during implementation and community-based activities.
  • Conduct random checks on quotations, goods, and services, including occasional visits to project sites when necessary, to ensure transparency andcost efficiency.
  • Support building capacity for ADP/Project staff and partners on relevant World Vision financial policies and procedures.
  • Support the timely resolution of audit findings and follow-up actions to address identified compliance and financial control gaps.
  • Provide support to other ADPs/Projects when required through cross-reviews, and cross-audits.
  • Provide timely feedback and recommendations to the Finance Manager and ADP Manager to support continuous improvement of WVIV’s financial management systems and practices and ensure effective financial oversight and risk management.

Budget Management and Financial Reports (35%)

  • Assist the ADP or Project Manager in planning and developing ADP/project budgets in alignment with the ADP/Project Plan of Action and logframe.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports in a timely manner, including:

- Preparing high-quality Voucher Interface data.

- Ensuring the accuracy of the project’s core combined logframe report from the SunSystem.

- Preparing monthly/quarterly variance analysis and explanations for items of financial reports

- Updating and maintaining the asset register.

  • Review and verify financial reports generated from the SunSystem to identify any non-project-related expenses, discrepancies, or irregularities in accordance with the Finance Manual.
  • Monitor project spending trends and regularly update the ADP/Project Manager on the financial status to help prevent risks of ineffective spending, over-expenditure, or under-utilization of the project budget
  • Support budget revisions and realignments as required to ensure effective financial management.
  • Monitor and follow up the myPbas database to ensure the commitment or no discrepancy between the Project and myPbas budget.

Data analysis and additional funding acquisition (10%)

  • Conduct financial data analysis and provide forecasts to support the ADP/Project Manager in making informed decisions and managing financial risks effectively.
  • Support resource mobilization efforts by contributing to the preparation of quality project budgets for new proposals and funding opportunities.

System, financial administration and other responsibilities (10%)

  • Establish and maintain a systematic filing system for key documents (both hard and soft copies) in compliance with World Vision standards and audit requirements.
  • Maintain all financial and relevant administrative records required for internal and external audits, and provide support during audits of the ADP or Project.
  • Provide financial administration and documentation support to the ADP/Project Manager to ensure proper financial management and record-keeping of ADP activities.
  • Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of data entry and appropriate coding in Sun System and other financial management systems.
  • Support staff in using financial templates and systems.

Others (5%) - Perform other tasks assigned by the manager to contribute to the team performance


KNOWLEDGE/QUALIFICATION FOR ROLE:

  • At least 2–3 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, or financial management, preferably in NGOs, development projects, or international organizations.
  • Experience in budget planning, financial reporting, and financial compliance.
  • Experience working with financial systems or accounting software (e.g., SunSystem or similar accounting platforms) is an advantage.
  • Experience supporting audits, financial monitoring, and documentation management.
  • Experience working with donor-funded projects and multiple funding sources (e.g., grants, sponsorship, or private funding) is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with program teams and provide financial guidance to non-finance staff.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Motorbike driving licence

title: Senior Compliance Specialist - Investigator
description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior Compliance Specialist – Investigator supports the team responsible for developing and executing the overall strategy for internal compliance investigations. In this role, the Compliance Investigator leads investigations involving a wide range of alleged violations of law or GE Aerospace policy.

Working closely with stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, HR, and other functions, the investigator handles concerns raised through the open reporting system and conducts investigations in a thorough, fair, and objective manner. This individual must be a self-starter with the ability to manage a large and varied caseload simultaneously, work independently with minimal supervision, and maintain strong attention to detail.

The role also requires excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively within a team and engage confidently with senior business and functional leaders across the organization.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead and conduct independent investigations
  • Carry out prompt, thorough, and objective investigations into alleged violations of law or company policy. Cases may involve any of GE Aerospace’s Spirit & Letter policies. For example, matters may concern complex questions involving respectful workplace, finance, conflict of interest, quality, sourcing, EHS, information technology and security, intellectual property, improper payments, competition law, and more
  • Review and assess complaints and allegations and be able to develop and manage investigate plans and strategies
  • Conduct concern raiser, witness, and subject interviews
  • Conduct investigative research: including review and analyze all reliable and relevant information (i.e. emails, data files, invoices) including performing forensic analysis and reviewing GE Aerospace policies & procedures
  • Provide oral briefings to senior leadership and functional owners on cases, and identify appropriate corrective actions
  • Draft reports to ensure investigations are clearly and properly documented
  • Maintain client relationships in the face of conflicting demands or directions and provide evidence-based conclusion and recommendation on sound diagnosis and information
  • Know and understand all applicable legal and policy requirements pertaining to the conduct of investigations including in areas involving employee interviews, data privacy, labor and employment requirements, and more; monitor changes in such laws and policies and provide guidance to colleagues with respect to such changes

Required Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 10 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 12 years of professional experience
  • Minimum 6 years of professional experience in conducting workplace investigations
  • Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience
  • Eligibility Requirement: Legal authorization to work in the US is required.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Law degree, postgraduate degree in business or another relevant field, or equivalent experience in audit or quality
  • At least 7 years of experience in Compliance, Law, Audit, Quality, Human Resources, or a related field
  • Strong analytical and evaluative skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to think clearly and respond effectively under pressure, balance multiple competing interests, and share lessons learned with teammates
  • Proven ability to prepare, present, and discuss findings and recommendations with senior leaders, and to produce clear, concise, and compelling reports
  • Demonstrated problem-solving ability and sound judgment
  • Fluency in English required; additional language skills are a plus

The base pay range for this position is $155,000 - $206,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 20th, 2026.

title: Lead Cloud Data Engineer
description:
Lead Cloud Data Engineer

Panera Bread is more than just a bakery-café; it’s a digital leader reshaping the quick-service restaurant industry. With over half of our sales generated through digital channels, Panera has led innovations like Rapid Pick-Up®, drive-thru ordering, geofencing for mobile pickup, and personalized loyalty programs. We’re transforming and building best-in-class omnichannel dining at scale, merging hospitality with advanced technology to deliver seamless experiences for millions of guests each week. A visionary technology leader ready to design systems that handle billions of transactions, lead top-performing teams, and shape the future of digital dining, Panera offers the opportunity to make a significant industry impact. Join us & help revolutionize & transform the way world experiences food.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Lead Cloud Data Engineer to lead the design, development, delivery, and operational excellence of our enterprise data platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role serves as a critical bridge between enterprise architecture and solution delivery, translating strategic data architecture into scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready data solutions that support both operational and analytical business needs. The successful candidate will provide hands‑on development support, technical leadership across the full data lifecycle, including data ingestion, integration, streaming, transformation, orchestration, governance, retention and production operations. Combining deep technical expertise with strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, this individual will lead a team of data engineers, establish engineering best practices, drive delivery excellence, and ensure the performance, scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency of enterprise data solutions.

As a data engineer, you will partner closely with architects, product owners, business stakeholders, and platform engineering teams to deliver high‑impact data products and capabilities that enable strategic business outcomes. The role requires exceptional problem‑solving skills, a passion for engineering excellence, and a proven ability to drive architectural consistency, code quality, automation, and operational maturity across the data ecosystem. The ideal candidate will also stay at the forefront of emerging AI, Generative AI, and agentic technologies, identifying opportunities to improve engineering productivity, automation, data quality, and overall platform efficiency.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test and deploy large scale enterprise data engineering pipelines and data processing ETL/ELT routines in Google Cloud data platform

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

  • Drive the design, development, and deployment of scalable batch, real-time, and streaming data pipelines aligned with enterprise architecture standards, cloud well‑architected principles, and business objectives.

  • Translate enterprise data architecture patterns into practical, secure, scalable, and production‑ready solutions that support operational, analytical, and data product workloads.

  • Establish, enforce, and continuously improve engineering best practices, including solution design reviews, code reviews, reusable frameworks and design patterns, modular development, testing standards, CI/CD practices, release management and deployment governance.

  • Design and implement enterprise workflow orchestration, scheduling, and automation solutions to enable reliable, efficient, and resilient data processing across the data ecosystem.

  • Define and promote reusable architectural patterns, frameworks, and standards that improve solution consistency, maintainability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

  • Ensure all solutions adhere to enterprise data governance, data quality, security, privacy‑by‑design, regulatory compliance, and Data‑as‑a‑Product principles.

  • Drive the evaluation, adoption, and implementation of emerging technologies that create measurable business value and improve the effectiveness of the data engineering platform.

  • Own and lead production operations, including release management, monitoring, observability, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner closely with support and operations teams to ensure platform stability, reliability, resiliency, and compliance with enterprise change management and operational processes.

  • Collaborate with enterprise architects, product owners, business analysts, BI developers, data engineers and cross‑functional stakeholders to align data engineering solutions with business priorities, governance requirements, and data product delivery goals.

  • Optimize platform performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency through effective use of cloud‑native technologies, automation, and engineering best practices.

  • Evaluate and leverage emerging AI, Generative AI, and agentic AI capabilities to enhance data engineering productivity, automate operational processes, improve data quality and data cataloging, and accelerate data solution delivery.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, MIS, or related field (Master’s preferred).

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform development, and cloud‑based data solutions, including demonstrated technical leadership, & team mentoring responsibilities.

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience designing, building, and delivering large‑scale enterprise data platforms and pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar.

  • 4+ years of hands‑on experience with BigQuery, including SQLroutines performance tuning, query optimization, workload management, partitioning, clustering, materialized views, and query optimization.

  • 4+ years of hands‑on experience with Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Managed Apache Spark), Python, PySpark, SQL, and Pandas for large‑scale batch, streaming and real‑time data processing.

  • Proven experience managing cloud infrastructure consumption, capacity planning, environment provisioning, and cloud cost optimization, including reservation and usage optimization strategies.

  • Deep expertise with Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Datastore, DataStream (CDC), Pub/Sub, and event‑driven architectures supporting operational, analytical, real‑time, and streaming data integration.

  • Hands‑on experience with Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Compute Engine, App Engine and serverless computing architectures supporting batch, real‑time, and streaming data processing solutions.

  • Advanced experience designing and implementing workflow orchestration and automation solutions using Cloud Composer (Managed Airflow DAG), Cloud Workflows, Cloud Scheduler, and serverless execution frameworks.

  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices using Terraform Cloud and GitLab.

  • Demonstrated experience implementing Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, Master and Reference Data Management, and Data‑as‑a‑Product principles within enterprise data ecosystems.

  • Experience working with enterprise data ecosystems and related technologies, including Oracle EDW, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Power BI, and Looker.

  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges in large‑scale, production‑grade environments.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and business teams and effectively communicate complex concepts with diverse audiences.

  • Working knowledge of cloud security, networking, and governance, including IAM, VPC networking, firewall management, observability, logging, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Dataplex (Knowledge Catalog), and enterprise data catalog’ing practices.

  • Working knowledge of AI and agentic development capabilities, including Vertex AI, Google Gemini Enterprise, Agent Studio, Model Garden, Agent Development Kit (ADK), and MCP integrations a plus.

Working Conditions

Hybrid work environment with onsite presence required in Newton MA/or St Louis, MO

Physical Requirements

Regularly required to sit, stand, talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate keyboards and devices.

Direct Reports

No. Train and Mentor Junior engineers, and contract workers

Competitive salary $127,461 - $163,660 annually.

The actual pay offered will be determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, job-related knowledge, skills, and geographical location. Individual compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

Archiving Technology entwickelt und betreibt technologische Lösungen für die Archivierung innerhalb der Deutschen Bank.   • Sie gestalten den Einsatz von KI und Machine Learning innerhalb unserer Lösungen, bewerten technische Ansätze und stellen gemeinsam mit Entwicklung und DevOps deren sichere, zuverlässige und nachhaltige Integration in die Gesamtarchitektur und den Betrieb sicher
  • Sie treffen wesentliche Architekturentscheidungen, bewerten technische Lösungsalternativen und berücksichtigen dabei Geschäftsprozesse, Informationssicherheit sowie regulatorische und technische Anforderungen
  • Sie arbeiten eng mit Softwareentwicklung, Architektur, DevOps und Produktverantwortlichen zusammen, entwickeln gemeinsam Lösungen für komplexe technische Herausforderungen und optimieren kontinuierlich Architektur, Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse


Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
