title: Teamleder til voksenområdet i Aarhus – stærk kliniker med lyst til ledelse
description:
Vil du kombinere klinisk arbejde med ledelse og sætte en tydelig faglig retning? Vi søger en psykolog eller læge med solid klinisk ekspertise inden for voksenpsykiatri, ledelseserfaring og et oprigtigt ønske om at lede. Som teamleder på Hejmdal Privathospital i Aarhus bliver du spillende træner og et fagligt flagskib for et tværfagligt team af psykologer, speciallæger og sygeplejersker.

Spillende træner med fagligt og ledelsesmæssigt ansvar

Du er tæt på både patienterne og medarbejdernes hverdag. Du deltager selv i udredning og/eller behandling inden for dine kompetenceområder og omsætter din kliniske erfaring til faglig sparring, fælles læring og høj kvalitet i patientforløbene. Samtidig tager du ansvar for den daglige ledelse og skaber tydelige rammer, hvor medarbejderne har tillid, handlerum og mulighed for at udvikle sig.

Dine primære opgaver er at:

  • Deltage i det kliniske arbejde med udredning og behandling af voksne.
  • Sætte faglig retning, lede konferencer og understøtte mono- og tværfaglig sparring.
  • Varetage daglig personaleledelse, herunder medarbejderopfølgning, udviklingssamtaler, trivsel, sygefravær og rekruttering.
  • Sikre overblik over kapacitet og kalendere og bidrage til en velfungerende drift.
  • Bidrage til afdelingens udvikling i tæt samarbejde med klinikchefen og din teamlederkollega på B&U området.

Vi søger dig, der kan og vil lede

Du er psykolog eller læge med solid erfaring med psykiatrisk udredning og behandling af voksne. Du har ledelseserfaring og vælger ledelse til, fordi du motiveres af at udvikle mennesker, skabe retning og tage ansvar for helheden. Din faglige tyngde gør dig til en kvalificeret sparringspartner, og du bringer den i spil med både tydelighed og ydmyghed over for andres kompetencer.

Du kommunikerer ordentligt og klart, træffer beslutninger og følger op. Du kan balancere faglig kvalitet, medarbejdertrivsel og daglig drift og værdsætter et samarbejde, hvor vi bruger hinandens fagligheder og tager fælles ansvar for patienternes forløb.

Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab – også for dig som leder

Du bliver en del af et engageret miljø med høje faglige ambitioner, kollegial støtte og plads til humor. Vi prioriterer sparring, løbende udvikling og et trygt arbejdsmiljø. Som leder får du støtte fra klinikchefen, HR og Hejmdals tværgående lederfællesskab – og mulighed for at præge både din egen rolle og udviklingen af voksenområdet i Aarhus.

Hos Hejmdal ønsker vi at skabe et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv med fleksible rammer og plads til forskellige behov og erfaringsniveauer. Du får mulighed for at fastholde og udvikle din kliniske faglighed, samtidig med at du udfolder dit lederskab.

Om Hejmdal Privathospital

Hejmdal Privathospital har afdelinger i Aalborg, Aarhus, Odense og på Frederiksberg. Vi er et tværfagligt fællesskab af psykologer, sygeplejersker, speciallæger og administrativt personale, som sammen leverer psykiatrisk udredning og behandling til børn, unge og voksne. Vores tilgang bygger på faglighed, ordentlighed og medmenneskelighed – med ambitionen om at hjælpe flest muligt bedst muligt.

Praktisk information

  • Arbejdstid: Som udgangspunkt 37 timer om ugen. Andre ønsker kan drøftes.
  • Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt.
  • Ansøgning: Vi læser ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende.
  • Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte klinikchef Birgitte Rosenkilde på tlf.: 93894135

title: Consultancy on Communications for the EU 4 Gender Equality Programme (Phase III) EECA Region
description:
Job Purpose:

The purpose of this consultancy is to lead the development and implementation of communication, outreach, advocacy and visibility activities under the third phase of the “EU 4 Gender Equality: Together against gender-stereotypes and gender-based violence” joint programme, funded by the European Union and implemented jointly by UNFPA and UN Women.

The programme, running from July 2026 to December 2029, aims to advance gender equality and women’s empowerment in Armenia, Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine. Building on the achievements and lessons learned from previous phases, it focuses on transforming discriminatory social and gender norms, preventing gender-based violence, expanding women’s economic opportunities and strengthening gender-responsive policies and practices.

The consultant will support the programme’s strategic communications and visibility efforts by developing compelling content, coordinating communication campaigns and ensuring consistent messaging and donor visibility across regional and country-level activities.

The consultancy will contribute to raising awareness of programme results, promoting positive narratives on gender equality and strengthening engagement with diverse audiences, including civil society, media, creative industries and other relevant stakeholders.

You would be responsible for:

Under the direct supervision of the EU4GE Regional Project Manager, the consultant will:

  • Oversee the implementation of the programme’s communication and visibility plan and update it as necessary to ensure consistent messaging, visual identity and donor visibility.
  • Review, edit and provide quality assurance for communication and visibility products developed by Country Offices and consultants, ensuring accuracy, consistency, quality and compliance with programme messaging and donor visibility requirements.
  • Develop creative communication concepts, campaigns and storytelling approaches to communicate programme activities, achievements and results to diverse audiences.
  • Produce inspirational stories highlighting programme results at the regional level, including web stories and multimedia products such as photographs, quote cards, videos, newsletters and other digital content.
  • Develop communication and advocacy materials, including briefing materials, press releases, feature articles, newsletters and other visibility products, and coordinate their dissemination through appropriate channels.
  • Coordinate the production of multimedia content, including infographics, videos, photographs and other digital assets.
  • Ensure visibility of successful programme initiatives, results, events and campaigns across UNFPA and UN Women national, regional and global communication platforms, including management of the programme’s regional social media channels.
  • Monitor and analyse print, broadcast and social media coverage related to the programme.
  • Support the design and implementation of communication campaigns, advocacy initiatives and special events.
  • Provide guidance to Country Offices and partners on the application of programme communication protocols, visual identity standards and European Union donor visibility requirements.
  • Coordinate the EU approval process for communication and visibility materials developed under the programme, serving as the focal point for EUDIGITOOL. Provide technical support to Country Office colleagues on approval procedures, manage relevant platform access and facilitate the resolution of EU comments and feedback.
  • Support the recruitment of communications-related consultants, including designers, editors, illustrators and videographers, as needed, and assist with related procurement and payment processes.
  • Lead the engagement and supervision of video producers and other communication specialists responsible for developing audiovisual and communication materials.
  • Identify strategic communication opportunities, partnerships, activities and platforms to maximise programme visibility and outreach.
  • Develop concepts for regional communication and advocacy events and oversee their implementation.
  • Facilitate interviews with programme partners, beneficiaries and personnel to support communication and storytelling activities.
  • Prepare talking points, speeches and other messaging materials for programme representatives and senior management.
  • Collaborate closely with UNFPA and UN Women communications colleagues at regional and country levels to ensure alignment with corporate communication policies, messaging and initiatives.
  • Identify, document and share communication best practices and lessons learned from Country Offices, facilitating the exchange of communication products and information.
  • Deliver training sessions and workshops on communication, visibility and advocacy, as appropriate.
  • Collect, consolidate and edit communication and visibility inputs from Country Offices for donor reports, publications and other corporate reporting requirements.

Duration and working schedule:

  • The consultancy will be for 11 months, with the possibility of extension, on a full-time basis.
  • The consultant will be remunerated based on a monthly fee rate, subject to the submission of completed attendance sheets and progress reports and the acceptance of deliverables.

Place where services are to be delivered:

  • Remote / Home-based.

Delivery dates and how work will be delivered (e.g. electronic, hard copy etc.):

The consultant will deliver the assigned work electronically, via email and online platforms, in accordance with deadlines agreed in advance with the supervisor.

The consultancy will involve the development and delivery of communication and visibility products, including:

  • Implementation and regular updating of the programme communication and visibility plan.
  • Communication and advocacy materials, including web stories, press releases, articles, newsletters and multimedia products.
  • Communication campaigns and visibility activities highlighting programme results.
  • Quality-assured communication materials compliant with EU donor visibility requirements.
  • Coordination of communication materials submitted through EUDIGITOOL for EU approval.
  • Communication support for regional events, campaigns and advocacy initiatives.
  • Communication inputs for donor reporting and other programme publications.
  • Brief monthly progress reports outlining completed activities and deliverables.

Specific milestones and deadlines will be agreed with the EU4GE Regional Project Manager.

Monitoring and Progress Control:

  • The supervisor will establish milestones and deadlines and monitor the consultant’s progress on an ongoing basis.
  • The consultant will participate in regular coordination meetings with the EU4GE Project Manager, programme staff, UNFPA and UN Women Regional Communications Teams, and relevant Country Office teams.
  • Payment will be made monthly upon submission of the attendance certificate and acceptance of brief monthly progress reports detailing implemented activities and deliverables by the EU4GE Project Manager.

Supervisory Arrangements:

  • The consultant will work under the direct supervision and overall guidance of the EU4GE Regional Project Manager.
  • The consultant will collaborate closely with UNFPA and UN Women teams at regional and country levels to ensure effective implementation of the programme’s communication and visibility activities.

Expected Travel:

  • Travel may be required. When needed, travel costs will be covered separately.

Qualifications and Experience:

Education:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in communications, journalism, public relations, social sciences, international relations or a relevant field.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in communications, advocacy and/or public relations.
  • Experience working on gender equality and women’s empowerment.
  • Outstanding oral and written communication and editorial skills, with demonstrated ability to produce communication products and content for online platforms and social media.
  • Experience developing high-quality written content for online and traditional communication materials.
  • Experience within the UN system, particularly with UN Women and/or UNFPA, is an asset.
  • Experience providing communications support for online and offline events is an asset.
  • Computer literacy and the ability to effectively use office technology, IT tools, the internet and email.

Language:

  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
  • Knowledge of Russian is an asset.

Required Competencies:

Values:

  • Exemplifying integrity,
  • Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,
  • Embracing cultural diversity,
  • Embracing change


Core Competencies:

  • Achieving results,
  • Being accountable,
  • Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,
  • Thinking analytically and strategically,
  • Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

description:

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

The Site Lead/Site Services Manager is responsible for leading a team providing excellent customer service and creating exceptional experience for all client staff, their guests and vendors partners who are their business partners. The Site Lead must be able to effectively communicate information verbally regarding the building, the office and its facilities, and facilities in and around the area. Additionally, it is the responsibility of the Site Lead to maintain the cleanliness, comfort, safety, and overall appearance of their assigned building/office to the highest standards, either through self-performance or vendors. The Individual must be able to offer assistance to all staff at this site. The expression “Going above and beyond” is a normal operating standard for this position. The Individual will perform any other tasks that may be assigned to them which is related but not exclusive to customer service, hospitality and experience, finance and admin, project coordination, the broad spectrum of facilities & building management and operations (hard and soft services, transport and waste management, etc.), space planning, event management and any others that may fall within the scope mentioned.

In general, the tasks include but are not exclusive to the following:

Site Operations Management

  • Assist Supervisor/Manager to deliver services in accordance with client KPIs and SLA
  • Develop, implement and maintain building procedures and performance measures to ensure simplification and accuracy of work methods and reliability of systems
  • Always ensure adequate supply of materials for the proper operation of the buildings and management of services
  • Co-ordinate with Building Managers and the Business Units on projects, building/office and operation issues, working closely together to derive at a holistic solution which includes immediate short-term as well as long term fixes
  • Manage a program of scheduled inspections for the property to ensure correct building operations, energy conservation, safety and cleanliness is upheld
  • Manage of Preventive and Planned Maintenance programme to minimize maintenance, repair, risk of equipment failure and replacement costs
  • 24/7 emergency call support and site attendance
  • Recommend continuous quality improvement practices and implement Best Practice operations
  • Ensure all Critical Environment (CEM) requirements are met (secondary)
  • Ensure all Reactive Maintenance is completed as per the agreed timeframes, and the relevant communication is first broadcast to the general population or stakeholders, whichever is the standard operating procedure
  • Review existing operations/dashboard regularly to reduce costs and improve operational standards
  • Manage space planning and optimization including office layouts, workspace configuration, and renovation projects to support evolving business needs and hybrid work models, ensuring quality delivery within budget and timeline parameters

title: Research Specialist
description:
Job Profile:

Lab and Research Specialist 2

Job Family:

Lab and Research Support

Time Type:

Full time

Apply before 11:59 PM Arizona time the day before the posted End Date.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree and three (3) years of experience appropriate to the area of assignment/field; OR, Any equivalent combination of experience and/or training from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.

Job Profile Summary:
Provides technical lab support by independently performing basic lab and research-related tasks to ensure accurate research results that can expand on the knowledge of the field of study. Responsible for following lab safety standards.

Job Description:

Position Salary Range: $55,000 - $65,000 per year; DOE


Job Description:


As a Research Specialist, you will provide experimental and instrumental support to users requesting services from Eyring Materials Center with expertise on assigned processing and synthesis equipment, analytical techniques, as well as data analysis and interpretation when applicable. You will also be responsible for maintaining and/or coordinating maintenance on the assigned equipment and techniques. The broad range of materials being synthesized and analyzed includes semiconductors, ceramics, glasses, alloys, geological samples and a wide range of inorganic, organic, and hybrid materials.


Essential Duties:

  • Furnace lab and chemistry support:
    • Primary contact for all high-temperature synthesis and processing requests within EMC
    • Operating and supervising synthesis and processing using graphite-, tungsten-, molybdenum disilicide-, silicon carbide-, and Kanthal®-element furnaces under vacuum, reducing, oxidizing, or inert conditions (as appropriate for element type).
    • Using and maintaining glass high-vacuum manifolds and Schlenk lines for synthesis, processing, and transfer of air-sensitive materials including sealing ampoules using oxyhydrogen and oxyacetylene torches.
    • Planning, execution, and optimization of complex chemical reactions under a variety of conditions (high temperatures, high pressures, reactive atmospheres, etc.) to create novel compounds or to scale up production of existing materials.
    • Effectively assessing risks to safety and property, collaborating with local safety experts, and implementing appropriate engineering and process safeguards.
  • Analytical support:
    • Understanding of suitable modes of characterizing synthetic products and the availability of those modes within ASU research ecosystem.
    • Primary contact for training, service and user support on the High-Resolution X-ray diffractometer
    • Ability to assist with analytical techniques as needed by the facility, including (but not limited to) X-ray diffraction, TG-DSC, FTIR, Raman, UV-Vis, etc.
  • General facility-related activities:
    • Managing user requests, instrument scheduling, and billable work with Agilent iLab.
    • Implementing or coordinating maintenance (as appropriate) for instrumentation in assigned EMC laboratories.
    • Reviewing product specifications and recommending new/replacement parts for the assigned instruments. Negotiating prices, terms and conditions with suppliers.
    • Effectively communicating progress and challenges with team-members and management.
    • Maintaining accurate research records, standard laboratory procedures, and managing inventories of chemical reagents and lab supplies.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of the principles, methods, and techniques of high temperature processing and thermal analysis instruments including thermocouples, controllers, vacuum pumps, pressure gauges, and residual gas analyzers, etc.
  • Knowledge of chemical synthesis: designing routes for multi-step syntheses from scientific literatures; running reactions under controlled temperatures, pressures, and atmospheres; optimizing processes to improve reaction yields and safety and enabling potential pilot-scale operations.
  • Knowledge of proper and safe handling, use, and disposal of hazardous materials and waste.
  • Knowledge of standards and best practices for storing and using compressed gases, including oxidizing-, flammable-, and reactive-gases.
  • Skill in both verbal and written communication.
  • Skill in troubleshooting and problem-solving and in planning, implementing, and supervising laboratory activities.
  • Demonstrated accountability, dependability, and ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Good working knowledge of analytical capabilities within the GMSF including X-ray diffraction, TG-DSC, FTIR, UV-vis and a range of spectroscopy techniques, vacuum practice and thermal analysis.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and to sharing knowledge and skills with colleagues.
  • Bachelor's degree in a field appropriate to the area of assignment and four years of related research experience; or
  • Master's degree in a field appropriate to the area of assignment and two years of related research experience; or
  • Any equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge, skills, and abilities have been achieved.
  • General hands-on experience with chemical synthesis.
  • Hands-on experience with high temperature processing.
  • Hands-on experience with X-ray diffraction.
  • Hands-on experience with TG-DSC, FTIR, and UV-Vis spectroscopy.
  • Hands-on experience with maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing instrumentation
  • In-depth understanding of the relationships among materials synthesis, structure, processing, and properties.
  • Experience managing and tracking multiple projects and prioritizing tasks
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the operating principles underlying characterization techniques relevant to the discipline
  • Demonstrated knowledge of modern research methods, data collection, and analysis
  • Evidence of effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience analyzing and evaluating data and preparing technical reports

Working Environment:

  • Activities are performed in an environmentally controlled office setting and laboratory subject to extended periods of being in a stationary position, operating computer and other office productivity machinery; required to move a moderate distance to perform work.
  • Frequently moves up to 25 pounds for various needs.
  • May be required to wear personal protective equipment before entering laboratories such as lab coat, gloves, safety glasses, closed toe shoes and respirator.,

Each year since 2016, ASU has been named the most innovative school in the nation, recognizing the university's culture of groundbreaking research and partnerships, as well as its commitment to helping students thrive in college and beyond. title: Director of Software Engineering
description:
If you are a software engineering leader ready to take the reins and drive impact, we’ve got an opportunity just for you.

As a Senior Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within Consumer & Community Banking, you lead multiple technical areas supporting our AI/ML platform, manage the activities of multiple teams, and collaborate across technical domains. Your expertise is applied cross-functionally to drive the adoption and implementation of technical methods, deliver innovative AI/ML capabilities at scale, and help the firm remain at the forefront of industry trends, best practices, and technological advances.

Job responsibilities

  • Leads the design and development of our AI/ML platform, ensuring robustness, scalability, security, and high performance
  • Manages and grows teams of talented engineers and AI specialists, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement
  • Collaborates with product management and cross-functional teams to define product vision, roadmaps, and deliverables for AI-driven features and capabilities
  • Drives the adoption of best practices in software engineering, machine learning operations (MLOps), and data governance
  • Sets direction and governance for agentic AI-enabled engineering and automation, including appropriate guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams
  • Stays abreast of emerging trends and technologies in artificial intelligence and machine learning and assesses their applicability to business goals
  • Ensures compliance with data privacy, security, and responsible AI requirements applicable to AI/ML solutions
  • Oversees the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML projects, from ideation and development through deployment, operation, and maintenance
  • Communicates complex technical concepts and solutions effectively to senior stakeholders across business, product, and technology
  • Manages budgets and resources efficiently and reports progress, risks, and challenges to executive leadership

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years of applied experience; in addition, 5+ years of experience leading technologists to manage, anticipate, and solve complex technical challenges
  • Advanced knowledge of software engineering, artificial intelligence and machine learning, machine learning operations (MLOps), and data governance
  • Experience developing or leading large, cross-functional teams of technologists
  • Demonstrated experience influencing highly matrixed, complex organizations and delivering value at scale
  • Experience leading complex projects supporting system design, testing, deployment, and operational stability
  • Experience with hiring, developing, and recognizing talent
  • Experience leading the adoption of agentic AI-enabled engineering practices across teams, including defining operating expectations, validation and quality controls, measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of sensitive inputs and outputs
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations, including data sensitivity, resiliency, security, and governance
  • Extensive practical cloud-native experience
  • Expertise in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a STEM field
  • In-depth understanding of search and ranking, recommender systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), similarity search, graph techniques, and other advanced AI/ML methodologies
  • Understanding of large language model (LLM) techniques, including agents, planning, reasoning, and related methods
  • Experience training and fine-tuning large language models and embedding models, including knowledge of LLM operations and AI operations

This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorganChase’s review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.

title: NewGen Project Manager
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Resource Manager, NewGen

__

Every great transformation starts with a clear plan and someone who can bring people together around it. As our NewGen Project Manager, you will be that person. You will shape how our projects are planned, delivered and adopted. You will turn ambitious ideas into measurable business outcomes, working with colleagues across functions and business areas at ABB.


Key responsibilities:


You will start by setting the direction. You will define a planning strategy that covers all the activities needed to manage the project well. You will choose the delivery approach that fits best, whether that is waterfall, agile or a hybrid. You will align with stakeholders on the scope and build a schedule that reflects it.

Next, you will define the budget, resources, timelines and work allocation together with your stakeholders. You will plan, coordinate and deliver your projects within the agreed time, scope, cost and quality. Along the way, you will prioritize tasks, keep project plans and charters up to date, and keep everyone informed of progress.


You will create the key project documents with your stakeholders. These include scope, acceptance criteria, financials, schedules and risk plans. You will guide the work through its phases and stage-gates, so resources are used efficiently and each milestone is met. You will make sure every activity follows company, program and IS procedures, as well as quality and safety standards.

Risk management will be part of your daily routine. You will identify, mitigate and monitor risks, issues and decisions, and you will spot opportunities and act on them. You will draw on your experience to anticipate contingencies and choose the best way forward. You will track progress, costs and resources, and address variances early.


You will also be the trusted contact and escalation point for your stakeholders. You will manage expectations, build strong relationships and keep projects aligned as strategies evolve. You will prepare and drive project and budget approvals, and you will define the governance structures and committees that support them. You will report on performance against plans and business outcomes, and you will keep a steady focus on realizing business value through delivery and implementation.


When a project closes, you will make sure the handover is smooth and capture lessons learned, so the next project benefits from them. Throughout, you will follow sound methodology, ABB directives and program management standards.


What you bring:


To be successful in this role, you bring more than 12 years of project management experience, ideally in transformation or change programs. You are comfortable working in cross-functional environments with many stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.


You have a proven track record of aligning projects with program objectives and delivering measurable business outcomes. Your strengths include project planning and execution, and managing resources and budgets. You are also experienced in managing risks, issues and dependencies, and you communicate clearly with stakeholders and governance forums.


You are a natural collaborator. You build alignment across multiple projects and teams, and you help business areas adopt change.


You also hold a recognized certification. This could be PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, an Agile/Scrum certification (such as CSM or SAFe), or ABB Program PM Certified under the IS Function Standard for IS Project Manager Certification.


Why ABB


At ABB, you will work in a global, collaborative environment with room to grow and learn. We welcome people from all backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. If you meet most of these criteria but not every one, we still encourage you to apply. We would like to hear your story.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Beredskabskoordinator
description:
Vil du være med til at styrke beredskabet i Syddjurs Kommune?

Vi søger en beredskabskoordinator, der kan skabe sammenhæng, sikre fremdrift og omsætte planer til handling – både i den kommunale organisation og i samarbejdet med lokalsamfundet.

Hvordan sikrer vi, at kommunen kan opretholde sine vigtigste funktioner, når en krise rammer? Og hvordan styrker vi samarbejdet med borgere, virksomheder, forsyningsselskaber og myndigheder, så vi står bedre rustet til fremtidens udfordringer?

Det er nogle af de spørgsmål, du skal være med til at finde svar på som vores nye beredskabskoordinator.

I Syddjurs Kommune har vi stort fokus på at styrke vores samlede beredskab. Vi har allerede igangsat en række konkrete indsatser, og nu søger vi en kollega, der kan være med til at samle trådene, skabe overblik og sikre, at vores planer og initiativer bliver omsat til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis.

Du bliver organisatorisk placeret i Ledelsessekretariat og Erhverv med en bred kontaktflade til kommunens ledelse, fagområder og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

En central rolle i udviklingen af kommunens beredskab

Som beredskabskoordinator får du en vigtig rolle i at koordinere og videreudvikle Syddjurs Kommunes samlede beredskabsindsats.

Du skal ikke løse alle beredskabsopgaver selv. Din vigtigste opgave bliver at sikre sammenhæng og fremdrift i arbejdet og understøtte de mange medarbejdere, ledere og samarbejdspartnere, der hver især har ansvar for forskellige dele af beredskabet.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Koordinere arbejdet med kommunens 12 igangsatte projektspor på beredskabsområdet og sikre fremdrift og implementering af konkrete løsninger, herunder nødstrøm, nødkommunikation og ordonnanssystem.
  • Koordinere udvikling, opdatering og vedligeholdelse af kommunens beredskabsplaner og sikre sammenhæng mellem de forskellige fagområders planer.
  • Udvikle og vedligeholde et fælles årshjul for beredskabsarbejdet, herunder planlægning, gennemførelse og evaluering af øvelser.
  • Understøtte kommunens ledelse og fagområder med rådgivning, koordinering og opfølgning på beredskabsindsatser.
  • Facilitere samarbejdet med relevante myndigheder, Beredskab & Sikkerhed, forsyningsselskaber og tværkommunale beredskabsnetværk.
  • Bidrage til at udvikle samarbejdet med distriktsråd, frivillige foreninger, erhvervsliv og andre lokale aktører om at styrke robustheden i lokalsamfundene.
  • Tage initiativ til fælles aktiviteter og videndeling, eksempelvis en lokal beredskabskonference, der kan samle relevante aktører om beredskab og samfundssikkerhed.

Du vil få en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du både arbejder med langsigtet udvikling, konkrete projekter og praktisk koordinering.

Vi søger en stærk koordinator, der kan få tingene til at ske

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund og gerne erfaring med beredskab, projektledelse, offentlig administration eller tværgående koordinering.

Du kan eksempelvis have erfaring fra en kommune, en anden offentlig myndighed, beredskabsområdet eller en større organisation, hvor du har arbejdet med komplekse projekter og mange forskellige interessenter.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med beredskabsplanlægning og krisestyring, men det er ikke et krav, at du er uddannet beredskabsspecialist. Vi lægger mindst lige så stor vægt på din evne til at skabe overblik, samarbejde og sikre resultater.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder struktureret og systematisk og kan holde styr på mange parallelle opgaver.
  • Er en dygtig projektleder og procesfacilitator, der skaber fremdrift og følger op på aftaler.
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og kan opbygge relationer på tværs af fagligheder, organisatoriske niveauer og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.
  • Kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til konkrete og anvendelige løsninger.
  • Kommunikerer klart og præcist – både mundtligt og skriftligt.
  • Er selvstændig, initiativrig og trives med at udvikle et område, hvor ikke alle løsninger er givet på forhånd.
  • Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har forståelse for arbejdet i en politisk ledet organisation.

Du bliver en del af Ledelsessekretariat og Erhverv

Du får din daglige base i Ledelsessekretariat og Erhverv i administrationsbygningen i Ebeltoft, hvor vi arbejder tæt på kommunens øverste administrative og politiske ledelse.

Her bliver du en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor samarbejde, koordinering og evnen til at skabe sammenhæng på tværs af organisationen er centrale elementer i opgaveløsningen.

Stillingen giver dig mulighed for at arbejde med et område, der har stor samfundsmæssig betydning, og hvor der er både politisk og ledelsesmæssig opmærksomhed.

Du får samtidig mulighed for at præge udviklingen af kommunens beredskabsarbejde og være med til at skabe nye samarbejdsformer, både internt i kommunen og med aktører i lokalsamfundet.

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med arbejdssted i Syddjurs Kommune.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Ansøgningsfrist: Den 5. januar 2027

Ansættelsessamtaler: 1. runde den 8. januar 2027 og 2. runde den 13. januar 2027

Syddjurs Kommune har omkring 44.400 indbyggere, fem hovedbyer og et stort opland med mange landsbyer. Vi er en kommune i udvikling og hvert år vælger mange familier at flytte hertil. Vores styrker er de aktive borgere, de mange bysamfund, en enestående natur og nærheden til storbyen Aarhus. Vi er en aktiv del af udviklingen i den midtjyske region, herunder Business Region Aarhus, som er et fællesskab mellem de 12 østjyske Kommuner på tilsammen en million østjyder, en halv million arbejdspladser og landets største vækstområde uden for hovedstadsområdet.

title: Digital PMO Lead
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Digital Transformation Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to drive and govern the execution of EL Service’s digital transformation program. You will collaborate across teams to bring visibility and governance to strategic digital initiatives, ensuring successful planning, execution, and delivery across global and regional teams. You will have an opportunity to apply and grow your expertise by promoting effective decision-making, driving organizational change, and supporting the adoption of digital solutions and ways of working across the business.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification Service Business Area, Digital Transformation function, globally.

Main stakeholders are digital product teams, engineering teams, regional and global business leaders, service organizations, and senior leadership teams.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Overseeing the planning, execution, governance, and delivery of strategic digital programs across the EL Service organization.
  • Tracking program OKRs, budgets, timelines, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance, while providing clear reporting and insights to senior leadership.
  • Establishing and managing governance frameworks, decision-making processes, and escalation paths to ensure effective cross-functional execution.
  • Driving change management initiatives and continuous improvements to support adoption of digital solutions and enhance program delivery effectiveness.

Our team dynamics

You will join a high-performing, collaborative, and globally connected team, where you will be able to thrive while helping shape the future of digital transformation within ABB Electrification Service.

Qualifications for the role

  • You have 10+ years of experience in program management, project management, or PMO leadership, with a strong focus on digital transformation, software delivery, or digital product development.
  • You are skilled in project and portfolio management tools such as Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, Aha, Rally, or Planview, and possess advanced knowledge of governance, reporting, and portfolio management practices.
  • You have proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects and programs, cross-functional teams, budgets, risks, and dependencies within a complex global organization.
  • You are passionate about collaboration, organizational change, continuous improvement, and driving alignment across teams.
  • Degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related discipline, with demonstrated experience in digital transformation and program delivery.
  • You are at ease communicating in English, with the ability to present program status, risks, and recommendations clearly and confidently to senior leaders and global stakeholders.
  • PMP certification is strongly preferred; PgMP certification, experience in industrial, manufacturing, energy, or field service environments, and familiarity with Agile frameworks, OKRs, and Stage-Gate methodologies are considered strong advantages.

More about us

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Small Grants Programme Assistant Mogadishu, Somalia
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

The Global Environment Facility (GEF) Small Grants Programme (SGP) is implemented by UNDP on behalf of the GEF Partnership. UNDP oversees the Small Grants Programme (SGP) through the Vertical Hub and the Nature Hub of BPPS. Funded by the Global Environment Facility (GEF), the Small Grants Programme efficiently channels direct grants to non-governmental and community-based organizations to help them cope with climate change; conserve biodiversity; protect international waters; reduce the impact of Persistent Organic Pollutants; and prevent land degradation. Helping communities with their initiatives for sustainable livelihoods while generating global environmental benefits is the core inspiration of the Small Grants Programme.

Launched in 1992 as a corporate programme of the GEF, the GEF Small Grants Programme (GEF SGP) has supported local action for over thirty years to address global environmental concerns. SGP aims to deliver global environmental benefits in the GEF focal areas of biodiversity conservation, climate change mitigation, protection of international waters, prevention of land degradation, and elimination of persistent organic pollutants through community-based approaches. To date, SGP has funded over 29,000 community-based projects covering more than 120 countries. It has gained considerable experiences at the community level, including adapting to climate change while addressing issues of the GEF focal areas. Further information can be found at: .

Duties and Responsibilities

Support Programme Implementation:

  • Contribute to day-to-day programme/project implementation, ensuring conformity to expected results, outputs, objectives and work-plans.
  • Assist the National Coordinator (NC) in prescreening project concepts and project proposals and evaluate the financial part of the project proposals.
  • Assist the NC in development and revision of grant application forms and other management tools, requirements of the programme, and other SGP documents.
  • Advise potential grantees on project preparation processes and guidelines, and report to NC and National Steering Committee (NSC) on project development activities, as required.
  • Provide day-to-day support and guidance to new and ongoing projects and its grantees, as required.
  • Assist the NC in project implementation, matters related to the grievance redress mechanism, monitoring and evaluation, including participation in field visits.
  • Support organization and preparation of minutes of NSC meetings and other SGP events.
  • Maintain contacts and professional working relationship with NGOs, governmental institutions, donors, other SGP stakeholders.
  • Assist NC in reporting regularly to the Central Programme Management Team (CPMT), United Nations Development Programme Country Office (UNDP CO), and assist NC in timely preparation of annual monitoring survey, and other CPMT, UNDP surveys and reports as required.
  • Support the NC in meeting relevant M&E requirements (e.g. Project Implementation Report (PIR), Midterm Review (MTR) and Terminal Evaluation (TE)
  • Draft memos and other operational documents on behalf of NC and respond to queries on SGP programme matters.
  • Regularly update and maintain SGP project database as well as stakeholders’ database.

Support Programme Financial Management :

  • Provide guidance, review, and control the accuracy of supporting documentation of projects’ interim and final financial reports, such as invoices, and advise the NC as required
  • Process payment requests from grantees and vendors through obtaining necessary clearances and authorizations, and ensuring payments are affected promptly, and in accordance with SGP Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Maintain close working contact with respective Regional Focal Point and seek her/his support, advice and guidance on how better to operate Quantum in accordance with SGP SOPs, if needed.
  • In collaboration with the NC, maintain financial integrity of the programme, implement and monitor accounting system and databases of SGP country operational budget.
  • Prepare and maintain the grant disbursement table and calendar, as well as track the Country Operating Budget to ensure compliance with the approved yearly budget.
  • Draft annual SGP Country office administrative and project budget proposals.
  • Management of the Petty Cash account with proper documentation and proper tractable records.
  • Enter, extract, transfer data from Quantum and SGP database and produce reports as required.
  • Follow up of travel arrangements and DSA payments for NC and NSC members
  • Provide other financial reports as required.

Provision of Administrative Support:

  • Procure office supplies, equipment, and furniture adhering to SGP and CO SOPs on procurement rules and regulation.
  • Manage and organize everyday office work.
  • Establish a proper filing system, maintain SGP country office administrative, financial, and management files and update them with original documentation or copy of the original documentation as necessary. Special focus on:
  • Establish and maintain a separate folder with all signed NSC meetings minutes that approve new SGP granted project
  • Establish and maintain projects filing system containing original MOAs and amendments, original or copies of interim and final reports with all supporting documents, and mission reports or evaluation documents.
  • Establish and maintain financial folders for all SGP country office financial transactions.
  • Maintain personnel files, performance evaluation reports, leave records, and other pertinent personnel/consultant records
  • Draft routine correspondence and communications and establish filing system to record communications with local stakeholders.
  • Provide administrative and operational support to organization of SGP events and activities as requested
  • Prepare background information and documentation, update data relevant to the programme areas and compile background material for the NC and NSC.
  • Ensure flow of information and dissemination of materials with all concerned.
  • Maintain an updated inventory of all physical assets and register all inventory in the asset inventory sheet.
  • Provide logistical and administrative support to visiting missions, travel arrangements, and meetings for the NC, NSC, adhering to SGP SOPs procurement rules and regulation.
  • Support with the project audit including with preparation and subsequent implementation of any audit recommendations.

Support Knowledge Management and Communication

  • Actively support the SGP country office in the efforts on knowledge management, knowledge networking and visibility of SGP.
  • In accordance with SGP branding guidelines, support NC and NSC in the efforts towards proper recognition of SGP in any KM & Communication material produced by SGP grantees or stakeholders.
  • Facilitate the organization of SGP advocacy events, workshops, stakeholders’ dialogues and round tables.
  • Assist in drafting articles and publications with proper recognition of SGP.
  • Participate at events for SGP information dissemination purposes
  • Maintain, update or provide valid SGP information for the SGP website, SGP Global database and UNDP CO website.

Provide support to the effective monitoring, evaluation, and reporting on progress of project implementation

  • Generate Performance Evaluation Report
  • Support implementation of the project monitoring system in alignment with its Monitoring and Evaluation framework to facilitate effective information sharing on project status and achievement of targets.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

  • The incumbent will be based in the UNDP [Mogadishu Somalia ] offices;
  • The incumbent will report to the SGP National Coordinator;
  • The incumbent will be given access to relevant information necessary for the execution of the tasks under this assignment;
  • The incumbent will be provided with a workstation (i.e. laptop, internet, phone, scanner/printer, etc.) and access to reliable internet connection

Competencies

Expected Demonstration of Competencies
Core
Achieve Results LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline
Think Innovatively LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements
Learn Continuously LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback
Adapt with Agility LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible
Act with Determination LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident
Engage and Partner LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships
Enable Diversity and Inclusion LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-Functional & Technical competencies:

Thematic Area Name Definition
Business management Communication

Ability to communicate in a clear, concise, and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience.

Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media and other appropriate channels.
Business Development Knowledge Generation

Ability to research information and to turn it into useful knowledge, relevant for context, or

responsive to a stated need.

Ability to apply existing concepts to new situations, and to develop new concepts to generate workable solutions and new approaches. Knowledge of relevant concepts,

conceptual models, and theories that can be

useful in addressing new situations.
Business Management Project Management Ability to plan, organize, prioritize and control resources, procedures and protocols to achieve specific goal
Administration & Operations Documents and records management Overall document (hard or electronic) management; registry and retention policy including storing and archiving

Administrations & Operations

 Events management (including retreats, trainings and meetings) Ability to manage events, including venue identification, accommodation, logistics, catering, transportation, and cash disbursements, etc.
Partnership management Relationship management Ability to engage with a wide range of public and private partners, build, sustain and/or strengthen working relations, trust and mutual understanding
2030 Agenda: Planet Nature Local Action

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

  • Secondary education is required. OR
  • A first level university degree (bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in Business or Public Administration, Environmental and Social Science will also be given due consideration, but it is not a requirement.
  • A certificate in Business Administration/ Accounting or Finance will provide distinctive advantage to the candidate

Experience:

  • Minimum five (5) years (with secondary education), two (2) years (with bachelors’ degree), of progressively responsible administrative or programme experience is required at the national or international level.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to review and edit documents, and ability to produce meeting reports identifying key actions is required.
  • Experience in project management/support at the rural/local community level is an asset
  • Experience in monitoring and evaluation and results-based management tools with a background and interest in the analysis of development issues and related policy matters will be an added advantage.
  • Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and advance knowledge of spreadsheet and database packages, experience in handling of web-based management systems is an asset.
  • Experience in supporting programme financial management is an advantage.
  • Experience in providing operational support, including event management and logistics, is an advantage.

Languages:

  • Fluency in English and Somali are required.
  • Knowledge of other UN Languages is an asset.

The following documents shall be required from the applicants:

  1. Personal CV or P11, indicating all past positions held and their main underlying functions, their durations (month/year), the qualifications, as well as the contact details (email and telephone number) of the Candidate, and at least three (3) the most recent professional references of previous supervisors. References may also include peers.
  2. A cover letter (maximum length: 1 page) indicating why the candidate considers him-/herself to be suitable for the position.
  3. Managers may ask (ad hoc) for any other materials relevant to pre-assessing the relevance of their experience, such as reports, presentations, publications, campaigns, or other materials.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

title: Manager, IT - Infrastructure and Technology Services
description:
Job Description Summary:

Location: Shanghai, China

Role Type: Individual Contributor

The Manager, Information Technology - Infrastructure & Technology Services is responsible for delivering stable, secure, scalable, and resilient technology infrastructure services that enable Coca‑Cola’s digital transformation and business operations globally. As the organization accelerates its digital-first strategy, modern infrastructure, cloud capabilities, operational resilience, and secure technology foundations are critical to ensuring business continuity, enabling innovation, and supporting enterprise growth. This role owns the performance, availability, reliability, and operational excellence of assigned infrastructure and technology services. The Manager partners closely with infrastructure, architecture, cybersecurity, cloud operations, product teams, business stakeholders, and external service providers to ensure foundational technology services are modernized, optimized, and aligned with enterprise standards and strategic priorities. The successful candidate combines deep infrastructure and service management expertise with strong operational leadership, vendor management, and continuous improvement capabilities. Using automation, artificial intelligence, operational analytics, and modern service management practices, this role drives service quality, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and business value delivery while balancing operational stability with innovation and long-term technology modernization.

What You will do for us:

  • Own the performance, reliability, availability, and operational quality of infrastructure and technology services that support enterprise business operations.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure roadmaps, capacity plans, lifecycle strategies, and operational resilience initiatives aligned with business and technology priorities.
  • Lead day-to-day infrastructure operations, ensuring services are delivered in accordance with service-level objectives, governance standards, and performance expectations.
  • Drive proactive monitoring, operational analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service reliability, efficiency, and user experience.
  • Provide leadership during infrastructure incidents, outages, and service disruptions, coordinating recovery activities, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and stakeholder communications.
  • Manage infrastructure change activities to ensure technology environments remain secure, stable, and resilient while enabling business transformation and modernization objectives.
  • Partner with architecture, cybersecurity, cloud operations, engineering, product, and business teams to deliver integrated technology solutions that support enterprise priorities.
  • Manage strategic relationships with infrastructure vendors, managed service providers, and technology partners to ensure service quality, contractual performance, and operational excellence.
  • Utilize infrastructure service metrics, operational trends, performance indicators, and insights to drive decision-making and improve outcomes.
  • Ensure infrastructure services comply with cybersecurity policies, governance requirements, regulatory obligations, and enterprise risk management standards.
  • Support disaster recovery, business continuity, resilience planning, and operational readiness activities across the technology landscape.
  • Drive the adoption of automation, artificial intelligence-enabled operations, and modern infrastructure management practices to improve scalability, efficiency, and reliability.
  • Support infrastructure investment planning and manage operating and capital expenditure budgets to optimize cost, value, and service performance.
  • Influence infrastructure portfolio priorities, technology refresh initiatives, operational roadmaps, and modernization efforts.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across technology and business functions to ensure infrastructure capabilities support evolving organizational needs.
  • Balance operational stability, security, innovation, and long-term value creation in a dynamic, global environment.

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in information technology with responsibilities spanning infrastructure operations, technology services, networking, service management, or platform delivery.
  • Experience working within manufacturing, bottling, supply chain, or consumer packaged goods environments is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated expertise in enterprise infrastructure technologies including networking, compute, server environments, infrastructure operations, and service management.
    • Infrastructure and connectivity: TCP/IP, LAN/WAN connectivity, and network infrastructure.
    • Output management: Multifunction printers, secure print, label printers, and network printers.
    • End-user and workplace technology: PC and deskside support, Microsoft and Apple operating systems, RDP, VDI, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Office, email, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Experience managing infrastructure service performance, availability, reliability, operational resilience, and service-level commitments.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure lifecycle management, capacity planning, operational governance, and technology modernization practices.
  • Experience leading infrastructure incident management, service restoration activities, root cause analysis, and operational improvement initiatives.
  • Knowledge of network infrastructure, connectivity technologies, local and wide area network environments, and enterprise technology ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, access controls, compliance requirements, technology risk management, and infrastructure governance frameworks.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors, managed service providers, and strategic technology partners to achieve operational and service objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage operational data, analytics, reporting, and service metrics to improve infrastructure performance and decision-making.
  • Experience managing operating and capital expenditure budgets, infrastructure investments, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Knowledge of disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and operational resilience best practices.
  • Understanding of enterprise service management processes including change, incident, problem, and release management.
  • Experience supporting workplace and end-user technology environments including collaboration platforms, desktop technologies, and productivity services.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, vendor management, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.

title: School Nutrition Supervisor
description:
POSITION TITLE:School Nutrition Supervisor
REPORTS TO:School Nutrition Director
BEGINNING DATE:Open Until Filled

NATURE OF WORK:

An employee in this class provides support to the Director by supervising a group of school cafeterias. The employee participates in the development, implementation, and oversight of the policies and procedures that govern the school system's school nutrition program. The employee exercises discretionary judgment within board policies and procedures. Errors by the employee could result in serious disruption of the food service program, undesirable facilities, and/or loss of money. The employee receives general direction. The employee may provide general supervision to several site managers.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • Applied working knowledge of: quantity food production including preparation and service, storage, sanitation, and safety.
  • Basic knowledge of nutrition as it applies to school age children.
  • Knowledge in the application, care, and maintenance of food service equipment.
  • Knowledge of principles and practices for supervision and training.
  • Oral and written communication skills.
  • Apply and implement record keeping techniques, using a variety of software programs.
  • Ability to operate district or personal vehicle to travel independently and continually to district sites to inspect and conduct work or respond to emergencies.

Ability to:

  • Apply professional knowledge and administrative ability to assist in implementing a district-wide school nutrition program.
  • Supervise the preparation of large quantities of food in a sanitary and safe manner
  • Reason logically and respond independently and creatively.
  • Provide skilled leadership in food service operations.
  • Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with administrators, teachers, pupils, subordinate personnel, and the general public
  • Train, supervise, and evaluate the performance of assigned personnel effectively in order to motivate to maximum productivity
  • Analyze situations accurately and adopt a decisive, appropriate, course of action
  • Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; talk or hear; and taste or smell.
  • The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • The employee must regularly lift or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift or move up to 40 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • The selected candidate must be able to perform the duties of a rigorous work schedule which includes lifting, loading, and unloading, and pass a physical examination and drug screen certifying this ability.

EDUCATION AND TRAINING:

  • Required High School Diploma. Associate's Degree in food services management, nutrition, or a related field preferred.
  • At least three years of experience in food service management or a related field, with some experience in a leadership role preferred.
  • Must possess and maintain a food protection manager certification recognized by the North Carolina Health Department.
  • Knowledge of the USDA regulations and guidelines required.

TERM OF EMPLOYMENT: 12 months

SALARY: Salary Grade 61

FLSA Status: Exempt

PERFORMANCE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Human Resource Management

  1. Considerable knowledge of the principles of leadership, organization and administration.
  2. Ability to lead cafeteria managers to provide quality meals and friendly service appropriate to a public school environment.
  3. Assist managers in work organization, preparation of work schedules, food & supply orders.
  4. Ability to build team spirit, inspire cooperation in others and to encourage team members to accomplish work assignments even under difficult conditions.
  5. Ability to motivate cafeteria staff members to follow school, local, state and federal rules, regulations, policies and procedures and in ensuring cafeteria managers meet expectations.
  6. Monitor meals per labor hours and suggest adjustments in labor.

  7. Completes required reports and employee relations

  8. Supervises school nutrition managers.

  9. Identifies problems and counsels managers regarding possible solutions.

  10. Determines school nutrition staffing needed in the schools.

  11. Recommends hiring and disciplining of employees.

  12. Provides on-the-job training.

  13. Approves or disapproves requests for annual and sick leave, appraises and recommends discipline for subordinate staff, and submits such records and reports as required by department management.

  14. Assist with training of new managers and employees; following procedures outlined in District training manuals.

  15. Performs or participates in job performance evaluation of assigned cafeteria managers.

  16. Assists with staff development.

Financial Reporting and Recordkeeping

  1. Ability to set goals, strategies, and priorities that are clear, challenging and relevant to purpose.

  2. Optimum knowledge of the use of computers to process, record, transmit and analyze data.

  3. Implements financial control procedures.

  4. Monitors expenditure of funds.

  5. Trains managers to complete reports.

  6. Monitors compliance to state and federal regulations.

  7. Perform on site reviews twice a year

  8. Facilitates visits of USDA and other auditors.

  9. Ability to fluently operate point of sale software.

Purchasing/Inventory Control

  1. Verifies quality of products received.

  2. Reviews product storage and inventories.

  3. Monitor frozen food and dry food inventory.

  4. Facilitates "choice menus" to reduce inventories.

Equipment/Facility Management

  1. General knowledge of the use and care of large kitchen equipment.

  2. Inspects for proper equipment maintenance.

  3. Assesses major equipment needs.

  4. Recommends major equipment purchases.

  5. Provides training in equipment use.

  6. Is on-call to handle emergency situations, including emergency feeding operations; and evaluate kitchens and report repairs after weather emergency.

Sanitation and Safety

  1. Assure all sanitation standards are maintained.

  2. Inspects facilities for cleanliness, health, and safety.

  3. Follows-up on sanitation, health and safety reports.

  4. Distributes written rules on sanitation.

Food Production and Service

  1. Knowledge of the principles and practices of food service administration team building and customer service.

  2. Assist staff with production records, recipes, and product development.

  3. Monitor food production daily for quality control purposes.

  4. Assures that planned menus are followed.

  5. Enforces standardized recipes.

Nutrition Education/Public Relations

  1. General knowledge of the nutritional and dietary needs of school children.

  2. Ability to exercise independent judgment and to use initiative when responding to emergencies, resolving problems and making improvements in the cafeteria operation.

  3. Ability to set priorities and allocate time so that tasks are completed and deadlines are met in a timely manner.

  4. Markets/promotes the school lunch program.
  5. Leads managers to establish effective communication with principals, faculty and staff to improve cafeteria customer service.

  6. Participates in manager meetings to disburse and gather information, and to identify means to improve the effectiveness of individual cafeterias.

  7. Ability to lead cafeteria managers to provide quality meals and friendly service appropriate to a public school environment.

  8. Establishes and maintains effective communication with school principals, other departments within Onslow County Schools, regulatory agencies and other stakeholders.

  9. Monitors cafeteria inspection reports and identifies procedures to resolve identified problems or deficiencies.

  10. Ability to travel to and from schools and administrative offices independently.

  11. Attends seminars, conferences, workshops, classes, lectures, etc., as appropriate, to enhance and maintain knowledge of trends and developments in the field of food services administration; reviews professional journals, attends association and professional meetings, and otherwise maintains contacts with food service professionals to facilitate exchange of information.

All other duties as assigned or required.

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees to this job.

Onslow County Schools does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, or age in its programs and activities.
