title: Management Data Analyst [Open to internal and external applicants]
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Within UNDP’s Bureau for Management Services (BMS), the Office of Human Resources (OHR), is the Management Consulting Team (MCT), which is constituted of a group of management consulting practitioners available on request to support UNDP offices and units worldwide to improve strategic and organizational effectiveness in line with UNDP’s Strategic Plan and corporate investments in organizational effectiveness and agility. This group is anchored by a core team of management advisors and consultants based in Bonn, who coordinate and deliver management consulting services globally in a participatory manner

Position Purpose

Under the guidance and supervision of the Chief of the Management Consulting Team (MCT), the Management Data Analyst is expected to contribute to support overall organizational effectiveness by making substantive contributions to MCT advisory engagements with internal and external stakeholders, including country offices and headquarters units. The Management Data Analyst undertakes research, data collection, and data analysis; develops data analysis tools and applications; manages databases and data platforms; supports internal coordination and knowledge management; and participates in all MCT engagements using a client, quality, and results-oriented approach. The Management Data Analyst works in close collaboration with the team members in developing content and in the delivery of organizational effectiveness advisory services.

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. This is a recognition of the interconnected nature of development risks & crises that the world is facing and that call for assembling of multidisciplinary teams for an integrated & systemic response. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration

Key Duties and Responsibilities

1. Undertake research, data collection, and analysis in support of UNDP’s organizational effectiveness focusing on achievement of the following results:

  • Undertake research, data collection, and analysis related to organizational performance, organizational effectiveness, and business process reviews;
  • Undertake end-to-end data analysis workflows from data collection, data wrangling, data exploration, data modelling, data analysis, data communication, and visualization;
  • Create and maintain databases, dashboards, and data management workflows in coordination with BMS/ITM as applicable;
  • Develop methodologies, tools, and software applications related to data analysis and organizational performance;
  • Make continuous improvements to organizational performance analytics; and
  • Support forward-looking analysis on organizational performance to highlight opportunities for MCT engagements.

2. Participate in client advisory engagements and make contributions in support of business transformation engagements focusing on the achievement of the following results:

  • Undertake research, data collection, analysis and visualization of information from diverse sources in support of MCT client engagements, including financial modelling and statistical analysis;
  • Support development of technical proposals, business cases, and implementation plans/roadmaps;
  • Support preparation for and participate in interviews, focus groups and workshops as required;
  • Support drafting of written outputs and end-of-engagement reports, as required;
  • Follow up with engagement clients on recommendations, as required; and
  • Proactively seek, analyze, and apply data sets relevant for MCT engagements.

3. Support data/knowledge management and coordination:

  • Maintain MCT’s data and knowledge platforms, including dashboards;
  • Develop and maintain MCT’s codebase, database, and data management tools and workflows
  • Contribute to the development of templates and standard operating procedures;
  • Perform administrative support functions to ensure smooth operations; and
  • Support internal coordination, communication, and knowledge management efforts.

Competencies

Core Competencies

  • Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline
  • Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is a pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements
  • Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open-minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback
  • Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible
  • Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in the face of adversity, confident
  • Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships
  • Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies

  • Digital & Innovation — Data collection: Being skilled in Data Sorting, Data Cleaning, Survey Administration, Presentation and Reporting, including collection of Real-Time Data
  • Business Management — Business Analysis: Ability to analyse business processes, business requirements, and identify and define solutions that will maximize the value delivered by an organization to its stakeholders.
  • Information Management & Technology — Data management and analytics: Ability to structure data, develop dashboards and visualizations. Design data warehouses, data lakes or data platform concepts. Familiarity with Machine learning, natural language processing or generation, and the use of artificial intelligence to support predictive analytics.
  • Business Direction & Strategy — Business Acumen: Ability to understand and deal with a business situation in a manner that is likely to lead to a good outcome. Ability to make good judgments and quick decisions within such frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of the operational frameworks in the organization
  • Business Management — Working with Evidence and Data: Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision-making
  • Business Management — Customer Satisfaction/Client Management: Ability to respond timely and appropriately with a sense of urgency, provide consistent solutions, and deliver timely and quality results and/or solutions to fulfil and understand the real customers' needs. Provide input to the development of customer service strategy. Look for ways to add value beyond clients' immediate requests. Ability to anticipate clients' upcoming needs and concerns.

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

  • Advanced University Degree (Master’s Degree or equivalent) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Computational Sciences, Business Administration, or related fields, is required, or
  • A first-level university degree (Bachelor’s Degree) in the above-mentioned areas with an additional 2 years of relevant work experience will be considered in lieu of the master’s degree.

Experience:

  • A minimum of two (2) years with a Master’s degree or four (4) years with a Bachelor’s degree of progressively relevant work experience in research, data collection, analysis, and supporting business transformation engagements is required;
  • Knowledge and experience of data science/analytics methodologies and approaches is required;
  • Advanced knowledge of spreadsheet and database packages, data modelling, statistical analysis and visualization tools required (e.g. SQL, R, Power BI) is required;
  • Demonstrated experience in database and cloud computing platforms required (e.g. Azure, Fabric) is desirable;
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in programming languages, libraries and frameworks for use in data science/analytics (e.g. Python, D3.js, DAX) is required;
  • Knowledge of practical applications of predictive analytics and generative AI desirable, including experience assessing and validating AI-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, relevance, and consistency;
  • Experience in performance improvement, business process reengineering, organizational effectiveness/organization development, process consultation, or management consulting is a distinct advantage;
  • Exposure to international development work is an advantage. Knowledge of the UN/UNDP system is desirable.

Language:

  • Fluency in English is required
  • Working knowledge of another UN language is desirable.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination, and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Probation

For all new UNDP fixed-term appointments (FTA), including for staff members being transferred or seconded to UNDP under the Inter-Organization Agreement concerning Transfer, Secondment or Loan of Staff, on an appointment of more than one year, continuation of the appointment beyond the initial 12 months is contingent upon the successful completion of a probationary period.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

title: Data Azure Cloud Engineer
description:
Amsterdam, Spaklerweg (Amsterdam, Noord-Holland, Nederland)



Een groot aantal kandidaten kan op deze functie solliciteren, dus zorg ervoor dat u uw cv en sollicitatie zo snel mogelijk verstuurt.
Functieomschrijving

Als Data Azure Cloud Engineer bij Furore beheer je en ontwikkel je innovatieve oplossingen voor de Azure-infrastructuur. Kom ons team versterken!


Ziekenhuizen staan momenteel aan het begin van een digitale transitie naar de cloud. Om haar klanten in de zorgsector optimaal te kunnen adviseren en ondersteunen legt Furore de focus op een overgang naar de Azure Cloud. Als Azure cloud engineer ben jij de spil in deze verandering.


Jouw rol omvat het ontwikkelen van nieuwe cloud dataplatformen voor gebruik in de zorg en het meenemen van collega’s in deze transitie, een uiterst uitdagende taak waar we razend enthousiast over zijn. Met een baan bij Furore kun jij een belangrijke bijdrage leveren binnen het maatschappelijke werkveld.


Furore is een specialist in de ZorgICT en realiseert voor tal van ziekenhuizen (realtime) dataplatformen, meestal gebouwd op basis van Microsoft-technologie (SQL Server, SSAS, SSRS en PowerBI). In deze platformen worden alle relevante databronnen ontsloten: het patiëntendossier (EPD), diverse klinische systemen, HR-systemen, financiële systemen, etc. De datamodellering wordt met (inter)nationale standaarden opgezet. Denk daarbij aan ZIB's (zorginformatiebouwstenen) en HL7 FHIR.


Binnen de ziekenhuizen ontstaat nu een focus op de cloud. Nieuwe dataplatformen worden niet meer on premise ontwikkeld, en bestaande on premise dataplatformen staan voor een cloud migratie. Furore ondersteunt de ziekenhuizen met advies en implementatie. Om deze transitie een succes te laten zijn hebben we mensen als jij nodig, met kennis en ervaring van het ontwikkelen en migreren van dataoplossingen in Azure.


Als cloud engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van een realtime dataplatform dat datagedreven applicaties en rapportages ondersteunt voor patiëntenzorg, bedrijfsvoering en wetenschappelijk onderzoek. Of het nu gaat om een realtime dataplatform dat dashboards in de zorg ondersteunt, een data infrastructuur voor AI-toepassingen of een BI datawarehouse: jij bent degene die er samen met collega's voor zorgt dat zorginstellingen kunnen beschikken over de juiste datavoorziening.


Bij Furore werk je samen met ervaren professionals aan uitdagende projecten. Veel zorgprofessionals zijn voor hun werkzaamheden afhankelijk van ons platform en dit aantal blijft groeien. Aan jou de uitdaging om deze groei mede te helpen realiseren. In ons team krijg je veel inspraak bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van passende oplossingen, er is genoeg ruimte om te experimenteren en er zijn uiteenlopende kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen.


Voorbeelden van recente projecten

  • On premise near realtime dataplatform met verschillende ziekenhuizen, met cloud transitie op de roadmap.
  • Planfase van een Azure cloud dataplatform voor een ziekenhuis, inclusief de architectuur, het devops proces, datamodellering, etc.
  • Eigen Azure producten ontwikkelen binnen Furore met opleiding en kennisdeling.

Jouw vaardigheden

  • Analytics requirements vertalen naar passende oplossingen en services op Azure, zodat datagedreven applicaties hun weg naar productie vinden;
  • Data near real time laten stromen met optimale performance voor eindgebruikers;
  • Op efficiënte wijze de toenemende vraag naar data opvangen in schaalbare oplossingen;
  • De complexiteit van zorgdata vangen in de juiste informatiemodellen en technologische oplossingen;
  • Infra-as-code en CI/CD pipelines gebruiken om deployments op Azure te implementeren en te onderhouden;
  • Monitoren van gebruik, performance en load van het analytics platform;
  • Developers ondersteunen, bijvoorbeeld bij het in productie nemen van applicaties of bouwen van pipelines.

Jij bent te herkennen aan je uitstekende kennis van data(processing), hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Azure Dataplatform projecten en je hebt talent om de kern uit de boodschap te halen.


Vinden mensen je eigenzinnig en recht door zee? Of juist doordacht in je aanpak? Mag allebei, want verschil moet er zijn. Voor deze functie ben je vooral kwaliteits- en servicegericht, communicatief vaardig en strategisch. Als Azure cloud engineer heb je natuurlijk verstand van zaken, waaronder:



  • Je hebt aantoonbare werkervaring in het ontwikkelen van datagedreven oplossingen in de Cloud (waarbij Azure uiteraard een grote pré is);
  • Je hebt aantoonbare kennis van infrastructure-as-code (b.v. Terraform, Bicep), containerisatie (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD- en GIT-versiebeheer;
  • Je weet hoe je oplossingen bouwt die voldoen aan gestelde eisen op het gebied van bruikbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, veiligheid en onderhoud;
  • Je bent resultaatgericht met een analytische mindset en kan je keuzes en overwegingen goed overbrengen binnen het team;
  • Kennis van de zorg- of wetenschapssector is een pré;
  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, in woord en geschrift.

Voor deze functie heb je minstens een hbo-diploma, aangevuld met 5 jaar werkervaring als Senior Developer of Azure Specialist.


Wat krijg je van ons

  • Een contract voor 32-40 uur per week.
  • Een uitstekend salaris en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden dat past bij jouw relevante kennis en werkervaring.
  • Een vergoeding van € 1.000,- voor het inrichten van jouw thuiswerkplek, waarmee je een bureau, stoel, beeldscherm, headset etc. kunt aanschaffen. Je krijgt een telefoon en laptop in bruikleen;
  • Verschillende mogelijkheden om kennis uit te bouwen via cursussen, trainingen en opleidingen, waaronder een ontwikkelprogramma voor medioren en teamleidersprogramma;
  • Sportieve activiteiten, spelletjesmiddagen en een persoonlijke coach, naast een stoelmasseur.
  • De mogelijkheid om nieuwe technieken eigen te maken en te onderzoeken hoe die toegepast kunnen worden.
  • Een mobiliteitsregeling, een OV-jaarkaart (1e klas) of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

Bij Furore gaat het om meer dan alleen een baan. Het gaat om een kans om impact te maken en een bijdrage te leveren aan de zorg en wetenschap. xgiwjmb Ben jij klaar voor deze uitdaging?

title: o9 Global Test Lead
description:
Job Description

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.

You will be a senior testing leader within the Mondelēz International Digital & Technology organization, responsible for leading end-to-end quality assurance and testing activities across large-scale transformation programs, including the o9 Enterprise Operations Planning (EOP) platform rollout. You will own the testing strategy, manage testing cycles, and drive quality outcomes across multiple workstreams and regional stakeholders in the CPG industry.

How you will contribute

You will lead the test management function for o9 EOP and other large transformation programs, ensuring that quality is built into every stage of delivery. Working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and platform vendors, you will define and execute a robust testing framework that covers functional, regression, integration, performance, and UAT testing. Specifically, you will:

• Define and own the end-to-end test strategy, test plans, and testing governance framework for large-scale ERP and planning transformation programs, including o9 Wave deployments across NALA, MEU, and AMEA.

• Lead and manage all testing phases including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Regression Testing, Performance Testing, and Go-Live readiness validation.

• Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks using Selenium and TOSCA, ensuring maximum test coverage and reusability across program cycles.

• Track and manage testing cycles end-to-end — including test case creation, defect logging, triage, resolution tracking, and exit criteria sign-off — using industry-standard test management tools.

• Manage relationships with multiple stakeholders including business leads, process owners, technical architects, and vendor teams, ensuring alignment on quality standards, timelines, and testing outcomes.

• Establish and maintain defect management processes, ensuring timely escalation, prioritization, and resolution of critical defects in collaboration with development and platform teams.

• Lead UAT exit approval processes, coordinating with business stakeholders to secure sign-offs and document test completion evidence for program governance.

• Drive continuous improvement in testing practices by introducing automation, optimizing test cycles, and reducing manual testing effort over time.

• Provide regular test status reporting to program leadership and key stakeholders, including metrics on test execution progress, defect trends, and risk indicators.

• Coach and mentor testing analysts and junior team members, fostering a quality-first culture across delivery teams.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

• Leading quality assurance and testing workstreams for large-scale ERP, supply chain, or enterprise platform transformation programs in the CPG or FMCG industry.

• Hands-on expertise with test automation tools, specifically Selenium (for web-based UI automation) and TOSCA (Tricentis) for end-to-end test automation and continuous testing.

• Test management tools such as JIRA/Zephyr, ALM (HP Quality Center), Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms for managing test cases, cycles, and defect tracking.

• Designing and executing SIT, UAT, regression, and performance testing strategies for complex, multi-system landscapes including ERP (SAP), planning platforms (o9, IBP), and integrated non-SAP applications.

• Stakeholder management — communicating testing status, risks, and quality outcomes clearly to both technical teams and senior business leadership across multiple regions and functions.

• Driving UAT processes including test scenario design with business users, defect triage sessions, exit criteria definition, and formal sign-off procedures.

• Agile and waterfall delivery methodologies, with the ability to adapt testing approaches to program context.

• Working in global, matrixed organizations with geographically distributed teams and multiple vendor partners.

• Risk-based testing approaches — identifying critical test scenarios and prioritizing coverage based on business impact.

• Building and maintaining reusable test asset libraries that accelerate future testing cycles and regression runs.


More about this role


What you need to know about this position:

• This role is a key leadership position within the o9 EOP program and will support UAT, SIT, and Go-Live testing activities across all wave deployments.

• The Testing Lead will coordinate closely with the Solution Architect, Integration teams, Business Process Owners, and the o9 vendor team to ensure full end-to-end test coverage.

• The role requires strong organizational skills to manage parallel testing workstreams across multiple regions and business functions simultaneously.

• This position sits within the Digital & Technology function and reports into the o9 Program Leadership / Quality Assurance Lead.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

• Experience testing o9 Solutions, SAP IBP, SAP S/4HANA, or equivalent enterprise supply chain and planning platforms.

• Familiarity with supply chain planning processes — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP, Trade Promotion Management (TPM) — and the ability to translate business scenarios into effective test cases.

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Develops practices, with experience integrating automated tests into build and release pipelines.

• Exposure to AI-powered testing tools or intelligent test automation practices is a plus.

• Experience with data validation testing — including master data, transactional data, and integration payload verification across system boundaries.


Education / Certifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. An engineering background is strongly preferred.

• ISTQB certification (Foundation, Advanced Test Manager, or Agile Tester) is highly desirable.

• Trecentist TOSCA certification (e.g., TOSCA Automation Specialist Level 1 or 2) is a strong advantage.

• SAP or o9 functional knowledge certifications are a plus.

• Project Management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe) are beneficial given the stakeholder and program management scope of this role.

Job specific requirements:

• Minimum 8–10 years of experience in QA and software testing roles, with at least 4–5 years in a test lead or test manager capacity on large transformation programs.

• Proven track record of successfully leading UAT exit approvals and Go-Live readiness validations for enterprise platform programs.

• Demonstrated experience managing and reporting to senior stakeholders across business and IT in a global CPG or FMCG environment.

• Strong hands-on experience with both Selenium and TOSCA automation frameworks is mandatory.

Travel requirements:

• Occasional travel may be required to support regional testing activities and stakeholder workshops across NALA, MEU, and AMEA.





No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.

We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as Oreo, belVita and LU biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Sour Patch Kids candy and Trident gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.

Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.

title: Sekretariatschef til Ældre og Sundhed, Aalborg Kommune
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for et stærkt sekretariat – og være med til at skabe sammenhæng mellem politiske ambitioner, strategisk udvikling og den daglige drift på et af kommunens vigtigste velfærdsområder?

Ældre- og sundhedsområdet står midt i store forandringer. Med ældreloven og sundhedsreformen ændres rammerne for fremtidens nære sundhedsvæsen. I Aalborg Kommune er udgangspunktet stærkt. Ældre og Sundhed er kendetegnet ved høj faglighed, betydelig udviklingskraft og en organisation, der gennem en årrække har været på forkant med udviklingen.

Som sekretariatschef får du en central rolle i at understøtte den politiske og administrative ledelse og skabe sammenhæng på tværs af Ældre og Sundhed. Du bliver en tæt sparringspartner for ældre- og sundhedschefen og indgår i en chefgruppe, hvor fælles ansvar, samarbejde og helhedssyn er afgørende.

Du overtager et velfungerende sekretariat med dygtige, selvstændige og engagerede medarbejdere. Her er høj faglighed, stærke relationer og stor lyst til at udvikle nye løsninger. Din opgave bliver derfor ikke at bygge noget op fra bunden, men at videreudvikle det stærke fundament. Særligt skal du styrke sekretariatets nærhed til driftsområderne, skabe tydelige prioriteringer og sikre, at de mange kompetencer bringes i spil, hvor de skaber størst værdi.

Du skal blandt andet:

  • lede og udvikle sekretariatet med tillid, tydelighed og nærvær og skabe fælles retning blandt stærke og selvstændige fagligheder
  • sikre kvalificeret politisk og administrativ betjening med høj kvalitet i beslutningsoplæg, sagsfremstillinger og økonomiske prioriteringer
  • være en tæt og tillidsvækkende sparringspartner for ældre- og sundhedschefen og bidrage aktivt til chefgruppens fælles ledelsesansvar
  • styrke samarbejdet mellem sekretariatet og driftsområderne og bidrage til at omsætte de store reformer til konkret praksis
  • varetage det overordnede ledelsesansvar for Videnscenter for Demens og understøtte centrets fortsatte udvikling.

Hvem er du?

Du har solid erfaring med ledelse af en sekretariats-, stabs- eller konsulentfunktion og er vant til at navigere i en politisk styret organisation. Du har erfaring med politisk betjening, økonomistyring og strategisk udvikling og forstår samspillet mellem politiske prioriteringer, administration og drift. Kendskab til ældre- og sundhedsområdet er en fordel.

Som leder sætter du retning uden at detailstyre. Du skaber følgeskab gennem tillid, nærvær og tydelige forventninger og trives med at lede medarbejdere, der både kan og vil selv. Du har politisk tæft, organisatorisk forståelse og blik for helheden. Du er relations stærk, lyttende og samarbejdsorienteret, men også i stand til at prioritere og stå fast, når det er nødvendigt. Og så ser du dig selv som en del af et hold – både i sekretariatet og i den samlede chefgruppe.

Sekretariatet har 16 medarbejdere, og du får desuden det overordnede ansvar for Videnscenter for Demens med ca. 65 medarbejdere og egen leder. Du refererer til ældre- og sundhedschef Henrik Ravn.

Arbejdsstedet er Storemosevej 19, 9310 Vodskov.

Næste step?

Du kan læse meget mere om stillingen i det uddybende stillingsnotat her.

Søg stillingen via dette link.

Aalborg Kommune samarbejder med Mercuri Urval om rekrutteringen. Vil du vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte Carsten Gløvermose Nielsen, Partner og direktør i Mercuri Urval, på tlf. 3025 9801 eller ældre- og sundhedschef Henrik Ravn på tlf. 2520 3800.

Ansøgningsfrist er den 2. december 2026. Første samtalerunde afholdes 9. december og anden samtalerunde 16. december.

Forventet tiltrædelse er 1. februar 2027.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Efter gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Forud for endelig ansættelse skal der foreligge en straffeattest og indhentes referencer.

Send ansøgning:

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem.

Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder - Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.

Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

title: Team Lead Software Engineering Real Time Data
description:
Heb jij een passie voor software engineering en real-time dataverwerking, en weet je technische richting te combineren met leiderschap? Breng jij diepgaande technische expertise mee én krijg je energie van het ontwikkelen van mensen, het maken van keuzes en het vertalen van strategie naar schaalbare oplossingen? Kom in beweging en versterk Nederlandse Loterij als Team Lead Software Engineering Real Time Data.



Om te solliciteren, leest u eenvoudig de volgende functieomschrijving door en zorgt u ervoor dat u relevante documenten bijvoegt.

Data staat centraal in alles wat we doen. Data ondersteunt steeds meer bedrijfskritische toepassingen, waaronder personalisatie, verantwoord spelen, fraudepreventie, anti-witwasmaatregelen en naleving van wet- en regelgeving. Daardoor nemen ook de eisen aan datakwaliteit, stabiliteit, veiligheid en technische diepgang toe.


Als Team Lead Software Engineering Real Time Data ben je de inhoudelijke en inspirerende technische leider van het team achter het Real Time Data Platform van Nederlandse Loterij. Je verbindt de strategie van Data Management en de organisatiebrede architectuur met de dagelijkse uitvoering. Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de technische richting, platformarchitectuur en codekwaliteit en zorgt dat oplossingen schaalbaar, veilig, transparant, beheersbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn.


Daarnaast ben je de leidinggevende en HR-vertegenwoordiger voor de teamleden. Je ondersteunt hun ontwikkeling, functioneren, inzetbaarheid en samenwerking en creëert een omgeving waarin mensen verantwoordelijkheid nemen en kunnen groeien.


Je blijft als lead engineer actief betrokken bij het bouwen en draaiende houden van het platform, doorgaans 50% van je tijd. Niet om zelf alle complexe vraagstukken op te lossen, maar om context en betrokkenheid te behouden, voorbeeldgedrag te tonen en het vakmanschap van het hele team te versterken. De rest van de tijd verdeel je over je HR-verantwoordelijkheden en verder brengen van de architectuur van het platform.


Als Team Lead scoor je door:



  • de organisatiebrede data- en technologiearchitectuur vertalen naar een duidelijke technische koers voor het Real Time Data Platform. Je leidt ontwerpbeslissingen over cloud-native softwarecomponenten, event streams, API’s, integratiepatronen en operationele betrouwbaarheid. Daarbij bewaak je dat oplossingen schaalbaar, testbaar, veilig en goed beheerbaar zijn en stem je keuzes af met architecten, de Technical Product Owner en betrokken teams.
  • bijdragen aan het ontwerpen, bouwen, testen en beheren van cloud-native softwareoplossingen voor real-time dataverwerking. Je zorgt ervoor dat data uit verschillende bronsystemen betrouwbaar, veilig en schaalbaar wordt verwerkt en beschikbaar komt voor bedrijfskritische toepassingen binnen Nederlandse Loterij.
  • hands-on werken met technologieën en patronen zoals Python, Kafka/Event Hubs, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, API’s, Terraform, CI/CD, observability en event-driven softwareontwikkeling. Je helpt het team om robuuste, goed testbare en onderhoudbare oplossingen te bouwen die ook onder hoge belasting betrouwbaar blijven functioneren.
  • engineering best practices neer te zetten en te bewaken voor onder andere codekwaliteit, testbaarheid, documentatie, code reviews, observability, security en operationele prestaties. Je schrijft infrastructure as code en automatiseert bouwen, testen en uitrollen via CI/CD-pipelines.
  • technische risico’s, afhankelijkheden en technical debt zichtbaar te maken en samen met de Technical Product Owner te prioriteren, waarbij jullie continu de juiste balans bewaken tussen businessprioriteiten, noodzakelijke platforminvesteringen, continuïteit, technische verbetering en het beheersen van technical debt.
  • engineers te coachen en te ondersteunen met feedback, mentoring, pair programming en kennisdeling en een open, veilige en lerende cultuur te creëren waarin mensen steeds meer zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid nemen.

En ook dit wil je vast weten: het Real Time Data Platform Team bouwt en beheert het real-time dataplatform van Nederlandse Loterij. Dit platform verwerkt grote hoeveelheden events en maakt betrouwbare real-time data beschikbaar voor teams en toepassingen binnen de organisatie. Daarmee ondersteunen we bedrijfskritische processen rondom onder andere verantwoord spelen, fraudepreventie, anti-witwasmaatregelen, rapportages en operationele dataproducten. De nadruk ligt op softwareontwikkeling voor real-time dataverwerking: van event-driven integraties en API’s tot serverless componenten, monitoring en geautomatiseerde deployments. We bouwen schaalbare, veilige en goed beheerbare oplossingen, zodat de organisatie kan vertrouwen op tijdige en correcte data.


Je rapporteert aan de Head of Data Management en werkt dagelijks nauw samen met de Technical Product Owner. Samen werken jullie aan de technische roadmap en bewaken jullie een realistische balans tussen nieuwe functionaliteit, continuïteit en duurzame technische verbetering.


Samen werken, samen winnen

Nederlandse Loterij is dé betrouwbare kansspelorganisatie van Nederland. Met acht sterke merken zijn we marktleider en expert op het gebied van verantwoord, eerlijk en veilig spelen. Vrijwel onze volledige opbrengst gaat naar een gelukkig, gezond en sportief Nederland. Naast een kansspelorganisatie met een maatschappelijke rol zijn we natuurlijk ook een werkgever. Binnen onze organisatie werken meer dan 500 toptalenten.


Door samen te werken en samen te winnen, is er altijd reden om te juichen. Binnen Technology helpen we elkaar presteren en gaan we voor gezamenlijk succes. Onze verschillen maken ons samen sterk. Beweging? Dat zit in ons DNA. Jij en je collega’s voelen je thuis in een omgeving waarin geen dag hetzelfde is.


De verschillende mensen die hier werken zijn graag in beweging, ontwikkelen zichzelf continue en gaan voor de winst. Dat maakt iedereen binnen Nederlandse Loterij tot een toptalent.


Jouw talent is een optelsom van:



  • een afgeronde HBO- of WO opleiding
  • brede, aantoonbare ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, data engineering of platform engineering binnen een cloudomgeving, bij voorkeur met real-time dataverwerking, event-driven architectuur of backend-systemen.
  • sterke kennis van Python en moderne software-engineeringprincipes, aangevuld met ervaring in Azure, CI/CD, DevOps, Terraform, API-ontwikkeling, observability en databases zoals SQL en NoSQL. Ervaring met Kafka, Event Hubs, Azure Functions of Cosmos DB is een sterke pré.
  • het vermogen om complexe ontwerpdiscussies te leiden, technische richting te geven, heldere besluiten te nemen en strategische doelen te combineren met pragmatische voortgang.
  • aantoonbare coachende en leidinggevende ervaring. Je creëert een cultuur van vakmanschap, verantwoordelijkheid en leren, geeft eerlijke en constructieve feedback en voert ook lastige gesprekken zorgvuldig.
  • organisatorische sensitiviteit en communicatieve kracht. Je werkt effectief samen met engineers, Product Owners, architecten, management, HR en businessstakeholders en kunt complexe onderwerpen op verschillende niveaus uitleggen.

Daarnaast neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor het gezamenlijke resultaat en breng je actief verandering tot stand wanneer techniek, processen, besluitvorming of samenwerking daarom vragen. Je werkt analytisch, leert nieuwe concepten snel en combineert daadkracht met reflectie. Ook bij tegenslag of onduidelijkheid houd je focus en help je het team obstakels te overwinnen en steeds zelfstandiger technische verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.


Als Team Lead Software Engineering Real Time Data bieden we jou:



  • een salaris dat ligt tussen €5.500,- en €7.800,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring
  • een interessante bonusregeling
  • een functie voor 32 - 40 uur per week
  • voor €3,25 geniet je van een gezonde en gevarieerde lunch in ons bedrijfsrestaurant

Ons kantoor in Rijswijk is in principe de plek waar jij je werk doet, maar je werkt vooral op een plek die het beste past bij wat je doet. xgiwjmb Bekijk hieronder welke arbeidsvoorwaarden jij nog meer kan verwachten.

title: Data Engineer met Maatschappelijke Impact & Groei
description:
Klimaatroute in Amsterdam zoekt een ervaren Data Engineer om het datalandschap verder vorm te geven en data-oplossingen te bouwen. Je krijgt de kans om een significante impact te maken in de verduurzaming van Nederland en werkt nauw samen met diverse teams om inzichtelijke rapportages te ontwikkelen.

title: Workplace Experience Ambassador
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.


Job Description

Our goal is to be the most welcoming and friendly place to work ; our people deliver this with a fun and caring attitude. Our Workspace Experience Ambassadors build a sense of community within the workspace & create memorable experiences through supporting colleagues and their work, regardless of where that is.

Joining our team as a Workspace Experience Ambassador, you will help build and lead a supportive and social place, where we can all be at our best. To achieve this, the Ambassador creates a welcoming atmosphere and is the primary point of contact for all employees and their visitors. The core focus is to be an unrivalled experience creator for all colleagues, build long term relationships, and use workspace data to enhance the workspace experience.


We always:

  • Choose to be happy and care about the happiness of others.
  • Are open and true to ourselves and others.
  • Are accountable and care about facing challenges and owning them.
  • Care about being engaged in heart and mind.
  • Provide an exceptional hospitality experience at every touch point.
  • Care about performance and solutions.
  • Care to praise and acknowledge success.
  • Care about our environment and our future.

What this job involves:

  • Deliver an exceptional customer experience to our client
  • Create a welcoming, first-class atmosphere for client and visitors.
  • Support the client’s App by updating the latest information for a digitalized customer experience with content management and system uploading.
  • Take ownership of digitalized services that support client within the workplace.
  • Maintain the space at a high standard and support way finding and Content Screen management for collaboration and common area across scattered business partners and functions.
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders & encourage interaction between colleagues.
  • Drive and develop the community by organising engaging, popular events.
  • Understand the needs of the business or businesses you support
  • Create a culture of community well-being, supporting and guiding client through the challenges & opportunities of the new workplace environment

Community engagement:

  • Deliver an exceptional experience to our colleagues to enable them to flourish. Create a welcoming, first-class atmosphere for colleagues and their visitors.
  • Take ownership of all services within the hybrid workspace. Proactive attitude and delivery to enhance the service offering. Ensure that the space is maintained to a high standard and have minimal complaints.
  • Build relationships and encourage interaction between colleagues. Drive and develop the community by organising engaging, popular events and map the participation.
  • Understand the needs of the business and what drives the businesses you support.
  • Create a culture of Community Well Being, supporting and guiding colleagues through the challenges & opportunities of the new workspace environment.
  • Support and collaborate with other Experience Ambassador to deliver the shared vision.

Content and events

  • Building a concious community through a local event calendar (align to the regional calendar).
  • Synergise event initiatives and messaging on shared goals with ERGs, HR, and contractors.
  • Drive collaboration and partnerships across a range of different industries through the community calendar – E.g., craft-making workshops with a distributor, yoga sessions with an influential instructor etc.
  • Immerse yourself within the work profile of each business to communicate and promote events and offerings to enhance the community engagement.
  • Gatekeeper of the digital signage and communication displays.
  • Contribute to monthly newsletter to connect with users and to promote community activities.
  • Work alongside the Catering and Events team to brainstorm, plan and organise events, relating to the community’s interests.
  • Develop an engaging content plan, including blog pieces, articles, social media posts, newsletters, and videos and ensure events are consistently promoted in a timely manner.
  • Work with the communications team to create event collateral and promotion materials for events in a timely manner.
  • Engage with the online community and respond to comments and requests.
  • Take ownership of resolving issues and providing a personal follow-up as necessary
  • Responsible for maintaining up to date Customer journeys and to map service standards.


Technology:

  • Work with BI&T team toIntroduce innovative technical solutions to increase Customer Experience, to increase engagement with events and to demonstrate efficiency through these tech solutions.

Desired or preferred experience and technical skills:

  • Have outstanding confidence and strong networking skills.
  • Have a passion for and understanding of the Future of Work (FoW) model.
  • Have a great sense of teamwork, accountability, mindfulness, and the willingness to go the extra mile for the users and your team.
  • Have strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Understand how to interpret and use feedback to increase service levels and enhance key touch points. Be competent in translating feedback data.
  • Be knowledgeable about current and future technology resources that are available in the industry to offer an enhanced hybrid service.
  • Be exceptionally organised and well-versed in multitasking
  • Be able to handle pressure, think quickly and calmly.
  • Have an energetic, cheerful, and outgoing personality.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in customer service, events, sales, or related industries
  • Prior experience in co-working, corporate real estate or start-up experience would be an advantage.
  • Proficient computer skills such as MS office and email etiquette.
  • Flexible to work in shifts or occasionally out of hours when requested
  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written).
  • Good negotiation skills, coordination, and networking capability.

Location:

On-site –Hong Kong, SAR, China

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Design Manager

What this job involves:

Pillar of the team

Working closely with either the project manager or the project manager (or both), you’ll play a pivotal role in driving project success. You’ll take ownership of small projects, and provide a boost to the major ones. Being one of the leaders at the helm, you’ll explore ways to bring out the best in your team by striving to ensure optimal outcomes for all stakeholders. Likewise, you’ll play a lead role in managing the organisational structure for each project, making sure that all reporting, communication and working procedures are streamlined, and that every project has clear objectives in place.

Your attendance at project meetings is necessary, and you’ll be expected to create project-related reports, analyses and reviews. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail is crucial; this role needs someone who is good at forecasting project expenditure and ensuring effective management of project budgets.

Building strong client relationships

We live and breathe client satisfaction. We therefore need someone who shares the same passion and dedication. You’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients by identifying their needs, requirements and constraints.

Of course, as you represent our clients’ best interests, you’ll also keep in mind JLL’s own business needs—and, thereby, strive to achieve an ideal balance between the two. You’ll do so by being on the lookout for opportunities to introduce potential prospects to other business lines at JLL and build relationships with clients. You’ll also see to it that project revenue and payment cycles are properly managed to avoid bad debt.

Upholding excellence in project delivery

For over 200 years, JLL has become synonymous with project success—you will help continue this history of excellence. You’ll manage professional consultants necessary for the design and documentation of the project, as well as carry out contract administration of all vendors professionally and in accordance with legal requirements to protect commercial interests of clients and JLL. You will also help identify project risks and implement measures to mitigate them. Similarly, core to our reputation is our strong focus on health & safety and on sustainability, and you’ll be expected to keep these front-of-mind at all times.

Likewise, you should have a great sense of urgency when it comes to solving problems, improving products or services, finding new markets, and implementing new strategies. You are resilient and can deal effectively with competing priorities and tight deadlines.

Sound like you?

Our successful Project Managers …

  • Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their perspective.
  • Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
  • Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
  • Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
  • Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.

To apply you need to be:

An expert in the field

We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a degree in any property-related discipline, and at least three years of experience in design, construction or project management.

Our project management teams are tech-savvy and digitally enabled. We are the digital leader in project management, so it’s important that you help drive the effective use of JLL technology platforms to deliver our projects.

An empowering colleague

In this role, you’ll work with people of different ranks and responsibilities—that is why the ideal candidate is expected to promote open and constructive relationships with superiors, subordinates, peers and clients. With a healthy drive to succeed, you’ll achieve your goals most effectively when you work together and collaborate.

What we can do for you:

At JLL, our purpose is to shape the future of real estate for a better world.

We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.

Apply today!

title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
Make your mark on one of the world’s largest enterprise networks—grow your engineering career while delivering stable, secure connectivity at global scale.

As an Infrastructure Engineer Associate at JPMorgan Chase within the Corporate Sector, you design and implement data network solutions for corporate sites, retail branches, and ATM connectivity. You partner with engineering, project management, and support teams to drive network delivery from planning through remote execution. You use strong technical expertise and organizational skills to improve stability, supportability, and performance across a large global environment.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Maintain configuration standards, certificate renewals, code upgrades, and risk remediation activities in partnership with business stakeholders
  • Lead end-to-end design and implementation of LAN, WAN, Wi‑Fi, and security solutions for corporate, retail branch, and ATM network connectivity
  • Implement complex network hardware and software configurations through remote execution of changes
  • Analyze production network infrastructure data to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities
  • Develop repeatable processes and documentation to enable consistent global execution of common functions
  • Recommend new network technologies that improve stability, supportability, and performance
  • Validate new configurations prior to implementation, including review and approval of changes where required
  • Partner with global engineering, implementation, and support teams during project turnover to ensure adherence to standards and compliance
  • Coordinate delivery activities with clients, operations personnel, vendors, and contractors to meet business requirements

  • Resolve tier 4 escalations and proactively identify solutions that improve operational efficiency

Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:

  • Demonstrate 7+ years of professional experience working in large-scale enterprise or carrier network environments
  • Possess proven knowledge of routers, Ethernet switches, firewalls, internet appliances, and business applications
  • Apply a detailed understanding of TCP/IP routing protocols, MPLS, NAT, BGP4, OSPF, DNS, firewall policies, geo-load balancing, proxy and cache servers, VPN technologies, layer 4–7 switching, security, QoS, internet protocol telephony, Wi‑Fi, cellular, and network management and monitoring software
  • Maintain advanced knowledge of network operating systems, network equipment, and networking protocols
  • Streamline processes and procedures for executing global data network projects across large device estates
  • Program in at least one language such as Java, Shell, Awk, SQL, PHP, Python, or Perl with a strong base in object-oriented design and development
  • Adhere to professional software engineering practices across the software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
  • Design complex network solutions based on reference architecture and existing standards, and establish new standards when required
  • Execute major implementations and changes by planning work, coordinating resources, and completing remote delivery to expected outcomes
  • Troubleshoot complex issues using packet-level analysis and structured problem-solving approaches

  • Hold CCNP or CCDP certification or demonstrate equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:

  • Hold CCIE certification
  • Demonstrate expert-level knowledge of Cisco routing and switching security techniques including 802.1x, network access control, port security, private VLANs, access control lists, distributed blackholing, unicast reverse path forwarding, DHCP snooping, dynamic ARP inspection, identity services engine, terminal access controller access-control system plus, secure shell, and simple network management protocol
  • Leverage experience developing lab test solutions and performing testing in remote lab facilities to support implementation best practices
  • Apply skills with software-defined wide area networking (SD-WAN), Ansible, and Python to support automation and consistent execution
  • Bring experience working in the financial services industry

title: Fagligt stærk og helhedsorienteret sagsbehandler til vores Ydelsesteam
description:
Vil du gøre en forskel for borgere i Herlev Kommune og brænder du for korrekt sagsbehandling, god service og et tæt samarbejde på tværs af fagområder?
Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Ydelsesteamet.

Hos Herlev Kommune prioriterer vi medarbejdernes udvikling og faglige vækst og nu har du muligheden for at blive en del af et team, hvor både faglighed og trivsel er i centrum.

Om Ydelsesteamet

Ydelsesteamet består af i alt 7 medarbejdere, herunder én faglig leder. Teamet arbejder med en bred pallette af myndighedsopgaver inden for forsørgelsesområdet og har et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor sparring, læring og fælles retning er centrale elementer i hverdagen.

Hver medarbejder har sin egen sagsstamme, inden for områderne: kontanthjælp, pension og enkeltydelser.

Du bliver en del af en enhed med en bred og varieret opgaveportefølje. Vi forventer ikke, at du mestrer alle fagområder fra dag ét. Til gengæld bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor kollegerne hver især har specialiseret viden inden for forskellige områder og står klar til at understøtte din faglige udvikling og oplæring.

Vi lægger stor vægt på fælles faglighed på tværs af teamet. Det betyder, at vi løfter opgaverne i fællesskab, deler viden og hjælper hinanden, så borgerne oplever en sammenhængende og kvalificeret indsats – uanset hvem i teamet borgeren møder.

Du vil blive en aktiv del af teamets faglige fællesskab, hvor vi både forventer og understøtter, at man løbende udvikler sig og bidrager til den fælles kvalitet i opgaveløsningen.

Dine opgaver

Du vil bl.a. komme til at arbejde med:

  • Behandling af ansøgninger om hjælp til forsørgelse og enkeltydelser
  • Opfølgning i sager i tæt samarbejde med jobcentret og andre fagområder
  • Supplementsberegninger, udbetalinger og administrationssager
  • Behandling af klager over afgørelser
  • Sagsbehandling på tværs af forsørgelsesydelser og pension

Vi sikrer grundig oplæring, så du trygt kan sætte dig ind i nye områder, hvis du ikke allerede kender dem.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med sagsbehandling på ét eller flere ydelsesområder (fx kontanthjælp, fleksløntilskud, ledighedsydelse, enkeltydelser eller pension)
  • Kan oversætte lovgivning til et klart og forståeligt sprog
  • Arbejder systematisk, kvalitetsbevidst og med blik for helheden i borgerens sag
  • Kan balancere selvstændighed med samarbejde og bidrager positivt til teamets udvikling
  • Har lyst til at indgå i en fællesfaglig retning, hvor vi lærer af hinanden på tværs
  • Derudover vil det være en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til KY, KP og SBSYS, men ikke et krav

Vi tilbyder

  • Fleksibel arbejdstid og mulighed for at arbejde hjemme når det passer med driften.
  • Grundig introduktion, personlig onboardingplan og fast makker i opstartsperioden.
  • Moderne lokaler i Herlev Bymidte.
  • Fokus på trivsel, humor og en uformel omgangstone.
  • Faglig udvikling, faste sparringsmøder og tværgående samarbejde
  • Frugtordning – så energien følger med dagen igennem

Organisatorisk er vi en del af jobcenteret og er forankret som del af Jobservice, hvis målgruppe er de jobparate, dagpengemodtagere og fleksjobområdet. Vi arbejder hver dag sammen om at skabe de bedste løsninger for borgerne. Selvom vi har forskellige fagområder, ser vi os som ét samlet hold med et fælles ansvar for kerneopgaven.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer. Løn og ansættelse følger gældende overenskomst og principperne om ny løn.
Stillingen ønskes besat 1. januar 2027.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 19. november 2026. Vi forventer at afholde samtaler den 24. og 25. november 2026.

Yderligere oplysninger får du hos faglig leder Dennis Priis på 23 66 19 51.

Herlev Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Mød vores medarbejdere

På kan du møde nogle af vores medarbejdere fra forskellige arbejdspladser i kommunen. De fortæller hver især om, hvad de arbejder med, og hvorfor de er glade for deres arbejde.

Søg stillingen

Du søger stillingen online. Husk at vedhæfte din ansøgning, CV og andre relevante bilag. Når du har sendt ansøgningen, modtager du en e-mail som kvittering. Vær opmærksom på, at mailen kan være placeret i din mappe ”Spam/uønsket post”.

Om Herlev

Herlev er placeret i hjertet af hovedstadsområdet med en velfungerende infrastruktur. Transportmulighederne til og fra Herlev er gode med s-togsstation, busser og fire letbanestationer i byen. Samtidig byder Herlev på let adgang til grønne områder. Vi er i fuld gang med at udvikle byen, så den også i fremtiden har et levende handelsliv, en spændende bymidte og er attraktiv at bo og drive virksomhed i.

I Herlev Kommune arbejder vi ambitiøst og målrettet på at sikre, at vores tilbud til borgerne også i fremtiden er på et højt niveau. Det gør vi ved at indrette organisationen med et større fokus på at styrke fagligheden og understøtte dialogen med borgerne, samt forkorte afstanden mellem det lokale politiske niveau og kommunens medarbejdere.

title: Brug din faglighed til at udvikle praksis – bliv fagkoordinator på Othello
description:
Vil du være med til at styrke den faglige kvalitet, udvikle praksis og skabe endnu bedre hverdage for beboerne? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Othello Plejehjem søger to sundhedsuddannede medarbejdere til nyoprettede stillinger som fagkoordinatorer. Her får du mulighed for at bringe din faglighed i spil på nye måder, understøtte dine kolleger og være med til at sætte retning for den faglige udvikling på tværs af huset – helt i tråd med den nye Ældrelov.

I tæt samarbejde med afdelingslederne skal du være med til at omsætte faglig viden til god praksis, skabe sammenhæng i helhedsplejen og sikre, at vi lærer af hinanden i hverdagen. Du får en central rolle i at styrke kvaliteten i pleje og omsorg – både gennem faglig sparring og ved selv at være tæt på praksis.

Du skal ikke vælge mellem faglig udvikling og nærvær med beboerne. Hos os får du mulighed for begge dele. Cirka en tredjedel af din arbejdstid vil være knyttet til opgaver i praksis, hvor du sammen med kollegerne kan omsætte faglig viden til handling.

Othello er midt i en spændende udvikling, hvor vi sammen skaber en fælles faglig retning og en arbejdsplads, hvor både beboere og medarbejdere trives. Du bliver en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi tør stille spørgsmål ved vaner, dele vores erfaringer og finde bedre løsninger sammen.

Vi søger dig, der har lyst til at tage fagligt ansvar, skabe følgeskab gennem dialog og gøre en konkret forskel for både beboere og kolleger.

Fagkoordinatorens opgaver
Fagkoordinatorerne skal samarbejde med ledelsen om faglige prioriteringer, arbejdsgange og læring. Fagkoordinatorerne har en særlig rolle i forhold til følgende ansvarsområder:

Faglig sparring og vejledning
Du er en tilgængelig faglig sparringspartner for kollegerne. Du bidrager til refleksion over konkrete situationer, deler viden og understøtter faglige vurderinger med respekt for kollegernes erfaringer og kompetencer.

Kvalitet og faglige arbejdsgange
Du er med til at omsætte retningslinjer og ny faglig viden til hverdagspraksis. Du understøtter god dokumentation, følger op på kvalitetsinitiativer og hjælper med at skabe fælles arbejdsgange på tværs af huset.

Læring og kompetenceudvikling
Du bidrager til introduktion af nye kolleger, deler viden og skaber muligheder for læring i det daglige arbejde. På sigt kan du også få en rolle som tovholder på beboerkonferencer.

Sammenhængende pleje med beboeren i centrum
Du hjælper med at forbinde faglig kvalitet med beboernes ønsker, vaner og livshistorier. Du er med til at sikre, at faglig udvikling ikke bliver et mål i sig selv, men skaber mærkbar værdi i beboernes hverdag.

Vil du møde os? Kom til "Åbent Hus", onsdag d. 4. november 2026 kl. 15 – 16. Mød blot op, og vi er klar til dialog over en kop kaffe.

Hvem leder vi efter?
Du er sundhedsuddannet og har lyst til at bruge din faglighed på nye måder. Måske har du allerede erfaring med faglig vejledning, oplæring eller kvalitetsarbejde. Måske er du den erfarne kollega, som andre naturligt søger sparring hos, og som har lyst til at tage næste skridt.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • har en stærk faglig interesse og lyst til at omsætte viden til god praksis
  • kan formidle faglig viden på en forståelig og respektfuld måde – både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • trives med at vejlede kolleger og skabe læring gennem dialog og refleksion
  • arbejder systematisk og følger op på aftaler og opgaver
  • kan skabe overblik og bevare roen, også når hverdagen er travl
  • er nysgerrig på nye metoder og har mod på at udfordre vaner på en konstruktiv måde
  • samarbejder godt på tværs og kan se værdien i fælles arbejdsgange og faglige standarder
  • møder beboere, kolleger og pårørende med respekt, nærvær og en positiv tilgang
  • fortrolig med daglig journalføring.

Det vigtigste er din faglighed, din lyst til at lære og din evne til at få andre med. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Vi lægger vægt på, at du er nysgerrig, tager ansvar og har lyst til at udvikle rollen sammen med kollegerne og ledelsen.

Hvad får du hos os?

  • Faste sparringsmøder med afdelingslederne og netværk mellem de to fagkoordinatorer

title: Internship - Commercial Development | CM Navigator
description:
Got a commercial mindset, a curious brain and an appetite for making things happen?

Ever wondered how you turn a promising conversation into an actual customer? Or what it takes to open doors in international shipping and commodity markets?

At CM Navigator, you'll get to find out. By doing it, not just watching.

You'll join our commercial team, working with real customers, real opportunities and a digital market intelligence platform used by commodity traders around the world.

And while Navigator will be your home base, you'll also be part of the wider Copenhagen Merchants Group – spanning brokerage, shipping, terminals, logistics, plant proteins and energy.

Quite a universe to explore. Especially if you have a little Merchanteer in you.

What you'll be doing

Your work will sit at the intersection of people, markets, technology and commercial opportunities.

You'll learn how B2B sales and business development work in practice – from identifying potential customers to starting conversations, understanding their needs and helping turn interest into business.

Your work will include:

  • Identifying and researching potential customers across global shipping and commodity markets

  • Reaching out to prospects through phone, email and LinkedIn

  • Qualifying opportunities and arranging meetings and product demonstrations

  • Joining customer conversations and gradually taking the lead in some of them

  • Following market developments and spotting opportunities to start new conversations

  • Taking ownership of a smaller commercial project, such as exploring a new market or customer segment

You'll have clear goals, experienced colleagues to learn from and regular feedback along the way.

Some days, you'll open doors. Other days, you'll discover why they stay closed. Both are part of learning the commercial craft.

And yes, your work can actually help bring new customers into CM Navigator.

Who we're looking for

Got curiosity, initiative and a natural interest in people and business?

You don't need previous sales experience or an existing network in shipping and commodities. We'll help you build that understanding.

But we hope you:

  • Enjoy meeting people, asking questions and starting conversations

  • Are curious about international trade, markets and commercial opportunities

  • Combine initiative with structure and good follow-through

  • Can handle a "no", learn from it and keep your motivation

  • Communicate clearly and confidently in English

  • Are comfortable with Excel, numbers and digital tools

Experience with sales, student organisations, case competitions or entrepreneurial projects is a plus – but not a requirement.

Above all, we're looking for someone with the potential to become a Merchanteer: curious, commercially minded, good with people and motivated to turn opportunities into action.

What you'll get out of it

Real responsibility. Real customer exposure. And hopefully a considerably sharper commercial instinct.

You'll work alongside experienced sales and product colleagues, receive regular sparring and discover what it takes to develop business in international markets.

You'll also get a look inside the wider Copenhagen Merchants universe – a Danish, family-owned group where relationships, commercial thinking and entrepreneurial spirit are part of everyday life.

We're informal, pragmatic and prefer useful work over corporate theatre.

And yes, we have an octopus as our cultural ambassador, T.W. Heart. You'll understand eventually. Most of us did.

The practical bits

Location: CM Navigator, Pakhus 48, Nordhavn, Copenhagen

Period: Autumn 2027, as part of your CBS IST internship semester.

Eligibility: This internship is exclusively for students enrolled in CBS's BSc in International Shipping and Trade (IST). Applications from other programmes or institutions are not eligible for this particular opening.

Interested?

Upload your CV and a short video introduction (max. 60 seconds).

Tell us what makes you curious about freight markets, international trade and CM Navigator – and why you think we'd enjoy having you on the team.

No studio. No script. Just you.

Project Title: Enhanced Interpretation of GC×GC Measurements Using Density Functional Theory Density Functional Theory (DFT)

Goals and objectives

Comprehensive two-dimensional chromatography (GC×GC) separates hydrocarbons according to molecular size in the first column and polarity in the second column, resulting in a two-dimensional compositional map. For GTL products, Shell has developed specialized classification methods that assign product yields to hydrocarbon families based on carbon number and degree of branching.

At higher carbon numbers, however, molecules with different branching patterns increasingly overlap and can no longer be distinguished reliably. Furthermore, the current classification provides little information on branch location. Such structural information is important for predicting product roperties such as cloud point, pour point, and viscosity, and may provide valuable insights for catalyst development. This project will investigate whether Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations can support the interpretation of GC×GC data and improve hydrocarbon classification. Specific objectives are:

  • Refine the current classification methodology by distinguishing molecular classes that currently overlap, such as tetra- and penta-branched paraffins or ethyl-methyl substituted paraffins.
  • Assess whether highly branched species (e.g., penta-, hexa-, and hepta-branched paraffins) can be identified more reliably, particularly in highly dewaxed products.
  • Explore whether branch-position distributions can be inferred for lower carbon numbers and whether suitable descriptors can be developed to differentiate catalyst performance and selectivity.

This is a senior, highly visible role that sits at the intersection of product strategy, technical architecture, and applied machine learning — shaping how we design, deliver, and scale intelligent systems across our business. While you won’t directly manage a team, you will serve as a senior partner across engineering, product, and clinical organizations — helping set direction, unlock execution, and scale AI/ML impact across our platforms.

Our business is growing. Our customer needs are evolving. And our platform is advancing rapidly, especially as we embed more AI-native capabilities into our products. Today, our AI, GenAI and machine learning capabilities are fueling a new era in healthcare — powering intelligent systems that help people receive care outside the hospital and supporting providers with insights that enable better outcomes and lower costs. With one of the largest actionable datasets in the industry, we’re uniquely positioned to shape how healthcare is delivered across care settings, from home to post-acute to long-term care.

This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, believes architecture is a team sport, and has a proven record of bringing ML and GenAI-driven systems into production at scale.

Location: San Diego (Hybrid)

Let’s talk about the role.

As a Machine Learning Product Architect, you will own the end-to-end architecture of AI/ML/GenAI systems that empower our software products with advanced AI capabilities. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including business product managers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and software engineers to design and implement scalable AI. Your work will enable the integration of model training and inference in production environments, ensuring that both the data source and output are optimized for performance and accuracy. You will also work with leadership to communicate and demonstrate the value and impact of machine learning architectures.

Let's talk about responsibilities.

  • Architect scalable ML and GenAI solutions across model training, inference, and workflow AI automation, ensuring seamless integration across products.
  • Partner with product managers to translate business goals into AI-driven technical solutions that deliver measurable impact.
  • Deliver solutions that balance enterprise standards with bespoke innovation, combining platforms and models to meet both organizational and market needs.
  • Act as a strategic architect, focusing two-thirds on strategic direction and solution design, and one-third on initiative deep dives, team mentorship, and execution acceleration.
  • Lead the creation of Architectural References to demonstrate scalable approaches, reference patterns, and best practices.
  • Provide leadership in MLOps and GenAI infrastructure — model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment frameworks.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to ensure architectures meet the unique needs of different model types (ML, DL, GenAI, multi-modal).
  • Evangelize and promote AI/ML adoption across the organization, serving as a trusted advisor and visible champion of production-ready AI.
  • Evaluate emerging AI, GenAI, and cloud-native technologies; make recommendations for adoption at scale.
  • Define, Collaborate and implement governance, compliance, and security strategies for responsible AI use, ensuring adherence to regulatory and ethical standards.
  • Optimize ML and GenAI workloads for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Serve as the technology scout, evaluating and integrating emerging AI/ML tools and methodologies to evolve our tech stack strategically

Let's talk about qualifications and experience.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field.

title: Senior Product Manager, Global Year-End
description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants. Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe. We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your hiring experience matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive. If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.


The Tax & Year-End area at Shine

The Tax & Year-End area is a brand-new area at Shine with a dual mission: building the pan-European tax & year-end engine, and building a winning product for tax advisors and CPAs in Germany. German accounting and tax is a highly specialized domain, and building the right product requires more than generic product expertise. We need someone who can understand the tax advisory profession in Germany and help us turn that expertise into a stellar product.


Your role as Senior Product Manager, Global Year-End

The Tax & Year-End area is built around two core teams: Global Year-End, which takes accountants from raw books to approved annual accounts, and Global Tax, which takes those approved figures all the way to a filed and accepted tax return.

As Senior Product Manager, Global Year-End, you own the first half of the engine: the closing process. You lead the product side in a cross-functional team of engineers, design and accounting domain experts building a multi-country year-end module, natively integrated with the common ledger underlying Shine and able to run on top of other accounting systems. Germany comes first, with France close behind and Spain next. You will work hand in hand with the Senior PM for Global Tax: your output is their input.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the Global Year-End strategy and roadmap — from closing preparation to signed annual accounts

  • Build the closing workflow — checklists, period locks, review and sign-off between advisor and client, all in one place.

  • Automate the standard adjustments — accruals and deferrals, provisions, inventory and year-end reconciliations, so advisors spend their time on judgement, not data entry.

  • Build one year-end engine, not three products — define what is shared (closing workflow, adjustment framework, statement model) and what is local (GAAP rules, charts of accounts such as SKR03/SKR04, taxonomies, filing formats).

  • Own the handoff to Global Tax — define the contract between approved accounts and tax returns so figures flow through without re-keying.

  • Serve two segments on one engine — a first priority comprehensive solution for tax advisors and CPAs, and a second priority simplified, guided closing for business owners in Shine Micro.

  • Make AI a core capability — anomaly detection in the books, suggested closing entries, automated year-end reconciliations and draft explanations that advisors can review and approve.

  • Run deep discovery with advisors — shadow Kanzleien during closing season, map where time is lost today, and turn that into a sharp, prioritised backlog.

  • Orchestrate across the ecosystem — partner closely with Global Tax, Core Accounting, Advisor, the common ledger teams and the local products in France, Germany and Spain.

What success looks like:

  • German tax advisors close their clients' year end-to-end in Shine, from raw books through to E-Bilanz submission.

  • Time to close per client drops measurably, with a growing share of adjustments suggested automatically and accepted.

  • Approved accounts flow straight into Global Tax with no manual re-entry.

  • The engine architecture is proven multi-country, with France live or in beta on the same foundation.

  • Micro customers can complete a simple year-end on their own with confidence.

📍 Job located in Berlin, Germany with possibility of remote working days


About you
