title: Junior Transaction Monitoring Investigator with German
description:
ING Hubs Poland is hiring!


The expected salary for this position: 6100 - 7500 PLN

The financial ranges specified in the announcement are adjusted and may differ from the range specified in the remuneration regulations.

We are looking for you if:

  • You are interested in developing your career in Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Transaction Monitoring (TM). Previous experience in this area is welcome, but not required,
  • You have strong analytical skills and enjoy working with data, identifying patterns and looking for explanations behind unusual activities,
  • You have attention to detail and are able to review information carefully and draw logical conclusions,
  • You are willing to learn how financial crime, including money laundering and terrorist financing, can occur and how financial institutions work to detect and prevent it,
  • You can clearly explain your conclusions based on the information available and present them in a structured and concise way,
  • You are well organised and able to complete assigned tasks in a timely and accurate manner,
  • You are open to learning, feedback and adapting to new information, processes and changing situations,
  • You have a proactive attitude and are willing to contribute to team and process improvements as you develop your knowledge and experience,
  • You are a real team player and value cooperation and knowledge sharing,
  • You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • German language skills at intermediate level or above,

You'll get extra points for:

  • Any previous experience, internship or educational background related to banking, financial services, AML, KYC, Transaction Monitoring, compliance or financial crime prevention,
  • Basic knowledge or understanding of AML, financial crime or Transaction Monitoring concepts,
  • Relevant AML training, courses or certifications,
  • Experience working with data, conducting research or preparing written analyses and reports.

Your responsibilities:

  • Reviewing Transaction Monitoring alerts and cases and conducting risk-based investigations, with appropriate training and support,
  • Analysing customer and transaction information to identify potentially unusual or suspicious activity,
  • Conducting background research using available internal and external sources,
  • Gathering and reviewing information necessary to understand customer activity,
  • Documenting your analysis, findings and conclusions in a clear and structured manner,
  • Following relevant procedures and quality standards,
  • Cooperating with colleagues and more experienced investigators and actively participating in training and knowledge-sharing activities,
  • Contributing ideas for improvements as you develop your knowledge of the process.

Information about the squad:

The main responsibility of an AML Investigator is to review customers' transactional activity to identify unusual or potentially suspicious behaviour and support the detection and prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing.

You don't need to be an AML or Transaction Monitoring expert when you join us. We are looking for people with strong analytical skills, attention to detail, curiosity and a willingness to learn. Previous AML or banking experience can be an advantage, but it is not essential.

We will make sure you are properly prepared for the role. Every new joiner starts with a comprehensive training programme lasting several weeks, followed by practical on-the-job training and support from experienced colleagues. This will help you gradually build the knowledge and skills needed to conduct Transaction Monitoring investigations independently.

Once you gain experience, you will also have opportunities to broaden your responsibilities and contribute to additional activities, such as process improvements, knowledge sharing and other team initiatives.

One of the development opportunities available to permanent employees working in Transaction Monitoring is a dedicated training programme prepared by ACAMS (Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists). The three-step certification programme consists of Anti-Money Laundering Foundations, Sanctions Foundations and Certified Transaction Monitoring Associate.

It is a great opportunity to build your AML knowledge from the ground up and develop your career in financial crime prevention.

title: MASE Compliance - Compliance Advisor Principal Associate
description:
MASE Compliance - Compliance Advisor Principal Associate

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

In Capital One’s Compliance and Ethics Organization, we support the business in managing regulatory compliance risk through advice and effective challenge. Model, Adverse Action, and Script Enhancement (MASE) Compliance is focused on assessing compliance risk in models and scripts and advising the business on how to manage the identified risk.

Responsibilities:

  • Assessing the regulatory alignment of the logic in specific computer code (script) reviews (in partnership with code experts) for the Code Design Intent Review (CoDIR) process. CoDIR is designed to evaluate the regulatory requirements the script is intended to effectuate and whether the script, as designed, meets that regulatory intent and to report the results of the assessment to the script owner.

  • Collaborate with script owners, business risk offices and compliance partners across the enterprise to ensure regulatory risk stemming from scripts is appropriately managed

  • Engage with the Tech and Data Risk Management team to ensure regulatory risks are appropriately addressed within the Script Governance Standard and platform

  • Provide effective challenge and guidance on compliance risks related to the use of scripts and support lines of business through various interactions and forum engagements

  • Advise lines of business on application of Compliance requirements to the activities executed through the use of computer code/scripts

  • Assist, when necessary, in the assessment of regulatory risk associated with the use of models through the Model Compliance Inherent Risk Assessment (MoCIRA)

  • Identify trends in data and advise on identified emerging risks

  • Maintain subject matter expertise of applicable laws and regulations

  • Engage and respond to inquiries from Internal Audit and Regulatory Examiners covering the scope of regulatory risk stemming from the use of scripts

  • Conduct targeted validations and reviews on scripts that implement controls over applicable regulations

  • Maintain expert understanding of Compliance Risk Management Framework and applicable laws and regulations

  • Assist in capturing, maintaining, and analyzing compliance data, interpreting it to ensure consistency and adequate Compliance Risk Management

The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Strong organizational skills, clear results orientation, and focus on achieving both short and long term goals;

  • Ability to navigate “gray space” or ambiguous situations to drive and execute an agenda in a fluid environment while managing competing priorities;

  • Collaborative, solution-oriented mindset with solid teamwork skills; ability to build and leverage the capabilities of a high-performing team;

  • Highly developed interpersonal, presentation, and communications skills (written and oral) coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal, and negotiation skills;

  • Ability to effectively challenge the first line of defense in a manner that is respectful and geared towards strengthening business initiatives;

  • Successful track record of thriving in both a highly regulated industry and a fast paced, entrepreneurial, and dynamic environment;

  • Ability to balance operating independently with appropriate escalation and interaction with senior leadership;

  • Ability to thrive as a team player and interact with associates across functions, departments, and job levels, both inside and outside the Compliance Department;

  • Understanding of key regulatory and audit requirements and three lines of defense risk management framework;

  • Self starter with proven ability to develop new processes and procedures with little direction; and

  • Strong knowledge of the use of computer code and script to drive business processes.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • At least 2 years of experience in compliance, legal, or audit

  • At least 2 years of experience supporting, partnering, and interacting with internal business clients

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree or Law Degree

  • 4+ years of experience in compliance, legal, or audit

  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist, Certified Information Privacy Professional, Series 7, Series 24, Series 63 or Series 65 certification

title: Senior Software Engineer (Java) - Regulatory and Cross Product Technology, AVP
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Java) - Regulatory and Cross Product Technology, AVP

Location: Pune

Corporate Title: AVP

Role Description

  • Regulatory and Cross Product Technology aims to be an industry leading function that delivers sustainable regulatory compliance through technology automation and competitive operating leverage to create a safe and controlled operating environment that protects the Deutsche Bank franchise and its clients.

Details of the role and how it fits into the team

  • In order to do this, we must ensure that we remain an engineering focused organization. We are looking for technologists who demonstrate a passion to build the right thing in the right way.
  • You will work as part of a cross-functional agile delivery team, including analysts, developers and testers.
  • You will bring an innovative approach to software development, using the latest technologies and practices, as part of a focus on business value. You will be someone who sees engineering as team activity, with a predisposition to open code, open discussion and creating a supportive, collaborative environment. You will be ready to take a leading role in all stages of software delivery, from initial analysis right through to production support. You will have an opportunity to work in an environment that provides continuous growth and learning, with an emphasis excellence and mutual respect.
  • For the next possible date, we are looking for two conscientious and motivated Tech Engineers, who are especially proud of their skills as programmers!

What we’ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • Work as part of a delivery team collaborating with others to understand requirements, analyze and refine stories, design solutions, implement/test them and support them in production
  • Drive and support the prioritization of User Stories and Backlog definition, in order to streamline execution of program priorities while aligning the product with the underlying architecture
  • Write code and write it well. Be proud to call yourself a programmer. You closely collaborate with users, analysts, developers and testers. Use test driven development, write clean code and refactor constantly.
  • Define and evolve the architecture of the components you are working on. Contribute to architectural decisions at a department and bank-wide level.
  • Ensure that the software you build is reliable and easy to support in production. Be prepared to take your turn on call providing 3rd line support when it’s needed
  • Ensure that your team can build, test and release software with short lead times and a minimum of waste. Work to develop and maintain a highly automated Continuous Delivery

Your skills and experience

  • Deep knowledge of Java, the JVM, object orientation and SOLID principles
  • Significant development experience, working within an agile environment and using modern engineering practices
  • Extensive knowledge in modern Javascript frameworks e.g. React, Angular, HTML5, Bootstrap, Node.js. and of the REST principles and associated technologies
  • Experience of Docker and Kubernetes as well as exposure to a range of modern build tools, such as Maven, Jenkins, etc.
  • Using Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery to ensure that changes can be done quickly and safely
  • Understanding of Business Canvas models applied to agile as well as prioritisation techniques such as RICE, MoSCOW, Value vs Effort, Kano model, Story Mapping and Opportunity scoring
  • Extensive knowledge in Financial Services environments, especially around Client KYC Onboarding and Customer Master Data Management.
  • Architecture and design approaches that support rapid, incremental and iterative delivery, such as Domain Driven Design, CQRS, Event Sourcing and Microservices
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and relational databases

Soft skills

  • Help create a culture of learning and continuous improvement within your team and beyond
  • Share skills and knowledge in a wide range for topics relating to software delivery
  • Lead, mentor and teach other engineers

Education/Qualifications

  • We are happy to consider candidates with a wide variety of educational backgrounds and qualifications. Qualifications in computer science, business and economics are beneficial for the role.
  • We also look favorably upon candidates with equivalent practical experience. This could have be gained in the workplace or in other contexts, such as contributing to open source software or working on personal projects.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

About us and our teams

Please visit our company website for further information:

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Studentermedarbejder i Business Finance
description:
Er du i gang med en videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi og ønsker du at prøve dine teoretiske færdigheder af i virkeligheden? Er du skarp, lærenem og har en god forretningsforståelse?

Så er du måske vores nye studentermedhjælper!

Du vil blive en del af finans-funktionen hos HMF, og arbejde tæt sammen med finans-teamet omkring eksempelvis månedsrapportering, analytiske opgaver, samt bogføring. Du vil indgå som en integreret del af teamet, og du vil få stort ansvar fra dag ét.

Som studentermedhjælper i finansafdelingen ved HMF Group A/S får du mulighed for at arbejde med konkrete problemstillinger igennem dit daglige arbejde hos os. Omfanget af stillingen vil som udgangspunkt være 15 timer ugentligt med fleksibilitet omkring eksamensperioder.

Skarp studerende med styr på den teoretiske værktøjskasse

Helt konkret søger vi dig, der har sans for detaljen og trives med at arbejde struktureret med økonomiske data og bogføring. Du forstår vigtigheden af korrekte data og bidrager til at skabe overblik gennem præcist og omhyggeligt arbejde.

Konkrete opgaver som stillingen kan indeholde:

  • Udførelse af bankafstemning og afstemning af interne koncernkonti
  • Vedligeholdelse af forskellige analysefiler samt forberedelse af debitor oversigt
  • Bidrage med diverse administrative og analytiske opgaver afhængigt af behov i finans-teamet
  • Oprettelse af leverandører i ERP-system samt generelle bogføringsopgaver
  • Support på medius faktureringsregistrering og Acubiz First Card bilagsgodkendelse
  • Ad hoc analyser som fx analyse af konkurrenter


Analytisk, struktureret og med stærke sociale kompetencer

Du vil få bred kontakt med mange stakeholders på tværs af organisationen, og derfor er det vigtigt, at du formår at opbygge tillidsfulde relationer og trives i samarbejdet med andre. Det er samtidig en fordel, hvis du har en struktureret og analytisk tilgang til dit arbejde og kan omsætte økonomiske data til konkrete input, der understøtter forretningen – hvad enten det handler om afstemninger, opfølgning eller analyser.

Du er formentlig kendetegnet ved:

  • Du er i gang med en relevant økonomisk uddannelse, f.eks. BSc.oecon., Erhvervsøkonomi (HA), cand.oecon., cand.merc., etc.
  • Du er tillidsvækkende og god til at skabe relationer på tværs af organisationen
  • Du sætter en ære i at levere et professionelt stykke arbejde af høj kvalitet
  • Det er en fordel hvis du kan Excel på et vist niveau, og har kendskab til Dynamics 365, men det er ikke et krav
  • Du er IT-kyndig, og er ikke bange for at kaste dig over nye og ukendte systemer


Er du vores nye kollega?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, eller vil du høre flere gode grunde til, at du skal være vores nye ”Finance student worker”? Så kan du kontakte Finance Student Worker Maja Fjord Kristensen på mfk@hmf.dk.

Send din ansøgning, karakterudskrift og dit CV til os via knappen nedenfor. Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!


Om HMF Group

HMF Group A/S er en af ​​verdens førende kranproducenter inden for lastbilmonterede kraner. Med hovedkvarter i Danmark er vi repræsenteret over hele verden gennem egne datterselskaber, salgs- og servicepartnere. HMF har +500 ansatte og omsatte i 2025 for ca. DKK 985 mio.

title: Data engineer Geo Analytics & KLIC
description:
Als Data Engineer Geo Analytics & KLIC maak je geo- en assetdata betrouwbaar, beschikbaar en bruikbaar. Vanuit ’s-Hertogenbosch werk je aan datastromen die Enexis helpen betere beslissingen te nemen en het energienet toekomstbestendig te houden.


Lees de volgende functieomschrijving zorgvuldig door om er zeker van te zijn dat u de geschikte kandidaat bent voor deze rol voordat u solliciteert.
  • Den Bosch
  • HBO
  • 32 tot 40 uur
  • Salaris tussen € 4.953,- en € 7.076,- bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur per week
  • Inclusief de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden kan je salaris oplopen tot € 9.107,- bruto per maand
Wat ga je doen?

Met jouw energie kan het

  • Je maakt betrouwbare data beschikbaar voor de energietransitie en een robuust energienet.
  • Je werkt op het snijvlak van data, techniek en business en krijgt ruimte om nieuwe ontwikkelingen toe te passen.
  • Je kunt daarbij rekenen op goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een persoonlijk budget, een vitaliteitsbudget en ruimte voor opleidingen.

Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan

Je gaat aan de slag binnen Asset Planning & Performance (APP). Binnen deze beheer- en verbeterketen werken vijf teams aan datagedreven planvorming en het verbeteren van de prestaties van het elektriciteits- en gasnet. Jij wordt onderdeel van Geo Analytics & KLIC (GAK), binnen het domein nettopologie en toegankelijkheid van sensor- en assetdata.

Je zorgt ervoor dat geo- en assetdata uit ons geo-registratiesysteem op de juiste manier worden ontsloten, getransformeerd en geladen naar het Geo Data Warehouse (GDWH). Dit warehouse is onderdeel van het Enexis Data Platform. Zo kunnen collega’s en andere afnemers werken met betrouwbare data. Je bouwt niet alleen nieuwe oplossingen, maar beheert en verbetert ook bestaande datastromen. Daarmee draag je direct bij aan de continuïteit en kwaliteit van onze dataketen.

Tegelijkertijd kijk je vooruit. Je volgt ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data engineering, automatisering en kunstmatige intelligentie. Je onderzoekt hoe AI kan helpen bij het verbeteren van datakwaliteit, het automatiseren van controles en het slimmer voorspellen en beheren van datastromen. Daarbij houd je oog voor betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, uitlegbaarheid en verantwoord gebruik van data en AI.

Dit zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Beheren en doorontwikkelen van ETL-datastromen voor geo- en assetdata.
  • Testen of datastromen en data correct werken na technische en functionele wijzigingen.
  • Bewaken en verbeteren van de datakwaliteit met validatieregels, geautomatiseerde kwaliteitscontroles en monitoring.
  • Analyseren van afwijkingen en bijdragen aan structurele oplossingen.
  • Uitvoeren van DevOps-werkzaamheden, zoals CI/CD, monitoring, logging en incidentopvolging.
  • Samenwerken met stakeholders binnen onder andere Asset Management en Operations.
  • Vragen uit de business vertalen naar passende dataoplossingen.
  • Verbetermogelijkheden signaleren en bijdragen aan een stabielere, snellere en beter voorspelbare dienstverlening.
Functie-eisen

Zo pak jij het aan

Je werkt graag in een complexe technische omgeving en krijgt energie van analyseren, verbeteren en samenwerken. Je begrijpt hoe belangrijk betrouwbare data zijn voor goede besluitvorming en robuuste processen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk, stelt vragen als iets niet duidelijk is en zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega’s en stakeholders. Ook leer je continu van wat jullie opleveren en van wat er in de praktijk beter kan.

Verder heb je:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als data engineer in een complexe omgeving.
  • Ervaring met SQL, DLT, dbt, ETL en AWS.
  • Ervaring met data engineering, automatisering en het ontwikkelen en beheren van datastromen.
  • Kennis van CI/CD, monitoring, logging en geautomatiseerde datakwaliteitscontroles.
  • Ervaring met het analyseren van datakwaliteitsproblemen en het structureel oplossen van afwijkingen.
  • Ervaring met het vertalen van businessvragen naar dataoplossingen.
  • Ervaring binnen de energie-, water- of infrastructuursector of een vergelijkbare sector is een pré.
  • Kennis van Smallworld en/of Spatial Eye is een pré.
  • Interesse in de praktische toepassing van kunstmatige intelligentie binnen data engineering is een pré.
Team & cultuur

Je zet je schouders eronder met

Jouw collega’s van de afdeling Geo Analytics & KLIC. Het team maakt deel uit van Asset Planning & Performance en werkt op het snijvlak van geo-informatie, assetdata, data engineering en IT. Samen zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor zowel ontwikkeling als beheer. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit onder andere Asset Management, Operations en de IT-teams KLIC GAK.

Binnen het team combineren jullie technische kennis met inzicht in de bedrijfsprocessen van Enexis. Jullie delen kennis, pakken incidenten samen op en zoeken steeds naar manieren om de dataketen stabieler, slimmer en beter beheersbaar te maken.

Wat krijg je van ons?

En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou

  • Je ontvangt 28,7% bovenop je salaris: 8% vakantiegeld, een 13e maand van 10,7% en een persoonlijk budget van 10%. Dit kun je laten uitbetalen wanneer je wilt, of je kunt hier extra verlofdagen van kopen.
  • Mogelijkheden om hybride te werken, inclusief een door ons ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 netto per dag.
  • Bijdrage van 70% aan je ABP Keuzepensioen: Enexis betaalt twee derde van de premie, jij draagt een derde bij.
  • Een vitaliteitsbudget van € 700,- bruto per jaar, dat je bijvoorbeeld kunt inzetten voor je sportabonnement, je hobby of om je huis te verduurzamen. Je kunt dit ook opsparen tot € 2.100,- voor je studiekosten of de aflossing van je studieschuld.
  • Ruimte om te groeien met ons interne ontwikkelplatform en/of externe opleidingen en trainingen.
  • Laptop of tablet en telefoon die je ook buiten werktijd mag gebruiken.
  • Een mobiliteitskaart waarmee je eerste klas reist en een reiskostenvergoeding.
  • 24,5 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband.
  • Met je persoonlijk budget en 13e maand koop je tot wel 35,5 extra verlofdagen.
  • Ook hebben we een fietsplan om je te stimuleren vaker voor de fiets te kiezen.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
The Tax team manages the global tax and customs affairs of ASOS, including indirect taxes, customs compliance, direct taxes, transfer pricing, tax governance, risk management, and tax transformation. The team partners closely with Finance, Technology, Supply Chain, Logistics and External Advisors to ensure compliance, manage risk and deliver value across the business., We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help us rethink how data and technology are used across Indirect Tax & Customs. In a high-volume global e-commerce business, tax outcomes are created across millions of transactions and multiple systems spanning customer orders, payments, fulfilment, logistics, customs, returns and finance. We want to connect that data. You'll work directly with Indirect Tax & Customs specialists and with Data, Technology, Finance and Supply Chain teams to build scalable data products, automated controls and analytics that solve real business problems. This isn't a traditional tax role. You don't need to be a VAT or customs expert. We're looking for a strong data engineer who is curious about complex business processes and wants to use technology to fundamentally change how they work. What You'll Do You'll help us build a trusted data foundation connecting the complete transaction lifecycle: Order

  • Payment Fulfilment Shipment Customs Tax Return Accounting Compliance
  • Design and build scalable data pipelines across complex transactional systems
  • Develop reusable data models supporting tax, customs, finance and supply-chain outcomes
  • Automate reconciliations currently dependent on manual data manipulation
  • Build controls that analyse complete transaction populations and identify exceptions
  • Connect ERP, e-commerce, logistics, customs and tax datasets
  • Develop analytics and dashboards that identify risk and financial opportunities
  • Improve data quality, lineage and auditability
  • Explore opportunities to use automation, machine learning and AI to solve tax and customs challenges.
  • You'll have the opportunity to work on problems such as: Can every customs declaration be matched back to the correct shipment and transaction? Are all transactions reaching the correct VAT reporting process? Can we automatically identify import VAT that hasn't been recovered? Can we detect unusual tax outcomes before they become compliance issues? Can we use data to identify customs duty savings or recovery opportunities?
  • Build a trusted Indirect Tax & Customs data foundation
  • Automate key reconciliations
  • Introduce continuous, exception-based controls
  • Reduce manual spreadsheet-driven processes
  • Identify tax and customs leakage opportunities
  • Improve visibility of tax risk
  • Develop new automation and AI use cases.

If you enjoy solving complex data problems and want to see your engineering work translate directly into measurable business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

Je gaat werken aan een migratie-project in een datawarehouse (SQL server) en Power BI on premise rapportage omgeving. Het datawarehouse (SQL Server) van de Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie (RSO) wordt begin 2027 naar de Directie Samenwerkingsverbanden en Uitvoering (DSU) gemigreerd. Om deze migratie soepel te laten verlopen zijn we op zoek naar een Data Engineer.


Naast de migratie van het datawarehouse staat er, voorafgaand aan deze migratie de ontsluiting van een nieuwe bron in de planning. Dit betreft het vervangen van een bestaande bron naar een nieuwe bron gebaseerd op een low code platform (Mendix). Als data engineer zorg je dat alle gegevens uit de oude bron op de juiste plek in de nieuwe bron terechtkomen en dat in de rapportagebehoefte kan blijven worden voorzien. Uiteraard zorg je ervoor dat de kwaliteit van de data in orde is en leg je de herkomst, de lineage en de beschrijvingen van de data (metadata) goed vast.


De opdracht bestaat uit 2 onderdelen:


Zo goed mogelijk klaarzetten van het huidige datawarehouse en de daarbij behorende laadprocessen. Dit omvat:


Ontsluiten nieuwe bron (CSV bestanden).


Afronden laatste wensen omtrent laadprocessen t.a.v. rapportages die reeds beschikbaar zijn. Hierin zal je samenwerken met de business analist en medewerker reporting van RSO.


Migratie van DWH van de RSO naar DSU in samenwerking met DSU.


De werkzaamheden vinden plaats in een team. De data engineer is voornamelijk verantwoordelijk voor het back-end gedeelte van het datawarehouse.

title: Project Analyst, NPSA-8, DS - Kyiv, National Position
description:
Background

In April 2024, UNDP launched a 5-years Green Energy Recovery Programme in Ukraine, which is an integrated initiative designed to diversify the country's energy mix and address the impact of the war on its outdated energy systems. Developed through extensive consultations with the Government of Ukraine, local and regional authorities, the Programme aims to respond urgently to targeted attacks on the energy sector and support its green energy recovery.

The Programme supports the National Energy Strategy of Ukraine, contributing to energy security and independence, promoting a green recovery and transition of the energy sector, and facilitating further synchronization with the EU energy markets. This effort builds on UNDP’s engagement in energy system reconstruction and recovery, leveraging partnerships and lessons learned from the “Winterization Support to Ukraine” project.

Aligned with the UN Ukraine Transitional Framework 2023 and UN Winterization plans, UNDP is providing immediate support to national and local governments to repair energy infrastructure, ensuring critical services to war-affected populations. The Programme focuses on distributing generation sources, decentralizing the power system, and increasing the share of renewable energy sources to reduce reliance on coal generation and reduce CO2 emissions.

The Programme will enhance access to energy from decentralized renewable sources, foster economic empowerment, and improve public governance in the energy sector. These outputs will contribute to Ukraine’s nationally determined contributions (NDCs) towards the Paris Agreement, aimed at reducing global greenhouse gas emissions.

Sustainable energy solutions will be introduced through pilot projects, aligned with the UNDP nexus approach to risk reduction and resilience enhancement in war-affected communities. By boosting energy supply and decentralizing the energy system, the Programme aims to reduce reliance on humanitarian aid for essential services in these areas.

In this context, UNDP is recruiting the Project Analyst, who will be responsible for the overall support of implementation of the Green Energy Recovery Programme in Ukraine and other related outputs related in the portfolio, performing a variety of standard operational services within the project’s frameworks ensuring high quality and accuracy of work.

The incumbent will promote UNDP’s mandate as a gender-responsive organization with zero tolerance to any kind of discriminatory and abusive behaviour, including sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse.

  • Facilitate dissemination of project deliverables to the stakeholders for improving performance and contributing to wider learning;

  • Support preparation of briefing materials, background notes and other information materials for meetings with donors, Government counterparts and other project stakeholders.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Under the direct supervision of the Project Analyst, and the overall guidance of the Programme Manager, the Project Analyst provides ongoing project and administrative assistance support to the project, performing a variety of standard administrative processes ensuring high quality and accuracy of work.

Du bidrager til, at vores boligafdelinger fremstår velholdte, trygge og attraktive, samtidig med at du sikrer et højt serviceniveau overfor beboere, medarbejdere og samarbejdspartnere.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt team med andre driftslederassistenter og serviceledere, hvor samarbejde, videndeling og sparring er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Stillingen giver både ansvar, indflydelse og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Koordinering, prioritering og opfølgning på drifts- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver
  • Tilsyn med håndværkere, leverandører og øvrige samarbejdspartnere
  • Behandling af rekvisitioner, tilbud og administrative opgaver, herunder opfølgning på budgetter og driftsjournaler
  • Koordinering og opfølgning på forsikrings- og skadesager
  • Opfølgning på vedligeholdelsesplaner, tekniske anlæg og lovpligtige eftersyn
  • Dialog og samarbejde med afdelingsbestyrelser og øvrige interessenter
  • Bidrag til udvikling og optimering af arbejdsprocesser
  • Sikring af høj kvalitet og god service over for beboere og samarbejdspartnere
  • Ledelse og koordinering af medarbejdere ved servicelederens fravær

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring med drift, vedligeholdelse eller ejendomsadministration
  • Gerne har en ejendomsfaglig eller teknisk baggrund
  • Arbejder struktureret og har gode planlægnings- og koordineringsevner
  • Er fortrolig med IT-systemer og administrative arbejdsgange
  • Trives i samarbejdet med mange forskellige mennesker
  • Kan skabe overblik og sikre opfølgning på opgaver
  • Er serviceminded, løsningsorienteret og ansvarsbevidst
  • Har kørekort

Vi tilbyder

  • En nøglefunktion med stor kontaktflade og selvstændigt ansvar
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med gode sparringsmuligheder
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads præget af samarbejde, ordentlighed og høj faglighed
  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af fremtidens boligdrift

Bliv en del af holdet

Vi søger en engageret kollega, der motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem struktur, samarbejde og god service. Hos os får du mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i hverdagen og sætte dit præg på driften af nogle af områdets største boligafdelinger.

Vi stiller høje krav til vores medarbejdere, men investerer samtidig i deres udvikling, trivsel og faglige kompetencer. Du bliver en del af en organisation, hvor ansvar, samarbejde og kvalitet går hånd i hånd.

title: Re-Advertisement : NATIONAL POST: Programme Analyst, Youth, Kabul, Afghanistan, NO-B
description:
Please note that this vacancy is open only to nationals of Afghanistan.

Qualified female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. UNFPA is committed to achieving gender balance and fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce.

The Position:

The Programme Analyst, Youth is based in the UNFPA Afghanistan Country Office in Kabul and operates in a highly complex, fragile and sensitive environment.

The position leads the design, coordination and oversight of UNFPA’s youth portfolio, including the strategic and operational management of UNFPA-supported Youth Centres. The role ensures that youth programming is cross-cutting and integrated across Reproductive Health (RH), Gender-Based Violence (GBV), social cohesion, life skills and humanitarian response interventions.

The incumbent plays a critical role in safeguarding and advancing adolescents’ and young people’s health, protection and wellbeing—particularly for adolescent girls—through context-adapted, principled and culturally sensitive programming approaches.

The position reports directly to the Deputy Representative.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact and sustained results and ensure effective external relations, communications, and partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results.

Job Purpose:

The Programme Analyst, Youth provides technical leadership and programme management support for UNFPA’s youth portfolio, ensuring effective implementation, quality assurance and integration of youth-focused interventions across health, protection and resilience programming, including oversight of UNFPA-supported Youth Centres in a complex and evolving operating environment.

You would be responsible for:

Programme Development and Technical Support

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of youth programming within the Country Office portfolio, ensuring integration across Reproductive Health (RH), Gender-Based Violence (GBV), social norms and resilience initiatives.
  • Provide technical support on adolescent and youth engagement approaches, including life skills, youth participation and community-based interventions.
  • Support the development of guidance, tools and programme approaches to strengthen youth-focused programming across UNFPA interventions.
  • Assist in identifying innovative and sustainable solutions to integrated youth programme designs and implementation.

Oversight of Youth Centres

  • Ensures the effective functioning and quality assurance of UNFPA-supported Youth Centres as platforms for youth engagement, life skills and wellbeing services.
  • Monitor implementing partners to ensure delivery of planned activities and compliance with programme, financial and safeguarding standards.
  • Contribute to strengthening the capacity of implementing partners involved in youth centre programming

Programme Management and Monitoring

  • Support the preparation and management of annual workplans, budgets and implementing partner agreements related to youth programming.
  • Monitor progress of programme activities, identify implementation challenges and identify solutions and mitigation measures.
  • Conduct field visits and assessments to monitor programme implementation and inform programme improvements.
  • Contribute to programme reporting, documentation of lessons learned and knowledge sharing

Partnerships and Coordination

  • Maintain collaborative relationships with local authorities, community stakeholders, youth networks and civil society partners to support programme implementation.
  • Coordinate with relevant UNFPA programme units to ensure integration of youth interventions across programme areas.
  • Oversee the Adolescents and Youth coordination bodies including providing technical guidance for the Adolescents and Youth Working Group chaired by UNFPA
  • Participate and contribute in relevant coordination mechanisms and results group, and assist CO senior leadership through sharing of analysis, advocacy briefs and technical inputs as required

Resource Mobilisation and Reporting

  • Contribute to the preparation of programme documentation, donor reports and briefing materials related to youth interventions.
  • Support resource mobilization efforts through inputs to proposals and programme development processes.

Perform any other duties as may be assigned by the supervisor or designated authority.

Qualifications and Experience:

Education:

  • Advanced university degree in gender studies, youth development, international development, and/or other related social science fields is required; or
  • A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • At least two years (with master’s degree) or four years (with bachelor’s degree) of increasingly responsible professional experience in the field of development or humanitarian programming are required.
  • Work experience in the field of Reproductive Health is preferred.
  • Specialized knowledge and experience in Youth Development approaches will be desired.
  • Experience in programme/ project management including experience in large multi-sector programmes is desirable.
  • Prior experience in the UN system is an asset.
  • A thorough understanding of the UN system in general, and especially UNFPA mandate, its policies and operations and current development topics and political issues in Afghanistan will be an added advantage.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a team is required.

Languages:

Fluency in English and local language Dari and/or Pashto is required. Working knowledge of other UN languages would be an asset.

Required Competencies:

Values:

  • Exemplifying integrity
  • Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system
  • Embracing cultural diversity
  • Embracing change

Core Competencies:

  • Achieving results
  • Being accountable
  • Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen
  • Thinking analytically and strategically
  • Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships
  • Communicating for impact

Functional Competencies:

  • Advocacy/advancing a policy-oriented agenda
  • Leveraging the resources of national governments and partners/building strategic alliances and partnerships
  • Delivering results based programmes
  • Internal and external communication and advocacy for resource mobilization

Compensation and Benefits:

This position offers an attractive remuneration package including a competitive net salary plus health insurance and other benefits as applicable.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

Disclaimer:

Selection and appointment may be subject to background and reference checks, medical clearance, visa issuance and other administrative requirements.

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

Applicants for positions in the international Professional and higher categories, who hold permanent resident status in a country other than their country of nationality, may be required to renounce such status upon their appointment.

title: AIOps Engineer, NCT
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: AIOps Engineer, NCT

Location: Pune, India

Corporate Title: NCT

Role Description

  • Deutsche Bank’s Strategy & Innovation Engineering team is part of the TDI Chief Strategy & Innovation Office. The team partners with business and CIO teams to evaluate emerging technologies, build and operate reusable AI capabilities, and enable safe, responsible AI adoption across the bank.
  • As an AIOps Engineer within the India engineering and operations team, you will develop automation and improve the reliability, observability and operational readiness of enterprise AI platforms, shared AI services and agent-based solutions. This hands-on Associate role combines cloud engineering, DevOps/MLOps and production support with AI-assisted incident analysis and controlled remediation. You will collaborate with application, platform, architecture, security and governance teams to turn operational challenges into reusable engineering solutions.

What we’ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • Build and maintain reusable AIOps capabilities for telemetry collection, alert correlation, incident context enrichment, root-cause analysis and operational automation.
  • Engineer and support cloud-native AI services on Google Cloud Platform, using GKE, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, storage, messaging and approved enterprise integrations within agreed ownership boundaries.
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines and reusable infrastructure-as-code modules using GitHub Actions, Terraform and container tooling, with testing, security checks and controlled releases.
  • Implement logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, health checks and service-level indicators to improve service visibility and reduce alert noise.
  • Develop AI-assisted diagnostic and runbook workflows, integrating operational knowledge and incident history; evaluate output accuracy and retain human review for consequential decisions.
  • Implement policy-bound remediation through approved pipelines, with least-privilege identities, approval gates, rollback, failure safeguards and traceable action records.
  • Contribute to production incident investigation and engineering fixes; enable L1/L2 support through runbooks, diagnostic guidance, knowledge transfer and clear escalation paths.
  • Improve production readiness through capacity and performance analysis, recovery testing, monitoring, support handovers and release/change documentation.
  • Embed applicable security, data protection and AI controls into engineering workflows; support vulnerability remediation and maintain evidence with designated control owners.
  • Automate onboarding, service-management integration and routine operational tasks; measure improvements in detection and resolution time, manual effort, service reliability and cost.
  • Document reusable patterns and contribute to proofs of concept, technical reviews and continuous improvement with global engineering and support teams.

Your skills and experience

  • Hands-on experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, MLOps or production engineering, with practical ownership of automation and troubleshooting tasks.
  • Practical Google Cloud Platform knowledge, including GKE/Kubernetes, Cloud Run, IAM, VPC networking, Cloud Storage, Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring.
  • Experience with Terraform, Git, GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD tooling, Docker and secure software delivery practices.
  • Strong Python programming skills, with working knowledge of shell scripting, SQL, REST APIs and Linux troubleshooting.
  • Experience implementing observability, analysing logs and metrics, investigating incidents and creating operational dashboards and runbooks.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI applications, including model APIs, prompt and inference patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, agent workflows and evaluation.
  • Understanding of least privilege, workload identity, secrets management, network security, vulnerability management and auditable change practices.
  • Understanding of responsible AI, data protection, traceability and human oversight, with the ability to translate control requirements into practical engineering actions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, clear written and verbal communication, and effective collaboration across distributed technical and control teams.

Preferred experience and qualifications: Experience with Vertex AI, OpenTelemetry, ServiceNow integrations, agent frameworks, model/agent evaluation or controlled remediation is an advantage. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering or an equivalent discipline is desirable. Relevant Google Cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps/SRE or AI/ML certifications and experience in banking or another regulated industry are advantageous.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

About us and our teams

Please visit our company website for further information:

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Site Reliability Engineer I
description:
About NCR VOYIX

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.

The Global Command Center (GCC) Site Reliability Engineer (I) is responsible for monitoring and supporting business-critical applications and infrastructure across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. The role provides first-level event and incident response while supporting day-to-day reliability operations, including infrastructure maintenance, certificate management, deployments, observability, and production support.


The engineer works closely with application, infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, network, and SRE teams to maintain service availability, minimize business impact, and continuously improve operational reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and customer-facing services for availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Analyze, acknowledge, prioritize, and triage alerts and events, performing initial troubleshooting and escalation as required.
  • Provide L1 production support and participate in incident and major incident response.
  • Support monitoring and observability using tools such as AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, and ServiceNow Event Management.
  • Perform routine infrastructure maintenance and server patching across Azure, GCP, AWS, VMware, Windows, and Linux environments.
  • Manage SSL/TLS certificates, including monitoring, renewal, installation, validation, and expiration prevention.
  • Execute and validate application deployments following established change and release processes.
  • Support Operational Readiness Reviews by validating monitoring, alerting, runbooks, escalation paths, and support procedures.
  • Identify recurring incidents, monitoring gaps, and operational risks and contribute to service improvements.
  • Support automation of repetitive operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or APIs.
  • Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, incident records, and operational documentation.
  • Follow established incident, problem, change, and event management processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience in Event Management, Production Support, SRE, NOC/Command Center, DevOps, or Infrastructure Operations.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, GCP, and/or AWS.
  • Understanding of monitoring, incident management, server administration, networking, SSL/TLS certificates, and deployment processes.
  • Familiarity with Windows and/or Linux environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 shift-based support environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise monitoring/observability and ITSM tools.
  • Basic scripting knowledge in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
  • Exposure to CI/CD and automation.
  • Understanding of SRE concepts including SLI/SLO/SLA, MTTD, MTTR, availability, and resiliency.
  • Azure, GCP, or AWS certification is a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Event and incident management
  • Technical troubleshooting
  • Operational discipline and attention to detail
  • Customer focus and ownership
  • Communication and collaboration
  • Prioritization and decision-making under pressure
  • Continuous improvement mindset

Success Measures


Success will be measured through effective event detection and response, service availability, reduction in MTTD/MTTR and recurring incidents, monitoring effectiveness, successful certificate renewals and deployments, infrastructure maintenance compliance, automation adoption, and reduced customer impact.

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Averna powered by Spherea is a global engineering and technology business specialising in test, quality and validation solutions for complex and safety-critical products and systems.

With a heritage spanning more than 70 years, we support leading aerospace, defence and technology organisations throughout the complete product lifecycle – from engineering and development test through production and manufacturing test to in-service support, MRO and obsolescence management.

Our capabilities range from individual automated test systems and specialist test equipment through to complex integrated test facilities, supported by engineering services, software and instrumentation expertise.

The combination of Averna and Spherea brings together approximately 1,800 people worldwide with engineering, manufacturing and support capabilities across Europe, North America and Asia. In the UK we have a particularly strong heritage in aerospace and defence test and support and work closely with major OEMs, defence primes and equipment manufacturers.

This is an engineering software role, not general business application development. You will develop software for test, measurement, simulation and control systems, interacting with instrumentation, data acquisition hardware, communications interfaces and units under test. The software supports test sequences, data processing, operator guidance, diagnostics and traceable evidence. You will work across the lifecycle with systems, hardware, electrical, mechanical and project engineers, from requirements through implementation, integration, verification, acceptance, commissioning and support. Regular work alongside physical equipment is required, with occasional UK and international travel.

Key responsibilities

  • Analyse system and software requirements and contribute to architecture, detailed design and technology selection. Develop software for automated and manual test, measurement, simulation and control applications.
  • Produce maintainable, documented code and develop test sequences, operator interfaces, instrument drivers, data-processing functions, diagnostic tools and reports.
  • Integrate software with instrumentation, data-acquisition hardware, switching systems, communications interfaces and units under test. Implement suitable error handling, logging, user access controls and recovery mechanisms.
  • Reuse proven frameworks and components where appropriate, and modify, extend or migrate software for existing and legacy test systems.
  • Participate in the complete lifecycle, including requirements, feasibility, architecture, detailed design, implementation, unit testing, software and hardware integration, verification, validation, factory acceptance, site acceptance, commissioning and in-service support.
  • Contribute to technical reviews and produce plans, specifications, design descriptions and test evidence. Maintain traceability between requirements, design, implementation and verification.
  • Estimate software effort and provide realistic input to project plans and proposals. Identify risks, assumptions, dependencies and constraints, and assess readiness for integration, formal testing and customer acceptance.
  • Apply source control, configuration, release and change-management practices. Ensure releases are identifiable, reproducible and supported by required documentation; contribute to safety, cybersecurity and compliance activities where needed.
  • Define and perform unit, integration and system testing. Debug in laboratory and production environments and investigate issues across software, hardware, communications and instrumentation.
  • Support demonstrations, factory acceptance, installation, site acceptance and commissioning. Resolve defects, issue controlled updates and support equipment during warranty and operational life.
  • Work with customers and multidisciplinary colleagues to clarify requirements, communicate progress and risks, participate in workshops and reviews, share technical knowledge and improve reusable components and engineering methods.
  • Contribute to feasibility studies, solution development, software estimates, technical proposals, bid reviews and customer clarification meetings.

Qualifications

Essential skills and experience

  • Degree, HNC/HND in software engineering, computer science, electronic engineering, systems engineering or a related discipline.
  • Experience developing software for engineering, industrial, scientific or equipment-based applications.
  • Practical experience with at least one relevant language or environment, such as C/C++, C#, LabVIEW, TestStand or Python.
  • Sound understanding of software architecture and structured design; experience debugging and testing software in a practical engineering environment.
  • Familiarity with source control and configuration management, technical documentation and software test evidence.
  • Understanding of the development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, integration, verification and controlled release.
  • Logical and analytical problem-solving, initiative in resolving issues, and the ability to understand complex technical information.
  • Effective teamwork, written and verbal communication, and confidence engaging with customers and non-software disciplines.
  • Ability to manage assigned work, report progress realistically, meet commitments and adapt to different technologies and projects.
  • Willingness to work alongside engineers and physical equipment and travel occasionally in the UK and internationally. Right to work in the UK.

Desirable technical experience

  • Aerospace, defence, space, rail, energy or another regulated sector; automated or special-to-type test equipment.
  • LabVIEW/TestStand; modern C++ including maintenance of C++14 codebases; hardware-in-the-loop, simulation or real-time test systems.
  • Data acquisition, signal conditioning, switching, instrumentation control or commercial test instruments.
  • Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, serial, RS-232, RS-422, RS-485, CAN, ARINC 429, AFDX or MIL-STD-1553.
  • Multithreaded, event-driven or real-time software; operator/HMI development, automated test sequencing and results reporting.
  • Relational databases, requirements traceability, unit and automated testing, continuous integration, design patterns, object-oriented development or Windows engineering applications.
  • Industrial/test-system cybersecurity, software safety, coding standards, regulated development, build/release management or legacy software migration.
  • Factory/site acceptance and commissioning, or experience in geographically distributed teams. Relevant Armed Forces technical experience in electronics, avionics, communications, weapons systems, test equipment, maintenance, diagnostics or training is welcomed, alongside demonstrable software-development ability.

Additional Information

We offer:

  • A collaborative and supportive team with true international reach
  • An attractive salary package with benefits such as generous pension scheme (4% employee / 8% employer, full family health care plan, family health cash plan, 27 days holiday + bank holidays, Life assurance & income protection insurance
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth
  • Be part of a company that puts ESG at the heart of its mission, for people, planet, and performance.

Security requirements

Due to the nature of our aerospace and defence work, applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain the level of UK national security clearance required for the role.

Some projects may also be subject to additional nationality, residency or export-control restrictions. Any such restrictions will be considered as part of the recruitment process and will depend upon the programmes to which the successful candidate is assigned.

title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Business Transformation
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Team Summary:

Visa’s Vision is to be the best way to pay and be paid for everyone, everywhere. We partner with over 16,000 financial institutions globally to build superior payments products and experiences that enable customers – consumers, businesses, large corporations and governments – to pay or be paid.

A unique opportunity exists to join Visa's Indonesia market team. Indonesia is one of the fastest-growing commerce and digital payments ecosystems and one of Visa's most strategically important markets in Asia Pacific. Strong economic growth, rapid digital adoption, evolving consumer behaviors, and the accelerating shift toward digital commerce make Indonesia one of the most dynamic and exciting markets in the world.

What a Senior Manager, Strategy & Business Transformation, Indonesia does at Visa:

The Senior Manager, Strategy & Business Transformation, Indonesia plays a pivotal role in shaping and delivering Visa's growth agenda in one of Asia Pacific's most dynamic payments markets. This role combines strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and cross-functional leadership to advance Visa's long-term ambitions while delivering near-term business outcomes.

The successful candidate will build a deep understanding of Indonesia's evolving payments landscape, the needs of clients and ecosystem stakeholders, industry trends, and Visa's strategic priorities. Working closely with country, regional, and functional leaders, they will help define market strategies and translate them into focused, actionable programs that drive sustainable growth, strengthen capabilities, and enhance business performance.

The role will lead high-impact initiatives spanning multi-year strategy, market and business expansion, innovation, capability development, and new growth opportunities. It will bring together stakeholders across functions, align resources behind shared objectives, and move priorities from insight and concept through to implementation and measurable outcomes.

The role also serves as an important bridge between Visa and Indonesia's broader payments ecosystem. The successful candidate will collaborate with financial institutions, industry associations, ecosystem partners, and other relevant stakeholders, including leading day-to-day commercial and partnership discussions and negotiations, to support industry development and identify opportunities for shared progress. Through these engagements, the role will help reinforce Visa's position as a trusted, constructive, and collaborative partner committed to advancing Indonesia's digital commerce and payments ecosystem.

This is a strategy role with real execution accountability and visible market impact. The successful candidate will identify opportunities, develop compelling business cases, mobilize cross-functional teams, establish fit-for-purpose governance, and drive initiatives from concept through execution. The role offers broad exposure to senior leaders and the opportunity to build skills across strategy, commercial decision-making, industry collaboration, and enterprise-wide transformation.

The successful candidate will report to the Senior Director, Head of Strategy & Business Transformation, Indonesia, and work closely with the Indonesia Country Leadership Team, regional partners, and cross-functional teams across Visa.

Key Responsibilities (non-exhaustive):

  • Shape Indonesia's multi-year strategy alongside the Head of Strategy & Business Transformation by translating market, client, industry, regulatory, competitive, and performance insights into clear choices and actionable priorities.
  • Support the annual strategic planning and prioritization process, connecting country ambitions, account plans, functional priorities, resource allocation, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery of priority strategic initiatives, from opportunity definition and business-case development through funding, governance, cross-functional mobilization, implementation, and performance tracking.
  • Own the day-to-day coordination of the Innovation & Market Development program in Indonesia, working with internal teams and relevant external stakeholders to develop and implement initiatives that support the broader payments ecosystem.
  • Identify and size new growth opportunities and market whitespace, including but not limited to underserved segments, innovative credit models, and domestic, cross-border, and B2B opportunities; recommend priorities and translate selected opportunities into fundable business cases.
  • Maintain an integrated view of the country strategy and strategic portfolio, ensuring initiatives reinforce one another, address the most important opportunities, and avoid unnecessary duplication.
  • Build trusted working relationships across Visa and with financial institutions, industry associations, ecosystem partners, and external delivery counterparts, independently leading day-to-day commercial and partnership negotiations, serving as a credible day-to-day point of contact.
  • Establish practical governance, milestones, decision forums, and progress tracking for strategic initiatives, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, and decisions required to maintain momentum.
  • Develop scorecards and performance insights that connect strategy to execution, enabling leadership teams to assess progress, sharpen priorities, and make informed decisions.
  • Prepare clear, high-quality materials for senior leadership and relevant external stakeholders, translating complex analysis into compelling narratives, recommendations, and decisions.
  • Coordinate closely with Asia Pacific and other market Strategy and/or Business Planning and Operation teams, sharing market insights and supporting regional strategic forums and leadership engagements.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

  • At least 8 years of relevant experience, including 3 or more years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, business development, market development, or a related role. Experience in payments, financial services, fintech, technology, or another partnership-driven industry is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure and lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives from concept through execution, including independently negotiation and closing commercial or partnership agreements with external stakeholders, with sound judgment on when to work independently and when to bring others together.
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, including market analysis, opportunity sizing, business-case development, and financial or commercial modeling.
  • A track record of turning analysis into practical recommendations and driving those recommendations toward decisions, implementation, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt quickly as circumstances evolve, and maintain momentum in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Strong communication and executive presence, with the ability to develop clear presentations, simplify complex topics, and engage credibly with senior leaders and external industry stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence without formal authority, build trust across functions and organizations, and create alignment among stakeholders with different perspectives.
  • High standards of integrity, curiosity, ownership, and attention to detail, paired with a practical and collaborative working style.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; experience with AI-enabled productivity, research, or analytical tools is preferred.
  • Strong written and spoken English and Indonesian communication skills.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Applied AI ML Lead RISK MODELING
description:
JPMorganChase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with operations worldwide and a leader in investment banking, financial services for consumers and small business, commercial banking, financial transaction processing, and asset management. A component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, JPMorganChase & Co. serves millions of consumers in the United States and many of the world’s most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under its Company and Chase brands. Information about JPMorganChase & Co. is available at Company website. Chase Consumer & Community Banking serves consumers and small businesses with a broad range of financial services, and its Risk Management organization partners with each sub-line of business to identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate risk. We are currently seeking an Applied AI/Machine Learning Lead for the Risk Modeling team.

As an Applied AI/Machine Learning Lead – Vice President within Chase Consumer & Community Banking Risk Modeling, you will lead the design, development, deployment, and monitoring of AI, machine learning, and statistical models, segmentations, and strategies leveraging big data and distributed computing platforms. Your work will support risk management for the credit card and small business portfolios, helping drive long-term profitable growth through strong business acumen, disciplined execution, and clear communication to senior stakeholders. You will partner closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams across the full modeling lifecycle—from problem framing and conceptualization through production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. You will serve as a hands-on individual contributor while also mentoring junior team members as needed, helping shape technical direction and establishing modern AI-enabled ways of working, including responsible use of generative AI in core workflows.

Job responsibilities

  • Design and develop sophisticated AI, machine learning, and statistical models to drive impactful business decisions in consumer and small business credit risk (for example, segmentation, underwriting and decisioning support, and portfolio strategies).
  • Apply novel approaches and advanced machine learning techniques to solve high-value problems, balancing predictive performance, stability, interpretability (where needed), and operational constraints.
  • Leverage big data, distributed computing, and cloud platforms to optimize and accelerate model development processes, enabling scalable feature engineering, training, scoring, and monitoring.
  • Partner with senior management to define modeling roadmaps, align solutions to business needs, communicate trade-offs, and drive execution through production delivery.
  • Collaborate across the full model lifecycle with key stakeholders in marketing, risk, technology, model governance/model risk management, fair lending, compliance, and other control partners through conceptualization and problem framing; development and testing; review/validation support and documentation; deployment and model usage; and ongoing model monitoring and maintenance.
  • Embed AI and generative AI into core workflows (responsibly) to improve speed and quality of delivery, including accelerating prototyping and experimentation; improving developer productivity (code generation/refactoring with strong review and testing discipline); producing high-quality model documentation and artifacts (assumptions, limitations, monitoring plans); and synthesizing results into decision-ready narratives for leadership.
  • Promote strong governance and controls by ensuring models are well-documented, reproducible, monitored, and maintained with disciplined change management and clear performance reporting.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Advanced degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Econometrics, Physics, or other related quantitative fields (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in developing and managing predictive risk models in financial institutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI, including Generative AI, to improve core modeling workflows while maintaining rigorous model risk and control standards.
  • Strong programming proficiency (Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, PySpark, SQL) and ability to write production-quality, maintainable code (version control, testing, reproducibility, and documentation).
  • Familiarity with cloud services and distributed computing (for example, AWS SageMaker, Amazon EMR, Spark) to scale model development and operationalization.
  • Fundamental understanding of consumer lending business and how models support credit risk decisioning and portfolio strategies.
  • Deep understanding of advanced machine learning algorithms (for example, random forest, XGBoost, neural networks) and tuning/validation procedures, including performance evaluation and robustness/stability considerations.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to convey complex modeling concepts and results clearly to senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience designing, building, and deploying production-quality AI and machine learning models end-to-end, including model monitoring/drift and sustainable maintenance practices.
  • Expertise in data wrangling and model building on distributed Spark environments with a focus on stability, scalability, and efficiency; GPU experience is a plus.
  • Experience supporting governance expectations in regulated environments (model documentation quality, explainability/interpretability as appropriate, monitoring, and change control); experience partnering with Fair Lending stakeholders is a plus.
  • Strong ownership and execution skills with a track record of delivering models into production and driving adoption.
  • Ability to collaborate across multiple stakeholders on initiatives of strategic importance; comfort leading through influence.
  • Exposure to generative AI and large language model patterns (for example, evaluation approaches, retrieval-augmented workflows, safety/quality guardrails) applied pragmatically to analytics/modeling productivity and/or risk use cases.
