title: Business Insights Analyst- Branch Network Distribution
description:
Position Overview

Citizens Bank is executing a multi-year transformation of its retail branch network, shifting toward a performance-driven, growth-oriented distribution model and investing in branch reformats, refreshes, closures, de novos, staffing models, and operating-hour changes.

The Business Analyst, Branch Network Distribution will support the reporting, analytics, experimentation, and impact measurement used to understand network performance and evaluate whether branch actions are delivering their intended outcomes. The analyst will work with more experienced team members to prepare data, build recurring reporting, conduct structured analyses, and translate findings into clear business insights.

This is a hands-on developmental role for an early-career analyst who is eager to build technical, analytical, and business skills while supporting visible priorities across Distribution Transformation, Retail Banking, Marketing, Finance, and the Consumer Bank.

Key Responsibilities

Network Performance Reporting & Insights

  • Support the development and maintenance of reporting and dashboards that measure branch network performance using leading and lagging indicators.

  • Prepare performance views across banker, branch, market, and enterprise levels to support day-to-day management and longer-term decisions.

  • Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities and summarize findings for review by senior team members and business partners.

Branch Action Analytics & Impact Measurement

  • Support analyses that measure the results of branch network actions, including reformats, refreshes, closures, de novos, staffing changes, and changes to operating hours.

  • Assess outcomes across customer behavior, productivity, financial performance, and growth using established analytical approaches.

  • Help account for factors such as market conditions, seasonality, and overlapping initiatives, with guidance from experienced analysts.

Experimentation & Test-and-Learn Support

  • Assist in developing pilots and tests with clear objectives, success measures, comparison groups, and evaluation plans.

  • Prepare analyses that help determine whether an initiative should be expanded, refined, or discontinued.

  • Document methods, assumptions, and results so conclusions are transparent and repeatable.

Physical Network Marketing Value Analysis

  • Support analysis of the branch network as a customer acquisition, relationship-deepening, and brand asset.

  • Help assess how branch presence, format, and investment relate to customer behavior across channels and over time.

  • Partner with Marketing, Finance, and Distribution colleagues to incorporate relevant data into growth and investment analyses.

Data Preparation & Analytical Execution

  • Build working knowledge of branch, banker productivity, customer, marketing, and financial data.

  • Use SQL and tools such as Alteryx, or equivalent tools, to source, cleanse, join, and prepare analytical datasets.

  • Complete quality checks and help maintain consistent metrics, definitions, assumptions, and documentation across analyses and reporting.

Business Intelligence & Tool Support

  • Build and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using established data models and team standards.

  • Help improve the automation, performance, usability, and documentation of reporting assets.

  • Learn and apply business intelligence, visualization, and emerging analytical tools to improve productivity while following applicable governance requirements.

Business Partnering & Communication

  • Work with team members and business partners to clarify questions, gather requirements, and translate business needs into structured analysis.

  • Prepare clear presentations, summaries, and supporting materials that explain findings, implications, and limitations.

  • Respond thoughtfully to feedback and refine analyses and reporting based on stakeholder needs.

Project Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Manage assigned work, meet agreed timelines, and provide clear updates on progress, questions, and risks.

  • Contribute to team projects by completing defined analytical workstreams with guidance and review.

  • Identify practical opportunities to improve data quality, repeatability, speed, and clarity.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.

  • 0-3 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, finance, strategy, or a related role; relevant internships, academic projects, or co-op experience may be considered.

  • Foundational SQL skills and experience working with structured data; exposure to Alteryx or a similar data preparation tool is helpful.

  • Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform through work, internships, or academic projects.

  • Working knowledge of analytical methods, including trend analysis, performance measurement, and basic test or comparison design.

  • Ability to organize data, check work carefully, and communicate findings in a clear and concise manner.

  • Interest in financial services, retail banking, customer analytics, or physical distribution is helpful but not required.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Analytically curious - asks thoughtful questions, looks for patterns, and is eager to understand what the data means

  • Detail-oriented - produces accurate work and checks data, assumptions, and outputs carefully.

  • Clear communicator - explains analysis in straightforward language and adapts based on feedback.

  • Collaborative - works effectively with teammates and business partners and contributes positively to team outcomes.

  • Organized and accountable - manages assigned work, follows through on commitments, and raises questions early.

  • Growth-oriented - seeks feedback, develops new technical and business skills, and applies lessons to future work.

Hours & Work Schedule

  • Hours per Week: 40
  • Work Schedule: Monday - Friday
  • Hybrid: 4 days per week on-site

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $80,000 - $106,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. title: Staff Engineer- MLOps
description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

As a valued member of Stryker’s AI innovation unit, you will work alongside trailblazers, industry visionaries, innovators, and inventors who are committed to bringing computer vision, AI/ML and digital innovation to the operating room and other healthcare settings. You’ll contribute to fast-paced cycles of innovation and develop core technologies that power a wide array of Stryker’s solutions, including: surgical robotics and navigation, image-guided surgery, treatment selection, outcome assessment, and clinical decision intelligence. You will apply your core skills across a range of deployment platforms spanning from mobile applications, cloud services, and SDKs to embedded systems, edge devices, and mixed reality (XR) platforms. You will have an opportunity to work across a wide variety of therapeutic areas ranging from orthopedics and neurosurgery to emergency care and operating room safety and efficiency – plus many more.


We are in search of a skilled and experienced Staff MLOps Engineer to join our team, with a focus on building systems and applications that interact with AI models in a cloud-native Azure environment, with Azure Machine Learning (Azure ML) at the core of our ML platform. In this position, you'll be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software applications that flawlessly integrate with state-of-the-art AI and machine learning technologies.


What You Will Do:

· Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable MLOps systems and pipelines that interact with AI models and systems.Build and operate end-to-end ML workflows on Azure Machine Learning, including training pipelines, experiment tracking, model registry, and managed online/batch endpoints.

· Cooperate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, AI researchers, and AI/ML engineers, to understand requirements, define project scope, and ensure alignment with business goals.Contribute technical expertise in evaluating, selecting, and implementing software technologies, tools, and frameworks in a cloud-native (Azure + Azure ML) environment.

· Troubleshoot and resolve intricate software problems, ensuring optimal performance and reliability when interfacing with AI/ML systems.

· Participate in software development project planning and estimation, ensuring efficient resource allocation and timely solution delivery.

· Contribute to the development of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.

· Contribute to the development of high-performance data pipelines, storage systems, and data processing solutions.

· Implement monitoring and observability for deployed models and platform services (performance, data/model drift, reliability), with dashboards and reporting in Power BI and Grafana.

· Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, including design specifications, API documentation, data models, data flow diagrams, and user manuals. Mentor junior engineers and promote MLOps and software engineering best practices across the team.


What You Will Need:

Minimum Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.7-10 years of relatable work experience, including a minimum of 4 years in machine learning operations or software/platform development.

· Strong knowledge of machine learning concepts, technologies, and integration techniques.

· Strong knowledge of programming languages commonly used in AI/ML, such as Python, R, or C++.

· Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning (workspaces, pipelines, compute, model registry, and endpoints) and the broader Azure cloud platform.

· Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras, and model/experiment tracking tools such as MLflow.

· Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and project management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.Experience with version control systems, such as Git, and CI/CD tools, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.

· Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates.Knowledge of data modeling techniques, and familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools.

· Experience building monitoring and visualization dashboards with Power BI and Grafana.

Travel Percentage: None
